jobs.description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

What is a Senior Staff Partnerships Lead at Mozilla?

Senior Staff is a senior individual contributor level at Mozilla. People at this level are recognized leaders in their field. They take on complex, ambiguous work that spans several disciplines and organizations with little supervision, lead strategic external relationships, and are comfortable working with executives inside and outside Mozilla.

About this team and role:

Mozilla’s New Products organization is an internal incubator for high-potential ventures. We’re building a new Firefox product for PC gamers, and partnerships across the games industry are central to how it reaches players and grows.

As the partnerships lead, you’ll be responsible for identifying, initiating, and closing the gaming partnerships that bring the product to more players. You will report to the Director of Product and build new gaming partnerships that advance the product roadmap.

What you’ll do:

  • Own the product’s partnerships strategy and pipeline across cloud gaming services, storefronts and launchers, publishers and studios, community platforms, and hardware makers.
  • Originate, structure and close deals that bring players, product capabilities and new revenue, such as distribution, co-marketing, in-game rewards and revenue-share agreements.
  • Plan and deliver partner launch moments with Firefox marketing that reach players where they already play.
  • Identify and propose new product features in support of partnerships, and evangelize new product features with partners.
  • Lead each deal across Mozilla: shape terms with Legal and Finance, scope partner integrations with product and engineering, and hold every partnership to Mozilla’s standards for privacy, trust and responsible design.
  • Represent Mozilla with senior leaders across the games industry, and bring what you learn from partners and the market back into product strategy.

What you’ll bring:

  • 10+ years in business development, product marketing, or strategic partnerships, including 5+ years in the games industry.
  • A track record of originating and closing multi-party commercial partnerships from first conversation to signed agreement, including revenue-share and co-marketing deals.
  • Established relationships with decision-makers across the PC gaming ecosystem, and the standing to get meetings with senior leaders at platform holders and publishers.
  • Strong commercial judgment: you can model deal economics, structure terms that work for both sides, and negotiate with senior counterparts.
  • Experience taking deals through legal, finance, product and marketing teams to launch, without an established playbook.
  • Clear, persuasive communication with executives inside and outside the company, and willingness to travel for partner meetings and industry events.
  • Commitment to our values:
    • Welcoming differences
    • Being relationship-minded
    • Practicing responsible participation
    • Having grit

Bonus points for: partnerships experience at a browser, operating system or consumer software company; distribution deals such as device pre-installs or app store placements; and a passion for PC gaming and its communities.

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Quarterly well-being stipend
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

Source is an ecosystem of independent technology companies behind responsible access to web data. Source works behind the scenes, providing shared standards and dedicated support that help each company grow.

The team waiting for you:

The security team is responsible for safeguarding our infrastructure and applications against an ever-evolving landscape of cyber threats. As a Cybersecurity Analyst, you will be on the front lines of our operations, actively managing our SIEM environments and leading incident response efforts. With our data ecosystem rapidly expanding, scaling our security monitoring and automated detection capabilities is more timely and critical than ever. Your work here directly ensures the integrity of our complex data operations, keeping our products secure and our global customers protected.

In this role, you will:

  • Monitor, triage, and investigate alerts from the SIEM (Wazuh/Elasticsearch) and other security tools, separating true positives from noise.
  • Run incident response steps: containment, evidence collection, root cause analysis, and remediation follow-up.
  • Build, tune, and maintain detection rules and decoders for various attack scenarios in Wazuh and Elasticsearch.
  • Onboard and normalize new log sources to expand our visibility.
  • Continuously improve SOC operations by identifying gaps in detection logic, playbooks, and triage workflows.
  • Help assess and validate external pentest and bug bounty reports.

Your skills & experiences:

  • 2-4 years of experience working in security operations, incident response, or application security.
  • Experience with SIEM platforms (Wazuh, Elastic/ELK, Splunk, or similar), including writing queries and detection rules.
  • Scripting skills (Python, Bash, or similar) for automation, log parsing, and building testing tools.
  • Strong understanding of web technologies and how they are attacked, including HTTP/S, session management, authentication protocols (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, JWT), REST and GraphQL APIs, and browser security controls (SOP, CORS, CSP).
  • Certifications such as OSCP, OSWE, BSCP (Burp Suite Certified Practitioner), eWPT/eWPTX, GWAPT, GCIH, or CySA+.

Nice to have:

  • Knowledge and practical experience of OWASP Top 10 exploitation.
  • Experience with WAFs, bot management, or anti-abuse systems (Cloudflare, Akamai, AWS WAF, or similar).
  • Experience with cloud environments (AWS, GCP, Azure) and containerized apps (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with Elastic Fleet/Agent and Wazuh rule and decoder development.
  • "Don't meet everything above? Apply anyway. We're looking for what's next, not what's already been done."

Tech stack:

  • Wazuh & Elasticsearch (ELK)
  • Python & Bash
  • Web Security (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, JWT, REST, GraphQL, SOP, CORS, CSP)
  • Cloud & Containers (AWS, GCP, Azure, Docker, Kubernetes)
  • WAFs (Cloudflare, Akamai)

jobs.description:
Title: Channel Sales Director

Location: Remote (Northeast, Texas or West Coast)

Timeframe: Immediate

Reports To: VP of Sales

About the role:

Forte Technologies is seeking a high-performing Channel Sales Director to build and scale our indirect sales engine. This role owns Forte’s presence across the Technology Solutions Distributor (TSD) ecosystem and the agents, trusted advisors, and referral partners who sell through it, turning those relationships into a consistent source of partner-sourced pipeline and new recurring revenue.

As Channel Sales Director, you will recruit, enable, and activate channel partners, establish Forte as a go-to managed services provider within the TSD supplier portfolio, and work alongside agents to close complex IT service deals with their end customers across managed services, cybersecurity, cloud, professional services, and advisory. This role is ideal for a relationship-driven seller who can treat the channel as a territory, build partner mindshare from the ground up, and convert referrals into long-term managed services clients.

What You’ll Own:

You will be accountable for generating pipeline and closed revenue through the TSD ecosystem and partner community, including:

  • Channel-Sourced Pipeline: Build a healthy, predictable pipeline of qualified opportunities referred by TSDs, agents, and partners.
  • Partner-Sourced Revenue: Close new managed services and recurring agreements that grow MRR through the channel.
  • Partner Activation: Grow the number of productive agents and partners actively selling Forte, and move new partners from signed to producing.
  • Operational Rigor: Maintain accurate pipeline, forecasts, partner attribution, and partner plans in CRM; ensure clean opportunity and deal registration hygiene.

Key Responsibilities:

TSD & Partner Ecosystem Development

  • Build and manage strategic relationships with TSD channel managers, supplier management teams, and leadership.
  • Identify, recruit, and onboard high-potential agents, trusted advisors, and referral partners aligned with Forte’s target customers.
  • Segment and prioritize the partner base by productivity, vertical focus, geography, and growth potential.
  • Represent Forte at TSD events, partner summits, roadshows, and industry conferences to build mindshare.

Partner Enablement & Activation

  • Develop and deliver partner enablement, including training sessions, sales playbooks, battle cards, and co-branded collateral.
  • Position Forte’s full portfolio so partners can confidently identify managed services, cybersecurity, cloud, and professional services opportunities.
  • Host partner webinars, lunch-and-learns, and TSD-sponsored programs to keep Forte top of mind with agents.
  • Partner with Marketing on through-channel campaigns, SPIFFs, and incentives that drive referral activity.

Opportunity Management & Deal Execution

  • Engage quickly on partner-referred opportunities and run discovery and needs analysis jointly with the agent and end customer.
  • Collaborate with Engineering and Solutions teams to design right-fit offerings and build compelling proposals.
  • Manage quoting, deal registration, and contracting requirements specific to each TSD and partner.
  • Negotiate terms and close new recurring revenue contracts while protecting the partner relationship.

Channel Strategy & Execution

  • Build and execute a channel plan with targets, priority TSDs and partners, and activity KPIs.
  • Track partner performance, attribution, and commission and residual accuracy in collaboration with Finance.
  • Maintain disciplined pipeline management with accurate close dates, probabilities, and revenue estimates.
  • Monitor competing suppliers within the TSD portfolio to differentiate Forte and grow partner share of wallet.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work with Marketing, Solutions Engineering, Professional Services, Finance, Operations, and Leadership to optimize the channel sales motion.
  • Ensure smooth handoff of closed channel accounts to Onboarding and Client Partners while keeping the referring partner informed.
  • Share partner feedback, market insights, and buying trends with leadership to inform offerings, pricing, and go-to-market strategy.

What Skills & Experience You’ll Need:

  • B2B technology sales experience (MSP or SaaS preferred), including channel, partner, or indirect sales.
  • Established relationships within the TSD ecosystem and agent community strongly preferred.
  • Proven track record of generating channel-sourced pipeline and closing new recurring revenue.
  • Working knowledge of TSD business models, including supplier agreements, deal registration, commissions, and residuals.
  • Ability to articulate IT/MSP services: Microsoft 365, Azure, cybersecurity, cloud, and networking.
  • Experience selling into SMB and mid-market organizations through partners.
  • Executive presence and strong communication and presentation skills; comfortable training partner audiences and engaging C-level stakeholders.
  • CRM and partner portal proficiency (HubSpot, Salesforce, TSD portals, etc.).
  • Strong organizational skills—able to manage multiple partners, opportunities, and deadlines with minimal oversight.
  • Willingness to travel for TSD events, partner meetings, and industry conferences (as required).
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred; equivalent experience welcomed.

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

The Safety Triage & Insights team builds data-driven safety experiences that surface actionable insights, engage drivers directly, and help fleets focus resources where they matter most. We develop the systems, APIs, and customer-facing products that power safety event review, supervisor workflows, driver analytics, and AI-driven experiences across Samsara’s Safety organization. The team is deeply invested in AI, LLMs, and emerging agentic technologies, both in the products we build and in how we engineer them, enabling rapid iteration and highly personalized, insight-driven user experiences.

As a Sr. Software Engineer I on the team, you will lead the design and evolution of systems that sit at the intersection of real-time data processing, AI-powered insights, and customer-facing product experiences. You’ll partner closely with Product, Design, ML, and platform teams to build scalable services, intelligent workflows, and next-generation AI capabilities that help organizations move beyond reactive incident review toward proactive, data-informed safety management.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in Canada.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: The software, firmware, and hardware you build will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

  • You want to build for scale: With over 2.3 million IoT devices deployed to our global customers, you will work on a range of new and mature technologies driving scalable innovation for customers across industries driving the world's physical operations.

  • You are a life-long learner: We have ambitious goals. Every Samsarian has a growth mindset as we work with a wide range of technologies, challenges, and customers that push us to learn on the go.

  • You believe customers are more than a number: Samsara engineers enjoy a rare closeness to the end user and you will have the opportunity to participate in customer interviews, collaborate with customer success and product managers, and use metrics to ensure our work is translating into better customer outcomes.

  • You are a team player: Working on our Samsara Engineering teams requires a mix of independent effort and collaboration. Motivated by our mission, we’re all racing toward our connected operations vision, and we intend to win – together.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the end-to-end development of customer-facing products and platform capabilities, from design and implementation to rollout and operational excellence.

  • Ship new product experiences quickly, validate with customers, and iterate toward scalable, high-impact solutions.

  • Build AI-powered workflows and experiences using modern LLM and agentic technologies, including evaluations, feedback loops, and human-in-the-loop systems.

  • Collaborate across Engineering, Product, Design, ML, and platform teams to deliver cohesive experiences across web, mobile, APIs, and downstream integrations.

  • Lead complex technical initiatives by resolving ambiguity, driving architectural decisions, and raising the quality and scalability of the systems you own.

  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 4+ years of experience building, shipping, and operating scalable and reliable customer-facing production systems.

  • Experience developing end-to-end solutions across backend services, APIs, and modern web applications.

  • Proven ability to move quickly, navigate ambiguity, and make thoughtful technical tradeoffs.

  • Experience or demonstrated interest in AI-native development, including LLMs, evaluations, and agentic workflows.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills across engineering and cross-functional partners.

  • A growth mindset, strong product intuition, and excitement for learning new technologies and building impactful customer experiences.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience building and scaling customer-facing AI/LLM-powered products in production environments.

  • Experience working across the stack with modern technologies such as Go, GraphQL, TypeScript, React, and AWS.

  • Familiarity with LLM evaluation, monitoring, and optimization tools and practices, including feedback loops, observability, and cost/performance tuning.

  • Experience operating in fast-paced, highly collaborative environments with distributed teams.

Contract / Remote (US-Only)

About Mochi
Mochi began as a virtual obesity medicine practice. Today, patients come to us for much more: hair loss, skin concerns, menopause and hormone care, mood, and healthy aging. Our goal is simple: one trusted provider who can help with all of it, at a price people can actually afford, from wherever they are.
We are growing quickly, and we are looking for nurse practitioners who want to practice broadly, keep learning, and help shape what whole-person virtual care looks like.

The Basics
  • Contract role, fully remote (US only)
  • You set your own schedule, with availability any time of day or week
  • Video visits plus asynchronous care for an ongoing patient panel

What your work looks like

  • Care across every Mochi care area: weight and metabolic health, dermatology and skin, hair loss, hormone replacement therapy and menopause, depression and anxiety, and longevity.
  • Visits built around what the patient asked for: before each visit, see which care areas your patient selected, then assess each one, treat it when clinically appropriate, or note why not.
  • Asynchronous care: review intake forms, photos, labs and history, and build or adjust treatment plans between visits.
  • Ongoing management: new prescriptions, refills, dose changes and side-effect follow-up across all care areas.

About the Role

We operate in an AI-first engineering environment, where AI-powered development is at the core of how we design, build, and deliver software. As our engineers ship faster with AI coding agents, our infrastructure and delivery pipelines have to keep pace, and security has to be built in from the start.

We're looking for a hands-on DevSecOps Engineer to own our cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, and platform reliability, with security embedded into every layer. You'll spend most of your time building: infrastructure as code, deployment pipelines, observability, and the automated guardrails that let engineers ship quickly and safely. You'll work closely with Engineering, QA, Product, and Compliance and help our engineers own security and reliability end-to-end.

Our stack: React, TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, on AWS.

Core Responsibilities

  • Own our cloud infrastructure: Design, build, and operate our AWS environment using infrastructure as code, with a focus on reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency.

  • Build secure delivery pipelines: Own CI/CD end-to-end, embedding automated security checks (SAST, dependency and container scanning, secrets detection) so every change is validated before it reaches production.

  • Engineer security into the platform: IAM, network segmentation, encryption, and secrets management as defaults, so the secure path is the easy path.

  • Drive reliability and observability: Monitoring, logging, and alerting that give us fast detection and clear signal, and lead incident response and post-incident improvements.

  • Build with AI agents: Use tools like Claude Code to accelerate infrastructure work, automation, and troubleshooting while owning the correctness and security of the output.

  • Support compliance through automation: Partner on SOC 2 and other regulatory requirements by automating evidence, controls, and audit readiness.

  • Enable engineering teams: Help engineers understand and own the infrastructure and security of the services they ship, through tooling, documentation, and hands-on support.

  • Support compliance through automation: Partner with our Compliance Lead to implement and automate the technical controls and evidence collection behind SOC 2 and other regulatory requirements, so audit readiness is continuous and built into our infrastructure rather than a manual effort.

Key Requirements

  • 4+ years in DevOps, platform, or infrastructure engineering, with security as a core part of how you work.

  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS and infrastructure as code (Terraform, CDK, or similar).

  • Deep experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions or similar), including integrating automated security tooling.

  • Experience with containers and orchestration (Docker, ECS, or Kubernetes), and with observability tools (Datadog, CloudWatch, or similar).

  • Solid understanding of cloud security fundamentals: IAM, networking, encryption, secrets management, and vulnerability management.

  • Hands-on experience using AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) to build and maintain infrastructure and automation, with the judgment to validate their output.

  • Strong ownership mentality and the ability to influence engineering practices across teams.

  • Experience implementing technical controls and automating audit evidence, including with compliance automation platforms (Vanta, Drata, or similar) or policy as code.

  • Nice to Have

    • Experience in FinTech, banking, payments, or environments subject to SOC 2, PCI DSS, or similar regulatory requirements.

    • Experience with policy as code, compliance automation, or cloud security posture management tools.

    • Experience with incident response, threat modeling, or penetration testing coordination.

This is a remote first role. While we expect you to come to the office for monthly team building events, the work is remote first.

jobs.description:
Our Mission

Buildings account for over a third of greenhouse gas emissions in the US and globally. The most viable pathway for decarbonizing the built environment is to replace fossil fuel appliances with efficient, electric alternatives (e.g. replacing a gas furnace with a heat pump), and then powering those electric appliances with carbon-free electricity. Billions in incentives are available each year to make upgrades more affordable, yet finding and claiming funds is time-consuming, costly, and risky for potential participants. Furthermore, these programs are expensive to administer for incentive providers. Rock Rabbit delivers an AI-powered API and app to make it fast, easy and reliable for participants to find and claim rebates, tax credits and financing for electrification projects. Rock Rabbit also partners directly with incentive providers to make these programs more equitable and cost-effective to administer. Rock Rabbit integrates the highly fragmented landscape of actors, processes & data to drastically reduce friction across the value chain - ultimately accelerating the rate of building decarbonization.

About The Business

We are building an AI-powered data and workflow SaaS platform to accelerate building decarbonization. Our platform allows for streamlined discovery, application, and ultimately end-to-end management of incentives and financing. With a small team and in only one year, we have built out our core product suite, closed dozens of contracts, been accepted into multiple accelerators, won multiple awards, processed millions of dollars in incentive funds, and attracted top tier venture capital investors. We are now rapidly expanding across the nation.

The Role

  • You’ll strengthen the relationships and own the systems that keep Rock Rabbit growing: every renewal and expansion accelerates building decarbonization.

  • You’ll be a primary partner to our customers from kickoff through renewal: utilities, community choice aggregators, public agencies, equipment manufacturers and distributors.

  • You’ll run core business operations, including planning, budgets, operating rhythms and compliance, as a close partner to our CEO and the leadership team.

  • You’ll work closely with domain experts who have decades of experience in building decarbonization and incentive administration, across our Growth, Analysis & Operations and Product teams, on a high-performing, diverse and mission-aligned team.

  • You’ll report to our VP of Growth and have real autonomy to shape how we manage, grow and support our accounts.

  • You’ll help us achieve scale: building systems, AI automation and processes. As we grow, the role can specialize toward customer success, revenue operations or business operations leadership.

Account Management & Customer Success

  • Be the day-to-day partner: serve as the main point of contact for our incentive provider and OEM/distributor customers, building trusted relationships at every level

  • Partner on implementations: work alongside our analyst team, who lead program setup and configuration, to keep customer launches on schedule; as the function grows, take on increasing ownership of implementation planning and coordination

  • Partner with Growth on renewals and expansion: convert pilots into long-term contracts, manage renewals, and surface expansion opportunities to the Growth team

  • Drive contractor and distributor activation: design and run programs that get contractors and distributors onboarded, submitting claims, and getting paid through Rock Rabbit

  • Keep revenue data accurate and automated: maintain HubSpot as the source of truth for accounts, contracts and renewals, and build the automated dashboards and reporting on pipeline, renewals and ARR that leadership relies on

Business Operations

  • Run operating rhythms: organize OKRs, leadership meetings, all-hands and team retreats so decisions happen on time with the right information

  • Support planning: maintain headcount and budget plans, cash flow forecasts and burn tracking with our CEO

  • Keep the business running: lead compliance, coordinate contracts, vendor and legal workflows

  • Drive special projects and KPIs: lead cross-company initiatives, such as new tools and process improvements, and track company performance for leadership

About You

  • 6+ years across customer success, account management, revenue operations or business operations at a B2B SaaS or venture-backed company, ideally serving utilities, energy efficiency programs, or the HVAC and building electrification industry

  • AI-native: you use AI tools every day as a core part of how you work, and can show workflows you’ve built yourself, such as automating reporting, account research, meeting follow-ups or CRM updates

  • A track record of retaining and growing accounts: renewals, expansions, and turning pilots into contracts

  • Strong analytical and spreadsheet skills: comfortable building budget trackers, KPI dashboards and simple financial models

  • Process-minded: you set clear expectations, measure against them, and fix the gaps

Preferred Qualifications (Not Required)

At MEDvidi, the AI Receptionist Team builds and improves Voice AI Agents that interact directly with patients and automate critical parts of the patient journey.

Our AI systems handle real-world patient conversations across voice and text channels, support operational workflows, and help patients navigate care more efficiently.

The team works on complex patient support scenarios, including prescription-related inquiries, pharmacy communications, patient verification, and operational processes involving healthcare providers.

As these agents become more autonomous and handle increasingly complex interactions, understanding how they behave in production becomes a critical product and business challenge.

We're looking for an AI Product Analyst who can help us evaluate, monitor, and continuously improve these systems.

You'll work at the intersection of Product, Engineering, Operations, and AI, helping the team understand how AI behaves in the real world, where it creates value, where it fails, and what should be improved next.

We're building an AI-first team where experimenting with emerging technologies, challenging traditional workflows, and using AI to accelerate everyday work are part of our culture.

Why This Role:

  • Real-world AI impact: Work on one of the most visible AI products inside MEDvidi, directly influencing patient interactions.
  • Shape the future of Voice AI: Help build and improve AI Agents that handle increasingly complex healthcare workflows.

jobs.description:
Join beqom — where tech meets impact

beqom is a high-growth B2B SaaS company that provides industry-leading tools for pay equity and transparency, compensation, and performance management.

Trusted by some of the world's most respected companies, beqom enables HR and business leaders to navigate global compliance and make smarter pay decisions that attract, retain, and motivate top talent.

Founded in Switzerland and serving clients worldwide, our powerful, enterprise-ready products are fuelled by beqom pay intelligence.

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Application Security Engineer to strengthen the security of our SaaS platform within a fast-growing organisation of approximately 250 employees. This role is responsible for embedding security throughout the software development lifecycle, ensuring our applications and APIs robustly protect customer data, and enabling engineering teams to ship secure software at pace.

You will act as the go-to application security expert, combining hands-on technical work with developer enablement, and working closely with Engineering, DevOps, Product, QA, and Compliance teams.

What you'll be doing

Secure Development Lifecycle

  • Own and drive the application security programme across the beqom SaaS platform
  • Embed security into the SDLC through threat modelling, secure design reviews, and security requirements
  • Perform secure code reviews and guide engineers on remediating findings
  • Integrate and tune SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets and container scanning in CI/CD pipelines
  • Manage software supply chain security, including open-source dependency risk and SBOMs

Testing & Vulnerability Management

  • Coordinate external penetration tests and responsible disclosure submissions
  • Own application vulnerability management: triage, risk-rate, and drive fixes within agreed SLAs
  • Define secure coding standards aligned with the OWASP Top 10 and OWASP ASVS

Platform & Cloud Security

  • Review and secure APIs, authentication, authorisation, and multi-tenant data isolation
  • Partner with DevOps on cloud-native application security (containers, Kubernetes, IaC) in Azure and AWS

Enablement, Incident Response & Compliance

  • Build and run a Security Champions programme across engineering teams
  • Deliver secure development training for developers and QA
  • Support incident response for application-layer security events, including root-cause analysis
  • Provide application security evidence for ISO 27001 and SOC 2 audits

Governance & Customer Engagement

  • Contribute to security policies, standards, and procedures relating to software development
  • Track and report application security metrics and risk posture to leadership
  • Assess the security of new features, third-party integrations, and AI/LLM capabilities
  • Act as the application security subject-matter expert in customer and prospect engagements
  • Participate in customer security reviews, audits, and due diligence calls
  • Respond to the application security sections of customer security questionnaires

Skills & Experience

What you'll bring

  • Excellent, client-facing communication skills and written skills
  • 6+ years of experience in application security, secure software development, or a related field.
  • Hands-on experience with SAST, DAST, SCA and secrets-scanning tools (e.g. Checkmarx, Veracode, Snyk, SonarQube, GitHub Advanced Security).
  • Strong knowledge of OWASP Top 10, OWASP ASVS and common web and API vulnerability classes.
  • Practical experience with threat modelling and secure architecture reviews for cloud-native applications.
  • Ability to read and review code in at least one modern language, ideally C#/.NET, JavaScript/TypeScript or Python.
  • Experience embedding security into CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps practices.
  • Strong understanding of cloud application security (ideally in Azure and AWS).
  • Experience in the SaaS (Software as a Service) industry.

Bonus points if you have

  • Certifications such as OSCP, OSWE, GWAPT, CSSLP, or CISSP.
  • Background as a software developer before moving into security.
  • Experience with container and Kubernetes security and IaC scanning (e.g. Terraform, Bicep).
  • Familiarity with ISO 27001, SOC 2, and GDPR requirements as they apply to software development.
  • Experience running a bug bounty or Security Champions programme.
  • Knowledge of AI/LLM application security risks (e.g. OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications).

Why join us?

  • Your career, your design. Unleash your ambition in our dynamic, autonomous environment.
  • Drive meaningful change. Build a fairer future for every employee by joining a market leader that is improving the world of work.
  • Belong to something bigger. Collaborate with a passionate, diverse and talented team around the globe.

jobs.description:
About Figure

We’reFigure (Nasdaq: FIGR), and we’re building the future of capital markets with blockchain and AI. We make lending faster and cheaper for everyone by automating the origination process and using blockchain as the source of truth for loan ownership and connection to our capital marketplace.

It’s all one ecosystem that spans three lines of business:

  • Lending: HELOCs, cash-out refinance, DSCR loans, and crypto-backed loans for homeowners, investors, and small businesses. Through Kiavi, a Figure company, we also finance real estate investors with bridge, fix-and-flip, rental, and new construction loans.
  • Markets: On Figure Markets, people can lend and earn with Prime and $YLDS, an SEC-registered, interest-bearing security that settles like cash. OPEN is our blockchain infrastructure for issuing, distributing, and trading equities.
  • Partnerships: Banks, credit unions, fintechs, home improvement companies, and other lenders and brokers originate loans on our platform. DART records loan ownership on blockchain, and Figure Connect connects originators with institutional loan buyers.

See all of our products on figure.com.

Here’s where we are today:

  • $35B+ in equity unlocked for homeowners on Figure’s platform
  • 382K+ households served
  • 800+ B2B partners, including banks, credit unions, and fintechs
  • AAA-rated HELOC securitizations from S&P, KBRA, and Moody’s
  • $23B+ funded for real estate investors through Kiavi since 2013
  • Recognized by CNBC (World’s Top Fintech Companies 2026), Fortune (Crypto 100, 2026), and Inc. (2026 Inc. 5000)

If you want to help build the next era of lending, we’d love to meet you.

About the Role

We're looking for an Underwriting Manager, Construction to join our growing team! As Underwriting Manager, Construction, you'll serve as the operational bridge across cross-functional teams, driving alignment and execution throughout the loan lifecycle. You'll manage a specialized team of Construction Underwriters and own the construction vertical across policy, process, and product success. You'll be the primary escalation point for complex, stalled transactions, making decisive structural calls to unblock workflows. You'll also structure deals upfront, oversee the pipeline, and drive efficiency and production strategy across alternative product lines, including Multifamily. With a deep understanding of secondary-market expectations, new-construction legal and insurance requirements, and multifamily cash flow analysis, you'll make sure each project is sound at origination, monitored through completion, and ready for a successful loan sale. If you want to own construction lending end to end and are ready to unblock hard deals, this role is for you.

What You'll Do

  • Serve as the primary escalation and resolution point for new construction and multifamily transactions, and as the cross-functional liaison who drives loan progression by resolving complex underwriting and operational requirements
  • Run early deal reviews and structuring consultations with sales to evaluate complex or borderline transactions, structure complex loan scenarios in clear, executable terms beyond standard guidelines, and minimize downstream credit exception requests
  • Oversee pipeline progression, drive workflow efficiencies, and manage production strategies for alternative product lines, including Multifamily and other specialized transaction types
  • Apply rigorous cash flow analysis to multifamily projects, evaluating income, expenses, and stabilization assumptions to confirm each transaction is structured to perform as underwritten
  • Monitor construction projects from origination through final draw, verify milestone requirements are met, and spot projects falling behind schedule or budget early, working with the borrower, sales, and servicing partners to address risks before they become losses
  • Collaborate with Capital Markets on loan sale and diligence requests so construction files are complete, well documented, and aligned with investor and secondary-market expectations
  • Partner with operations and technology teams to close automation gaps and drive the system support needed to optimize cross-functional workflows
  • Contribute to credit policy for the construction vertical, partner with credit risk teams on policy rollouts, align credit guidelines and standard operating procedures, build a continuous feedback loop to resolve operational inconsistencies, and enforce intake guardrails so loan files hold all required documentation before credit review
  • Keep current on jurisdiction-specific legal requirements for new construction and on insurance requirements such as builder's risk coverage, and make sure credit policy and loan documentation reflect them in every market we serve
  • Manage, coach, and mentor a team of specialized Underwriters, with regular feedback, performance evaluations, and strategic workload balancing, and protect our culture by keeping the environment open, communicative, and collaborative, with knowledge sharing and professional development

What We Look For

  • 7+ years of experience in a similar or closely related field
  • 1+ years of experience in people management
  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative business or finance discipline (such as Finance, Economics, Accounting, Statistics, or Business Analytics)
  • Demonstrated experience applying quantitative analysis to support business decisions
  • Solid understanding of secondary-market dynamics, including the loan sale process and the diligence standards investors apply to construction loans
  • Familiarity with the geography-specific legal requirements that govern new construction
  • Working knowledge of the nuances of insurance requirements for new construction projects
  • Demonstrated ability to track projects from origination through draws and hold them to milestone requirements
  • Proficiency in cash flow analysis for multifamily property projects
  • Strong working knowledge of property valuation methods and appraisal types, with the ability to guide the valuation process and answer questions from underwriters, sales, risk, and external partners about valuation types, methodology, and how they apply to construction and multifamily transactions
  • Proven ability to quickly master and work expertly in the tools the construction team uses
  • Hands-on experience with AI tools such as Claude or Copilot, with an automation-first mindset
  • Ability to troubleshoot workflow issues independently and translate between operational needs and technical solutions
  • Experience with Tableau, JIRA, Trust Point, and Appraisal Works (preferred)
  • Experience with Salesforce (preferred)
  • Adhere to all company security policies and data handling procedures.
  • Complete mandatory security awareness training within required timeframes.
  • Promptly report any suspected security incidents or suspicious activity to the Security team.

Salary

  • Base Compensation Range: $101,600 - $152,400/year
  • 25% annual bonus, paid quarterly
  • Company equity in the form of RSUs

This is the compensation range for the role in the United States. Actual compensation may vary based on a candidate’s experience, skills, location, internal equity, and evolving business needs. While most offers are generally made within the middle of the range, final compensation is determined based on the factors above.

Benefits

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% employer-paid premiums for employees and their dependents on select plans
  • Company HSA, FSA, Dependent Care FSA, 401(k), and commuter benefits
  • Employer-paid life and disability insurance
  • 10 observed holidays and PTO plan
  • Up to 12 weeks of paid family leave
  • Continuing education reimbursement

California Residents, please review our California Employee and General Workforce Privacy Notice for further information. By submitting your application, you are agreeing and acknowledging that you have read and understand the above notice.

jobs.description:
Role Title: Optomechanical Design Engineer — Precision CNC Parts (Remote)

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Fully remote

Opportunity Snapshot

Pay: $90 -$155/hour

Duration: Initial phase of 20 part packages; production phase to follow

Location: Fully remote, no geographic restrictions

You'll need: 5+ years designing CNC-machined production parts, technical decision authority, and access to parametric CAD software

Your tasks: Author original CAD part packages, and peer review packages from other engineers

micro1 is engaging senior optomechanical and mechanical design engineers to create original CAD part packages for a client project in precision optics and optomechanics. Your engineering judgment is what matters here — no prior AI experience required.

Each package is a new part you design from scratch: a difficult, high-value CNC part with a specific machining challenge, backed by a drawing with full GD&T, a design rationale, and a production scenario you justify from experience. Every part is independently reviewed by three other engineers, and you'll review others' work as well.

What you'll do

  1. Design original parts in parametric CAD, delivered as native files plus STEP.
  2. Produce the technical drawing: dimensions, tolerances, GD&T and datums, material and condition, finish, revision, drawing standard.
  3. Write the design context: intended function, interfaces, operating conditions, the machining challenge, and your material and process rationale.
  4. Build the production scenario: estimated unit cost and drivers, CNC cycle and setup hours, assumed volume, sourcing difficulty and lead time — with the engineering basis for each estimate.
  5. Peer review other engineers' packages against technical quality, production realism, and engineering value, with part-specific evidence for every score.
  6. Revise your own packages against review findings.

What we're looking for

  1. 5+ years of production engineering experience with comparable CNC parts, materials and processes in precision optics or optomechanics.
  2. Technical decision authority: you owned or approved critical design choices — drawing, tolerance or material approval, production release, or enforcing engineering quality standards. Design leads, principal and staff engineers, and technical authorities are the profile.
  3. Experience at OEMs or specialist suppliers whose engineering standards you can reproduce.
  4. Strong GD&T and tolerancing judgment, including cost and inspection implications.
  5. Access to parametric CAD software (SolidWorks, NX, CATIA, Creo or similar) and the ability to deliver native files plus STEP.
  6. Industry experience, not academic.

Important: originality and IP

Every design must be your own original work. You cannot use designs owned by a current or former employer or customer, and you cannot substitute public or purchased CAD. All deliverables become the client's property. If you're currently employed, check your employment agreement regarding outside work and invention assignment before applying.

How the selection process works

  1. Apply and complete the screening questions
  2. Complete the AI interview for this role — it's how your expertise gets in front of the client
  3. Profile review, including evidence of comparable parts and decisions owned
  4. Onboarding — our Talent Ops team will get you set up

As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

The Veeva Link mobile team is looking for an experienced QA Engineer to help us ensure the high quality of our iOS App. You will help the mobile team to validate the app releases, find potential issues early and ensure a great customer experience by writing manual and automated tests for native iOS applications (SwiftUI/UIKit). At Veeva Link, we're building the intelligence layer for life sciences, creating connected data applications that accelerate drug development and significantly improve patient outcomes. Our core belief: combining the highest quality data with state-of-the-art software delivers immense value.

We believe execution matters most. Progress comes from speed, accuracy, and quality in what we build every day. Our engineering approach emphasizes clear product definitions leading to meticulous technical designs. We leverage a modern tech stack to deliver inherently reliable applications and a great user experience.

Our work spans two critical areas:

Data-Driven Insights

We develop sophisticated applications that map and understand global scientific and medical expertise, providing high-impact insights and AI-generated intelligence. Engineers here tackle complex data modeling, entity resolution, and advanced machine learning.

Intelligent Business Workflows

We engineer workflow applications powered by our data, using AI to find patterns and route information precisely. This involves designing scalable pipelines and intelligent automation.

Why Join Veeva Link?

Build products that create a significant positive impact in global healthcare.
Work in an environment led by a CEO with an engineering background.
Work Anywhere means you can work in an office or at home on any given day.
Empowered Autonomy: Tech decisions are made within teams, giving engineers significant autonomy.

Job Title: Product Marketing Manager - Ostro

Job Location: Boston, MA

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

We are looking for an exceptional Product Marketing Manager to own the product marketing plan and drive market adoption for Veeva Ostro, the leading conversational AI platform for life sciences brands. Operating with the speed and autonomy of a startup inside Veeva, you will translate AI capabilities into clear, compelling value that resonates with buyers. You will collaborate closely with strategy, product management, sales, and customer success to shape messaging, build practical sales enablement, drive content marketing, capture customer case studies, and prepare thought leadership presentations for industry events. This role is ideal for a strong writer who works independently, moves fast with high quality, and knows how to market AI software based on real business value.

What You’ll Do

    • Own the Product Marketing Plan: Build and execute the end-to-end marketing plan for Ostro, collaborating closely with strategy, product management, sales, and customer success to drive awareness and adoption.
    • Shape & Apply Messaging: Partner on core positioning and translate it into clear, differentiated product messaging across all sales and marketing channels.
    • Build Sales Enablement & Collateral: Create and maintain a library of practical sales tools, including pitch decks, product briefs, demo scripts, and competitive battlecards, that empower our sales team to win.
    • Drive Content Marketing: Write and produce high-impact content, such as thought leadership articles, website copy, blog posts, and product videos, that clearly articulates the benefits of Ostro.
    • Capture Customer Case Studies: Work directly with customers to turn their real-world results into case studies, testimonials, and customer advocacy assets.
    • Event Thought Leadership: Partner with customers and Ostro leadership to build compelling presentations for industry conferences and events.

Requirements

    • B2B Product Marketing Experience: 5+ years in B2B SaaS product marketing, ideally at a hypergrowth startup or within a fast-moving business unit.
    • AI Product Marketing Experience: Proven experience marketing AI-powered software, specifically translating capabilities into concrete customer outcomes rather than buzzwords.
    • Authentic, Clear Writing: Demonstrated ability to turn positioning into crisp, compelling messaging and write strong product content (decks, datasheets, blogs, and speeches).
    • High Ownership & Startup Speed: Able to own a plan end-to-end, work independently with little oversight, ship quickly, and adapt as priorities shift.
    • Cross-Functional & Customer Presence: Experienced partnering with strategy, product, sales, and customer success, and comfortable working directly with customers and executives on conference presentations.

Nice to Have

    • Experience in life sciences, healthcare technology, patient engagement, or commercial pharma software.
    • Proven success bringing innovative B2B cloud or AI offerings to market.

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

    • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
    • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party, unless you have already completed it with Veeva previously.
    • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
    • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
        1. A conversation with the hiring manager
        2. A practical case exercise
        3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.

jobs.description:
This role is Remote, however there will be a requirement to attend the Salisbury office on occasion therefore we are looking for someone within a 2 hour commute to Salisbury.

We’re on the lookout for an Investment Analyst to join our busy Investment Oversight Team. You will primarily be working in the Technical Investments Team and the role will encompass the on-boarding, management and administration of Non-Standard / Specialist investments held across the Nucleus group.

Integral to this role is excellent organisation and prioritisation, attention to detail and "heroic reaction" skills. This means being a pro at managing both tasks that are assigned to you and new or existing projects all whilst also supporting the team in a variety of investment operations functions.

Every day you’ll manage your workload, ensuring actions are dealt with within agreed timeframes, enabling our advisers to get the best outcome for their clients.

You’ll spend most of your time:
• Undertaking a thorough in-depth due diligence assessment on Non-Standard / Specialist investments to enable you to make a fully informed decision on acceptability.
• Making a recommendation including a detailed rationale of the acceptability of Non-Standard / Specialist investments to Senior Leadership.
• Liaising with the administration support to finalise the onboarding of assets and ensuring that receipt of title is accurate and reflects the true position.
• Acting as a point of contact for escalations and complex technical investment issues whilst ensuring that client deadlines, all internally agreed key performance indicators, service standards and regulatory reporting requirements are met.
• Processing of client instructions, managing internal and external queries across multiple channels accurately and to the service standards set by the Company, whilst at all times maintaining confidentiality and demonstrating discretion with clients and business introducers.
• Developing a thorough understanding of the risks of investing into Non-Standard / Specialist investments whilst assessing alignment with regulatory guidance on high-risk and speculative investments.
• Proactively identifying risks within the department and escalating concerns to Technical Team Leader.
• Using and producing Management Information reporting and board papers to identify and support the mitigation of risks and accurate record keeping with the ability to escalate where tolerances exceed limits.
• Creating, reviewing and enhancing of process guides, key literature, controls, communication templates and webpages.
• Supporting the Management team with the preparation, coordination and completion of regulatory data requests.
• Receiving referrals and considering adjustments of existing or ongoing fees relating to both active and impaired Non-Standard investments.
• Receiving and reviewing Workplace Pension Scheme data, produce investment reports, consider and take forward actions and notifications to customers.
• Sharing your knowledge and supporting your colleagues across the Technical Investment team and wider business.
• Building and maintain third-party relationships, ensuring we get the best from our suppliers and our clients are at the heart of everything you do.

A bit about you
Your friends would probably describe you as the “super-organised” one, ridiculously well planned and someone who can tackle multiple complex tasks during the working day. You’re the type of person who asks great questions to understand expectations but can react like lightening to solve problems as they occur.

We’ve always placed more importance on cultural contribution above technical ability, but we’d really like you to have/be:
• Previous experience in the financial services industry and ideally working within a SIPP provider.
• Understanding of the SIPP investment lifecycle and the risks inherent with a wide range of investments.
• Knowledge of different asset classes and impact to operational processes.
• Excellent relationship building skills.
• Able to prioritise the high impact work, but never neglect the details.
• Excellent communication skills – We need you to be completely comfortable representing our culture and values, with an emphasis on a speedy, friendly style.
• Able to anticipate the needs of those you work with, juggling conflicting priorities.
• The ability to think laterally and come up with new solutions to old problems.
• Helping people makes you happy.

A little about us 
We’re the Nucleus Financial Platforms group and we help make retirement more rewarding.

People come first - whether it’s our colleagues, or the advisers and customers we support, we know that working in partnership and collaboration leads to the best outcomes. Together, we’ve shaped the platform to how it is today. We work hard, and we celebrate hard too. 

Our ambition is to create a platform with a difference, putting the customer centre stage meant tearing up the rule book and starting from scratch. We’ve come a long way since then, but our mission remains just as focused. That’s why our culture, values, and social responsibility are things we keep at the top of our agenda – because we know they matter and have a big impact. 

Our culture is one of the many things that sets us apart from the pack. We want to have an environment where our people feel that they can make a real difference, know they’ll be rewarded for their efforts and more importantly, enjoy themselves at work. 

Inclusion and diversity at Nucleus 
As with most things in life, who cares, wins. We really care about inclusion. 
For us it’s not a tick box exercise; inclusion and diversity are embedded in our culture and everything we do. It’s a commercial imperative. It isn’t about being PC. It’s about being future-relevant and durable. We owe it to ourselves and the industry to ensure we are playing our part in creating a fair, balanced and transparent financial services sector. 

More diversity means broader experience, a wider set of perspectives and a better collective ability to problem-solve. And it means being more representative of customer groups, which supports areas such as product development. 

At Nucleus, we offer a generous blend of benefits for the things that really matter to our people, including a non-contributory pension, bonus, enhanced parental leave, paid time off for emergencies, health and wellbeing initiatives and flexible working options.

jobs.description:
Overview

The HIM Certified Coder is responsible for accurate and timely coding of hospital inpatient, hospital outpatient and/or professional fee encounters using appropriate ICD10/ICDPCS, CPT, or HCPCs codes and appropriate coding software such as computer assisted coding and encoders as a means to ensure compliant billing of Carle claims. HIM Certified Coder is responsible for understanding and applying all regulatory coding guidelines, such as National and Local Coverage Determinations and application of CPT modifiers. HIM Certified Coder is also responsible for understanding and applying coding knowledge to resolve billing edits related to coding. HIM coder uses Carle electronic medical record systems to review clinical encounters.

Responsibilities

Responsible for accurately coding all records according to the appropriate coding classification (ICD-10 and/or CPT and/or HCPCs and modifiers) system. The assignment of codes will accurately reflect the diagnoses and procedures pertinent to the patient. Provides interdepartmental coding assistance, as needed, to determine accurate coding assignment. Develops methodology to provide a coding process that is compliant with regulatory agencies including the utilization of reference materials such as, but not limited to, Center for Medicare Services (CMS) publications, Coding Clinic, CPT Assistant, etc. Facilitates optimization of revenue while maintaining compliance standards for the organization through varied venues and tasks (auditing/monitoring, training, facilitation of charges through the claim scrubber system, assisting with various patient or payor related charge/account inquiries, research on various coding/billing related topics as requested by various sources internal and external to the organization, etc.). Serves as an expert resource regarding CPT, HCPCS, ICD-10-CM, all other necessary coding systems, and regulatory guidelines for all internal and external parties. Serve as liaison for coding and billing staff to ensure accurate charge capture. Reports any documentation and coding improvement needs based upon review findings. Responsible for maintaining coding certification, knowledge and skills to successfuly perform job duties Performs provider and peer coding audits as requested Assist with monitoring of internal controls for coding and billing. Facilitates external audit activities and reporting of such activities to the appropriate administrative personnel.

Qualifications

Certifications: Registered Health Information Technician (RHIT) - American Health Information Management Association (AHIMA); Registered Health Information Administrator (RHIA) - American Health Information Management Association (AHIMA); Certified Professional Coder (CPC) - American Academy of Professional Coders (AAPC); Certified Outpatient Coder (COC) - American Academy of Professional Coders (AAPC); Certified Inpatient Coder (CIC) - American Academy of Professional Coders (AAPC); Certified Coding Specialist - Physician-Based (CCS-P) - American Health Information Management Association (AHIMA); Certified Coding Specialist (CCS) - American Health Information Management Association (AHIMA), Education: , Work Experience:

jobs.description:
Role overview

As an Account Executive at ChargeLab, you’ll open net-new accounts across the US, selling the full ChargeLab package: our charging software plus the hardware that runs on it. You’ll own the full sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery to demo, proposal, negotiation and close.


This is a hunter role. Most of your pipeline will come from your own prospecting, not inbound leads or an inherited book. You’ll also know how to fund a project, using rebates, grants and utility programs to help customers say yes faster.


We’re looking for a competitive, self-directed seller with 4–7 years of B2B sales experience who thrives in a fast-paced startup environment. If you’ve built a territory on your own and hit quota, we’d love to hear from you.


What you’ll do

Hunt for new business

  • Build your own pipeline through cold calls, email, LinkedIn, events and referrals, with roughly 70% of your time spent on net-new accounts.

  • Take over an existing pipeline of open prospects and own the full sales cycle: prospect, discover, demo, propose, negotiate and close.

  • Target charge point operators, multifamily and commercial real estate, property managers, hospitality, fleets, municipalities, tribal nations, utilities and governments.

  • Recruit and activate electrical contractors, installers and distributors as ChargeLab resellers, then help them close deals with their own customers.

  • Find sites with chargers stranded when another network shuts down or ends support, and move them to ChargeLab.

  • Qualify hard and early, map every decision maker on larger deals, and close out deals that won’t move.

  • Keep HubSpot accurate, log why deals are won or lost, and forecast your pipeline weekly.


Sell software and hardware together

  • Scope full projects: charger count, Level 2 vs. DC fast charging, power and load needs, payments and ongoing support.

  • Lead with the hardware-plus-software bundle on new sites, and pitch ChargeLab software alone to owners who already have chargers.

  • Get in at the hardware spec stage through contractors and distributors, before a competitor’s software comes bundled with the chargers.

  • Explain OCPP, hardware-agnostic software and power management in plain language to non-technical buyers.

  • Work with solutions engineering on site walks, quotes and technical questions.


Use funding to win deals

  • Know the incentive landscape in your states: federal programs like NEVI and CFI, state grants and rebates, and utility make-ready programs.

  • Match each prospect to the programs they qualify for and build that funding into the proposal and ROI.

  • Track application windows and help customers and installers meet program rules (qualified product lists, uptime, reporting and payment requirements).

  • Use upcoming funding rounds to start conversations and create urgency.


Represent ChargeLab in market

  • Attend trade shows, utility workshops and industry events in your region.

  • Share what you hear from the field with product and marketing, including competitor moves and pricing.

  • Travel about 25–30% of the time for site walks, partner meetings and industry events.


Company details

ChargeLab builds open, hardware-agnostic software for managing electric vehicle (EV) chargers. Charge point operators, property owners, fleets and utilities use our platform to run their chargers, process payments, balance power and keep sites online. We manage more than 15,000 ports at more than 2,500 sites across the US and Canada, with more than 200 charger models integrated. We pair our software with networked Level 2 and DC fast chargers so customers can buy one complete solution from us, from single condo buildings to statewide networks.

Qualifications

Must have

  • 4–7 years in B2B sales or business development, with at least 2 years in a closing role

  • A proven record of net-new sales: you’ve built a territory or pipeline mostly on your own and hit quota

  • Deals closed in the $50,000–$250,000+ range with several stakeholders (owners, contractors, utilities, finance), alongside a steady flow of smaller deals

  • Experience selling hardware plus SaaS, or a solution that bundles equipment, installation and recurring software

  • Experience recruiting or managing channel partners such as contractors, resellers or distributors

  • Working knowledge of at least one funding stream (utility rebates, state grants, federal programs or tax credits), including how a customer qualifies and how the money flows

  • Strong writing and presentation skills; you can build a clear proposal and ROI case

  • Disciplined CRM habits (HubSpot preferred) and comfort with tools like LinkedIn Sales Navigator or ZoomInfo

  • Based in the US, authorized to work in the US, and able to travel

Nice to have

  • EV charging, solar, storage or other clean energy sales experience

  • Experience selling in California, including CTEP and legal-for-trade requirements, low carbon fuel credits, and state and utility incentive programs

  • An existing network of electrical contractors, installers or charge point operators in the region

  • Experience writing or supporting grant applications or responding to RFPs

  • Familiarity with public sector buying: cooperative contracts, state contracts or municipal procurement

  • Basic electrical knowledge (amperage, panel capacity, make-ready work)

This is your chance to help design, build, scale, and address the systems that will serve as the backbone of CodePath’s future. Expect work that blends a mix of new projects and rebuilds of existing pipelines and models that require attention.

What You'll Do

  • Data Platform & Architecture: Design and maintain a scalable, modern data infrastructure (data warehouses, pipelines, data lakes, analytic products)

  • Share responsibility for CodePath’s Google Cloud Platform infrastructure (CloudRun, BigQuery, App Engine) to support data and dashboarding needs, including security and permissions, scalability, and uptime

  • Propose and implement innovative solutions to improve data ingestion, processing, and storage
  • Develop and implement metrics to demonstrate that data engineering solutions align with business objectives and strategic goals

  • Proven ability to work autonomously and deliver outcomes in a fast-changing environment
  • Expertise in building data pipelines end-to-end, from ingestion through transformation to final visualization. Deep understanding of data modeling principles (dimensional modeling, data normalization)

Nice to Have

Salary is determined based on your relevant experience and skills as evaluated through our interview process.
