jobs.description:
The financial industry is growing at a record pace, but our data providers are still stuck in the past — with cumbersome onboarding processes, complicated APIs, slow infrastructure, and expensive licensing costs.

Databento is the market data platform for modern finance. The company provides real-time and historical data across futures, options, and equities through a unified API. By owning the entire market data stack end-to-end, Databento is the first platform of its kind to combine the performance and reliability demanded by the world's leading trading firms with a dramatically simpler developer experience. Our team includes alumni of Two Sigma, Citadel Securities, Flow Traders, IMC, Tower Research, Jump Trading, HRT, Jane Street, and SIG.

We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to make institutional-grade market data easy to use for everyone, from individual developers to large financial institutions. We grow through our product, so design matters at every stage of the user journey: discovery, onboarding, activation, and team-wide adoption. You'll shape experiences across our web app, docs, and new developer workflows.

You'll take on two types of work, from the blank page to the last pixel. The first is new features and initiatives. You'll take loosely defined problems from framing to launch, from how people find and access our data to how teams manage licenses, and help shape new business initiatives that take Databento into new markets, products, and customer segments. The second is high-stakes refinements. A routine update, like expanding our market coverage, can ripple across docs, the web app, and marketing pages. You'll refine these surfaces so every update is clear and leaves no room for confusion.

This is a high-ownership role on a small team. When a project doesn't have a PM, you'll step in to define the problem and move the work forward.

Responsibilities

  • Lead complex, ambiguous design projects from problem definition through launch and iterationAlign cross-functional stakeholders and drive decisions when the path forward isn't clear
  • Balance user needs, business goals, and technical constraints to make pragmatic design calls

jobs.description:
About 2hourglass

2hourglass is a fast, mobile window and door glass repair company based in Pennsylvania. Our technicians go to the customer's home or business and fix broken glass, foggy (failed-seal) glass and window hardware on site, often the same or next day. About 80% of our work is residential and 20% commercial.

Our promise is in the name: speed and certainty. Customers send a photo, get a price, and we fix the one window they need. We don't push them to replace five. That approach has earned us roughly 1,300 five-star Google reviews.

Our biggest opportunity is the homeowners who don't know their window can be repaired at all, so they live with it. Our new website is live. Over the next 6–12 months we're improving its conversion, sharpening our Google and Facebook ads, and launching email and SMS follow-up. Over the next 2–3 years we want a marketing machine that runs without depending on the founder. This role is the first step toward that.

This is a fantastic opportunity for a results-driven, hands-on person to join our team. The role is remote, part-time, and headquartered in Pennsylvania (US Eastern time).

The role

As our Marketing Coordinator, you'll plan, coordinate and carry out our marketing across the website, Google Ads, Facebook/Meta, email, SMS and reviews. You'll be our first and only in-house marketing person.

You'll work directly with the founder. He sets the strategy and big-picture goals; you own the day-to-day execution and keep projects moving. We also work with an outside marketing coach, so you'll have a clear plan and support.

Hours

Starts at 20 hours/week, with potential to grow toward full-time

Location

Remote; overlap with US Eastern business hours required

Reports to

Founder

Pay

[$25–35/hour] depending on experience

You'll need to organize, plan and structure your own workload. We don't have the time or the inclination to micromanage. You'll get a lot of freedom and a lot of responsibility.

What you'll do

  1. Website performance and metrics (top priority). Our new website is live. Track how it and our Google Ads landing pages perform (traffic, bounce rate, calls and quote requests) and make the adjustments the numbers call for: copy, offers, reviews and calls to action. Keep each county and service page current and working.
  2. Paid ads coordination. Support our Google Ads (people ready to book now) and Facebook/Meta ads (people who don't know repair is possible). Brief and manage ad creative, and work with any outside agency or freelancer.
  3. Content and social media. Plan and run a content calendar that teaches homeowners their broken, foggy or sticking windows can be repaired. Create, schedule and post content, reply to comments, and repurpose content across channels.
  4. Copywriting. Write and edit copy for the website, ads, emails, SMS and social posts in a clear, friendly, local-business voice.
  5. Email, SMS and CRM. Build and manage welcome, follow-up and reactivation campaigns in our CRM (Close). Re-engage stalled leads and past customers.
  6. Reviews and social proof. Turn our ~1,300 five-star Google reviews into marketing assets. Keep our Google Business Profile active and fresh.
  7. Offers and referrals. Help launch and promote a low-cost entry offer and simple referral and repeat-customer programs.
  8. Tracking and reporting. Maintain a weekly marketing dashboard: leads by source, cost per lead and per job, landing-page performance and ad return. Flag what's working and what isn't.
  9. Project management. Create and keep project timelines, manage freelancers and vendors, and make sure campaigns ship on time.
  10. Coordination with the team. Work with the founder and office team so marketing, lead follow-up and scheduling stay aligned.

Your first 90 days

By day 90, we should see clearly which marketing produces booked jobs, and the website should be converting better than at your start.

Timeframe

What success looks like

Days 1–30

You know our services, customers, brand and tools (Close CRM, website, ad accounts). Our weekly marketing dashboard is up to date. Stalled leads from Facebook have been followed up.

Days 31–60

You've set a baseline for website and landing-page conversion and made a first round of data-driven adjustments, such as stronger use of our reviews and the "send a photo, get a price" offer. A content calendar is running on Facebook.

Days 61–90

Website and landing-page conversion has improved against the day-30 baseline. Welcome and reactivation email/SMS sequences are live. The entry offer and a referral program are launched. You present a monthly results report to the founder.

What we're looking for

The six non-negotiables

  • Copywriting. You'll write for the web, ads, email, SMS and social media. Your writing must be excellent, and we'll ask for samples.
  • Tech-savvy. You don't need to be a technical expert, but you pick up new tools fast: CRMs, website builders, ad platforms, email tools and AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude or Perplexity.
  • Project management. You set deadlines, keep them, and move several projects forward at once.
  • Self-starter. Goals will be clear. Often it'll be up to you to decide what needs to happen, when and how, and then do it without being chased.
  • Teachable and coachable. We do marketing differently, and there's a lot to learn on the job. We hire mainly on attitude.
  • Leadership potential. You'll start as our only marketer. As you hit goals, we expect this role to grow into leading a small marketing team.

Nice to have

  • Experience marketing a local or home-services business (trades, cleaning, HVAC, roofing, real estate)
  • Hands-on experience with Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager or Google Business Profile
  • Experience with Close or a similar CRM, and with email/SMS automations
  • Basic design skills (Canva or similar) and basic video editing
  • Comfort with dashboards and numbers (Looker Studio, Airtable, Google Sheets)

Perks of the job

  • Fully remote, with flexible hours you set around US Eastern business hours
  • Starts at 20 hours/week, with potential to grow to full-time
  • Real ownership: your work goes live fast and you'll see its impact on booked jobs
  • Hands-on marketing and management experience, with coaching from an experienced marketing team
  • Pay: [$25–35/hour depending on experience]

jobs.description:
Who we are

At Domino, we build solutions that help the largest, highly regulated organizations adopt AI to accelerate mission-critical use cases. Our platform integrates a streamlined model and app development environment, advanced model, agent, and app hosting capabilities, and novel governance capabilities providing regulator-ready AI at scale. Our customers — like Johnson & Johnson, GSK, Bristol Myers, UBS, FINRA and the US Navy — are using our software to solve some of the most important challenges in the world, such as developing new medicines, securing our financial markets, or protecting our country. Backed by Sequoia Capital, Coatue Management, NVIDIA, Snowflake and other leading investors, we have been in business for over a decade but are still a small team operating with the spirit of a startup. In the world of AI today, we believe that the future is still being invented — and we want to be the ones building it. For more information, visit

What we are building

The Automation Team at Domino acts as a force multiplier for engineering, building the tools and systems that enable teams to ship code confidently and consistently. A core part of this mission is Tempest, an in-house platform that orchestrates realistic, long-duration workloads against live Kubernetes clusters and validates the results against real observability data. Today, when scale testing surfaces a bottleneck, a resource misconfiguration, or a regression in system behavior, the team can identify and report the issue — but we need someone who can take the next step: profiling services, tracing root causes through Prometheus and New Relic data, and partnering with platform engineers to drive durable fixes. Focused on iteration and continuous improvement, the team looks for targeted enhancements that create outsized impact, and this role will close the gap between detection and resolution at the infrastructure level.

What your impact will be

In your first year, you will:

  • Serve as the technical owner of Tempest, Domino's scale and reliability platform, ensuring it remains reliable, extensible, and aligned with evolving infrastructure needs
  • Diagnose and drive resolution of performance bottlenecks and resource misconfigurations surfaced by scale testing — working directly with platform and infrastructure teams to ship fixes, not just file tickets
  • Deliver accurate, data-driven sizing recommendations for customer-facing documentation based on rigorous empirical testing across deployment sizes
  • Strengthen observability across scale testing by improving Prometheus and New Relic instrumentation, making it faster to pinpoint root causes during and after multi-day load runs
  • Establish and operationalize scale testing on cloud platforms, ensuring appropriate sizing and configuration guidance for this increasingly divergent product line
  • Partner with platform teams to enable effective scale and reliability testing across additional cloud providers, helping position Domino for future multi-cloud success
  • Increase the efficiency and leverage of a small team by building infrastructure automation that scales operationally as the product and customer base grow

What we look for in this role

  • Background in SRE, platform engineering, or infrastructure with hands-on experience operating and troubleshooting distributed systems in production Kubernetes environments
  • Strong proficiency in Python and comfort working in a large, modular codebase that spans orchestration, infrastructure automation, and systems integration
  • Experience with observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, New Relic, or similar) — writing queries, building dashboards, and using metrics to diagnose performance and reliability issues at the systems level
  • Demonstrated ability to go beyond detection to resolution: profiling services, identifying resource bottlenecks, and working with engineering teams to ship durable fixes
  • Familiarity with performance and load testing methodologies (e.g., Locust, k6, or similar) as part of a broader infrastructure or reliability practice
  • Clear ownership mindset — self-directed, accountable, and able to communicate priorities and status effectively in a remote, async environment

What we value

  • We value a growth mindset. High-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and see the opportunities for success
  • We believe in individuals who seek truth and speak the truth and can be their whole selves at work
  • We value all of you that believe improving is always possible At Domino Everything is a work in progress – we can do better at everything

jobs.excerpt: NVIDIA has helped redefine what computers can do.
jobs.description:
NVIDIA has helped redefine what computers can do. Now, generative AI is opening new possibilities for how people learn, create, and tackle problems. Realizing that potential means answering some of the hardest questions in AI: Where do models fall short? Which risks are we missing? How do we know our safeguards are working? As an expert in machine learning for Evaluations, you’ll help establish the evidence that guides the next generation of safer AI. Your curiosity and scientific judgment can shape what we test, what we learn, and what we build next.


We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer / AI Researcher / Data Scientist to join our AI Safety and Responsibility efforts within Enterprise Risk Management. Engaging directly in engineering tasks, you will apply your data science and statistics skills. You will turn open research questions into rigorous benchmarks, inventive experiments, and tools that reveal how multimodal large language models behave under pressure. Working with researchers and platform engineers, you’ll connect those discoveries to better training methods and safeguards, with reproducible results that inform technical reviews and executive decisions. If you love asking the question no one has thought to test, and building a convincing way to answer it, come help us define what progress in AI safety looks like.


What You Will Be Doing:

  • Safety Benchmarking: Design and maintain safety benchmarks for large language and multimodal models, translating risk scenarios into test cases, datasets, and scoring rubrics.
  • Evaluation Methodology: Define metrics and protocols that assess safety alongside model usefulness, using baselines, uncertainty estimates, and failure analysis to distinguish meaningful improvements from noise.
  • Reproducible Evaluation: Build reusable Python pipelines with versioned datasets, model configurations, and experiment tracking to reproduce results and compare performance across model releases.
  • Automated Red-Teaming: Develop tools to discover failure modes and expand evaluation coverage, incorporating human review to validate automated scoring and provide additional judgment.
  • Failure Analysis: Investigate model failures with researchers, document actionable findings, and develop regression tests to assess whether model changes resolve identified issues.
  • Results and Communication: Partner with platform engineers to store and aggregate evaluation results, and clearly communicate findings, limitations, and emerging risks to researchers and decision-makers.

What We Need To See:

  • Education and Experience: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience, with 6+ years in the field of machine learning engineering or evaluation.
  • Evaluation Design: Experience developing benchmarks, metrics, and statistically sound comparisons for ML systems, including selecting baselines and interpreting uncertainty. Ability to translate ambiguous evaluation questions into testable experiments.
  • Engineering: Strong Python skills and experience building maintainable shared tools, data pipelines, and experiment-tracking workflows.
  • Analytical Rigor: Ability to assess dataset quality, identify limitations in metrics and scoring methods, and support conclusions with reproducible evidence.
  • Communication: Clearly explain findings and tradeoffs to researchers, engineering partners, and executives.

Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd:

  • Evaluation: Experience evaluating LLMs, multimodal models, or agentic systems through adversarial testing or automated red-teaming.
  • Community Contributions: Contributions to public benchmarks or evaluation frameworks.
  • Research Publications: A publication track record and interest in continuing to publish at top tier venues.
  • Human-Aligned Evaluation: Experience validating model-based evaluators against human judgments or designing human-in-the-loop evaluation workflows.
  • Statistical Rigor: Strong model evaluation skills and a commitment to sound statistical practices, including confidence intervals.
Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary ranges for this position are:
187,500 USD – 364,000 USD for Level 4; and 232,500 USD – 442,000 USD for Level 5.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

jobs.title: Customer Success Executive (APAC & Middle East)
jobs.excerpt: Our hotel partners across Asia are mid-shift while our UK team sleeps — and we're looking for a Customer Success Associate to be the in-region contact who picks up their questions and issues in their own time zone.
jobs.description:
Our hotel partners across Asia are mid-shift while our UK team sleeps — and we're looking for a Customer Success Associate to be the in-region contact who picks up their questions and issues in their own time zone.

The role at a glance
  • Title: Customer Success Associate
  • Location: Remote, based in Singapore (nearby APAC time zones considered), working mostly APAC hours
  • Compensation: £35,000 – £37,000 per year
  • Contract: 2-year contract
  • Team: Customer Success (APAC & Middle East pod), reporting to the Enterprise Customer Success Manager

This is an associate-level customer success role on our APAC & Middle East team, and it's built around two things.

  • You'll be our our in-region first response. When a property hits a problem overnight UK time, you pick it up, work with the hotel team and our in-region support, and hand the UK team a clear head start — rather than the hotel waiting for London to wake up.
  • You'll own the day-to-day relationship with our standard properties across a region of more than 120 hotels and 13 brands. That means support follow-through, re-onboarding properties that need it, and making sure every hotel gets real value from our platform.

Enterprise and Growth accounts sit with the Enterprise Customer Success Manager. You'll shadow and support that work as you learn, and take on more over time; this role is the in-region contact for standard properties.

Role Focus & Operating Context
You'll communicate with hoteliers the way great hoteliers talk to their guests. Every message is written by you, with care. You'll work mostly in APAC hours, with some overlap into UK afternoons — more at the start. You'll sit in a small regional pod alongside Product Solutions, Support and Sales, with property teams from front office to GM as your day-to-day contacts.

What you'll work on and own
  • The overnight queue — what happens when a property's guest messaging stops at 2am in London and you're the one awake
  • Standard property relationships — day-to-day contact with front office, guest relations, operations and GMs
  • Re-onboarding — showing property teams how the platform works, how to configure it and how to escalate
  • Adoption — playbooks rolled out property by property, starting with the lowest-usage sites
  • The regional read-out — a usage, adoption and support-trends dashboard reviewed monthly
  • Clean records — accurate Salesforce data and product feedback routed to the right team

Responsibilities

  • You'll be the named, same-time-zone contact for standard properties across APAC and the Middle East.
  • You'll pick up issues raised outside UK hours, work them with the property and in-region support, and hand the UK a clear head start.
  • You'll own tickets from standard properties alongside Support, escalating to the Enterprise Customer Success Manager when needed.
  • You'll re-onboard properties where gaps remain after deployment, so teams use the platform with confidence.
  • You'll roll out adoption playbooks property by property, starting with the lowest-usage sites, and build localised guides and training.
  • You'll shadow enterprise calls and pick up location-level work on Enterprise accounts as you learn.
  • You'll track usage, adoption and support trends in a regional dashboard, with a monthly read-out.
  • You'll flag at-risk properties early, so we keep the hotels we have.
  • You'll keep Salesforce accurate for every property you support.
  • You'll route product feedback and requests through Product Solutions intake.

Requirements

What you'll bring
  • Guest-facing experience in luxury hotel operations — front office, guest relations, guest experience or rooms division
  • Written and spoken English to luxury-hotel standard — you know how to write to a GM
  • A real understanding of how a property runs, shift to shift
  • Ownership — you take a problem from first message to resolution without being chased
  • Comfort with simple reporting and data (spreadsheets, PMS or CRM reports)
  • Confidence explaining technology to non-technical hotel teams
  • Based in Singapore or a nearby APAC time zone, and able to contract with Alliants from there
  • Availability to work mostly APAC hours, with some flexibility into UK afternoons
Nice to have
  • Customer success, onboarding or account support experience at a hospitality technology company
  • Hands-on use of Salesforce, Jira or Intercom
  • Experience running training for hotel teams
  • A regional language such as Mandarin, Arabic, Japanese, Bahasa or Thai
To thrive in this role, you'll be someone who:
  • Asks questions before jumping to a fix, and finds the real problem
  • Treats every hotelier like a valued guest
  • Uses usage data and ticket trends, not anecdote, to decide where to focus
  • Works confidently on your own and knows when to escalate
  • Adapts naturally across the cultures of APAC and the Middle East
  • Wants to understand how the technology works underneath

Benefits

Who is Alliants and what do we do?
Alliants, established in 2009, is dedicated to producing customer engagement technologies and services that pave the way for a more human, sustainable, and promising future for hospitality.

At Alliants, we are all in for our people and our industry.

What's in it for you?
We know we all work better in an autonomous, collaborative, diverse and equitable space. To support you in becoming the best version of yourself, we offer:
  • Remote, in region: work remotely from Singapore, mostly in APAC hours
  • Flexible hours: once you're settled in, a late day for the UK is balanced by a later start the next day
  • Time to learn: around six months to learn the platform, including shadowing enterprise calls
  • A regional team: work alongside our APAC & Middle East Customer Success and Product Solutions colleagues
  • A warm welcome: to celebrate you joining Alliants, we'll plant a Great Oak tree in your honour

Alliants celebrates diversity and is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Levanta is the creator affiliate platform built for modern e-commerce. You'll work closely with the Partner Development team (our agency-focused SDR function) to build and work a pipeline of target agencies, and you'll personally close the first few pieces of business — client referrals — that these new agencies send to Levanta. Agency Prospecting & Acquisition

  • Qualify inbound agency interest (contact-us form fills) and route or own outreach as appropriate
  • Own agency pipeline deal records end-to-end, progressing agencies through each stage of our partner acquisition funnel until we have several live clients.
  • Track and improve conversion rate and velocity at each stage, including the path to an agency's first few referrals and first few signed clients— the benchmark for "graduating" an agency into active growth status
  • Maintain ongoing activity (emails, meetings) with agencies throughout the acquisition phase to keep momentum through signing and first production
  • Collaborate with our agency enablement team to identify agencies that need additional upfront training and enablement to develop an affiliate marketing practice within their business. Guide the agency through that process, including completing a certification training.

Sales & Closing

  • Work referrals and client introductions that newly signed agencies send to Levanta through the full sales pipeline (pre-pipeline qualification, meeting held, conversion by stage, to closed-won)
  • Own and report on deal creation by source, conversion rate by stage, average deal size, closed deal count, and closed-won TCV for your book of acquisition-stage agencies
  • Be accountable to efficiency metrics for how quickly we successfully acquire a new agency partner.

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Partner with the Partner Development team to continuously refine targeting, messaging, and qualification criteria
  • Hand off productive agencies to the Agency Growth Manager with clean records and full context once they hit the growth benchmark
  • Collaborate with agency customer success to ensure the first few customers on Levanta are having a successful experience, which will aid in our ability to work with future customers of the agency.
  • Maintain a deep understanding of the affiliate, Amazon advertising, Walmart, and eCommerce ecosystems to keep Levanta ahead of industry trends and opportunities

What You'll Be Measured On

  • The primary goals will be signed TCV and the number of successfully onboarded new agencies.
  • TAM coverage: ICP-fit agencies identified vs. engaged
  • Prospecting activity and effectiveness (email, call, LinkedIn volume and reply/connect rates)
  • Agency pipeline conversion rate and velocity by stage
  • Ongoing acquisition-phase activity (emails sent, meetings held, active contacts per agency)
  • Agency sales pipeline performance: deal creation by source, pre-pipeline-to-meeting conversion, conversion rate by stage, average deal size, closed deal count, and closed-won TCV

What We're Looking For

  • Proven experience in partnership, business development, or sales roles within the Amazon, Affiliate, Performance Agency and/or eCommerce space
  • A strong network of contacts within Amazon agencies, performance marketing agencies, Affiliate agencies, and/or eCommerce agencies — or a demonstrated ability to build one quickly
  • Comfort owning both the prospecting/pipeline-building motion and the direct sales close
  • Strong understanding of the affiliate and/or Amazon/eCommerce ecosystem
  • Highly driven and motivated to achieve and exceed targets
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills
  • Experience working a CRM-based pipeline with defined stages, conversion rates, and activity metrics

What Levanta Offers:

  • A dynamic and supportive work environment where innovation and creativity are encouraged.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Open vacation and sick policy, take the time you need.
  • Opportunity for professional growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding startup.
  • A culture that values diversity, inclusion, and the impact of every team member on our success.
  • Must have a permanent address in one of our hub states: California, Florida, New York, Ohio, Utah, Texas, Michigan, Washington, Colorado, Massachusetts, North Carolina, Pennsylvania, or DC.

jobs.title: Consultant Senior - TransformationRH & SIRH
jobs.excerpt: Votre rôle Vous intervenez auprès de PME, ETI et grandes entreprises, du cadrage à la mise en œuvre opérationnelle de leurs projets.
jobs.description:
Votre rôle

Vous intervenez auprès de PME, ETI et grandes entreprises, du cadrage à la mise en œuvre opérationnelle de leurs projets.

Conseil et transformation métier RH

  • Réaliser des diagnostics des organisations, des pratiques et des processus RH ; identifier les irritants et les leviers de performance.
  • Animer des ateliers métiers, challenger les pratiques existantes et co-construire les processus cibles avec les référents métier.
  • Accompagner la définition des modèles opérationnels cibles : organisation, rôles et responsabilités, gouvernance, internalisation ou externalisation des activités.

Cadrage et transformation SIRH

  • Traduire les besoins métiers en exigences fonctionnelles, rédiger des cahiers des charges et accompagner la sélection de solutions et de prestataires.
  • Piloter ou accompagner opérationnellement les déploiements SIRH, en lien avec les équipes RH, IT, Finance, les éditeurs et les intégrateurs.
  • Coordonner la reprise des données, la recette métier, la préparation de la mise en production et la transition opérationnelle.

Chefferie de projet RH et SIRH

  • Piloter en autonomie des projets de transformation RH, avec ou sans composante SIRH : feuille de route, planning, budget, risques et dépendances.
  • Structurer et animer la gouvernance, coordonner les parties prenantes et préparer les arbitrages.
  • Anticiper les difficultés, mobiliser les expertises nécessaires et sécuriser la réalisation des projets.

Conduite du changement

  • Analyser les impacts humains, organisationnels et opérationnels des transformations.
  • Définir et mettre en œuvre les actions de communication, de formation et d’accompagnement adaptées aux populations concernées.
  • Favoriser l’adoption des nouveaux modes de fonctionnement et l’autonomie des équipes.

Une diversité de missions au-delà des RH

La transformation RH et SIRH constitue votre domaine de spécialisation privilégié, sans être votre unique terrain d’intervention. En fonction des besoins clients, vous serez également amené à intervenir sur d’autres projets de la practice : transformation organisationnelle, optimisation de processus métiers, pilotage de projets digitaux, évolution des modes de fonctionnement ou conduite du changement. Votre capacité à transposer vos méthodes de conseil à d’autres environnements métiers est essentielle.

Quelques exemples de missions

  • Pilotage transverse du déploiement d’un SIRH de gestion des temps et activités et de l’externalisation de la paie.
  • Cadrage des besoins et rédaction d’un cahier des charges pour la sélection d’un SIRH et d’un prestataire de paie.
  • Diagnostic et optimisation des processus RH en vue du renouvellement d’un SIRH.
  • Accompagner la transformation de la filière RH d’un grand Groupe

Votre contribution au développement du cabinet

  • Contribuer au développement des offres RH/SIRH, aux avant-ventes et à la rédaction des propositions commerciales.
  • Capitaliser sur les missions, enrichir les méthodes et outils et partager vos connaissances.
  • Accompagner les consultants moins expérimentés et contribuer aux initiatives collectives de la practice.

Votre profil

Vous vous retrouvez dans ces points…

  • Vous êtes diplômé d’une formation supérieure de niveau Bac+5 et justifiez d’au moins 4 ans d’expérience dans le conseil, la transformation RH/SIRH ou au sein d’une direction RH avec une forte dimension projet.
  • Vous disposez d’une solide compréhension du fonctionnement d’une DRH, de ses enjeux stratégiques et opérationnels et de ses principaux processus : administration du personnel, paie, gestion des temps, recrutement, formation, talents, notamment.
  • Vous savez appréhender les besoins métiers au-delà de leur traduction dans un outil, identifier les impacts organisationnels et proposer des améliorations adaptées.
  • Vous avez contribué activement à au moins un déploiement SIRH jusqu’à sa mise en production, idéalement depuis le cadrage. Vous maîtrisez les principales étapes du déploiement et comprenez les interactions entre les processus RH, le SI et les autres fonctions de l’entreprise.
  • Vous maîtrisez les fondamentaux de la gestion de projet et savez animer des ateliers, formaliser des besoins et produire des livrables structurés.
  • Vous êtes capable et avez envie d’intervenir sur des problématiques de transformation en dehors du périmètre RH/SIRH.

On peut dire de vous que vous avez…

  • Une posture de conseil, une capacité à questionner les besoins et à formuler des recommandations argumentées.
  • De solides capacités d’analyse, de synthèse et de rédaction.
  • Une aisance relationnelle et une capacité à instaurer une relation de confiance avec des interlocuteurs variés.
  • De l’autonomie, de la rigueur, un sens des responsabilités et une capacité à anticiper.
  • De la curiosité intellectuelle, de l’adaptabilité et un esprit collectif.

Les expériences complémentaires appréciées

Une expérience en cabinet de conseil, en sélection de solutions, en externalisation RH, en conduite du changement ou en avant-vente constitue un atout. La connaissance de plusieurs solutions SIRH et la pratique de l’anglais professionnel sont également appréciées.

Rejoignez-nous !

Vous souhaitez mettre votre connaissance du métier RH au service de transformations concrètes, élargir votre champ d’intervention et contribuer au développement d’une activité de conseil ? Rejoignez notre practice People & Transformation.

Entité

Orange Consulting accompagne les entreprises et les institutions dans leurs enjeux métiers, organisationnels et de transformation digitale, de la définition de leur stratégie à sa mise en œuvre opérationnelle. Rejoindre notre cabinet, c’est bénéficier d’un environnement à taille humaine, collaboratif et ouvert sur les expertises du Groupe Orange.

Au sein de la practice People & Transformation, nous accompagnons nos clients dans l’évolution de leurs organisations, de leurs modes de fonctionnement et de leurs pratiques, en plaçant l’humain au cœur des transformations.

Dans le cadre du développement de notre activité, nous recherchons un Consultant Senior disposant d’une solide culture métier RH et d’une expérience concrète de déploiement SIRH. Au-delà des outils, vous comprenez les enjeux opérationnels des directions RH, savez challenger leurs besoins et les accompagner jusqu’à la mise en œuvre de solutions adaptées.

Turner & Townsend is seeking to appoint a new Sustainability Program Manager forthe Americas Regionto provide Sustainability Services to Projects in the region, in support of the Workplace Infrastructure, Sustainability and Accessibility (WISA) Regional Partners (The Client). The role works with the Global Sustainability Program Management Lead, other regional Program Managers and the client (WISA Regional Partner) across the Americas region (excluding the Bay Area) to support pipeline and active projects.

The Sustainability Program Manager will be responsible for overseeing Sustainability services delivery for global technology client in the region on new capital projects, track and report compliance as well as working with stakeholders to develop Sustainability standards to improve efficiency, operation and best practices across the portfolio.

The role will ensure that the Sustainability Design Requirements on given Projects are identified early, agreed upon, tracked and reported on throughout the project lifecycle in accordance with client established processes. The role involves multiple touch points with the Program and Project Managers, the appointed Design Teams and the Google WISA Regional Partners (Client), who are accountable for the successful implementation and reporting of the Sustainability requirements.

What you'll do

  • Provide an overview to project teams on SWS-TI requirements and WISA standards (as needed).
  • Manage the Project Specific Brief (PSB) process for WISA sustainability workstream across the project lifecycle including project kick-off, during project delivery, to close-out.
  • Create a single source document for WISA to monitor, track and analyze all in-flight PSBs to ensure all sustainability deadlines are met. (e.g., there are currently over 160 in flight PSBs in our global portfolio; each region manages a component of this scope).
  • Leverage existing data insights (SWS, SPH, Environmental Reports) to inform discretionary recommendations (WISA RP approval required) Attend PSB meetings (kick-off and alignments) to ensure the project is aligned with baseline standards. Provide project milestone reviews of Sustainability SWS-TI deliverables (SD, DD, CD, Close-Out...) and review with the WISA Regional Partner for all projects following the D2D model.
  • Facilitate regular coordination as needed with regional vendor teams (i.e. Design Teams) to support regional compliance and reporting.
  • Escalate issues to WISA RP, as appropriate.
  • Facilitate regular coordination, as needed, with Regional Program Managers and Local Project Managers to ensure SWS-TI project compliance. (Request meetings with the Consultant, clarify project scope, seek GE approval for exemptions, etc.).
  • Building List Management: Perform quarterly building list checks for TI projects to ensure dashboard accuracy.
  • Leadership and hands-on position to assist client and the Project Team deliver against established project programming, governance and delivery strategy in line with the broader Google’s Sustainability goals.
  • Deliver services that meet business objectives & Turner & Townsend KPIs (program delivery, quality, stakeholder engagement, process efficiency, client satisfaction, innovation).
  • Arrange/undertake training of the local Project teams to ensure their understanding of the processes/standards.

What you'll need

  • Bachelor's degree in Sustainability, Environmental Science, Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, Business, or a related field required; Master's degree preferred. Professional credentials such as LEED AP, WELL AP, ENV SP, PE, RA, PMP, or equivalent sustainability certifications are highly desirable.
  • 8-12 years of experience leading sustainability, ESG, decarbonization, energy management, workplace, real estate, construction, or capital project programs across multiple geographies.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and implementing regional sustainability strategies, governance frameworks, performance metrics, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Strong leadership experience influencing cross-functional teams and stakeholders across business units, real estate, facilities, design, construction, procurement, and operations.
  • Proven ability to manage complex programs, establish priorities, drive accountability, and achieve sustainability targets across large portfolios.
  • Experience supporting corporate sustainability reporting, carbon reduction initiatives, energy efficiency programs, renewable energy strategies, waste reduction, water conservation, and environmental compliance efforts.
  • Ability to communicate complex sustainability objectives and performance data to executive leadership, clients, and diverse stakeholder groups.
  • Advanced knowledge of sustainability frameworks and standards, including ESG reporting, GHG accounting, carbon management, LEED, WELL, ENERGY STAR, ISSB, GRI, CDP, and Science Based Targets initiatives.
  • Advanced proficiency in Google Suite, Power BI, with experience utilizing sustainability reporting and analytics platforms.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into actionable business insights.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, facilitation, and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Ability to lead strategic initiatives across multiple countries and cultures within a fast-paced, matrixed environment.
  • Demonstrated commitment to innovation, operational excellence, and advancing sustainability outcomes at scale.

About Orium

Orium builds smart, modern commerce solutions for enterprise brands. We're the leading composable commerce consultancy and systems integrator in the Americas, with more composable launches than any firm in the region, and a member of the MACH Alliance. We combine AI, data and composable systems so people and intelligent agents can work together, and we partner with best-in-class technology providers including commercetools, Stripe and Contentstack across three lines of business: Commerce, DXP and Agentic.

We're a remote-first company with team members across the Americas. A certified BCorp for over a decade, we're based in Toronto, and in June 2024 we acquired the Mexico-based ecommerce agency Gluo.

About the Opportunity

Orium is seeking a senior Strategic Account Manager to be the trusted partner for some of our most important enterprise clients. You'll own a small portfolio of complex accounts, be the person clients call when things get hard, and help them see their problems in a new way.

You're at your best in the room with senior stakeholders, whether you're leading a workshop, resetting expectations or making the case for what comes next. You'd rather go deep with a handful of clients than chase new logos, and you measure success by the trust you earn and the accounts you grow.

Responsibilities

  • Own 5 to 8 priority enterprise accounts as the main commercial contact and trusted advisor
  • Act as the senior escalation point, leading honest conversations when expectations, scope or budgets need resetting, and getting relationships back on track
  • Lead and participate in client workshops, steering committees, roadmap planning and quarterly business reviews, challenging assumptions and reframing problems when a client is heading the wrong way
  • Drive account growth through renewals and expansion across our Commerce, DXP and Agentic practices, including partner-led opportunities with commercetools, Stripe and Contentstack
  • Shape new opportunities with our delivery and strategy teams, from problem statement through pitch and SOW
  • Help clients move from project work into ongoing optimization and managed services
  • Develop and maintain account plans and forecasts in partnership with sales leadership
  • Maintain strong working relationships with delivery teams to keep engagements on scope, high quality and aligned to client goals and KPIs
  • Use AI tools for account research, meeting prep and opportunity spotting
  • Travel to meet clients and partners across the Americas as needed

Skills and Qualifications

  • 5+ years in client-facing, revenue-accountable roles such as Account Director, Client Partner, Strategic Account Manager or Customer Success leader
  • Experience at a professional services firm, agency, systems integrator or B2B SaaS company
  • A track record of managing senior enterprise relationships through difficult moments, and coming out with more trust than before
  • Experience working with B2B clients
  • Confidence leading workshops and executive conversations, and the creativity to turn what a client asks for into a better problem to solve
  • Proven ability to grow accounts through renewals and expansion, and comfort owning a revenue number
  • Strong commercial judgment across scope, margin and forecast
  • Knowledge of the digital commerce landscape, including composable commerce, modular DXP and emerging AI and agentic technologies, is an asset
  • Experience with modern digital tools and an openness to integrating AI-powered solutions into your daily work*
  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to critically evaluate AI-assisted decisions and workflows*
  • A mindset of continuous learning and the ability to adapt quickly to new technologies and trends*
  • Based in Canada

*AI expectations will vary by role. Some positions focus on AI exploration and experimentation, while leadership roles may drive AI adoption and strategy.

Is this Role a Fit for You?

The role emphasizes trusted client relationships, commercial acumen and creative problem solving. We value people with a maker's attitude, collaborative energy and entrepreneurial spirit. You'll find fulfillment in the role if you...

  • Are passionate about client relationships. You can't sleep properly if we might miss a commitment, and you're the first to pick up the phone when something goes sideways.
  • Stay calm and direct in hard conversations. You know that honest, well-timed conversations build more trust than avoiding them.
  • Love reframing the problem. You get curious about the need behind the request and enjoy helping clients see a better path forward.
  • Have an interest in making the business work. You're an entrepreneur at heart and see account growth as the result of delivering real value.
  • Prefer depth over volume. You'd rather build long-term relationships with a few clients than chase new logos.
  • Thoroughly enjoy collaborative work. You partner closely with delivery, strategy and sales, and you put the team's success first.
  • Are naturally curious about AI. You look for ways to use AI and automation to work smarter, without losing the human touch.

Benefits and Perks

  • Enjoy a flexible schedule of full-time hours. As a remote-first organization, we care about the work you do, but it's up to you to choose where and how you do it.
  • Explore ongoing opportunities for professional development: training, conferences, certifications and in-house peer mentorship.
  • Experiment with new techniques, wear multiple hats and learn about new disciplines.
  • Pursue independent projects, explore new ideas and challenge yourself in your field with dedicated "Awesome Time" (self-directed professional development) annually and quarterly training budgets.

jobs.excerpt: Company Overview At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people.
jobs.description:
Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.


Department Overview

Motorola Solutions is a leading global Public Safety and Government communications technology solutions provider committed to creating maximum value for our customers by providing competitive solutions and services.
A new role has arisen within the Pre Sales organisation for a Europe Pre Sales Technical Architect.
The Pre Sales organisation provides technical and bid management support to the Sales teams within Europe enabling the delivery of compelling and winning proposals and solutions. This team provides support for the full range of solutions and technologies including:
- Opportunities for Motorola’s traditional core radio products and services, e.g. TETRA (DIMETRA), APCO P25 (ASTRO), DMR (MOTOTRBO).
- Opportunities with complex systems integration requirements often requiring significant 3rd party content
- Opportunities for new Motorola products and solutions, e.g. Broadband comms (MCX), Body Worn Video (BWV), Fixed Video (CCTV), HF comms, etc.


Job Description

Scope of Responsibilities/Expectations:

We are looking for a Pre Sales Technical Architect with a proven track-record on the following competencies:

  • Engagement with customers to fully understand problems and requirements, demonstrating deep knowledge of the customer’s problem space and solutions.
  • Requirements analysis of complex customer problems to determine compelling technology and service offerings.
  • Design of technology and service-based solutions, including generation of high-level designs, bill-of-materials, their documentation and management of the review process of these designs.
  • Presenting solution designs and implementation possibilities to potential customers based on both theoretical and practical implementation experiences.
  • Ability to build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders (e.g. such customer's key organisations like MoI, MoD and other agencies).
  • Ability to conduct demonstrations of Motorola products and solutions.
  • Supporting the procurement organisation to obtain and evaluate quotations from 3rd party equipment vendors.
  • Leading all technical sales activities related to assigned sales opportunities.
  • Working closely with the entire bid team to ensure overall customer objectives and strategy is maintained
  • In the short term, pre-sales support for the German Sales team, focusing on Body Worn Video solutions, mainly in the DACH region
  • In the long term, pre-sales support for the entire Europe, covering the majority of Motorola's solutions and technologies


Basic Requirements

Specific Knowledge/Skills:

  • A University Bachelor’s degree or similar (preferably in communications, computer science, software engineering or a similar field).
  • Generic knowledge about radio communications and IP networks.
  • Experience in a Pre Sales technical role, including tender answering.
  • Strong communication skills, both written and spoken. German and English are mandatory. Other European languages are desirable.
  • Ability to initiate and build solid working relationships and to be self-motivated, results-oriented and operate with minimal supervision
  • Motorola Solutions product portfolio experience and/or relevant experience in key competitor offerings is highly desirable
  • Experience in the following domains is highly desirable:
    - Body Worn Video (BWV) products and solutions
    - Mission Critical Mobile Broadband communications (MCX), including 3GPP
    - Land Mobile Radio technologies (TETRA, APCO P25, DMR)
    - Complex systems integration often requiring significant 3rd party content
    - HF Radio communications

The desired location for this position is either a Motorola office, hybrid or offsite in Germany.

German citizenship is mandatory.

The position assumes eventual travelling (up to 25%) to other MSI sites and customer locations within Europe if specific projects, customer meetings and demonstrations require.

A bit about Health & Happiness
At Health & Happiness (H&H), our vision is focused on premium nutrition and lifetime wellness; to inspire and achieve this vision we bring together seven international brands as we strive to make people around the world healthier and happier. We have established market positions in countries in Asia-Pacific, Europe, North America and Oceania with more than 2,700 employees working across the globe. We are excited about our future as we expand these premium, proven and aspirational brands to new markets, greeting consumers in all life stages.

Zesty Paws® specializes in providing premium products that are formulated with one important goal in mind – to keep our loving pets as strong as the bond they share with us. With a company culture rooted in passion, quality, transparency, and innovation, we are committed to making wellness more achievable and enjoyable for the four-legged member of your family.
Solid Gold was founded in 1974 on the belief that food can support the system at its core for lifelong health. That’s why we are so passionate about supporting the system, not masking problems. Solid Gold takes a holistic approach to gut health because we know that healthy digestion positively impacts both the immune system and overall wellness of pets. We proudly represent our products in specialty pet stores across the US and Canada
What this means for you

The variety of work creates unlimited opportunities to excel across a breadth of disciplines; you will be presented with a wealth of new pathways and opportunities to explore throughout your career. Working with us will be more than just a job; we guarantee a life-changing experience as you step into an environment that moves quickly and presents new challenges daily.

Our success as an organization is directly attributed to the health and happiness of our team. As a new team member, you will be empowered to positively contribute to our high-impact culture and be supported in bringing your whole self to work.
Your role within the team

We are looking for a driven, analytical, and commercially minded Junior DTC Manager to help grow and optimize our direct-to-consumer (DTC) business across our portfolio of pet food and pet supplement brands. The Junior DTC Manager, will play an important role in driving online revenue, improving conversion rates, enhancing the customer experience, and increasing customer retention and lifetime value. Working cross-functionally with marketing, creative, operations, and external agency partners, this individual will help execute our DTC strategy while identifying opportunities to improve performance and scale the business.

Key Responsibilities

· Support the execution of the DTC strategy to drive online sales, customer engagement and profitable growth.
· Own the DTC channel end to end, from site and merchandising to promotions, email and subscriptions.
· Plan and execute the DTC promotional calendar, aligned with brand priorities and margin goals.

· Manage the email and SMS campaign calendar and lifecycle flows (welcome, post-purchase, replenishment, win-back).
· Manage the subscription program, including offer structure, subscriber experience and churn reduction.
· Brief, manage and hold external agency and vendor partners accountable on scope, timelines and KPIs.

· Support new product and brand launches on DTC, from planning through go-live and post-launch optimization.
· Monitor site performance and key DTC KPIs, turning data and customer insights into clear recommendations and actions.

· Help optimize the customer journey through ongoing improvements to site experience, UX, content and personalization.
· Support forecasting, promotional planning and performance reporting across DTC channels.

· Partner with Marketing, Operations, Customer Service and other teams to ensure campaigns and trading plans are delivered effectively.

· Work with relevant team members and platforms to maintain a high-quality, reliable eCommerce experience.
· Monitor competitors, market trends and emerging eCommerce capabilities, bringing forward ideas for testing and improvement.

· Support a test-and-learn approach, tracking results and applying learnings to future activity.
· Contribute to projects that strengthen our DTC capabilities, processes and operating model as the channel grows.

How Success Is Measured: Net sales revenue vs. plan, conversion rate and average order value (AOV), subscription attach rate, active subscribers and churn, repeat purchase rate and customer lifetime value (LTV), email/SMS revenue and campaign performance

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

· Approximately 2-4 years of relevant eCommerce, DTC or digital trading experience.

· Hands-on familiarity with eCommerce platforms; Shopify experience would be highly valuable.
· Commercial mindset with an interest in driving online growth and improving the customer experience.

· Hands-on experience managing a subscription program on an eCommerce platform (Ordergroove, Skio, Recharge or similar).
· Experience running promotional calendars and email/SMS campaigns (Klaviyo or similar a plus).
· Proven experience managing agencies or external vendors.

· Experience supporting product or brand launches is a plus.

· Comfortable working with data, KPIs and reporting to identify trends and opportunities.

Benefits

  • Medical, vision, and dental insurance
  • HSA options
  • 6% 401(k) match
  • Short- and long-term disability insurance
  • 3 annual wellness days
  • 20 PTO days + 10 sick days annually
  • Monthly fitness stipend
  • Opportunities for continued education & professional development
  • Perks for your fur friends, including product stipends and pet insurance discounts

jobs.description:
Omada Health is on a mission to bend the curve of chronic disease.

Job overview:

Omada has built a leading position with employers, health plans, and PBMs. Our next chapter of growth includes the Medicare / Medicare Advantage plans, where chronic conditions are most prevalent and where virtual-first, human-led care can make the biggest difference. We are seeking an accomplished Medicare Advantage leader to build and lead this vertical.

Reporting to the Vice President of Channel Sales & Channel Growth, you will own the strategy, pipeline, and new business across Medicare Advantage (MA) plans and unique Medicare opportunities.. This is a builder and high-level business development sales role. You will bring an established network, a proven record of business development expertise and closing in highly regulated markets, and the judgment to turn a large opportunity into a repeatable growth engine. You will help shape how Omada competes and wins in Medicare.

Your impact:

Build the Medicare Advantage Vertical

  • Define and execute a multi-year go-to-market strategy for MA including target segments, priority accounts, value proposition, sequencing, and investment needs.
  • Own operational and functional cross-functional collaboration across Omada to help build this channel successfully.
  • Own new business and expansion bookings and Covered Lives across MA plans translating Channel Growth priorities into clear targets and execution plans.
  • Build a disciplined pipeline across national, regional, and provider-sponsored MA plans, Special Needs Plans (D-SNP/C-SNP), with rigorous forecasting and CRM management.
  • Balance near-term wins with long-term market-making, including multi-year pursuits and procurement cycles typical of this segment's buying cycles.

Win with Medicare Advantage Plans

  • Bring and build trusted executive relationships across MA plan leadership, including Medicare/Government Programs, Stars and Quality, Clinical and Care Management, Risk Adjustment, Supplemental Benefits, Member Experience, and Product.
  • Position Omada's cardiometabolic, GLP-1, and musculoskeletal offerings against MA plan priorities: Stars and CAHPS performance, medication adherence, total cost of care, member engagement and retention, supplemental benefit differentiation, and value-based arrangements.
  • Lead complex, multi-stakeholder deals from prospecting, discovery, first meeting all the way through contract, including pilots, performance guarantees, and value-based or risk-aligned pricing structures.

Shape Medicare Policy and Market Positioning

  • Serve as a senior voice of the Medicare and government market, bringing buyer, regulatory, competitive, and reimbursement insight into commercial, product, and clinical strategy.
  • Partner with Policy and Government Affairs on CMS and CMMI engagement, including the Medicare Diabetes Prevention Program (MDPP), Innovation Center models, and annual rulemaking (Rate Announcement, Physician Fee Schedule, Stars measure changes), and turn policy shifts into commercial opportunities.
  • Represent Omada externally as a thought leader at priority MA related industry events.

Drive Enterprise Alignment

  • Bring the voice of the Medicare member into Product, Clinical, Member Experience, and Operations decisions, including accessibility, device and technology needs for older adults, and compliance requirements.
  • Partner across Payer Sales and Alliances, Marketing, Finance, Legal, Analytics to remove barriers to growth and ensure successful launch and expansion.
  • Translate market insights into clear, actionable recommendations for Omada's leadership team to drive growth in this channel

About you:

  • 12+ years of progressive experience in healthcare sales, business development, or commercial leadership, including 7+ years focused on Medicare Advantage, Medicare, or government health programs.
  • An established, active network of senior relationships across national and regional MA plans, plus working relationships within CMS/CMMI.
  • Proven success personally closing large, complex, multi-year contracts with MA plans and/or government entities, not only building pipeline but signing, launching, and expanding deals.
  • Deep knowledge of MA plan economics and operations, including Stars/HEDIS/CAHPS, risk adjustment, supplemental benefits, the bid cycle, care management, and value-based contracting.
  • Working fluency in federal procurement and compliance, including contracting vehicles, security and privacy requirements, and long sales cycles with multiple decision-makers.
  • Experience in digital health, virtual care, population health, chronic condition management, or healthcare services selling into payers or government.
  • Exceptional executive presence, communication, and cross-functional influence. Comfortable building structure in an emerging business and operating as a player-coach.

Bonus points for:

  • Prior experience at an MA plan, CMS/CMMI, or government related healthcare procurement entities..
  • Experience building a new vertical or line of business from early pilots to scaled contracts at a high-growth company.
  • Experience with Special Needs Plans (D-SNP, C-SNP), dual-eligible populations, or Medicare-Medicaid integration.
  • Familiarity with MDPP, CMMI models, or other Medicare reimbursement pathways for virtual or preventive care.
  • Experience with cardiometabolic care, GLP-1 therapy programs, or Part D/pharmacy-adjacent solutions.
  • Deep operating knowledge of MEDDPICC or a comparable enterprise sales qualification framework.
  • Experience selling into state employee health plans or other public-sector benefit programs.

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary with generous annual cash bonus
  • Equity grants
  • Employee stock purchasing plan (ESPP)
  • Remote first work from home culture
  • Flexible Time Off to help you rest, recharge, and connect with loved ones
  • Generous parental leave

  • Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA)
  • Mental Health Support Solutions
  • ...and more!

It takes a village to change health care. As we build together toward our mission, we strive to embody the following values in our day-to-day work. We hope these hold meaning for you as well as you consider Omada!

  • Cultivate Trust. We listen closely and we operate with kindness. We provide respectful and candid feedback to each other.

AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit . Come join us.

About the Team:

Our diverse Product & Engineering team values innovation, collaboration, and the continuous improvement of our platform. We offer a dynamic work environment where employees can grow and thrive while working on cutting-edge technology that shapes the future of AI and search.

At AlphaSense, we believe that diverse experiences and perspectives are critical to our success. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees feel valued and empowered to be their authentic selves.

About the Role:

Investors and analysts open our app between meetings, on a train, before a call, and act on what they see. Mobile releases go through app stores and cannot be rolled back, so a problem can stay in customers' hands for days.

Our mobile product is growing fast, with new AI workflows arriving on iPhone, iPad and Android at the pace of the rest of the platform. Our quality practice has real foundations, including Appium and native UI test suites and real-device runs, but our newest features are ahead of our automated coverage, and release confidence still depends too much on individual effort.

As Staff Quality Engineer, you own one question: can we ship mobile with confidence, every release, on all platforms? You decide what we test and what we deliberately leave out, and you turn what you build into a way of working that Mobile Engineering owns with you.

You will report to the head of Quality Engineering and work day to day with the iOS and Android teams, alongside backend, web and platform QE.

What Makes this a Staff role:

  • You set direction, not a task list. Nobody hands you a test plan. You look at the product, the release risk and the team, and decide what matters most and why.
  • You own the outcome across platforms. Your scope is the quality of the product across clients, not one app or one team.
  • You work through influence. You are an individual contributor. Your standards stick because engineers see their value, and success means they write more testable code, make better release calls and need you less over time.

What You’ll Do:

  • Define mobile quality strategy. Set the long-term strategy built on "Quality by Design" and "Automation by Default": test layers, device and OS matrix, and release criteria for iOS and Android.
  • Set metrics the team can act on. Define quality metrics and coverage standards with Mobile Engineering and Product, so quality is measurable and sustainable without you.
  • Turn release day into a clear call. With no instant rollback, own the quality gates, staged rollouts and evidence behind every go or no-go decision.
  • Connect mobile to the rest of the platform. Mobile shares APIs and services with web, and customers update apps slowly, so changes elsewhere can break mobile after they have shipped. You are accountable for that risk.
  • Make the test platform dependable. Keep real-device and CI runs stable and fast (Bitrise, BrowserStack, GitLab, Allure), including test data and enterprise (Intune/MDM) builds.
  • Use AI where it earns its place. Use tools such as Claude Code, Cursor or Copilot yourself, and help the team decide where they help and where human judgment must lead.
  • Leave the team stronger. Coach engineers and QEs, review designs for testability, and leave behind standards other teams adopt.

What Success looks like:

  • First 90 days: You have audited current coverage, agreed a prioritized plan with Mobile Engineering and delivered your first measurable improvement.
  • By 6 months: Critical mobile journeys are covered in the right layers on both platforms, and release readiness is an evidence-based call.
  • By 12 months: Mobile quality is a practice the team owns, and other portfolios borrow your ideas.

Who You Are:

  • A quality engineer with 8+ years of experience, including 2+ at Staff or Lead level. You have connected quality strategy across web and mobile, not just worked on mobile alone, and set direction across several teams or apps as an individual contributor without people-management authority. You can show what changed because of it.
  • Strong hands-on experience testing native mobile apps on at least one platform (iOS or Android), with working knowledge of the other. You are comfortable with real-device cloud and CI/CD for mobile builds, can work with tools such as XCUITest, Espresso, Compose UI testing or Appium, and code in at least one language such as Kotlin, Java, Swift or Python.
  • Strong debugging skills across the mobile stack, from crash reports to network traces, and a good understanding of how mobile releases move through the app stores.
  • Excellent test design and API testing, and comfortable in the backend: you can read APIs, debug across the client and service boundary, and work with contracts.
  • Strong understanding of continuous delivery and release gating, with experience in test management systems such as Allure TestOps.
  • An active AI tool user, with examples of where it helped and where it fell short.
  • Practical about trade-offs, and able to explain a release call to engineers and to non-technical leaders.

Bonus points:

  • Enterprise mobile experience (MDM/MAM, Intune, SSO, mobile security standards such as OWASP MASVS).
  • Experience building a mobile quality practice from an early stage.
  • Mobile performance testing (app start time, memory, battery) and release monitoring (crash and performance signals, staged rollouts).
  • Experience across both iOS and Android.

What we offer:

  • Playing a part in the story of a fast-growing company
  • Competitive compensation package
  • Lunch and recreational benefits
  • Occupational health care

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.


In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.


Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.

Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).

At Leidos Australia, our work goes beyond a job title. We design, build, operate and support the systems, services and capabilities that help protect and advance the Australian way of life.


Backed by a global organisation of more than 40,000 people, our Australian team of around 2,000 has partnered with government, defence and national security customers for more than 30 years. We deliver mission-critical solutions where reliability, trust and purpose matter.


Leidos is a destination for people who want their work to have purpose, their contribution to be recognised, and their career to grow without needing to fit a single mould. Our Corporate Cyber Security team plays a critical role in protecting Leidos' global enterprise environment, ensuring the security of cloud platforms, collaboration technologies, business applications and corporate data.

This role will focus on securing enterprise cloud platforms including Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365 and AWS. Working alongside global cyber security, infrastructure and cloud engineering teams, you will help design, implement and operate security capabilities that protect Leidos' worldwide enterprise environment.

  • Provide guidance on cloud security architectures, shared responsibility models and cloud provider security capabilities.

  • Identify opportunities to automate security processes and improve operational efficiency.
  • Contribute to cloud security roadmaps and strategic initiatives that strengthen Leidos' cyber security posture globally.

We are looking for someone who brings judgement, curiosity and a collaborative approach to work that matters.

  • 5+ years' experience in Cyber Security, Cloud Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering or a related technical discipline.

  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365 security services, cloud-native security controls and shared responsibility models.

  • Solid understanding of networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, DNS, routing, firewalls and secure network design.

Advantageous, but not essential:


  • Experience with Microsoft Defender, Sentinel, Entra ID governance, Conditional Access and MFA.
  • Knowledge of CASB, cloud governance, logging, monitoring and enterprise-scale cloud security architecture.
  • Exposure to Infrastructure as Code, scripting or automation tools such as Terraform, Ansible, PowerShell or Python.
  • Experience across multi-cloud environments including Azure, AWS or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Relevant certifications such as Azure Security Engineer, Cybersecurity Architect, AWS Security Specialty, CCSP or CISSP are highly regarded.
