jobs.description:
Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes. Through our unparalleled science, data, technology and laboratory network, we advance diagnostics, accelerate innovation and help address some of the world’s most important health challenges. As we shape the future of healthcare, we are leveraging advanced technologies, intelligent digital solutions and data-driven innovation across our operations to enhance how work gets done and deliver greater value to customers and patients. With our global scale and deep expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people’s health around the world. Together, we’re improving health and improving lives.


Labcorp is seeking a Senior Manager, HR M&A to join our team.


Primary Responsibilities:

  • Leads the HR workstream for assigned M&A projects from diligence through integration, partnering with Division/Functional HRBPs and HR COEs to coordinate all HR efforts and to identify and reduce operational HR risks.
  • Provides expertise, strategic consulting as well as thought leadership to help drive effective people strategies for each deal and influence deal negotiations accordingly.
  • Analyzes target company data to identify key HR-related financial exposures in a due diligence context, including those related to compensation and benefits plans.
  • Review and provide input on purchase agreements, disclosure schedules, presentation materials, employee communications.
  • Build and manage detailed project management plans for M&A transactions, from diligence to integration, coordinating HR COE activities to meet deal timeline. Manages multiple concurrent deals.
  • Lead HR team meetings, serve as HR functional lead on diligence calls, develop HR integration plan for IMO team. Owns the HR integration plan and Day 1 / Day 30 deliverables.
  • Provide input on HR best practices on processes that will be utilized during all merger and/or acquisition initiatives, both domestic and international, continuously improving the deal execution and integration processes utilizing integration checklists, project templates, best practices and project management tools pertaining to HR.
  • Serves as the primary point of contact between Labcorp HR and Seller HR throughout the transaction lifecycle, building trusted relationships and managing information requests, data exchanges and transition decisions.
  • Leads discovery of the seller's HR, payroll, compensation, benefits, leave and HR policy practices. Documents current-state vs. Labcorp gaps and recommends transition approaches.
  • Partners with Total Rewards, Compensation, and Payroll COEs to plan employee moves to Labcorp benefit plans, pay practices and payroll, including timing, transition service agreements (TSAs) and any bridge or harmonization strategies.
  • Coordinates Workday data conversion, onboarding and Day 1 readiness for acquired employees.
  • Develops employee communications, FAQs and manager toolkits with HRBPs, and supports town halls and change management.
  • Tracks integration milestones, risks and decisions, and, in partnership with the lead HRBP, reports status to HR leadership and the Integration Management Office (IMO).

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 6+ years of HR experience, including experience in mergers and acquisitions
  • Bachelor's Degree, preferably in HR or similar field

Additional Job Standards:

  • Demonstrated minimum of 4-5 years’ project/program management experience.
  • Hands-on experience leading HR integration of acquired employees, including benefit, payroll and compensation transitions.
  • Broad HR generalist knowledge with understanding of complete employment lifecycle
  • Experience in international HR and M&A a strong plus
  • Working knowledge of US benefit plans, compensation structures and job architecture/leveling
  • Experience working directly with seller or target-company HR teams
  • Demonstrated leadership and management skills with the ability to drive to consensus on creative approaches to solving unique challenges in transitioning acquisition employees to Labcorp.
  • Proven ability to build credibility and influence with Seller HR and leadership, often before close and without formal authority.
  • Strong project management skills, including demonstrated ability to think end-to-end and manage multiple projects simultaneously with tight deadlines, ambiguous data, and rapidly shifting priorities
  • Keen attention to detail and accuracy, hands-on mentality, ability to influence in a global, matrixed environment
  • Knowledge of Workday utilizing best practices for M&A activities
  • Strong written and verbal communications; presentation skills.

About the Role:

This role is an integral part of the Global HR M&A team, reporting to the Sr. Director, HR M&A. The Sr. Manager leads HR workstreams for M&A projects end-to-end, from due diligence through integration, partnering closely with Division and Functional HR Business Partners, HR Centers of Excellence (Compensation, Benefits, Payroll, Talent Acquisition, HR Operations/Workday and others), Finance, Legal and the deal team.

This position is the primary liaison between Labcorp HR and Seller HR. The Sr. Manager gains a deep understanding of the seller's HR, pay and benefit practices so they can plan and carry out a smooth move of acquired employees onto Labcorp's plans, policies and job architecture.


Application Window: Open through 11/11/26

Pay Range: $120,000-$140,000 + annual bonus

All job offers will be based on a candidate’s skills and prior relevant experience, applicable degrees/certifications, as well as internal equity and market data.

The position is also eligible for an annual bonus under the Labcorp Bonus Plan. Bonuses are payable based on corporate and/or business segment performance and are subject to individual performance modifiers.

Support is a cornerstone of success at StarTree and a highly valued function within the organization. As a Technical Support Engineer, you will become a critical interface between customers and StarTree’s cross-functional teams, providing technical expertise and driving customer satisfaction.
This role requires you to become a subject matter expert on Apache Pinot and the StarTree Platform, delivering exceptional support to ensure customers achieve success. You’ll play a vital role in providing on-call support for urgent production issues, acting as a trusted advisor for resolving complex challenges.
At StarTree, learning and growth are at the heart of what we do. We are deeply committed to helping our team continuously build their technical skill sets, explore innovative solutions, and grow alongside our evolving platform.
StarTree is growing rapidly, with near-perfect customer renewal rates. This success has led to the rapid expansion of our support team, mirroring the increase in the number of customers leveraging StarTree solutions.

  • Contribute to StarTree’s knowledge base by documenting solutions, best practices, and lessons learned. Mentor and train team members to promote a culture of continuous learning and improvement.
  • Act as the voice of the customer, proactively sharing product feedback, feature requests, and trends with development teams to drive innovation and enhance the StarTree product roadmap.
  • Create internal tooling and identify opportunities to improve existing processes to increase team efficiency and effectiveness.

StarTree is a cloud-based software company that enables business customers to derive advanced insights from real-time and historical data. jobs.description:
Position Summary:

Serves as the clinical trial lead responsible for the planning, conduct and oversight of the operational portion of clinical studies per defined scope of work and ensures that clinical studies are conducted in accordance with the protocol, standard operating procedures (SOPs), ICH-GCP and all applicable regulatory requirements.

Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:

  • Primary clinical point of contact with the client
  • Collaborate with PM on monthly invoicing and variance management of clinical budget
  • Develop study related clinical documents (e.g. clinical plans, Informed Consent Form templates, study specific forms and manuals, CRF completion guidelines, study trackers, PSV/SIV slides and other training materials)
  • Identify and develop training needs for CRAs and third-party vendors specific to the study, protocol and practices including presenting these at Investigator Meetings and Study Kick-off meetings
  • Generate potential site list from key stakeholders and drive site feasibility process
  • Identify potential risks to the enrollment targets based on feasibility analysis and site’s contracted commitment
  • Develop and finalize the country recruitment/retention strategy
  • Develop timely and effective communication and good working relationships with investigators and study team to ensure effective and timely feasibility, site start up, enrollment, maintenance and close out procedures
  • Lead internal clinical team meetings and sets expectations for clinical team of CRAs and CTAs
  • Address all CRA and site questions and maintains Frequently Asked Question (FAQ) log as appropriate
  • Support in planning and conducting investigator meetings
  • Review and/or approve of IP release packages
  • Oversee, support and track all submissions and approvals to Competent Authorities and IRB/Ethics Committees in conjunction with regulatory departments as applicable
  • Develop clinical monitoring strategies for assuring study timelines are met and assuring quality deliverables
  • Generate and utilizes metric reporting (e.g., CTMS, DM Query Trends, Outstanding Monitoring Reports) to ensure that the study is conducted per plan and communicates issues to PM and CRAs as appropriate
  • Responsible for eTMF implementation and management
  • Collaborate with PM, CRAs and QA to develop any Corrective and Preventative Action Plan (CAPA) and is accountable for implementation and timely closure
  • Accountable to assist sites, internal staff and CRAs with the preparation for GCP audits
  • Work closely with PM for project-specific resourcing issues
  • Escalate pertinent CRA performance and site compliance issues when necessary
  • Collaborate with data management and CRAs to ensure data quality and compliance with data cleaning timelines
  • Manage processes for investigational product (IP) including drug accountability and reconciliation
  • When a cross-functional PM is not assigned to a given program, the CTM will assume project management responsibility as needed
  • Support business development and marketing activities as appropriate
  • May negotiate site budget and investigator contract with support from the legal department and/or site contracts group
  • May review site visit reports and ensures monitoring (i.e. scheduling and scope) is executed per monitoring plan
  • May be responsible for management of clinical vendors (e.g. labs, IP, patient diary, home health care) in conjunction with PM
  • May perform clinical data review of patient profiles, data listings and summary tables, including query generation
  • May have line management responsibilities
  • Performs other duties as assigned by management

Qualifications:

Minimum Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education/experience in science or health-related field. Advanced degree preferred
  • Minimum of 7 years of clinical research experience or proven competencies for the position with significant clinical monitoring experience

Preferred:

  • Advanced degree

Other Required:

  • Experience with Microsoft Office Products (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively interface with others in a team setting
  • Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and a customer service demeanor
  • Ability to travel domestically and internationally including overnight stays

Competencies:

  • Demonstrates mastery knowledge of ICH-GCP, relevant Precision SOPs, and regulatory guidance, as well as the ability to implement
  • Working knowledge of clinical management techniques and tools
  • Direct work experience in a cross-functional environment
  • Proven experience in functional management including proven experience in delegating while fostering cohesive team dynamics
  • Proven experience in planning, risk management and change management
  • High level of integrity and must inspire and demand the highest standards from a professional and ethical perspective
  • Ability to lead and inspire excellence within a team
  • Ability to create an environment where employees have a sense of ownership that will lead to increases in productivity and efficiency
  • Results oriented, accountable, motivated and flexible
  • Excellent time management, negotiation, critical thinking, decision making, analytical and interpersonal skills
  • Excellent presentation, verbal and written communications skills
  • In depth proven experience in pharmaceutical and/or device research required
  • Demonstrated successful independent negotiation and conflict management strategies

jobs.description:
About Descope

Descope is a modern identity provider for customers and AI agents. Our developer-friendly tools (visual workflows, SDKs, MCP server) help organizations to easily deploy authentication, authorization, MFA, SSO, and MCP / AI agent identity without writing custom code.

Recognized by Gartner as the only Visionary in the 2026 Magic Quadrant for CIAM, Descope is trusted by 1000+ organizations in production, including GoFundMe, Databricks, GoodRx, Linktree, and. The company has $88M in seed funding led by Lightspeed and Notable Capital.

Descope has won nine 2026 Top Workplaces awards from Energage based on a 96% overall Workplace Experience Score.

We’re “descoping” identity plumbing from developers’ daily lives while helping organizations turn identity into a business enabler. Come join us!

The Role

As a Solutions Engineer at Descope, you own the technical integrity of the sales motion. You help customers make confident technical buying decisions more quickly by connecting their desired business outcomes to credible, validated Descope solutions.

You work as one team with your assigned Account Executives, not as an on-call technical resource, and you are the technical point of contact for the customer's engineering, security, and product stakeholders.

Location: U.S Remote

You will own:

  • Technical discovery, mapped to the customer's business needs and desired outcomes, alongside the AE's business discovery
  • The technical strategy and solution hypothesis for each opportunity
  • Vision Generation, Technical Proof, and Prospect Education demos
  • Proof of Concept / Proof of Value (PoC / PoV) planning and execution, based on pre-agreed success criteria
  • The technical portions of RFP, RFT, RFI, and RFQ (RFx) responses
  • Competitive and technical objection handling
  • Architecture and platform integration guidance appropriate to the buying stage
  • Technical handoff to Customer Success, covering context, risks, gaps, assumptions, and commitments

You help coordinate:

  • The field-to-product feedback loop
  • The engagement of Product, Engineering, Security, Support, or other specialists to address gaps and deal blockers
  • The validation of customer-facing technical commitments that depend on other functions

You may be called on to help support:

  • Webinars, events, and white papers
  • Analyst relations
  • Partner enablement

How You'll Work:

  • Travel: currently less than 50%, for events and customer on-sites
  • Work performed outside working hours: intentionally limited, though occasionally necessary due to customer needs or your own preferred work-style (doing research, building things, etc. off hours)

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years in a customer-facing technical role (Solutions Engineer, Sales Engineer, Solutions Architect, or equivalent)
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with identity and access management platforms, ideally in a pre-sales or post-sales capacity at an identity-focused company (Okta, Auth0/Okta CIC, Ping Identity, ForgeRock, CyberArk, OneLogin, SailPoint, or similar)
  • A track record of owning and winning technical sales cycles, from discovery through technical close, including PoCs run against documented success criteria
  • Demonstrated experience designing and implementing CIAM solutions: customer-facing authentication, B2B federation, progressive profiling, and identity orchestration
  • Clear communication and executive presence, with the ability to adapt technical depth to developers, architects, CISOs, and business stakeholders
  • Background that includes participation in some aspect of the software development lifecycle
  • Human-centric and AI-friendly: you use AI tools to work faster and more thoroughly, while keeping human judgment, accountability, and customer relationships at the center of your work

Technical Skills

  • Hands-on familiarity with identity protocols and standards: OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML 2.0, LDAP, SCIM, WebAuthn/FIDO2, etc.
  • Hands-on experience with authentication methods (Magic Link, OTP, TOTP, push, biometrics, passkeys), SSO federation, and enterprise directory integration (Active Directory, Entra ID, Google Workspace)
  • Working knowledge of authorization models (RBAC, ABAC, ReBAC / fine-grained authorization)
  • Proficiency in at least one programming language (JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Java, Go, etc.), with the ability to build demo apps and build, modify, and troubleshoot integration code in customer environments
  • Familiarity with REST APIs, SDKs, and webhook-driven architectures
  • Understanding of cloud infrastructure platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and how identity integrates with modern application architectures (microservices, serverless, mobile)

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience specifically in CIAM (Customer Identity and Access Management) rather than workforce IAM; you understand the distinct UX, scale, and regulatory pressures of customer-facing identity
  • Familiarity with identity orchestration concepts: adaptive authentication, step-up auth, risk-based access, and identity flows, plus authentication for AI agents and MCP servers
  • Experience migrating customers from legacy identity providers, including user migration strategies and data portability approaches
  • Active participation in the identity community: conference talks, open-source contributions, or published technical content
  • Prior experience at a startup in a high-growth mode

Benefits

  • Health, sorted: Medical, dental, and vision with strong coverage. Premiums covered for the employee
  • Feel good, actually: Mental health support and wellness resources when you need them
  • Future you will thank you: 401k plan with employer match to help you build long term, as well as equity grants
  • More money in your pocket: Tax advantaged benefits for healthcare and dependent care
  • Life happens, and we make space for it: parental leave designed to support you when it matters most.
  • Stay connected: Monthly internet allowance to support your work from anywhere
  • Lunch is on us: Paid lunches when you're working from one of our offices, plus epic snacks
  • Keep growing: Budget and opportunities for personal and professional development, including courses and conferences

Compensation

Base salary range: 150,000-175,000 base.

On-target earnings are split 70% base and 30% commission.

Final offer will depend on experience, skills, location, and overall market data. We also consider leveling, scope, and internal equity to make sure offers are fair and consistent.

Build More Than Just a Career. Build Your Future.

At Vailexa, we’re not just hiring — we’re building thinkers, creators, and future leaders.

The Senior Cybersecurity Engineer will help protect a global, multi-business environment spanning industrial technology and healthcare solutions. The customer needs incident response help to backup our IR staff with overall coordination and support. This hands-on role owns key security platforms and controls across endpoints, cloud workloads, identities, and enterprise applications, with particular emphasis on CrowdStrike Falcon, incident response, and the security of Oracle cloud applications and integrations. The engineer will partner with information technology, application owners, security operations teams, and business stakeholders to improve security operations, reduce response time, and strengthen enterprise resilience.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the engineering, tuning, and day-to-day health of the CrowdStrike Falcon platform, including sensor deployment and coverage, prevention and response policies, host groups, exclusions, and integrations.
  • Investigate and respond to endpoint, identity, and cloud detections; lead containment, root-cause analysis, and remediation for security incidents in partnership with the Security Operations Center (SOC) or a managed detection and response (MDR) provider.
  • Secure Oracle cloud applications and integrations, including Oracle Fusion and Oracle Integration Cloud, through role-based access control, segregation of duties, privileged access, logging and monitoring, and security review of configuration changes.

  • Produce clear documentation, runbooks, and metrics, and communicate security posture to information technology and business leaders.
  • Support audit and compliance activities, including Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX), ISO 27001, and the NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF), by providing evidence and remediating identified gaps.

Qualifications:

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

  • Solid understanding of Windows, macOS, and Linux internals; networking; Active Directory; Microsoft Entra ID; and identity security.
  • Experience securing at least one major cloud platform: AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Scripting ability in PowerShell, Python, or a similar language for automation and analysis.
  • Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF, and CIS Controls.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical risk to non-technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Administration of CrowdStrike Falcon, including Falcon Insight EDR and Falcon Prevent. Experience with Falcon Identity Protection, Falcon LogScale or Next-Gen SIEM, or Falcon Fusion SOAR is a plus. CrowdStrike certifications such as CrowdStrike Certified Falcon Administrator (CCFA), CrowdStrike Certified Falcon Responder (CCFR), or CrowdStrike Certified Falcon Hunter (CCFH) are also a plus.
  • Experience securing Oracle Cloud applications or Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, including role and access design, segregation-of-duties controls, audit logging, and Oracle Integration Cloud or service-oriented architecture integrations. Oracle Cloud security certifications are a plus. OCI and ERP
  • Industry certifications such as Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH), GIAC Certified Intrusion Analyst (GCIA), GIAC Certified Enterprise Defender (GCED), CompTIA Cybersecurity Analyst (CySA+), or cloud security certifications.
  • Experience in a large, multi-business, or global enterprise.

Exposure operational technology, connected devices, or medical-device security.

CrowdStrike Falcon; Oracle Fusion; Oracle Integration Cloud; Oracle Cloud Infrastructure; AWS; Microsoft Azure; GCP; Windows; macOS; Linux; Active Directory; Microsoft Entra ID; PowerShell; Python; SIEM/SOAR platforms; Microsoft Defender; ServiceNow; Tenable; Qualys; Rapid7; MITRE ATT NIST CSF; CIS Controls.

About Qompyl

Qompyl is an early-stage, venture-ready technology startup developing an innovative mobile-first platform in the financial technology space. Our mission is to make complex financial tools simple, engaging, and accessible to a global audience. The platform redefines trading by emphasizing a hands-on, visual, and gamified approach to building and testing strategies. Through elegant design and seamless performance, Qompyl empowers users to interact with financial markets in a more intuitive and rewarding way.

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced commercial professional to lead and coordinate Qompyl’s strategic partnerships, direct broker relationships, provider ecosystem, and market expansion initiatives.

Qompyl works with and evaluates a broad range of external providers across brokerage services, market data, technology infrastructure, APIs, and other critical services. As we scale, many of these relationships will require custom commercial agreements, technical and operational coordination, ongoing relationship management, and close collaboration across the business.

A significant priority for this role will be developing direct relationships with brokers and brokerage platforms such as Alpaca, Tradier, Webull, tastytrade, Interactive Brokers, TradeStation, Public, Schwab, E*TRADE, and other firms identified in Qompyl’s broker integration roadmap.

This role will take ownership of the day-to-day work required to evaluate providers and strategic partners, establish and develop relationships, negotiate favorable and scalable commercial terms, coordinate relevant legal and compliance considerations, and support Qompyl’s future market-entry planning.

The ideal candidate combines strong commercial judgment with proven experience in complex negotiations, relationship building, and closing strategic agreements. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with significant ownership and direct exposure to Qompyl’s leadership team.

Core Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain a structured view of Qompyl’s broker, provider, and strategic partner ecosystem, including current relationships, potential alternatives, integration readiness, and long-term strategic value.

  • Lead commercial discussions and negotiations with brokers, brokerage platforms, market data providers, API partners, and other strategic partners.

  • Establish direct relationships with priority brokers to evaluate API access, account connectivity, order execution capabilities, user authorization models, market coverage, onboarding requirements, and partnership opportunities.

  • Negotiate pricing, revenue-sharing and referral models, minimum commitments, service-level agreements, support levels, API limits, certification requirements, data rights, termination provisions, and other commercial conditions.

  • Coordinate the commercial process required to move broker relationships from initial evaluation through technical diligence, contracting, integration approval, production readiness, and ongoing relationship management.

  • Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with brokers, providers, and strategic partners beyond the initial negotiation.

  • Serve as a key point of contact for partnership and provider-related matters, coordinating issue resolution internally and externally.

  • Identify and develop new strategic partnership opportunities that support Qompyl’s product capabilities, distribution, revenue model, customer acquisition, and international growth.

  • Work closely with Product, Engineering, Finance, Legal, and company leadership to ensure partnership decisions align with technical, financial, regulatory, operational, and business requirements.

  • Coordinate legal and compliance questions related to contracts, broker integration requirements, user authorization, regulatory responsibilities, financial promotion restrictions, data usage and redistribution rights, and international expansion.

  • Support market-entry planning and partnership readiness for priority markets, including the UK, Japan, the EU, and future regions.

  • Track active relationships, negotiations, integration opportunities, risks, dependencies, next steps, and outcomes, providing regular updates to leadership.

What We Are Looking For

  • Strong experience in strategic partnerships, commercial sales, business development, financial services partnerships, vendor management, or a related field.

  • Proven experience negotiating complex commercial agreements, large contracts, API partnerships, or strategic business relationships.

  • Strong commercial judgment and understanding of how partnership terms can affect long-term growth, product capabilities, cost structure, scalability, customer experience, and company value.

  • Excellent negotiation, relationship-building, and communication skills.

  • Confidence representing a company in external conversations with senior commercial, technical, legal, compliance, and executive stakeholders.

  • Ability to quickly understand Qompyl’s business model, product ecosystem, broker integration strategy, and technical dependencies.

  • Ability to coordinate commercial negotiations that involve technical integration, legal review, compliance analysis, and operational readiness.

  • Highly organized and capable of independently managing multiple partnership and market-expansion workstreams.

  • Comfortable working cross-functionally in a global, fast-moving, early-stage startup environment.

  • Experience in fintech, brokerage, financial services, trading technology, SaaS, technology infrastructure, market data, or API-based platforms is strongly preferred.

  • Existing relationships within the brokerage, trading technology, market data, or fintech ecosystem are a plus.

💡 Please Note - Equity-Only Structure

The position will transition to compensated status after the MVP launch and once funding or sustainable revenue is secured.

Principal Product Marketing Manager — AI Systems & Content Architecture

The Mission

As a Principal Product Marketing Manager — AI Systems & Content Architecture, you will determine the architecture of our narrative and collateral engine. Rather than operating as an artisanal, bespoke content creator, your mandate is to establish our foundational positioning architecture and engineer high-leverage, AI-driven workflows that generate enterprise-grade sales collateral at scale. You will own the strategic narrative for Sumo Logic’s Log Analytics Platform across Observability and Security personas, establishing automated knowledge loops, scalable asset generation engines, and self-serve frameworks that allow a focused team to deliver the output and velocity typically associated with a much larger company.

Strategic Transformation to AI-Led Architecture

  • AI-Augmented Asset Production: Replace manual drafting with prompt frameworks and retrieval pipelines to rapidly generate high-impact technical collateral from raw inputs.
  • Self-Serve Content Engines: Provide modular asset systems and AI repositories for field teams to dynamically generate persona-aligned collateral on demand.
  • Tiered Distribution: Focus full-funnel GTM on high-impact Tier-1 shifts while empowering PMs with self-serve playbooks for Tier-2/3 releases.
  • Strategic Systems Architect: Shift from tactical execution to designing the future operating model of Sumo Logic's product marketing engine.

Core Responsibilities

1. Strategic Positioning Architecture & Master Messaging

  • Establish and govern master narrative, value matrices, and core messaging across Observability and Security audiences.
  • Maintain a single source of truth for product capabilities and proof points driving downstream generative tools and campaigns.
  • Synthesize technical inputs into buyer-centric value propositions for practitioners and C-suite leaders.

2. High-Leverage, AI-Augmented Collateral Production

  • Modernize creation of sales assets, including solution briefs, pitch decks, white papers, and video scripts.
  • Build AI-assisted content pipelines (prompt libraries, RAG, structured templates) converting technical specs into field assets.
  • Partner with Sales Enablement to integrate generated collateral into field delivery tools and LMS platforms.

3. Self-Serve Field Content Systems & Modular Asset Kits

  • Design modular presentation kits allowing AEs and SEs to independently assemble stage-specific decks.
  • Maintain a searchable knowledge repository of approved copy blocks, proof points, and architectural diagrams.
  • Replace ad-hoc collateral requests with structured intake, template updates, and self-serve workflows.

4. Tiered GTM Launch Frameworks

  • Enforce a disciplined GTM release tiering system to optimize team bandwidth and commercial impact.
  • Drive cross-functional GTM strategies and core collateral packages for Tier-1 flagship innovations.
  • Provide self-serve launch toolkits for Product Managers to document routine Tier-2/3 feature updates.
  • Own end-to-end launch readiness and coordination across a portfolio of programs, from planning through post-launch measurement. Build and apply AI-powered workflows, such as automated launch tracking, content drafting, messaging QA, and stakeholder updates, to scale your impact and free up time for strategic work.

Qualifications & Experience

  • AI & Workflow Fluency: Practical enthusiasm and hands-on capability with modern generative AI tools to structure prompt chains, synthesize technical input, and scale content generation workflows.
  • Systems Mindset: A builder who naturally defaults to creating reusable templates, standardized blocks, and self-serve frameworks rather than writing one-off documents from scratch.

Customers around the world rely on Sumo Logic for trusted insights to protect against security threats, ensure reliability, and gain powerful insights into their digital environments. For more information, visit www.sumologic.com.

Who we’re looking for

Fieldwire is seeking a Deployment Specialist to join the Construction Success team and own the first chapter of the customer journey. As a Deployment Specialist, you will own customer onboarding, which we call a deployment. You will activate, train, and implement Fieldwire for customers who are just starting their Fieldwire journey, guiding them from kickoff to the end of deployment within the first three months of their contract.

We are looking for construction professionals who have experience using and deploying software to plan and manage construction projects. Our ideal candidate is highly organized, curious about our customers' businesses, and passionate about improving the construction industry. You will work alongside the Account Manager and Customer Success Manager to run flexible, well-planned deployments that show customers real value from the start and leave them with a clear plan for long-term success.

What you’ll be doing

You'll use your experience as a construction professional to turn a signed contract into a successful Fieldwire rollout. As a Fieldwire product and training expert, you will learn each customer's business, goals, and workflows, and use that understanding to shape the structure of their deployment. You will execute most of the deployment, from kickoff through the end of deployment, while the Customer Success Manager supports workflow buildout alongside you for the customer's long-term success. No two deployments are the same, so you'll adapt your approach to each client's needs, keep every deployment moving, and show measurable progress along the way.

A day in the life of XYZ will find you doing XYZ and frequently solving these types of problems:

  • Partnering with customers to understand how their teams work, and shaping each deployment around their goals so Fieldwire fits naturally into their day-to-day.
  • Helping teams from the field to the office feel confident and excited to use Fieldwire, and keeping every deployment moving forward.
  • Showing customers the value of Fieldwire early, and setting them up with a clear path for long-term success.

The primary responsibilities for our next XYZ will be to:

  • Become a Fieldwire product expert and learn best practices for configuring and utilizing the platform.
  • Understand client construction needs and current tech stack in order to seamlessly integrate Fieldwire into a company’s day-to-day workflows.
  • Build and maintain lasting relationships with Fieldwire clients.
  • Conduct web-based training(s) and demonstrations to educate clients on Fieldwire.
  • Own the deployment (onboarding) plan for each newly purchased account, including milestones, owners, and timelines, from kickoff through the end of deployment, typically within the first three months of the contract.
  • Activate and implement Fieldwire for new customers, including kickoff, configuration, user and project setup, and integration activities.
  • Learn each customer's business, goals, and workflows, and use that understanding to shape the structure of their deployment.
  • Define success measures with the customer early, then track them and show progress and value throughout the deployment.
  • Co-create a clear plan for long-term success with the Customer Success Manager and Account Manager, so the customer leaves the deployment knowing what comes next.
  • Follow up consistently and follow through commitments, keeping customer stakeholders engaged and blockers cleared.
  • Work cross-functionally with Support, Solutions Architects, and others as needed.
  • Communicate deployment status clearly and escalate risks early.
  • Create a successful internal handoff after the end of deployment, giving the Customer Success Manager and Account Manager the context, documentation, and success plan they need to continue the customer’s journey.
  • Capture lessons learned and help build repeatable deployment playbooks and templates.

At Fieldwire, we’re looking for our next XYZ to have the following skills and experiences

  • 3+ years of professional construction experience, preferably with a combination of field and office management roles, and/or 3+ years of ConTech experience, preferably with experience in technology implementation.
  • Excellent presentation and communication skills
  • Self-motivated and highly organized, with strong time management skills
  • Diplomacy and patience when working through customer issues
  • Comfortable communicating with anyone, from foreman to senior-level managers
  • A basic understanding of construction process from design to completion
  • An understanding of how all the different parties on a construction project interact and how they work with each other to drive a successful schedule/budget
  • Ability to creatively brainstorm unique solutions to client issues relevant to their needs
  • Desire to learn in a dynamic startup environment

And if you have any of the following, we REALLY want you to apply today!

  • Hands-on construction experience in the field or office, paired with experience in ConTech. You understand how projects get built and how technology can make that work easier.
  • A track record of implementing or deploying software for construction teams, from kickoff through adoption.
  • The rare combination of all three: construction know-how, ConTech fluency, and implementation experience.

Compensation:

The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows: $90,000 - $123,000

The salary range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this job in the US. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors such as your skills, qualifications and experience. In addition to the salary you may be eligible for a corporate bonus which can range up to 30%.

Why Fieldwire?

The field-first construction platform for less busywork and more building. Trusted on 4M+ projects worldwide, Fieldwire by Hilti gives crews reliable access to plans, tasks, and updates on one simple platform. It unites the field and office around a single, transparent source of truth, keeping teams aligned from start to finish. Designed for easy adoption, crews gain real-time visibility into progress, clear ownership of work, and the context to make confident decisions. As part of the Hilti Group, Fieldwire combines deep construction expertise with modern digital innovation to deliver better outcomes on every job. Learn more at Fieldwire.com.

Where is the job located?

This role is fully remote within the United States. Our headquarters are based in beautiful San Francisco and our office is centrally located right off of Embarcadero Bart station.

Treat PeteDME’s MSK Integrated Care patients from home. Our program pairs knee and lumbar bracing with physical therapy and remote therapeutic monitoring, delivered through a network of in-home therapists. Remote visits and monitoring are paid per visit and per call.

How you join
Every therapist on the remote caseload starts with six in-person brace fittings on patients from your own current caseload, so you know the devices you will be coaching patients on. Each fitting is a paid clinical visit — intake, fitting, and follow-up — at a flat fee agreed in writing before your first patient. We give you a one-page screening tool to identify candidates among the patients you already see, and we handle the prescription, benefit verification, and the paperwork.

This is not a sales role. We do not ask you to refer; you treat patients you already see.

After six fittings
Teletherapy patient referrals from PeteDME begin: our patients, work from home, on your schedule, paid per visit and per call.

What you get
• Free specialized training and certification in orthopedic bracing.
• AI-generated SOAP notes — no new EMR to learn.
• Keep your current job. This is additional, independent-contractor work alongside it.
• Flat fees fixed in advance; no part of your pay depends on volume or on referrals.

Requirements

    • Active physical therapist or physical therapist assistant license in the state where you practice.
    • Currently working in home health or another in-home setting.
    • You evaluate and provide treatment.

How to apply

    Complete the short questionnaire. It asks about your license, your setting, and your caseload, and it asks you to acknowledge that teletherapy referrals begin after six fittings. A clinical onboarding specialist will reach out within one business day.

What are Trust Fund Positions?
Trust Fund positions are unique to the Smithsonian. They are paid for from a variety of sources, including the Smithsonian endowment, revenue from our business activities, donations, grants and contracts. Trust employees are not part of the civil service, nor does trust fund employment lead to Federal status. The salary ranges for trust positions are generally the same as for federal positions and in many cases trust and federal employees work side by side. Trust employees have their own benefit program, which may include Health, Dental & Vision Insurance, Life Insurance, Transit/Commuter Benefits, Accidental Death and Dismemberment Insurance, Annual and Sick Leave, Family Friendly Leave, 403b Retirement Plan, Discounts for Smithsonian Memberships, Museum Stores and Restaurants, Credit Union, Smithsonian Early Enrichment Center (Child Care), Flexible Spending Account (Health & Dependent Care).
Conditions of Employment
  • Pass Pre-employment Background Check and Subsequent Background Investigation for position designated.
  • Complete a Probationary Period.
  • Maintain a Bank Account for Direct Deposit/Electronic Transfer.
  • The position is open to all candidates eligible to work in the United States. Proof of eligibility to work in U.S. is not required to apply.
  • Applicants must meet all qualification and eligibility requirements within 30 days of the closing date of this announcement.

OVERVIEW

SI is a diverse museum and research complex dedicated to the increase and diffusion of knowledge. The Office of Digital and Innovation (ODI) is driving the future of how the Smithsonian advances its mission and connects with the world. ODI works centrally and within Smithsonian units to unlock the full potential of our collections and resources, better understand and serve our audiences, and pioneer innovative approaches to accelerate and scale our impact—all while empowering staff across the Smithsonian with the tools and skills they need to success in and ever-changing digital world.
The Smithsonian Institution’s Office of Digital and Innovation (ODI) is seeking a Supervisory IT Specialist (Enterprise Architect) to lead the Institution’s Salesforce and customer relationship management (CRM) strategy. This position is responsible for the design, implementation, governance, and continuous improvement of Salesforce solutions across the Smithsonian. The selectee will ensure Salesforce capabilities align with Institutional and unit-level business objectives, integrate effectively with enterprise systems, and support long-term digital transformation goals. Working closely with stakeholders and technical teams, the Supervisory IT Specialist (Enterprise Architect) provides strategic and architectural leadership to optimize platform performance, scalability, and return on investment while enhancing service delivery across the Institution.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

The Supervisory IT Specialist (Enterprise Architect) leads the design, implementation, and continuous enhancement of Salesforce solutions across the Smithsonian Institution. This position ensures Salesforce capabilities align with Institutional and unit-level business objectives, integrates with enterprise systems, and supports long-term technology goals. The incumbent provides technical and architectural leadership, collaborates with stakeholders to define requirements, establishes best practices, and drives the optimization of Salesforce solutions to improve organizational performance, scalability, security, and service delivery.
  • Serves as the lead architect for the design, implementation, governance, and enhancement of Salesforce solutions across the Smithsonian Institution, ensuring alignment with business and mission objectives.
  • Directs the integration of Salesforce with enterprise systems, applications, and data platforms to ensure interoperability, data integrity, and operational efficiency.
  • Provides enterprise architecture expertise and technical guidance across Salesforce products, platforms, and emerging technologies.
  • Builds and sustains strategic partnerships with institutional stakeholders to support the successful delivery and long-term adoption of Salesforce solutions.
  • Collaborates with leadership to establish and maintain the Salesforce and CRM strategic roadmap, ensuring alignment with Smithsonian priorities and digital transformation initiatives.
  • Supervises Salesforce administrators, developers, and related technical staff and contractors, providing direction on architecture, development, and platform management activities.
  • Assigns work, establishes priorities, develops performance plans, conducts performance evaluations, and supports employee training, mentoring, and professional development.
  • Manages workforce operations, including scheduling, leave administration, performance recognition, conflict resolution, and disciplinary actions, as appropriate.
  • Promotes Smithsonian policies and principles related to equal employment opportunity and workplace safety.
  • Leads complex solution-design efforts and provides expert consultation to ensure alignment with enterprise architecture standards and Salesforce best practices.
  • Provides technical oversight for system integrations, APIs, middleware, and cloud-based data exchange solutions.
  • Ensures Salesforce solutions comply with applicable security, privacy, accessibility, and institutional governance requirements.
  • Provides technical leadership for application development activities, including solution design reviews, code reviews, testing, quality assurance, and performance optimization.
  • Evaluates system performance, analyzes business and technical data, and recommends improvements to enhance functionality, reliability, and user experience.
  • Ensures Salesforce solutions are scalable, sustainable, secure, and responsive to evolving organizational requirements.
  • Prepares and delivers briefings, reports, and recommendations to leadership regarding project status, risks, issues, and strategic opportunities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS

Candidates may qualify for this position through a combination of education, demonstrated knowledge, and related professional experience.
  • Certifications Salesforce Certified Application Architect, Salesforce Certified System Architect.
  • Expert knowledge of enterprise architecture principles and Salesforce platform architecturesufficient to design, implement, and provide strategic guidance across core and non-core Salesforce products and capabilities.
  • Expert knowledge of Salesforce ecosystem solutions, including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Marketing Cloud, and related technologies, sufficient to support enterprise-wide business needs.
  • Expert knowledge of Salesforce program and portfolio management sufficient to oversee large-scale, complex CRM initiatives and ensure alignment with organizational objectives.
  • Expert knowledge of systems integration methodologies sufficient to integrate Salesforce with enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, third-party applications, and other organizational platforms while ensuring data integrity, security, and interoperability.
  • Expert knowledge of middleware technologies, APIs, and integration frameworks, including tools such as MuleSoft, AWS Glue, and Apache Airflow, sufficient to support enterprise application connectivity and data exchange.
  • Knowledge of data migration, data governance, and data management practices sufficient to ensure the accurate and secure movement, maintenance, and utilization of enterprise data.
  • Knowledge of risk management, cybersecurity, privacy, and compliance principles sufficient to identify, assess, and mitigate risks related to CRM implementations, system availability, and data protection.
  • Knowledge of project and program management principles sufficient to oversee complex technology initiatives, manage competing priorities, and ensure successful delivery of business outcomes.
  • Skill in analyzing and resolving complex business and technical challenges, evaluating relevant information, and developing practical, data-driven solutions that align with strategic goals.
  • Skill in leading technical teams and providing architectural oversight to ensure the successful delivery, enhancement, and governance of Salesforce and CRM solutions.
  • Ability to lead the design, implementation, and optimization of enterprise Salesforce solutions that support organizational requirements and long-term strategic objectives.
  • Ability to build collaborative relationships and influence stakeholders at all organizational levels to facilitate decision-making, gain consensus, and advance strategic initiatives.
  • Ability to apply user-centered design principles and translate business requirements into scalable, effective technology solutions that address customer needs and operational challenges.
  • Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams, executives, business stakeholders, contractors, and external partners to achieve program goals and deliver enterprise solutions.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical and business information effectively, both orally and in writing, to technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership.
  • Ability to prepare and deliver briefings, reports, presentations, and recommendations to professional, managerial, and executive-level audiences regarding program status, architectural decisions, risks, and strategic opportunities.

jobs.excerpt: About Smart Working At Smart Working, we believe your job should not only look right on paper but also feel right every day.
jobs.description:
About Smart Working

At Smart Working, we believe your job should not only look right on paper but also feel right every day. This isn’t just another remote opportunity - it’s about finding where you truly belong, no matter where you are. From day one, you’re welcomed into a genuine community that values your growth and well-being.
Our mission is simple: to break down geographic barriers and connect skilled professionals with outstanding global teams and products for full-time, long-term roles. We help you discover meaningful work with teams that invest in your success, where you’re empowered to grow personally and professionally.
Join one of the highest-rated workplaces on Glassdoor and experience what it means to thrive in a truly remote-first world.

About the Role

As an AEO/GEO Lead (Technical AI Search), you will lead AI search performance for one of the UK's best-known online electrical retailers, driving its ambition to become one of the most visible, trusted and accurately represented retailers across AI-powered search platforms.

This is a senior, hands-on technical role, working remotely during UK business hours as an integral part of the ecommerce and digital team. You will work closely with the AEO/GEO Project Lead, CTO, engineering, paid search, commercial analytics, retail, trading, brand and marketing teams, contributing to regular stand-ups and team discussions.

You will build an evidence-led approach to AI search, enhancing how product information is discovered, interpreted and cited, while delivering measurable commercial results. This is an opportunity to shape a rapidly evolving discipline within a founder-led business with a strong commitment to an AI-first strategy.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain weekly AI visibility benchmarks across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot, Google AI Overviews and AI Mode, covering key retail categories and competitors.
  • Track citation share, recommendation share, sentiment, factual accuracy, AI-driven traffic and revenue, accounting for variations in AI responses and reporting commercial impact to senior stakeholders.
  • Audit and implement schema.org structured data across product, category and content templates, including Product, Offer, AggregateRating, Review, OfferShippingDetails, MerchantReturnPolicy and Organization.
  • Improve AI crawler access and technical discoverability through robots rules, log analysis, rendering checks, indexation, canonicalisation, crawl efficiency, faceted navigation and page performance.
  • Maintain consistent, machine-readable product, pricing, availability, delivery and review information across websites, product feeds and third-party sources.
  • Manage and optimise product feeds for Google Merchant Center, Microsoft Merchant Center and emerging AI shopping platforms, working closely with paid search teams.
  • Assess developments in agentic commerce, including AI checkout, merchant programmes, AI search advertising and potential membership recognition, through structured, evidence-led testing.
  • Strengthen buying guides, product Q&A, comparison content and entity visibility across authoritative knowledge sources, review platforms and third-party websites.
  • Partner with engineering, PR, brand and commercial teams to deliver technical improvements, create clear implementation tickets and verify completed work.
  • Drive structured experimentation, document hypotheses and outcomes, and build AI search knowledge across the wider business.
  • Establish AI visibility baselines and complete technical audits within the first 30 days, deliver priority improvements by day 60, and demonstrate measurable progress alongside a six-month roadmap by day 90.
  • Monitor performance against established baselines, covering AI citations, recommendations, factual accuracy, traffic, conversions, revenue, structured data coverage, feed quality and technical roadmap delivery.
  • Deliver AI visibility assessments ahead of key retail trading periods, including Black Friday and major product launches.

Requirements

  • 6+ years of SEO experience, including at least 4 years of hands-on technical SEO for large ecommerce websites managing tens of thousands of SKUs or more.
  • 12+ months of practical AEO/GEO experience, with demonstrated success in measuring and improving AI search visibility.
  • Clear understanding of AI search technologies, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), query fan-out, grounding sources, traditional search indexes and AI source selection and citation.
  • Expert-level knowledge of JSON-LD and schema.org structured data, including template-level implementation, validation and monitoring at scale.
  • Strong experience with Google Merchant Center product feeds, alongside working knowledge of Bing Webmaster Tools and Microsoft Merchant Center.
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL for analysis and automation, including using LLM APIs to run and score prompt sets.
  • Experience with log file analysis and crawling tools such as Screaming Frog, Sitebulb, Botify or Lumar.
  • Experience with GA4, BigQuery and Looker Studio or an equivalent analytics stack, along with confident Excel skills.
  • Working knowledge of HTML, JavaScript rendering and front-end frameworks to diagnose technical issues and prepare accurate engineering tickets.
  • Evidence-led, analytical approach with the ability to distinguish effective AI search practices from unsupported claims.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with engineers and senior commercial stakeholders.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in consumer electricals, appliances or other high-consideration retail categories.
  • Experience with AI visibility platforms such as Profound, Peec AI, Ahrefs Brand Radar or Semrush's AI toolkit, or building custom measurement tools.
  • Knowledge of knowledge graphs and entity optimisation, including Wikidata and Google's Knowledge Graph.
  • Experience with review platforms such as Trustpilot and review data syndication.
  • Exposure to agentic commerce, AI shopping feeds or AI checkout integrations.
  • Experience with Magento, Salesforce Commerce Cloud or headless commerce platforms.
  • Published articles, industry talks, experiments or open-source contributions demonstrating expertise in AI search.

jobs.title: Project Delivery Lead
jobs.excerpt: Thanks for your interest in Oklo!  We are searching for a Project Delivery Lead to join our team.
jobs.description:
Thanks for your interest in Oklo! We are searching for a Project Delivery Lead to join our team.

Position Description

This is a hands-on project management role focused on planning and driving assigned deployment work. You will turn broad objectives into practical steps, schedules and commitments, work across technical teams and external partners, and resolve the details that stand between a plan and completed work.

You will personally manage the work from planning through completion, including coordinating site readiness and contractor deliverables, closing requests for information (RFIs) and approvals, and going on-site to understand problems and get them resolved. The role reports to the Senior Director, Deployments.

This role begins with personally running assigned work. Responsibilities may grow as Oklo’s deployment needs evolve, potentially including team leadership.

Specific responsibilities may include:

  • Plan and drive assigned work. Break objectives into practical steps, sequence dependencies, and agree owners, dates and deliverables. Keep the plan tied to the established project schedule and show the impact when a commitment slips.
  • Keep teams and partners moving. Run focused planning and progress reviews, secure commitments, and resolve missing inputs or conflicting instructions. Recommend a next step when a decision, resource or priority tradeoff is needed.
  • Solve problems on-site. Travel to understand conditions, work with local teams and contractors, and resolve practical obstacles. Confirm that access, people, information and other agreed prerequisites are in place for the work to proceed.
  • Drive contracting. Assemble scopes of work, task orders, proposals and supporting documents. Get missing inputs and follow through on reviews, approvals, signatures and authorization to begin work. Track contractor deliverables, changes, costs and invoice questions with Procurement, Finance and the relevant specialists.
  • Manage RFIs. Identify the response and review owners, collect technical inputs, track deadlines and send responses through the required process. Confirm receipt, follow up on unanswered questions and keep the record current through closure.
  • Track down the details. Catch missing attachments, unsigned documents, access problems, unanswered requests and unclear owners. Contact the right person, confirm the next action and date, and check that the issue is resolved.
  • Keep records and updates useful. Use existing project records for milestones, owners, next actions, risks and completed work. Keep contractor, cost, approval and RFI status accurate, and make clear what is blocked and what is needed next.
  • Hand work over well. When responsibility moves to another team, transfer the current plan, records, contacts and open issues, and confirm the receiving owner has what they need.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Experience personally delivering complex physical or technical projects involving multiple functions or external partners.
  • Experience coordinating contractors, procurement, reviews or approvals and following unresolved items through to completion.
  • Ability to work independently with limited support and changing priorities.
  • Ability to build and manage a practical project schedule, identify dependencies and work through the impact of delays.
  • Clear writing and direct communication with specialists, contractors and senior leaders.
  • Sound judgment about technical and commercial dependencies and when to involve the appropriate specialist.

Bonus Qualifications:

  • Owner-side deployment, capital-project, EPC, industrial, energy, data-center, telecom/network or comparable field-delivery experience.
  • Experience working with government customers, regulated projects or nuclear deployment interfaces.
  • Experience hiring, coaching or leading project managers while remaining personally responsible for project work.
  • Experience transferring a project or team to the organization that will run it over the longer term.

Competencies

We are looking for a Project Delivery Leader that is:

  • Thorough and persistent: You notice the missing detail, ask the next question and follow through until the work is complete.
  • Independent and accountable: You bring recommendations, make decisions within your authority and close commitments without repeated reminders.
  • Credible across disciplines: You learn enough technical and commercial context to ask precise questions and earn commitments.
  • Practical and resourceful: You can enter an unfamiliar situation, establish what needs to happen and work with others to get it done.
  • Comfortable with change: You adjust the plan when priorities or facts change and make the next steps clear.
  • Passionate about clean energy
  • Passionate about making advanced fission a reality
  • Willing and able to learn quickly
  • Eager to work on a dynamic team, receive constructive feedback, and grow with us
  • Willing to think differently and do things in new ways
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, highly iterative startup environment
  • Excited to think creatively, critically, and reflectively about the problems they are solving, while not leaning only on what has been done before
  • Willing to propose novel and creative solutions to technical problems
  • An excellent writer who can write in modern active voice, so make your cover letter compelling and write it well!
  • Able to communicate technical content and results verbally

Who you are:

A startup person: You aren't driven by titles or hierarchy, and prefer efficiency to excess process. You don't need or expect to have a lot of guidance but you enjoy working in a fast-paced team. If you prefer the culture and feel of a large organization, that is great, but you likely won’t enjoy working with us! There is plenty of important work and plenty of good opportunities with organizations like that.

Motivated: You are self-motivated. You bring an enthusiasm to the team, and imbue a sense of passion that goes beyond clocking in and clocking out. This isn’t about a fake or arbitrary “pieces of flair” mentality or lack of work-life balance! It is about being a part of the vision and feeling a part of reaching team goals.

A team-player: Oklo genuinely is a team. We aren’t about taking credit for ourselves, and we aren’t about pushing blame to others. We do incredible things because we work as a team.

An excellent communicator: We need a person who is not only technically competent but also a clear and upbeat communicator.

Creative: Being creative means that when things fall outside clear scopes or processes or problems arise without clear solutions, you are able to identify it as well as invent ways to solve a problem or fill a need without micromanagement. The successful person in this job will not only be creative, but also enjoy being creative and solving open-ended problems which may change day-by-day.

Detail-oriented: This focus is a big part of excellence, consistency, and quality. Excellent grammar and spelling matter for both good communication as well as the image of the company that we put forward.

About Oklo travel requirements:

Oklo requires remote employees to travel to headquarters (Santa Clara, CA) twice a quarter annually, based on business or team needs, including attendance at team meetings, off-sites, and other company events or gatherings. For the first two weeks of onboarding, employees are required to be in person at headquarters in Santa Clara, CA.

About Oklo compensation:

Salary: $150,000-$190,000

Oklo offers flexible time off, equity, bonuses, competitive pay, 401(k), health insurance (with employer contribution), HSA, FSA, flexible work hours, wellness credits, and other benefits.

This position may involve access to information subject to U.S. export control laws. Only applicants who meet the definition of a U.S. person under applicable laws may be eligible.

About Oklo Inc.: Oklo Inc. is developing fast fission power plants to deliver clean, reliable, and affordable energy at scale; establishing a domestic supply chain for critical radioisotopes; and advancing nuclear fuel recycling to convert nuclear waste into clean energy. Oklo was the first to receive a site use permit from the U.S. Department of Energy for a commercial advanced fission plant, was awarded fuel material from Idaho National Laboratory, and submitted the first custom combined license application for an advanced reactor to the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission. Oklo is also developing advanced fuel recycling technologies in collaboration with the U.S. Department of Energy and U.S. National Laboratories.

#CHOP: Oklo’s Values
Collaboration: We go further, together. We bring diverse perspectives, listen actively, and build trust through transparency and respect. We work across disciplines, sharing ownership to turn complex challenges into shared successes.
Humility: We are team players who act for the good of the company and for the world. We are focused on our mission, not personal recognition.
Ownership: We take pride in what we do and how we do it. We are proactive in finding solutions and see tasks through to completion. We are committed to delivering on our promises to provide clean, reliable, and affordable energy.
Pathfinding: We chart new ground where no path exists by approaching challenges with curiosity, courage, and creativity while navigating ambiguity.

Candidates should be aware that employment may be contingent upon successful completion of a drug screening, and employees may be subject to drug testing at any time in accordance with company policy and applicable laws.

Recruitment Fraud Disclaimer

Oklo is aware of recent recruitment fraud attempts targeting job seekers. Please be cautious of anyone claiming to represent Oklo who does not contact you from an official Oklo email address.

All legitimate communications from our recruiting team— including application updates, interview requests, and job offers — will come exclusively from an @oklo.com email. Oklo will never ask for sensitive personal information, payments, or account credentials during the hiring process.

If you receive suspicious outreach or have concerns about the authenticity of any communication claiming to be from Oklo, please contact us through the official channels listed on our website.
