Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Digital Sales Representative - Expansion.

About the job

This position is needed to lead relationships within our Self Service customer base and Communications platform customers who consume our messaging, voice and email services. As our new Digital Sales Representative, you will be responsible for net new customer activations, transactional and solution selling, and closing deals within our Self Service account base.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Manage and expand customer accounts within the Self Service segment.
  • Own a book of business with the goal of protecting revenue and driving upsell and cross-sells
  • Execute programmable sales plays to consistently deliver strong revenue, gross margin, and gross profit results.
  • Work cross-functionally with representatives from product, finance, support, and services teams to execute renewals and drive DBNE
  • Generate and maintain an accurate sales pipeline and forecast utilizing our CRM, Salesforce through proactive efforts and collaboration with your manager.
  • Execute automation strategies to serve a large quantity of customers while maintaining NPS and preventing churn
  • Work closely with marketing teams to align on messaging and campaigns.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • 2 years closing experience or 1+ years closing experience at a SaaS or CPaas company, with a record of top performance
  • Demonstrated track record of managing business forecasts and financial models.
  • Comfortable working with business and highly technical leaders, while influencing their understanding and building supportive partnerships.
  • Analytical account development strategy based on using data to find opportunities and prove value.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with appetite to define processes and build programs.
  • Record of delivering revenue and gross profit results
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Location

This role will be remote, but is not eligible to be hired in CA, CT, IL, MA, MD, NJ, NY, OR, PA, RI, TX, VA, WA, or Washington DC

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Compensation

*Please note the salary range information provided applies only to candidates residing in California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State due to local requirements. Compensation for candidates in other locations will be discussed during the hiring process. Please note that hiring for this role is not restricted to the locations listed above.

The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:

  • Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Minnesota or Vermont: $35.34/hr - $44.14/hr.
  • Based in Washington D.C., Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts or California (outside of the Francisco Bay Area): $37.31/hr - $46.59/hr.
  • Based in New York, New Jersey, Washington State, or the San Francisco Bay area, California: $39.24/hr - $49.04/hr.
  • This role is eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave.
  • This role is eligible to earn commissions.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

Applications for this role will be accepted on an ongoing basis.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @ email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

jobs.title: Registered Cardiac Nurse-PST
jobs.excerpt: Heartbeat Health is the leading virtual-first cardiovascular care company in the country, providing patients with convenient, high-quality heart care through a combination of telemedicine, diagnostics, and virtual care programs.
jobs.description:
Heartbeat Health is the leading virtual-first cardiovascular care company in the country, providing patients with convenient, high-quality heart care through a combination of telemedicine, diagnostics, and virtual care programs. By leveraging real-time data and AI-powered insights, Heartbeat Health empowers providers and patients with personalized treatment plans, reducing hospitalizations and improving long-term heart health outcomes. Heartbeat Health is redefining how cardiovascular care is delivered in the digital age, led by our medical group of cardiologists, advanced practitioners, nurses, and care coordinators.

About the Role:

    This is a full-time, remote, patient-facing Registered Nurse position supporting our virtual cardiology team at Heartbeat Health. In this role, you'll work closely with patients, cardiologists, primary care providers, and other members of our clinical team to help coordinate care, provide patient education, and ensure patients receive timely and appropriate support throughout their care journey.

    This position requires consistent Monday–Friday availability from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM PST. We're looking for someone who can reliably support this schedule and work collaboratively with our clinical team in a fast-paced, virtual environment.

  • Education and Counseling: This role is a remote, patient-facing role. As part of our RN team, you will provide education about a patient’s diagnosis, test results and treatment plan.
  • Collaboration: Collaborate closely with cardiologists, PCPs and other healthcare professionals to ensure comprehensive and coordinated care for patients. Discuss complex cases and participate in multidisciplinary care teams. Utilize clinical decision making to escalate concerns to the care team.
  • Documentation: Maintain accurate and detailed patient records, including patient interactions, medical histories, assessments, treatment plans, progress notes, and discharge summaries within scope of practice. Ensure compliance with legal and ethical standards.
  • Follow-Up Care: Schedule and conduct follow-up virtual visits to monitor patients' progress and address any concerns or questions.
  • Patient Advocacy: Serve as an advocate for patients' needs and preferences, ensuring that they receive appropriate care and support throughout their healthcare journey.
  • Compliance: Adhere to legal and ethical guidelines, including patient confidentiality and telemedicine regulations, while providing virtual care.
  • Prioritization & Triage: Efficiently triage incoming patient requests and manage patient panel by prioritizing patients based on need and client SLAs.
  • Continuing Education: Pursue ongoing education and professional development in the field of cardiology to stay updated on the latest advancements and maintain relevant certifications.
  • Quality Assurance: Participate in quality assurance programs to monitor and improve the quality of cardiology care provided within the organization.

About You:

  • Must hold a current and unrestricted Registered Nurse (RN) license (Compact).
  • At least 3+ years of experience in cardiology. Experience in telemedicine is a bonus.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, especially in a virtual environment. Team-player is a must.
  • Ability to effectively educate patients and collaborate with a multidisciplinary healthcare team, including cardiologists and advanced practitioners.
  • Ability to work independently and make clinical decisions under appropriate supervision
  • Proficiency in using telehealth platforms and electronic health records
  • Commitment to patient-centered care and empathy for patients with chronic cardiology conditions
  • Compassion and empathy when working with patients and their families, especially when delivering challenging diagnoses or managing chronic cardiac conditions.

About our Culture:

  • We are mission-driven: we're revolutionizing the way cardiovascular care is delivered

  • We are fast-paced & agile: we move quickly, iterate often, and value experimentation

  • We are remote-first: ownership, autonomy, and trust are at the core of how we operate

  • We care about diversity: diversity allows us to build an excellent patient experience

  • We care about each other: we are stronger together through a culture of mutual respect and active support.

  • We invest in our people: Eligible employees have access to a competitive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, paid holidays, sick time, a 401(k), and additional benefits designed to support you and your family.

  • We are an equal opportunity employer: we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status

jobs.title: Outbound Account Development Representative - DACH
jobs.excerpt: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role

As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained — both on the job and through formal programs led by a world-class Sales team — to take on your next role as a closing Account Executive. On a daily basis, you will build and work a portfolio of target accounts for our EMEA business in the DACH region: researching each account for commercial signal, prioritising which contacts to approach and in what order, and running a connected, multi-touch outbound motion that generates qualified pipeline rather than one-off meetings.

We have offices in Paris and Amsterdam, and offer remote working from Germany, France, the Netherlands and London. Our European headquarters are based in London.

You should apply if

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: your efforts will result in real-world impact — helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: if you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less.
  • You’re excited by AI: you’ll use cutting-edge AI tools every day and sell some of the most advanced AI in the physical operations space.
  • You think several moves ahead: you'd rather build a real relationship across an account than force a single contact to a decision they're not ready to make.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: one day you'll be researching a transport operator, the next a food distribution centre. Our best reps dig into the businesses they support to make a sharper case for why Samsara matters to them specifically.
  • You treat rejection as a learning experience: in this role you will get hung up on and told no. You need the resilience to prepare, call again, and adjust.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go further than you have before.

In this role, you will

  • Research target accounts before outreach — pulling commercial signal out of public information (financials, news, hiring activity, compliance or safety pressure) to build a specific, defensible point of view on where Samsara adds value.
  • Build and prioritise an account-level contact plan, identifying who to approach first across a range of stakeholders (e.g. MD, Operations/Transport Manager, Compliance/H&S, Finance) and being able to justify that choice.
  • Run a connected, multi-touch outbound motion across phone, email and LinkedIn — using early conversations to gather information and multi-thread the account, not just to book a meeting at any cost.
  • Write personalised, researched outreach (including cold emails) that carries a specific point of view into every call, rather than working from a generic script.
  • Read what a contact gives you on the call and adapt in real time — including recognising when the right move is to gather information and position a follow-up with someone else, rather than push for a meeting the contact can't actually commit to.
  • Keep meticulous account and contact records in Salesforce.
  • Become a product expert and represent the Samsara brand at trade shows and events.

Minimum requirements for the role

  • 1–3 years professional experience, ideally in customer-facing roles
  • 6–12 months experience in a sales or equivalent target driven role
  • Highly motivated and committed, with a strong desire to work in target-driven sales
  • Proven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding targets in previous roles
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written
  • Curious, and able to ask insightful questions
  • A champion of a Growth Mindset
  • Highly proficient in English and fluent in German
  • AI Literacy and ability to showcase examples of leveraging AI in your work

An ideal candidate also has

  • Comfort turning unstructured information (an annual report, a website, a news article) into a clear commercial argument
  • Experience multi-threading or navigating multiple stakeholders within a single sale
  • A genuine willingness to prepare — to research and write — before a call, rather than relying on improvising well under pressure
  • Experience in closing-sales roles or similar target driven environment
  • A proven track record of achievement beyond work (e.g. academics, sports, charity)
  • Willingness to collaborate and influence in a "win as a team" environment
  • Excitement about solving new problems in innovative ways
  • Motivation to help build a fast-growing business in the IoT and SaaS space.

ADR pathways

Through Samsara's ADR program, there are always opportunities to move to the next level and take on more responsibility. With emphasis on continued professional development, training doesn't stop after onboarding — we provide opportunities to expand ADRs' understanding of the market and competitors, develop hard skills, and work with mentors to progress through three levels:

  • ADR I — focus on inbound leads: a high volume of conversations, sharing the ins and outs of our products, and fostering relationships with interested prospects. Learning opportunities include call sessions with senior Sales team members, tool training (Salesforce, Salesloft, Lusha), product knowledge, and objection handling.
  • ADR II — work on top-of-funnel movement, creating high-quality sales engagements, and supporting Account Executives. Enrolled in specialised training including professional writing, persona-based messaging, cold calling 2.0, and AE collaboration.
  • ADR III — work hand-in-hand with field Account Executives and Enterprise Regional Sales Managers. Partner on large accounts, implement territory plans, join weekly strategy meetings, and schedule/attend customer demos, alongside a mentorship program ahead of an AE interview.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

jobs.title: Associate Director of Technology
jobs.excerpt: WHO WE ARE Third Plateau is an impact consultancy partnering with philanthropy, nonprofits, and communities to build the infrastructure of change.
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Third Plateau is an impact consultancy partnering with philanthropy, nonprofits, and communities to build the infrastructure of change. We are one of Fast Company's Best Workplaces for Innovators!
OUR APPROACH
Third Plateau is built on a simple premise: creating lasting social good requires more than good intentions. Society’s most complex challenges are deeply rooted, interconnected, and resistant to quick fixes.

Philanthropists, foundations, and nonprofit leaders know this and are up for the challenge, bringing their passions and ambitions day in and day out. To realize that potential, they’re looking for a partner who brings the experience to design great strategies and the capacity to see them through. Third Plateau was built exactly for this work. Interested applicants are encouraged to learn more about our approach and our company values.

OVERVIEW

The Associate Director of Technology is a technical leader who bridges strategy and execution. This role is responsible for translating the firm’s technology strategy, as established by the Vice President of Technology, into implementation roadmaps and scalable, secure, and effective systems and processes for a 120-person organization, and for independently executing those plans. Reporting to the Vice President of Technology, the Associate Director leads enterprise systems administration and integrations, IT support and troubleshooting, and firmwide technology learning and AI adoption.
Essential duties and responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Cybersecurity, Risk & Governance

  • Implement and maintain practical cybersecurity controls, access standards, data retention and destruction practices, and other technology safeguards across the firm.
  • Partner with the Vice President of Technology to develop technology policies and governance standards, then translate them into clear processes, technical configurations, employee guidance, and training.
  • Monitor technology risks, industry practices, and vendor recommendations; validate technical implementation and follow through rather than relying solely on third-party assurances.
  • Support incident response, business continuity, vendor risk, and other technology-related governance activities while balancing firmwide standards with legitimate employee, client, and project requirements.

Technology Operations & Support

  • Administer and serve as atechnical owner for firmwide platforms including Microsoft 365, Slack, Zoom, HubSpot, 1Password, endpoint-management tools, and other core enterprise systems, with the ability to step in directly for troubleshooting, security response, or critical operational needs.
  • Own employee technology onboarding and offboarding, system provisioning, equipment lifecycle, inventory tracking, and related operational processes.
  • Serve as an escalation point for complex issues and critical technology incidents, including participation in after-hours coverage.
  • Manage the day-to-day MSP relationship, including technical oversight, escalations, service quality, and identification of recurring issues that require broader process, automation, documentation, or system improvements.

Knowledge Management & Collaboration Platforms

  • Administer and continuously improve the firm’s SharePoint environment, intranet, collaboration spaces, and related knowledge-management technologies.
  • Design and maintain appropriate permission and information-sharing structures for internal teams, client collaboration, and vendor partnerships, applying sound judgment to confidential and sensitive information.
  • Build and maintain system documentation, knowledge base articles, training materials, and other self-service resources that help employees use technology effectively.
  • Partner with business and content owners to improve information findability, ownership, consistency, and usability while accommodating legitimate differences in team and client workflows.

Enterprise Systems, Integrations & Data

  • Translate the firm’s technology strategy into implementation roadmaps with clear milestones, dependencies, and sequencing, and drive execution independently without day-to-day supervision.
  • Monitor the enterprise technology portfolio for usage, ownership, cost, risk, interoperability, supportability, and business value; identify opportunities to improve, consolidate, replace, or retire systems, preparing cost analyses and vendor and resource recommendations for decision by the Vice President of Technology.
  • Design, implement, and troubleshoot system integrations, automations, APIs, authentication methods, and data flows across enterprise and division-specific applications.
  • Establish and maintain technical standards, system ownership models, data hygiene practices, and foundational data governance controls that support a cohesive and scalable technology environment.
  • Evaluate new system and integration requests for technical feasibility, security, maintainability, scalability, and downstream impact; recommend practical solutions that address validated business and user needs while supporting legitimate division, client, and project requirements.

Technology Enablement, Innovation & Adoption

  • Partner with colleagues to identify and evaluate emerging technologies and technology-enabled process improvements based on defined business and user needs.
  • Design and execute controlled pilots with clear objectives, guardrails, feedback loops, and measures of success; use findings to refine solutions before broader implementation.
  • Lead the technical rollout and adoption of new systems and significant technology changes, including testing, documentation, training, change support, and evaluation of emerging capabilities such as artificial intelligence.
  • Shape department practice by establishing standards, sharing knowledge, and coaching colleagues on effective technology use.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

  • 7-9 years of progressive enterprise technology experience
  • Hands-on experience administering Microsoft 365 and enterprise SaaS platforms
  • Strong technical judgment, troubleshooting skills, and ability to learn unfamiliar systems independently
  • Experience implementing integrations, APIs, automations, and system changes
  • Ability to translate strategic direction into clear implementation plans and drive work independently
  • Strong customer orientation, communication skills, and low-ego collaboration

BENEFITS + PERKS

  • Remote-First Approach
  • Flexible & Generous Time Off
  • 100% employer-paid options for medical, dental, and vision coverage for you, with employer contributions toward dependent coverage
  • Employer-paid short- and long-term disability and life insurance
  • Employer contribution of up to $850 to your Health Savings Account
  • Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA, DCFSA and Commuter)
  • Initial home office stipend of $550, with $250 provided annually thereafter
  • An annual professional development stipend of $1,000
  • $110/monthly cell phone and home internet stipend
  • 13 weeks paid parental and medical leave
  • Annual discretionary bonus based on both company performance and individual performance
  • Up to $500 annually to invest in your mental, emotional, and physical well-being
  • Access to curated learning opportunities and team-based growth experiences to support the professional development of our team
Applications will be accepted through November 30, 2026, at 5:00 PM PST. Review of applications will begin after the posting closes, and only candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.
Not sure you meet 100% of our qualifications? Research shows that men apply for jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria. Yet, women and other people who are systematically marginalized tend to only apply if they meet every requirement. If you believe you could excel in this role, we encourage you to apply. We are dedicated to considering a broad array of candidates, including those with diverse workplace experiences and backgrounds. Whether you're new to this field, returning to work after a gap in employment, looking to transition, or taking the next step in your career, we would be glad to have you on our radar.
At Third Plateau, we believe in the power of diverse teams. In our recruiting efforts, we always seek to reach a broad and diverse pool of applicants to ensure our final candidates are not a homogeneous group in terms of demographics or experience. You can read more about our company values here. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds. Third Plateau is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to their race, color, age, religious creed, sexual orientation, or other personal characteristics.
Disclaimer: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that you will be added to our mailing list. You will receive updates, newsletters, and other communications from us. Should you wish to opt out at any time, you will have the opportunity to unsubscribe from our mailing list through the emails you receive.

jobs.title: Solutions Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Who we are DigiCert is a global leader in intelligent trust.
jobs.description:
Who we are

DigiCert is a global leader in intelligent trust. We protect the digital world by ensuring the security, privacy, and authenticity of every interaction. Our AI-powered DigiCert ONE platform unifies PKI, DNS, and certificate lifecycle management, to secure infrastructure, software, devices, messages, AI content and agents. Learn why more than 100,000 organizations, including 90% of the Fortune 500, choose DigiCert to stop today’s threats and prepare for a quantum-safe future at

Job summary

As a Technical Solutions Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in combining technical expertise with strong sales acumen to identify, qualify, and close new business opportunities across a defined portfolio of customer and partner accounts.
Your day-to-day responsibilities will involve close collaboration with customers, partners, and Account Managers to deliver business value, conduct demos and POC/Vs, and contribute to the success of bids and tenders. You will provide end-to-end technical and business value guidance before and during the sales cycle ensuring customer requirements are met with tailored, innovative solutions.
Acting as a trusted technical advisor, you will be a key point of contact for clients, offering strategic insight and hands-on support. You'll also work closely with cross-functional teams to align solutions with customer needs and organizational goals.

Expected Travel is 20-25%

What you will do

Working for the Solutions Engineering team is an exciting blend of technology and sales, with real world impact, that continually provides diverse challenges and continuous learning. At DigiCert, we are excited to evolve our Solutions Engineering team to the next level, not just as engineering experts, but becoming business value champions and advocates for our prospects and customers. As part of the Solutions Engineering team, you will be at the forefront of emerging trends like post-quantum cryptography, IoT security, zero trust architecture, and digital identity and automation.

Your day to day will include:

Customer Engagement and Technical Discovery

  • Conduct technical discovery calls to understand customer requirements, pain points, and existing infrastructure.
  • Lead or participate in product demonstrations, showing how solutions meet client-specific needs.
  • Translate complex customer requirements into actionable technical solutions or configurations.
  • Assist with scoping customer environments to recommend best-fit products or services.

Solution Design and Architecture

  • Create technical documentation, architecture diagrams, and integration guides for customer engagements.
  • Deliver engaging technical presentations that deliver business value to external stakeholders and customers.
  • Design customized technical solutions based on client needs, often involving product configuration, integration planning, and API usage.
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to validate feasibility or escalate edge-case needs.
  • Produce architecture diagrams, technical proposals, or proof-of-concept (PoC) plans.
  • Support the preparation and delivery of RFP/RFI responses, technical questionnaires, and bid documentation.

Cross Functional Collaborations

  • Partner with Account Executives and Customer Success Managers to align technical value with customer goals.
  • Liaise with Product Managers to share customer feedback and advocate for feature enhancements or roadmap items.

What you will have

Educational Background:

  • Degree in Computer Information Systems, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related technical field.

Technical Skills & Experience:

  • 4+ years’ experience as an SE or technical salesperson, or equivalent and applicable experience as a product manager, engineer, tech support agent or administrator of enterprise-grade or IT/IS software
  • General knowledge or background in IT (ideally server administration, server OS configuration, TCP/IP networking hardware, protocols, LAN and WAN technologies & configurations, and network design) and/or IS (ideally PKI, firewall management, IDS & IPS, vulnerability management, and network scanners), in engineering, administration or support roles
  • Familiarity with cryptographic principles, digital certificates, and PKI concepts.
  • Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Oracle Cloud) and container technologies like Kubernetes.
  • Experience or familiarity with ServiceNow, GitHub, and REST API integrations.
  • Hands-on exposure to scripting and automation using Bash, PowerShell, Python, or similar languages.
  • Experience with DevOps and infrastructure automation tools (e.g., Terraform, Ansible, Puppet, Chef).

Soft Skills

  • Self-motivated with ability to self-direct in strategic alignment with sales counterparts
  • Technical, organized and analytical, with ability to eliminate sales obstacles through creative/innovative thinking
  • Passion for continuous learning and applying innovative solutions to complex challenges.
  • Situational awareness and business acumen skills to support self-held critical values of professionalism, humility, and customer-focus
  • Basic project management skills to accomplish role requirements
  • Strong communications, interpersonal and presentation skills, in both written and verbal formats
  • Fluency in English

Nice to have

  • Cybersecurity certifications (CISSP, GSEC, CCSP, etc.).
  • Hands-on experience with certificate management and cryptographic tools.
  • Familiarity with code signing, load balancers, and secure key storage.
  • Understanding of SSO, SAML, OpenID authentication methods.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a proactive security mindset.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation and comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage
  • Retirement savings programs with company matching (401(k) or RRSP)
  • Generous paid time off, including holidays, and vacation
  • Paid parental leave and family support benefits
  • Life and disabilitycoverage
  • Flexible spending and health savings options (where applicable)
  • Health and wellness support, including gym reimbursement and wellness programs
  • Employee Assistance Program with 24/7confidential support for employees and families

We’re looking for a Senior Cloud Application Architect to contribute to the design and delivery of cloud-native applications on AWS, growing into architectural ownership while staying close to the code. This is a role for someone who enjoys hands-on development and wants to sharpen the judgment that comes from designing services, APIs, and event flows that have to run reliably in production. You’ll help decompose systems into well-bounded services, shape serverless and container-based deployments, and make the day-to-day calls that keep applications scalable, secure, and maintainable.

You’ll collaborate closely with senior architects, engineers, and product partners to translate requirements into sound application architecture, implement infrastructure as code and CI/CD pipelines, and integrate AI services where they add value. At Robots & Pencils, we design AI systems for a human world. Our name says it all. Robots and pencils means engineering paired with creativity, because every agent we ship has to work for real people in real workflows. That balance is baked into how we operate.

Every role here contributes directly to that mission. Here, you shape how AI systems integrate into enterprise operations, how teams move at real velocity, and how products create measurable impact for clients and the people they serve. We ship production-ready AI in 30 to 45 days. That pace demands people who take ownership, lead with craft, and care deeply about what they put their name on.

  • Proficiency in at least one backend language and familiarity with another (e.g., Python, TypeScript, Java, Go)

  • Familiarity with observability, scalability, and resilience practices in cloud applications

  • Experience integrating AI or LLM services into applications, including RAG or inference patterns

This position requires travel to our headquarters in Melville, NY 3 times per year for internal meetings and team building activities. We reimburse reasonable and necessary travel expenses, and you’re also welcome to work on-site anytime beyond these visits – our doors are always open.

POSITION SUMMARY:

Natera's Real-World Data (RWD) ClinicalAI team turns clinical documents into structured data. The team has developed a platform that is now integral to Natera’s key initiatives leveraging RWD. In this role, you will own the experience of the people who work in the platform for their day to day operations. You will also own agentic workflows end to end: translating a stakeholder team's process into reliable, repeatable automation, deciding where AI agents act and where people interact, and making sure the final output is something the team can actually use.

This is an individual-contributor PM role: you'll shadow users, dig into the data yourself, write the requirements, and drive changes from idea to rollout, continuously focused on efficiency and innovation for your users. You will partner closely with engineering, software quality, and clinical teams that consume the data.

If you like making complex, high-volume workflows simple for expert users, turning AI agents into outputs people trust and act on, and seeing the improvement show up in the numbers, you will enjoy this role.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Own the user-experience backlog and priorities for the user-facing application, including case review and editing, document navigation and evidence, work queues, and administrative review, in line with the overall platform roadmap.
  • Increase efficiencies without tradeoffs to accuracy: shadow end users, measure where the time goes, and validate problems before they become backlog commitments.
  • Turn intricate, multi-step review workflows into clear, intuitive interfaces.
  • Own how new AI capabilities appear to end users; define the experience, pilot with leads, and roll out without disrupting live production work.
  • Own agentic workflows end to end, from discovery through launch, validation, and iteration: translate a stakeholder team's needs into a phased workflow, decide where AI agents act and where people stay in the loop, and make sure the result is accurate, auditable, and efficient at scale.
  • Deliver usable outputs to stakeholder teams across the business: agree on what a finished output looks like and how success is measured, confirm it is used in their work, and close the loop when it is not.
  • Partner with the AI scientists and engineers to take agent prototypes to production: weigh evaluation results for user and stakeholder impact, decide how much autonomy a workflow is ready for, and own the pilot, rollout, and success metric.
  • Own the onboarding playbook for new user groups, including internal teams and vendor partners: access and roles, training cases in the test environment, team-lead setup, and support materials.
  • Plan user-facing releases so changes are tested, communicated, and adopted, with documentation and training built alongside clinical leads.
  • Replace manual work with self-service: own the user experience and rollout of an in-platform workflows and drive adoption of self-service project setup by delivery teams.
  • Define and track KPIs; use those metrics to guide priorities.
  • Own what happens after launch: measure adoption, iterate, and retire workarounds and manual processes once the product replaces them.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience, plus 5+ years of product management experience, including launching two or more user-facing software products or major releases.
  • Experience owning workflow software that expert users rely on all day, such as data abstraction or curation, annotation or labeling tools, clinical operations, or case management, where user productivity and data quality are the core metrics.
  • Strong, hands-on experience with agentic AI: you have defined and shipped products built on LLM-based agents or agentic workflows, and you understand evaluation, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop design well enough to make tradeoffs with engineers and AI scientists.
  • AI-native working style: you use AI tools every day to accelerate product discovery, synthesize user research, analyze data, draft requirements, prototype workflows, and pressure test ideas.
  • A track record of taking AI workflows from prototype to production, not just proofs of concept, and delivering them end to end to a business stakeholder with clear acceptance criteria and measured adoption.
  • A keen UX sensibility and a high bar for product craft: you have shaped complex, multi-step workflows into intuitive interfaces, working closely with designers and engineers.
  • Hands-on user research and continuous product-improvement curiosity: you shadow users, run usability tests, ask why users work around the product, and turn observations into prioritized changes.
  • Experience bringing order to high-volume request streams and rolling out changes to large or distributed user groups, including vendor teams, with severity rules, response targets, training, and change management.
  • Hands-on with data: comfortable writing SQL or using equivalent tools to check status, investigate issues, and measure outcomes.
  • Backlog ownership in an Agile team: writing user stories and acceptance criteria in Jira and working through sprint planning with engineering and QA.
  • Clear written and verbal communication with end users, engineers, and operations leads, including documentation and training material people actually use.

PREFERRED:

  • Experience with real-world data, clinical chart abstraction, or human-in-the-loop data-quality programs.
  • Fluency in oncology or clinical concepts, such as diagnoses, lines of therapy, biomarkers, and staging, or the ability to ramp quickly alongside clinical partners.
  • Experience shipping AI-assisted workflows where people review model output, such as pre-filled values, confidence cues, or recommendations.
  • Experience in regulated healthcare, including HIPAA and PHI handling.

jobs.excerpt: About the Job: LaunchDarkly is seeking a Pricing & Packaging Field Insights Lead to bring a practical, field-informed perspective to important pricing and packaging decisions.
jobs.description:
About the Job:

LaunchDarkly is seeking a Pricing & Packaging Field Insights Lead to bring a practical, field-informed perspective to important pricing and packaging decisions. This role will work across Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Deal Management, Finance, Product, and Marketing to understand how customers and field teams experience our current commercial model—and turn those insights into clear, evidence-based recommendations.

The role is designed for a commercially minded operator who can engage directly with customer-facing teams, identify recurring friction and opportunity, evaluate options, and communicate a point of view to decision-makers. The successful candidate will help ensure that pricing and packaging decisions are not only analytically sound, but also understandable, sellable, and workable in real customer conversations.

This is a role with a focused mandate: gather and synthesize field insights, assess pricing and packaging alternatives, and recommend decisions that improve clarity, customer value communication, and field execution.

Project scope and working model

  • The role will have a defined project plan, regular stakeholder reviews, and agreed decision milestones.
  • The scope may evolve as field research surfaces new evidence, but the primary outcomes will remain field insight synthesis and pricing and packaging recommendations.
  • The role is an individual-contributor position and does not include direct people management.

Responsibilities:

  • Gather and synthesize field insights
    • Design and lead the organization's structured approach to field research; interviews, listening sessions, deal review, establishing the methodology other teams adopt for surfacing pricing and packaging signal from the field.
    • Serve as the principal authority for distinguishing isolated anecdotes from repeatable, structural signal across account executives, sales leadership, solutions engineering, customer success, and deal desk; codify this judgment into frameworks others can apply.
    • Translate field feedback into strategic themes and hypotheses that shape long-term pricing and packaging direction, not just near-term decision inputs.
    • Set the standard for how field perspective is represented in pricing and packaging discussions, including the judgment calls on confidentiality and representativeness that less experienced contributors would escalate.
  • Evaluate options and recommend decisions
    • Exercise wide latitude in determining which pricing and packaging questions merit investigation, and in defining the approach, objectives and methods are largely self-determined, with accountability for outcomes that affect the function or company as a whole.
    • Serve as principal advisor and internal expert on the interaction between pricing/packaging models and field commercial behavior; erroneous judgment here carries company-wide, long-term consequences.
    • Develop decision materials that function as the authoritative reference for the problem space; evidence, options, tradeoffs, and risk, used directly by executive and senior leadership to commit to strategy.
    • Partner with Finance, Product, Revenue Operations, Deal Management, and executive leadership as a peer contributor to strategy, not just a validator of others' assumptions; shape how those functions think about pricing risk going forward.
    • Identify systemic risks: unintended incentives, inconsistent application, structural complexity before they surface in the field, and influence policy and future model design to prevent them proactively.
    • Determine when a pilot, test, or feedback loop is warranted as a matter of judgment and precedent-setting practice, not a recommendation escalated for approval.
  • Support decision readiness
    • Own the translation of approved decisions into field-wide implications, setting the narrative and framing that customer-facing teams and enablement functions build from.
    • Identify systemic gaps in guidance, tooling, training, or process; at the level of the operating model, not a single rollout that could limit adoption at scale.
    • Establish and maintain the organization's structured system of record for field evidence, decisions, and open questions, serving as the field-wide reference of record beyond any single engagement.
    • Deliver a final readout that functions as a durable, field-wide reference; findings, recommendations, decisions, and a forward-looking view of pricing and packaging strategy used to inform strategy well beyond the immediate engagement.
  • How success will be measured
    • Field research produces a clear, representative view of recurring pricing and packaging friction and opportunity.
    • Decision-makers have concise, evidence-based recommendations with transparent tradeoffs.
    • Recommendations reflect both customer value and the realities of field execution.
    • Key pricing and packaging decisions are easier for customer-facing teams to understand and apply.
    • The project leaves behind reusable insights, decision documentation, and practical next steps for ongoing ownership.

Qualifications:

  • Experience in pricing and packaging, commercial strategy, revenue operations, sales strategy, deal desk, solutions engineering, customer success, or a closely related B2B SaaS function.
  • Direct experience working with customer-facing teams and interpreting feedback from live customer or deal contexts.
  • Demonstrated ability to structure ambiguous problems, synthesize qualitative and quantitative inputs, and form a clear recommendation.
  • Strong commercial judgment, including the ability to assess customer value, field behavior, business impact, and operational tradeoffs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present a point of view to both executive stakeholders and field practitioners.
  • Ability to operate independently in a fast-moving, cross-functional environment and deliver against a defined project mandate within 3–6 months.
  • Sound judgment when handling confidential customer, deal, pricing, and employee information.

jobs.description:
About Pantheon

Pantheon WebOps Platform powers the open web, running more than 300,000 sites in the cloud for customers including Google, Princeton, Salesloft and Doctors Without Borders. Every day, thousands of developers and marketers create, iterate, and scale WordPress and Drupal sites to reach billions of people globally. Pantheon’s multitenant, container-based platform enables organizations to manage all of their websites from a single dashboard. Organizations including Clorox and the United Nations drive results through accelerated development and real-time publishing using Pantheon’s collaborative workflows.

The Role

The Senior Manager, Technical Support Engineering leads the operating model that helps Technical Support solve complex customer problems with speed, depth, and consistency. This role owns the systems, standards, and partnerships that allow a high-performing global team to do its best work.

The role includes leadership of specialized capability for complex escalations, platform reliability, proactive monitoring, on-call engineering tasks, and structured partnership with Engineering. This is an operational leadership role. The successful candidate will look for constraints in the system, identify practical solutions, and build repeatable ways of working. They will use data, customer signals, and team feedback to improve service without creating unnecessary processes.

What you will own

Global operating model

  • Lead Technical Support Engineering operations across multiple regions and locations
  • Design and maintain a follow-the-sun model with clear regional ownership, handoffs, on-call coverage, and escalation paths.
  • Establish operating cadences that make work visible, decisions timely, and ownership clear.
  • Ensure coverage, workload, and priorities match customer risk and business needs.
  • Build the mechanisms that allow the team to operate effectively across time zones without relying on constant manager intervention.

Operational excellence and continuous improvement

  • Diagnose operational problems at the system level, including unclear ownership, weak handoffs, avoidable escalations, capacity constraints, and inconsistent follow-through.
  • Design simple, durable solutions that improve speed and quality without adding process for its own sake.
  • Use service data, ticket trends, customer feedback, incident reviews, and team input to prioritize improvements.
  • Own the operating procedures, runbooks, playbooks, review mechanisms, and reporting needed to make the function scalable.
  • Establish clear standards for escalation quality, customer communication, Engineering follow-up, incident participation, and documentation.
  • Create feedback loops that show whether a change improved the customer experience and the team’s ability to deliver.
  • Use automation and AI thoughtfully to reduce repetitive work, improve signal detection, and increase the team’s capacity for complex issues.

Customer and cross-functional leadership

  • Act as an escalation leader for high-impact customer issues and incidents.
  • Ensure customers receive clear ownership, timely updates, and technically credible guidance.
  • Partner with Customer Success, Account teams, Product, Professional Services, and Engineering on complex customer situations.
  • Translate team performance, customer risk, and recurring technical themes into clear recommendations for senior leadership.
  • Connect Support execution to customer trust, retention, expansion readiness, and the company’s ability to deliver differentiated support offerings.

Team leadership and development

  • Build and sustain a high-performing team with clear standards for judgment, ownership, technical depth, and customer care.
  • Set clear expectations for managers, team leads, and engineers, then give them the context and tools to meet those expectations.
  • Coach leaders to solve operational problems independently rather than escalating every constraint upward.
  • Develop technical depth in platform troubleshooting, incident response, observability, and customer communication.
  • Own performance management, career development, succession planning, and retention for the function.
  • Make thoughtful decisions about readiness, role fit, and team structure with clarity and care.
  • Protect the conditions that allow strong engineers to do deep work while maintaining reliable customer coverage.
  • Build an environment where people raise risks early, challenge weak processes constructively, and follow through on commitments.

Measures of success

The Senior Manager will establish baselines early and use the measures below to drive decisions and continuous improvement.

  • Faster and more consistent acknowledgement and resolution of high-severity issues.
  • Improved quality and actionability of Engineering handoffs.
  • Fewer avoidable escalations and stronger trust from Engineering in Support triage.
  • Reliable follow-the-sun and on-call coverage across all three regions.
  • Clear ownership and timely follow-up throughout complex customer issues.
  • More recurring platform patterns surfaced with supporting data and converted into corrective action.
  • Meaningful contributions to post-incident reviews, reliability improvements, and reusable runbooks.
  • Strong customer outcomes on the most complex and highest-risk interactions.
  • A team that is engaged, technically capable, and able to operate with increasing autonomy.
  • Documented workflow improvements that increase capacity or reduce avoidable effort through automation and AI.

What we are looking for

  • Significant experience leading technical support, escalation support, site reliability, platform operations, or a related function in a SaaS, cloud, or web infrastructure environment.
  • Experience leading globally distributed or follow-the-sun teams.
  • A demonstrated record of improving support operations through better ownership, process design, metrics, and cross-functional execution.
  • Experience managing high-performing technical teams and developing managers or team leads.
  • Strong incident and escalation management experience, including customer communication during high-impact events.
  • Experience partnering with Engineering and Product to investigate defects, improve reliability, and address systemic issues.
  • Strong analytical judgment and the ability to turn operational data into clear priorities and decisions.
  • Experience building or improving service metrics, dashboards, operating reviews, and reporting for senior stakeholders.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain complex technical issues to non-technical audiences.
  • Working knowledge of observability, logs, traces, incident management, ticketing systems, and technical knowledge management.
  • Familiarity with WordPress, Drupal, and Next.js, or comparable web application and cloud infrastructure environments.
  • Experience using automation or AI to improve support workflows, knowledge access, triage, or operational visibility.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical, business, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.

What We Offer

We have all the usual perks and benefits but what we can really offer you is a fantastic work environment powered by an amazing team.

  • Industry competitive compensation and equity plan
  • Flexible time off, sick days, and 13 paid holidays
  • Comprehensive medical insurance including Health, Dental and Vision
  • Paid parental leave (plus fertility, adoption and other family planning benefits)
  • In-office workspace (San Francisco & Chicago)
  • Monthly allowance for wellness, reading and access to LinkedIn Learning for continued development
  • Events and activities both team-based and company wide that inspire, educate and cultivate

The base salary for this position is $164,400.00 – $205,500.00 annually for employees based in San Francisco and New York, and $147,700.00 – $184,600.00 annually for all other U.S. locations. Final compensation will be determined based on factors including role scope, relevant experience, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for a performance bonus and equity.

jobs.description:
Description

MEDvidi is an AI-powered mental healthcare platform setting a new standard for safe, effective, and scalable psychiatric care in the United States.

We combine licensed providers with proprietary AI tools to deliver consistent, outcomes-driven treatment for conditions like ADHD, anxiety, depression, and more. MEDvidi's technology automates charting, follow-ups, and treatment planning, freeing providers to focus on patient care while improving efficiency and clinical quality.

As Staff Product Designer, you will own the end-to-end design of MEDvidi's AI Track, the core line of AI-powered clinical tools where providers interact with model outputs in a regulated healthcare environment. Your design decisions directly shape how clinicians review, accept, and correct AI-generated notes, treatment plans, and recommendations, impacting both provider efficiency and patient outcomes.

You will work closely with product managers and engineers, reporting to the Director of Product. This is a senior IC role with no direct reports: you drive product design from problem definition through delivery, gather requirements independently, and bring solutions to release. Your scope includes provider-facing tools (Chart Review, AI Scribe, AI Receptionist), patient portal, and internal operational systems, all web-based.

Why this role

  • Zero-to-one in AI-first environment. You will shape new interaction patterns for agentic AI features: Chart Review, AI Scribe, AI Receptionist, where design quality directly affects clinical decisions.
  • Prototype in real code, not Figma mockups. Prototyping happens in Claude Code and Cursor on the actual codebase with production components. Your prototypes go straight to engineering without redrawing.
  • Co-own a design system built for humans and AI agents. You will evolve reusable components, tokens, and documentation that are readable by both your teammates and code-generation agents, a rare opportunity to define what design systems look like in an AI-native workflow.

Responsibilities

  • Own product design in your areas of the AI Track end-to-end: from defining the problem with the product manager, through user analysis, to working with engineers on the solution and accepting the build.
  • Design and iterate on human-AI interaction patterns: interfaces where providers verify, accept, edit, or reject model output and bring those patterns to a state where other teams can reuse them.
  • Ensure quality of design decisions: validate solutions with users when needed, perform design acceptance with engineering, analyze post-release results, and feed learnings back into the product.
  • Contribute to the design system within product initiatives: turn your solutions into reusable components in Storybook with tokens, naming, and documentation that are usable by both designers and AI code-generation agents.
  • Gather requirements independently: go to providers, medical operations, and product managers, identify problems, and bring back a proposal. There is no standing PM brief in AI Track, you shape the brief.
  • Accelerate design delivery using AI tools: build functional prototypes in Claude Code or Cursor on the real codebase with production components; prototypes go to engineering without redrawing.

This role is not for you if

  • You need a detailed brief before starting work. Requirements here are gathered by you, not handed to you, there is no PM or BA writing specs for AI Track.
  • You prefer managing people over hands-on design. This is an IC role with no direct reports; the impact comes from the quality of your own design decisions.
  • You design exclusively in Figma and hand off static specs. Prototyping at MEDvidi happens in code on the real codebase using AI agents, comfort with a code editor is a daily requirement, not a nice-to-have.

Requirements

  • 6+ years in product design, with a focus on complex work interfaces: EHR, admin panels, CRM, operational tools, or other systems where specialists perform their core work.
  • Demonstrable experience designing human-AI interaction: interfaces where users verify, accept, edit, or reject model output. Building a 0-to-1 agentic product is ideal; experience with review-and-approval interfaces for automated decisions also qualifies.
  • Hands-on prototyping in code using AI agents (Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent) on an existing component library or codebase, not just design tools.
  • Track record of contributing to a design system within product work: shipping reusable components, tokens, and documentation as part of feature delivery, not as a standalone project.
  • Proven ability to gather requirements independently, finding problems, talking to users and stakeholders, and driving a solution to release without waiting for a mandated brief.
  • Advanced English (B2+) and fluent Russian.
  • Availability to work within CET-compatible hours.

Would be a plus

  • Experience in healthcare or telemedicine products: understanding of HIPAA, clinical compliance constraints, and the provider's role in decision-making.
  • Experience leading a design team's transition to AI tools: setting up shared agent workflows, running workshops, driving adoption across peers.
  • Hands-on user research with specialist users: usability testing and interviews with doctors, nurses, or clinical operators (not only end consumers).

What we offer

  • High-impact environment: A chance to contribute to a product-driven company in the medical tech space.
  • Growth & compensation: Clear growth opportunities and a competitive compensation package.
  • Remote-first: Fully remote long-term collaboration under a B2B model.

jobs.description:
Overview

We’re looking for a full stack developer to help build and extend LIGER, an enterprise AI platform that connects knowledge, systems, and agentic workflows to accelerate outcomes across federal missions. You’ll join a small, cross-functional team shipping a ground-up product redesign, and increasingly, building the agentic capabilities that make LIGER genuinely powerful.

This isn’t a maintain-the-backlog role. You’ll work across the stack, own features end to end, and help shape how AI agents are integrated into workflows that real users depend on. If you’re excited about building systems where models do real work, not just generate text, keep reading.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

What You’ll Do

  • Build and ship full stack features across frontend (Angular, TypeScript), backend (Node/Python), and the integration layer between them
  • Design and implement agentic workflows: tool-calling, multi-step reasoning pipelines, and the infrastructure that makes them reliable
  • Own document processing and validation features end to end, including configurable parsing pipelines (Word/XML extraction, structure-aware chunking) that feed retrieval and citation-validation logic
  • Use AI coding tools as a daily part of your development workflow
  • Integrate and maintain connections to external services, data sources, and APIs as part of agent execution flows
  • Design backend data models for flexible, hierarchical business data: linked records, rollups, and customer-defined structures that evolve without a rebuild
  • Collaborate directly with our designer and engineering lead in working sessions; you’ll shape UX decisions, not just implement them
  • Contribute to backend architecture decisions around agent orchestration, state management, and LLM interaction patterns
  • Ship incrementally and stay close to users; we care about getting things in front of people, not perfecting in isolation

Qualifications

What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years of full stack development experience, or fewer years with demonstrable depth in agentic or LLM-native development; comfortable owning both frontend and backend
  • Experience using PostgreSQL to store, retrieve, and manage structured application data, including database design, SQL development, and operational support
  • Comfort with document-oriented data modeling (MongoDB or similar JSON-native stores) alongside relational, and judgment about when hierarchical business data fits schema-on-read better than a fixed relational schema
  • Proficiency in Angular and TypeScript on the frontend
  • Solid backend experience in Node.js and/or Python
  • Hands-on experience building with LLMs: prompt engineering, API integration, tool use, and managing model outputs in production
  • Active use of AI-assisted development tools in your day-to-day coding workflow
  • Experience designing RESTful APIs and backend services that support scalable, maintainable integration across distributed application components
  • Familiarity with agentic patterns: orchestration, tool-calling, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), multi-step agent flows
  • Relatively unopinionated by temperament: you fit the data model to the problem, not the problem to your favorite stack
  • Ability to move fast and iterate without heavy specs or detailed tickets

What Will Set You Apart

  • A portfolio of side projects, open-source contributions, or other evidence of a builder’s disposition; we care more about what you’ve built than where you’ve worked
  • Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP): building servers, defining tools, or integrating MCP into an agent stack
  • Experience building scalable document processing pipelines supporting extraction, chunking, metadata enrichment, indexing, and persistence for downstream semantic retrieval
  • Background on AI-native products where models are core to the user experience, not bolted on
  • Experience building enterprise business systems: workflow-heavy applications, rules engines, or systems-of-record with complex derived state
  • Experience developing software in environments governed by federal security and compliance requirements, with attention to secure coding, access control, auditability, and deployment constraints

About This Team

LIGER sits within LMI’s Chief Technology Office. We’re a small, high-visibility team building AI tools for federal agencies. The culture is collegial and fast-moving: engineers work directly with product and design, decisions get made in working sessions rather than committees, and shipped work beats polished plans.

We work with experts and partners across the US and India, run significant cloud and model-provider spend, and move fast. Today the IT work that keeps that running is spread across people. We are hiring one technical owner for IT and security: the vendors we pay, the API keys and accounts people use, the devices they work on, and the agents that should be doing most of the repetitive work.

This is a hands-on role. You will set the strategy, and you will also be the person who fixes someone's access on a Tuesday afternoon, at least until you have automated it. The best IT teams make things easier for people rather than adding processes, and we want someone who builds that way from day one.

What you'll do

  • Own vendor management and cost reduction: keep an inventory of every tool and vendor we pay for (seats, plans, renewal dates), run renewals, and negotiate with vendors including model providers and cloud. Know when an enterprise plan, a commit or a discount makes sense, and go get it.
  • Own API key and access management: how keys are issued, scoped, limited and retired, with all model usage running through our company gateway and spend limits and alerts that catch problems early. Handle access to AWS, Datadog, compute and internal tools with least-privilege defaults.
  • Build onboarding and offboarding for employees, contractors and experts: accounts, devices, tool access and guidance on day one, and fast, complete offboarding so nobody leaves with live credentials.
  • Set up device management and baseline security for company laptops (encryption, patching, endpoint protection), and partner with our security lead on policy, alert triage and audit readiness.
  • Be the technical escalation point for IT issues across the company, and build your own agents and automations so access requests, onboarding and routine tickets mostly handle themselves.
  • Decide if and when to bring in an outsourced IT vendor for time-zone coverage, and manage them so support stays fast and specific to how we work.

Who we're looking for

Required

  • 5+ years in IT, IT operations or security, ideally at a fast-growing tech or AI company.
  • Hands-on experience with identity and access (Google Workspace, Okta or similar), AWS IAM, and device management (Jamf, Kandji, Intune or similar).
  • A track record of cutting software and cloud spend through renegotiation, consolidation or plan changes, with numbers to show for it.

What this role is not

You are not building a large IT organization on day one, and you are not a ticket queue that waits to be told what to do. Project leads own the cost of the work on their projects; you own the systems, limits and visibility that let them do that well. If a fix can be automated, the expectation is that you automate it rather than staff it.

Job Title:Quality & Risk Lead
