About Medneo
At Medneo, we're passionate about delivering outstanding patient-focused diagnostic imaging services. Through our network of static imaging centres and innovative mobile imaging services, we work with healthcare partners across the UK to improve access to high-quality diagnostic services and make a meaningful difference to patient care.
Quality, safety and continuous improvement sit at the heart of everything we do. As our services continue to develop, we're looking for an enthusiastic, proactive and forward-thinking Quality &
Risk Lead to play a pivotal role in strengthening and driving our Quality and Risk function.
This is an exciting opportunity for someone who is passionate about clinical governance, patient safety and quality improvement, and who wants to make a tangible impact across a diverse and growing diagnostic imaging organisation.
The opportunity
Working closely with the Clinical Director and wider senior leadership team, you will take a leading role in supporting, coordinating and developing Medneo's clinical governance, quality assurance and risk management activities.
You will be a key point of contact for quality and clinical governance across our static and mobile services, providing guidance, supporting clinical teams and ensuring that robust systems and processes are in place to maintain the highest standards of patient care, safety and regulatory compliance.
From supporting incident investigations and clinical audits to monitoring performance, developing reporting systems and driving continuous improvement, you'll have the opportunity to influence how quality is embedded throughout the organisation.
This isn't simply a role about maintaining compliance. It's about identifying opportunities to do things better, challenging where necessary, supporting colleagues and helping create a culture where quality, safety and accountability are everyone's responsibility.
The role offers remote working, with flexibility to connect with colleagues across the UK and attend meetings or other activities at Medneo locations as required.

What you'll be responsible for

Clinical Governance, Quality & Compliance
  • Support the Clinical Director in leading and maintaining compliance with CQC requirements, ISO 9001, ISO 27001, ISO 14001, QSI and other relevant regulatory and accreditation standards.
  • Support the development, implementation and continuous improvement of Medneo's Quality Management System and clinical governance framework.
  • Ensure policies, procedures, clinical documentation and governance records remain accurate, current and accessible.
  • Act as a trusted point of contact for clinical teams, providing advice and guidance on quality, governance and compliance matters.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, transparency, learning and continuous improvement.
Patient Safety, Risk & Incident Management
  • Support the reporting, investigation and management of clinical incidents, complaints and patient safety concerns.
  • Apply the principles of PSIRF (Patient Safety Incident Response Framework) to support proportionate, learning-focused incident responses.
  • Identify themes, trends and emerging risks, ensuring learning is shared and appropriate improvement actions are implemented.
  • Support Yellow Card reporting and other relevant external reporting requirements.
  • Monitor risk registers and follow up outstanding actions, escalating concerns appropriately.
Clinical Audit & Continuous Improvement
  • Coordinate and undertake clinical audits across static and mobile imaging services.
  • Monitor audit outcomes, identify areas for improvement and support the development of effective action plans.
  • Track clinical projects, service developments and change management initiatives.
  • Support patient satisfaction monitoring and use feedback to identify opportunities to enhance the patient experience.
  • Work collaboratively with clinical and operational teams to drive measurable improvements in service quality.
Performance, Reporting & Data Management
  • Monitor and maintain quality and clinical governance KPIs.
  • Produce meaningful monthly quality and compliance reports, highlighting performance, trends, risks and areas requiring attention.
  • Maintain and develop spreadsheets, dashboards and reporting tools to support effective oversight of the Quality and Risk function.
  • Support the development and administration of Medneo's Business Management System.
  • Lead the monitoring of mandatory training, e-learning, competency compliance and policy reading across clinical and non-clinical teams.
  • Utilise Microsoft Excel, SharePoint, Forms and Power BI to improve data collection, reporting and visibility of compliance.
Leadership, Engagement & Collaboration
  • Build effective relationships with radiographers, clinicians, operational managers and senior leaders across the organisation.
  • Support and influence clinical teams to embed good governance practices into everyday working.
  • Provide guidance, challenge and support where standards or processes are not being met.
  • Support the Clinical Director with quality improvement projects and wider strategic initiatives.
  • Deputise for the Clinical Director when required and represent the Quality and Risk function at meetings and corporate induction sessions.

What we're looking for

We're looking for someone who combines strong organisational and analytical skills with a genuine passion for patient safety, quality and clinical excellence.
Ideally, you'll bring experience from a healthcare, clinical or diagnostic imaging environment, although this isn't essential. What matters most is your understanding of quality management, your ability to work collaboratively with clinical teams and your confidence in managing governance processes.
You'll ideally have:
  • Experience working within a Quality Management System (QMS), ideally in a healthcare or regulated environment.
  • A good understanding of clinical governance, patient safety and healthcare regulatory requirements, particularly CQC.
  • Experience or knowledge of PSIRF and the principles of effective incident investigation and organisational learning.
  • Experience planning, coordinating or undertaking clinical or quality audits.
  • An understanding of risk management, compliance monitoring and continuous improvement.
  • Strong analytical skills and confidence working with data, KPIs and performance reporting.
  • Excellent Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel and SharePoint.
  • Experience using Microsoft Forms and Power BI, or an enthusiasm to develop these skills.
  • An interest in using AI and digital solutions to improve efficiency and quality processes.
You'll also be someone who:
  • Takes ownership, works autonomously and proactively identifies opportunities for improvement.
  • Has exceptional attention to detail and takes pride in producing accurate, high-quality work.
  • Is confident communicating with colleagues at all levels, including senior leadership and clinical professionals.
  • Can constructively challenge, influence and support others to achieve the right outcomes.
  • Is organised, adaptable and comfortable managing competing priorities.
  • Has a positive, solutions-focused approach and thrives in a changing environment.
  • Understands the importance of confidentiality, professionalism and ethical practice.

Why join Medneo?

At Medneo, you'll be joining a collaborative and forward-thinking team where your contribution genuinely matters.

We offer:
  • Remote working – flexibility to manage your workload while remaining connected to teams across the UK.
  • Real influence – an opportunity to shape and strengthen quality and clinical governance across our services.
  • Professional development – opportunities to expand your expertise and develop your career within quality, risk and clinical leadership.
  • A collaborative culture – work closely with experienced clinicians, operational leaders and senior management.
  • Long-term opportunity – a permanent position within an organisation committed to delivering high-quality diagnostic imaging services.

  • Private Medical Insurance (Bupa) – includes pre-existing conditions
  • Add-On Family Health Options and Life Assurance x5

Who we are:

MHC is a global provider of AI-powered SaaS solutions for document, communication, and payment automation - purpose-built for highly regulated industries. We simplify complexity and unlock intelligence so organizations can deliver exceptional experiences with confidence.

Our platform helps enterprise and mid-market organizations improve efficiency, ensure compliance, and modernize customer communications at scale. Customers use MHC solutions to generate more than 10 billion documents and process billions in AP payments annually. Recognized as a Leader in multiple G2 reports and featured in analyst reports from Gartner, IDC, Aspire, and Aragon, MHC is built for organizations that can't afford to get it wrong.

People are at the center of everything we do - for our customers and within our own walls. MHC supports a flexible, work-where-you-live model, and for five consecutive years has been named one of Minnesota's Top Workplaces by the Star Tribune, based entirely on employee feedback. We are a team driven to grow, committed to being better than yesterday, and stronger together. We earn trust every day with our customers, our partners, and each other. We experiment boldly, and when our customers win, we win.

For more information, visit mhcautomation.com.

Who we are looking for:

We're looking for a hands-on Lead, Data & AI Engineering to build the data layer for MHC and the intelligence on top of it. You will own how data is ingested, modeled, governed, and served across the company, and you'll partner with Product and Engineering to ship AI- and LLM-powered features into our product.

This is a player-coach role. You will spend significant time in the code designing pipelines, building data models, and prototyping AI features while also managing and growing a small team of 1-2 data and AI engineers. You'll set the technical direction, establish the standards, and be accountable for both the platform and the people.

Why join us? MHC is at a pivotal moment. With a strong foundation and bold growth ambitions, we're not just scaling, we're transforming. We're looking for someone who isn't here to maintain the status quo, but to define what data and AI can do for our business and our customers.

This isn't a plug-and-play role. You'll have end-to-end ownership of green-field data and AI capability at a company with real data, real customers, and clear problems worth solving. You won't be handed a playbook you'll write it. You'll set the direction, build the foundation, and see your work shipped directly into the product, all while building and leading the team that does it.

If you want to architect the future of a global SaaS company, not just join it this is your opportunity.

What you will get to do:

Build the data layer

  • Architect. Design and build MHC's core data platform — ingestion, transformation, storage, and serving layers — across batch and streaming workloads.
  • Model. Model data for both analytics and product use cases, creating clean, well-documented, reusable datasets and a semantic layer the whole company can trust.
  • Govern. Establish data quality, lineage, observability, and governance practices so data is reliable, discoverable, and secure.
  • Pipe. Build the pipelines and feature/embedding stores that feed analytics, ML, and LLM applications.

Create intelligence from data

  • Mine. Turn raw operational and document data into intelligence — metrics, signals, predictions, and document understanding — that powers decisions and product features.
  • Apply AI. Build and evaluate models and retrieval systems (including RAG over documents) that extract, classify, summarize, and reason over MHC's data.
  • Productize. Partner with Product to design and ship LLM-powered features — from prototype to production — with appropriate guardrails, evaluation, and cost controls.

Lead the team

  • Manage. Manage, mentor, and grow a team of 2–4 data and AI engineers; set goals, give feedback, and develop careers.
  • Direct. Set technical standards and a pragmatic roadmap for data and AI; make build-vs-buy decisions and balance speed with long-term maintainability.
  • Partner. Collaborate across Product, Engineering, and business stakeholders to align the data and AI roadmap with company priorities.
  • Contribute. Stay hands-on — review code and designs, prototype hard problems, and set the bar for engineering quality.

What Success Looks Like in This Role:

  • First 90 days. In 90 days: you understand MHC's data and systems, have a prioritized data & AI roadmap, and have shipped early wins to the data layer.
  • Six months. In 6 months: a reliable, documented data foundation is in place, and the first AI/LLM-powered feature is in production or in customer testing.
  • One year. In 12 months: the team is delivering a steady stream of data products and AI features, with strong quality, governance, and a growing, high-performing team.

Education and Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field or equivalent years of experience.
  • 7+ years building data and/or backend systems in production, with recent hands-on experience in both data engineering and applied AI/ML.
  • Proven ownership of a data platform: strong SQL and Python, and experience with modern data tooling (e.g., a cloud warehouse/lakehouse such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, or Redshift; transformation tools like dbt; and orchestration such as Airflow, Dagster, or Prefect).
  • Hands-on experience building production AI/ML features, including practical work with LLMs — prompting, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings/vector search, evaluation, and integrating models via APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) or open-source models.
  • Solid software engineering fundamentals: data modeling, API design, testing, CI/CD, and building reliable systems on a major cloud (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • Experience leading or mentoring engineers — whether as a manager, tech lead, or senior IC ready to step into people management — and a genuine interest in growing a team.
  • Strong product sense and communication: able to translate ambiguous business problems into data and AI solutions, and explain trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred experience, skills, and knowledge:

  • Experience with document AI / intelligent document processing (OCR, extraction, classification) or NLP over unstructured text.
  • Experience operating LLMs in production — evaluation/observability, prompt and cost optimization, fine-tuning, or agentic workflows.
  • Background in B2B SaaS, document/process automation, fintech, or other data-heavy enterprise domains.
  • Familiarity with data privacy, security, and compliance (e.g., SOC 2, GDPR) in a multi-tenant SaaS environment.
  • Experience with streaming (Kafka/Kinesis), infrastructure-as-code, and MLOps/LLMOps tooling.

Worksite Location: This is a remote role. Candidates must be based in the United States.

This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

MHC Comprehensive Benefits Package

We offer a robust benefits package designed to support the well-being and financial security of our employees.

Our Benefits Include:

  • Workplace Flexibility
  • 401(k) Plan: Deferred and Roth options available to help you save for retirement, with a generous employer match of 50% up to maximum of 4.5% of gross pay.
  • Medical Plans: Comprehensive co-pay or HSA coverage options to keep you and your family healthy.
  • Dental and Vision Plans: Access to a large network of providers for dental and vision health.
  • Daycare and Medical FSA/HSA: Save on eligible daycare and healthcare expenses with our flexible spending and health savings account plans.
  • Group Term Life Insurance: Coverage of $50,000 to provide peace of mind.
  • Generous Paid Time Off (PTO) Policies: Ample time to relax and recharge.
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP): Support for personal and professional challenges.

Voluntary Benefits Available:

  • Additional Life Insurance
  • Critical Illness Insurance
  • Accident, Cancer & Hospital Indemnity Insurance
  • Legal/ID Shield
  • Pet Insurance

Parental Leave:

If your state offers a paid family or medical leave program, you will have access to those benefits. For employees in states without a state program, we offer:

  • Four weeks of paid paternity leave, available after one year of employment, with partial eligibility beginning at six months.
  • Twelve weeks of paid leave for the birth parent, eligibility rules apply.

jobs.excerpt: DESIGN LEAD Creative Team Lead Inspire the work.  Grow the people.
jobs.description:
DESIGN LEAD

Creative Team Lead

Inspire the work. Grow the people. Raise the standard.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We’re looking for a Design Lead who loves great creative work — and gets just as much satisfaction from helping other designers do their best work.

This is a hands-on creative leadership role. You’ll continue to design, particularly where your experience can make the biggest difference, while leading creative direction, raising quality across our work and supporting the growth of the designers around you.

You’ll work across a varied portfolio of digital and learning experiences, partnering with Designers, Content Writers, Video Editors, Developers, Project Managers, Learner Experience Leads and Client Partnership Leads to turn client challenges into thoughtful, engaging creative solutions.

Some weeks you’ll be closer to the work: solving a difficult design problem, shaping a concept or stepping into a complex project. At other times, your focus will be on coaching, reviewing work, planning capacity and making sure the team has the clarity and support it needs to deliver.

The constant is simple: you’ll help make our design work better and our designers stronger.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

You’ll lead creative quality across the portfolio, interpreting briefs, client objectives, brand guidance and feedback to establish clear and effective creative direction.

You’ll review work and give thoughtful, constructive feedback that helps designers strengthen both the quality of their outputs and their own creative judgement. You’ll help maintain strong visual standards and ensure our templates, assets and guidelines make great work easier to produce consistently.

As a people manager, you’ll support the designers you manage through regular 1:1s, coaching, feedback and development conversations. You’ll set clear expectations, recognise great performance and create opportunities for people to stretch, learn and take greater ownership.

You’ll also help keep Design running effectively. That means maintaining visibility of workloads and priorities, helping allocate work according to capacity and capability, spotting delivery risks early and removing blockers that could get in the team’s way.

And you’ll be an important voice for Design with our clients and wider teams. You’ll contribute to kick-offs, workshops and solution conversations, confidently presenting creative thinking and helping stakeholders understand the rationale behind our design decisions.

We’ll also look to you to keep us moving forward — exploring new tools, trends and creative practices and finding practical ways to improve our quality, efficiency and ways of working.

YOU’LL THRIVE HERE IF

You’re an experienced designer with excellent visual judgement and a strong understanding of brand, digital design and user experience.

You care about the details, but you can also see the bigger picture. You know when to get hands-on, when to provide direction and when to give someone else the space and support to solve the problem themselves.

You’ll probably recognise yourself in a lot of this:

  • You love producing excellent creative work and helping others raise theirs.
  • You give clear, specific and constructive creative feedback.
  • You enjoy coaching designers and helping people build confidence and capability.
  • You can translate sometimes messy client challenges into clear creative direction.
  • You communicate confidently with clients and colleagues from different disciplines.
  • You’re organised and comfortable balancing competing projects, priorities and deadlines.
  • You take ownership of problems and work collaboratively to solve them.
  • You’re curious about new tools, technologies and ways of working.
  • You can balance creative ambition with the commercial and operational realities of delivering client work.
  • You create an environment where people feel trusted to contribute ideas, experiment and do great work.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

You’ll know you’re making an impact when the quality and consistency of our design work keeps getting stronger; designers are developing greater confidence, capability and ownership; projects are delivered reliably; and clients and colleagues increasingly see Design as a trusted creative partner.

Most importantly, your impact won’t only be visible in the work you personally create. It will be visible in the quality of work the whole team is able to produce.

THE ONE THING

Raise the quality of design while building the capability of the designers around you, so Design consistently contributes exceptional work to client and business success.

WHAT YOU GET

We want great work to be recognised and rewarded, with a package designed to support your financial, physical and emotional wellbeing.

Competitive pay and reward — Your role is benchmarked against the external market, with a clear salary band and opportunities to grow your reward as your impact, capability and contribution develop.

Bonus opportunity — Eligible Quadmarkers can participate in our discretionary bonus programme, which recognises both company performance and individual contribution. The standard bonus target is 10% of base salary for eligible employees.

Flexible, remote-first working, with offsites too — Work from wherever you do your best thinking. Life happens, and if you need to flex, we’ll always aim to support that. Quarterly in-person team days help keep the relationships real.

Travel insurance — We believe in the importance of face-to-face time and want you to be able to spend time with colleagues and clients when you need to.

Private Medical Insurance — In the UK, we partner with Vitality, with health and life cover alongside rewards designed to help you stay healthy.

EAP and mental health support — Access to a confidential Employee Assistance Programme and mental health resources.

Enhanced leave — Our leave offering is enhanced beyond statutory requirements depending on location. In the UK, that means 25 days’ annual leave, plus three additional paid days when we shut down over the holidays.

LIFE AT QUADMARK

We care about what you achieve, how you achieve it and how you continue to grow.

Our CORE values shape how we work together: Choose to Learn, Own It, Respect Others and Elevate the Team.

For a Design Lead, that means staying curious and open to new ideas, taking ownership of delivery and quality, communicating with clarity and kindness, and creating the conditions for other people to succeed.

If you’re excited by the idea of combining excellent design craft with creative direction, client collaboration and people leadership, we’d love to hear from you.

- Experience implementing or managing offline conversion tracking.
- Ability to evaluate acquisition funnels and diagnose conversion problems.

Our core belief: combining the highest quality data with state-of-the-art software delivers immense value.

We believe execution matters most. Progress comes from speed, accuracy, and quality in what we build every day. Our engineering approach emphasizes clear product definitions leading to meticulous technical designs. We leverage a modern tech stack to deliver inherently reliable applications and a great user experience.

Our work spans two critical areas:

Data-Driven Insights

We develop sophisticated applications that map and understand global scientific and medical expertise, providing high-impact insights and AI-generated intelligence. Engineers here tackle complex data modeling, entity resolution, and advanced machine learning.

Intelligent Business Workflows

We engineer workflow applications powered by our data, using AI to find patterns and route information precisely. This involves designing scalable pipelines and intelligent automation.

Why Join Veeva Link?

Build products that create a significant positive impact in global healthcare.
Work in an environment led by a CEO with an engineering background.
Work Anywhere means you can work in an office or at home on any given day.
Empowered Autonomy: Tech decisions are made within teams, giving engineers significant autonomy.

    • Partner with mobile engineers to identify, isolate, and troubleshoot complex application defects

    • Collaborate with software engineers to establish robust testing protocols for new feature development
    • Anticipate complex user scenarios and edge cases to engineer thorough test coverage
    • Document and escalate defects via GitHub issues to deliver actionable insights to the Engineering team

    • Quality oriented mindset
    • 4+ years of experience working as a Quality Assurance Engineer for mobile
    • Combination of in-depth knowledge of quality assurance, solid understanding of mobile technologies, as well as knowledge of automation tools
    • Experience in manual testing, including checking network calls using Man-in-the-middle/Proxy (e.g. Charles, ProxyMan)
    • Familiarity with Cloud testing platforms (e.g. SauceLabs, LambdaTest)
    • Proficiency in writing native app code tests (e.g. XCUITest, etc)
    • Experience with Command line tools for iOS (xcrun, xcode-select, xcodebuild, npm, etc), as well as with configuration management or version control tools (e.g. git)
    • Proactively make continuous improvements regarding test coverage, execution and automation.
    • Experience with continuous integration software (e.g. GitHub Actions, Jenkins, TrevisCI, etc).
    • Good communication and interpersonal skills
    • Excellent command of the English language
    • Passion for all things mobile
    • AI-forward mindset: comfortable leveraging AI tools to speed up test case design, automation scripting, and debugging

Description

WHO WE ARE

Come join the company at the center of how the world adopts AI securely. Cyera’s mission is to give enterprises the confidence to embrace AI safely — deciding exactly what it can see and do as it reaches deeper into the business. We started by solving the hardest problem in data security: finding and securing data faster and more precisely than anyone thought possible. That foundation is now the essential AI trust infrastructure for the Fortune 1000. We’re hiring mission-driven talent to put those leaders at the center of our story.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Cyera is looking for a Principal Platform Marketing Manager to help lead the charge in shaping how the market understands Cyera as a unified data & AI security platform — and as the Trust Layer for Enterprise AI. This role sits within Portfolio & Solutions Marketing, and will own significant parts of the execution behind building and updating portfolio-level messaging and owning the corporate first-call deck.

As Cyera's portfolio has grown, so has the need for someone who can articulate why the platform is greater than the sum of its parts: how discovery, classification, posture management, access governance, and data-in-motion protection come together into a single, coherent data and AI security platform story.

This is a senior, high-visibility individual contributor role. You'll be the person other product marketers, sales, and executives turn to for the platform-level narrative — the one that ties together individual product pitches into a story that resonates with CISOs, data leaders, and boards. You'll work closely with the Senior Director to shape and execute that strategy, and extensively with peers across Product Marketing, Product Management, and Partner Marketing to keep it consistent everywhere it shows up.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Own execution of portfolio-level messaging — partner with the Senior Director to build and continuously refine the messaging framework for Cyera as a unified data & AI security platform and the Trust Layer for Enterprise AI, translating that strategy into concrete, usable assets.
  • Own the corporate first-call deck — serve as the primary owner and maintainer of Cyera's corporate first-call deck, keeping it current, sharp, and aligned to the latest portfolio narrative for use across sales, partners, and executives.
  • Activate the platform-level campaign — help drive execution of the go-to-market campaign built around the unified platform and Trust Layer for Enterprise AI narrative, working with Field, Digital, and Campaign Marketing to bring it to life across channels.
  • Build the connective narrative across products — work with product-line marketing managers to ensure individual product stories roll up into one coherent platform story, not a collection of disconnected pitches.
  • Develop core content — write and produce keynote and executive presentations, platform ebooks and whitepapers, analyst and press briefing materials, and other flagship content that defines how the market understands Cyera's platform.
  • Lead competitive and market positioning at the platform level — track how competitors and adjacent categories describe their own platforms, and ensure Cyera's platform story stays sharp and differentiated in response.
  • Partner with Product Management on platform strategy — represent the market and customer voice in platform roadmap and architecture conversations, and translate platform investments into external-facing narrative.
  • Enable the field — arm sales, sales engineering, and partner teams with platform-level talk tracks, decks, and objection handling that complement (not duplicate) product-specific enablement.
  • Support executive and analyst engagement — help prepare executives for keynotes, analyst briefings, and press interviews where the platform story is central.
  • Work extensively with Partner Marketing — collaborate closely with stakeholders across Cyera's Partner Marketing team to make sure the platform narrative is reflected consistently in partner-facing strategy and content.

Requirements

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 8+ years in product marketing or platform/solutions marketing at a B2B SaaS or cybersecurity company, including experience marketing a multi-product platform (not just a single product line).
  • Proven ability to build and land a platform-level narrative that senior technical and business audiences find credible — not just a rollup of feature lists.
  • Experience messaging in or around AI security, AI governance, or trust and safety for enterprise AI is a strong plus, given Cyera's positioning as the Trust Layer for Enterprise AI.
  • A genuine adopter of AI tools in your own workflow — you use AI to move faster on research, content creation, and messaging development, and bring that fluency into how you approach the role.
  • A true hands-on individual contributor: someone who does the strategic and creative work directly (writing, building, presenting) at a principal level, rather than someone who scopes and delegates. Cyera runs lean, so end-to-end ownership matters.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with real experience presenting to and influencing senior executives, analysts, and press.
  • A collaborative style — you'll work daily across Product Management, Product Marketing, Sales, and Partner Marketing, so building trust and alignment across teams matters as much as the content itself.
  • Data security, data privacy, or cloud security domain experience is a strong plus.

The final salary for this position will be determined in Cyera’s sole discretion, consistent with applicable law, and based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to the employee’s work experience, skills, and qualifications for the role, as well as the needs of Cyera’s business and other operational considerations.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role:

Alpaca's brokerage product team is looking for a Product Manager to define and drive new product initiatives and manage a portfolio of existing products across Alpaca Derivatives, the firm's regulated FCM. In this role you will be responsible for the creation and delivery of the roadmap for futures and prediction markets features while closely collaborating with internal management and business stakeholders across Alpaca.

With a deep understanding of the derivatives regulatory landscape - including the CFTC, NFA, designated contract markets, trading, settlement, market data, and clearing organizations - you will shape the product strategy that enables Alpaca to launch and scale its FCM, and to bring listed futures and prediction markets onto the Alpaca platform.

THINGS YOU GET TO DO

Product Ownership & Strategy

  • Own derivatives products for Alpaca, with a primary focus on listed futures and prediction markets.
  • Drive derivatives product strategy by analyzing ROI, market competition, regulatory requirements, and build-vs-buy scenarios across venues, clearing, and execution.
  • Contribute to the product roadmap and product strategy with a focus on FCM launch readiness, CFTC/NFA-compliant features, and partner demand for futures and prediction markets.
  • Write product requirements and work with engineers to execute builds that meet regulatory, exchange, and clearing standards.

Stakeholder Engagement & Regulatory

  • Lead customer and partner calls around derivatives process and product issues to gain insights and translate them into product improvements for Broker API and Trading API clients.
  • Participate in engagements with the CFTC, NFA, exchanges, and clearing organizations to drive product strategy and ensure regulatory alignment.
  • Report timely and accurately on product status and results to internal and external stakeholders, including regional partners and institutional clients.

Operations & Efficiency

  • Improve derivatives operation efficiency by providing solutions and owning the metrics, with a focus on margin, clearing, settlement, and trading-risk workflows.
  • Collaborate with operations, risk, and compliance teams to ensure seamless integration between Alpaca's global platform and the FCM market infrastructure.
  • Ad hoc duties and projects as assigned.

WHO YOU ARE (MUST-HAVES)

  • Excited about what Alpaca is building and passionate about expanding derivatives infrastructure for futures and prediction markets.
  • Strong understanding of CFTC and NFA frameworks, FCM market structure, and the listed derivatives landscape.
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, finance, or equivalent.
  • 5+ years of experience in Product Management, Engineering, Consulting, and/or starting a startup, preferably within financial services, fintech, or derivatives.
  • Demonstrated interest and experience in futures, prediction markets, listed derivatives, or adjacent trading / brokerage infrastructure.
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, with excellent collaboration abilities.
  • Business acumen to understand tradeoffs between stakeholders and technology feasibility with time and budget constraints.

WHO YOU MIGHT BE (NICE-TO-HAVES)

  • Experience and background working on and developing futures, prediction markets, or other listed derivatives products.
  • Technical background working with APIs, particularly in financial services or trading platforms.
  • NFA Series 3 (or the ability to obtain it), or other CFTC/NFA-recognized credentials.

jobs.description:
Our Mission

Our mission is to SAVE AND IMPROVE LIVES BY EMPOWERING HEALTHCARE CONSUMERS. Come be part of remarkable.

Overview

How you can make a difference

The Director Product Management, Product Pricing and Packaging Strategy is accountable for the pricing, packaging, and discounting strategy across HealthEquity's core products, including customer segment (Enterprise, Mid-Market, SMB), channel partner offerings, and pricing strategy for our Health and Wealth Platform. This role leads through evidence, product judgment, and influence, ensuring that portfolio performance and business metrics improve in ways that create sustainable customer and business value, and that pricing decisions ladder up to HealthEquity's financial goals. The role partners closely with Finance to implement pricing policy, process, and operations.

Reporting Structure:

Typically reports to a Product GM, VP Product GM or SVP of Product.

Is role a people leader?

No.

What you’ll be doing

  • Owns the pricing and packaging domain for core products, translating company and portfolio direction into explicit product choices, measurable outcomes, and a coherent roadmap.
  • Works with the product managers across the company to decide pricing strategy for new features, functionality, and products brought to market.
  • Define and monitor portfolio performance and business metrics, including price realization, discount rates, win rates, and margin; explain what changed, what did not, and how evidence changes the next decision.
  • Works with engineering to drive the implementation of pricing and packaging.
  • Integrates applicable pricing and billing decisions into product development from discovery through operation.
  • Leads critical company initiatives across functions that have implications on core product pricing and packaging strategy, including “Be Competitive” initiatives, dynamic pricing, flexible client-configurable pricing and billing, customer segment-based pricing, channel pricing and packaging, pricing and packaging strategy for M&A, and our HealthEquity Health & Wealth platform pricing strategy.
  • Engages with sales to decide and implement individual client-based pricing.
  • Partners with the finance team to implement pricing policies, process, and operations.

Key Initiatives Led by This Role:

Enterprise Package

  • Define and launch a competitive Enterprise package for deals.
  • Use competitive benchmarking and win/loss evidence to determine what to bundle, unbundle, and differentiate, and where HealthEquity wins, loses, or is at parity.
  • Set value positioning, price floors, and approval guidelines for competitive deals, and enable Sales with clear guidance and a deal review process.

Mid-Market Pricing and Packaging Strategy

  • Create a pricing and packaging strategy designed to win and grow in the Mid-Market, with defined segments, package tiers, and entry and expansion paths.
  • Validate pricing through customer research, willingness-to-pay analysis, and pilots, balancing competitiveness, acquisition cost, and long-term account profitability.

Channel Partner Pricing Strategy

  • Define pricing and economics for each type of HealthEquity channel partner, including wholesale, referral, revenue-share, and bundling structures.
  • Maintain pricing consistency and limit channel conflict between direct and partner-sold deals, in partnership with Channel Partnerships and Legal.

Health & Wealth Platform Pricing

  • As HealthEquity builds its Health & Wealth platform, develop a strategy to price to value of the platform.
  • Develop the product requirements and work with engineering to implement this strategy, including feature-based pricing capabilities, feature adoption-based pricing and discounting capabilities, dynamic pricing based on member preferences and willingness-to-pay, billing options (including annual billing and bundled subscription billing).

Client Configuration-Based Pricing

  • Drive the requirements and engineering implementation of client configuration-based pricing, where individual client contracts can be set up in a pricing and billing configurator for automated billing, invoicing, and tracking.

Discounting Strategy

  • Design a discounting framework that ladders up to HealthEquity's financial goals, with guardrails by segment, deal size, product, and channel, and clear approval tiers and escalation paths.
  • Partner with finance to monitor discount leakage, price realization, and exceptions, and report results to leadership.

Pricing Policy, Process, and Operations (with Finance)

  • Partner with Finance to implement pricing policies, governance, approval workflows, and operating cadence, including deal desk or pricing council decision rights and service levels.
  • Define the data, quoting and CRM requirements, and reporting needed to operate pricing consistently and auditably.
  • Guide the use of any HealthEquity pricing strategy agentic tools, including approved sources, rules, human review points, and traceability of agent-generated recommendations.

What you will need to be successful

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, or a related field; Master's degree preferred.
  • A minimum of 12 years of relevant product management, digital product, platform, financial technology, pricing, or comparable experience; equivalent combinations of experience and education are considered.
  • Demonstrated experience building and developing high-performing teams.
  • Demonstrated experience developing pricing, packaging, or discounting strategy for B2B or B2B2C products, including enterprise, mid-market, and channel partner segments.

Specialized Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Demonstrated ability to connect customer problems, business economics, technology constraints, and measurable outcomes.
  • Demonstrated experience with data-informed product management, experimentation, product analytics, and outcome-based roadmapping.
  • Strong financial acumen, including pricing models, unit economics, and experience partnering with Finance on policy and governance.
  • Demonstrated judgment in a regulated environment, including the ability to balance growth, customer value, risk, compliance, and long-term platform health.
  • Demonstrated people leadership, coaching, talent assessment, and inclusive team-building capability appropriate to the scope of the role.
  • Demonstrated experience shaping strategy and investment decisions across multiple teams, domains, or portfolios.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, structured decision-making, and cross-functional influence.
  • Ability to operate responsibly with AI-enabled tools, evaluate generated outputs critically, protect sensitive information, and maintain clear human accountability.
  • Product Management experience working with consumer directed benefits is strongly preferred.
  • Experience competing against large financial institutions, and experience with CPQ, CRM, and pricing analytics tools, are preferred.

Certifications, Licenses, Registrations:

Physical/Mental Requirements and Demands:

  • Work requires normal range of hearing, vision and verbal communication skills, with or without a reasonable accommodation.
  • Must be able to use a telephone or headset equipment and operate a keyboard and other office equipment, with or without reasonable accommodation.
  • Must be able to spend prolonged periods of each workday on the phone.
  • The ability to perform work at a computer station for 6-8+ hours a day and function in an environment with frequent interruptions is required.
  • Must be able to lift and move material weighing up to 20 lbs.
  • May experience elevated levels of stress during periods of increased activity and with work entailing multiple deadlines.
  • To help you succeed in your role and ensure member information stays protected, we require that you maintain a secure and stable work environment, i.e., safeguard client information, cameras on during work meetings, and provide a current updated photo. This is a core value of our culture and an essential job function for each of us.

Travel Requirements:

  • Occasional travel to attend training or meetings may be required.

This is a remote position.

Salary Range

$151000.00 To $200500.00 / year

Benefits & Perks

The actual compensation offer is determined based on job-related knowledge, education, skills, experience, and work location. This position will be eligible for performance-based incentives and restricted stock units as part of the total compensation package, in addition to a full range of benefits including:

  • Medical, dental, and vision
  • HSA contribution and match
  • Dependent care FSA match
  • Uncapped paid time off
  • Paid parental leave
  • 401(k) match
  • Personal and healthcare financial literacy programs
  • Ongoing education & tuition assistance
  • Gym and fitness reimbursement
  • Wellness program incentives

Onboarding & Travel

This is a remote role, with an in-person onboarding training component. New team members must participate in Trailhead, HealthEquity’s immersive onboarding experience Trailhead is designed to foster meaningful connections, support your integration into the organization, and equip you with a strong understanding of our business. Trailhead participation is a key expectation of this role. Trailhead is held onsite at our headquarters once per quarter. HealthEquity covers all required travel and accommodations.

This role may begin with a virtual, self-paced onboarding experience, followed by a mandatory onsite Trailhead session at a later date.

HealthEquity is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to team members with qualifying disabilities. Should you be selected for this role and require an accommodation, we will put you in touch with our Benefits Team so you can begin the accommodation request process.

Why work with HealthEquity

HealthEquity has a vision that by 2030 we will make HSAs as wide-spread and popular as retirement accounts. We are passionate about providing a solution that allows American families to connect health and wealth. Join us and discover a work experience where the person is valued more than the position. Click here to learn more.

You belong at HealthEquity!

We ensure equal opportunity for all applicants and employees without regard to race, age, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, status as a qualified individual with a disability, veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics. jobs.description:
Description

MEDvidi is an AI-powered mental healthcare platform setting a new standard for safe, effective, and scalable psychiatric care in the United States.

We combine licensed providers with proprietary AI tools to deliver consistent, outcomes-driven treatment for conditions like ADHD, anxiety, depression, and more. MEDvidi's technology automates charting, follow-ups, and treatment planning, freeing providers to focus on patient care while improving efficiency and clinical quality.

As Staff Product Designer, you will own the end-to-end design of MEDvidi's AI Track, the core line of AI-powered clinical tools where providers interact with model outputs in a regulated healthcare environment. Your design decisions directly shape how clinicians review, accept, and correct AI-generated notes, treatment plans, and recommendations, impacting both provider efficiency and patient outcomes.

You will work closely with product managers and engineers, reporting to the Director of Product. This is a senior IC role with no direct reports: you drive product design from problem definition through delivery, gather requirements independently, and bring solutions to release. Your scope includes provider-facing tools (Chart Review, AI Scribe, AI Receptionist), patient portal, and internal operational systems, all web-based.

Why this role

  • Zero-to-one in AI-first environment. You will shape new interaction patterns for agentic AI features: Chart Review, AI Scribe, AI Receptionist, where design quality directly affects clinical decisions.
  • Prototype in real code, not Figma mockups. Prototyping happens in Claude Code and Cursor on the actual codebase with production components. Your prototypes go straight to engineering without redrawing.
  • Co-own a design system built for humans and AI agents. You will evolve reusable components, tokens, and documentation that are readable by both your teammates and code-generation agents, a rare opportunity to define what design systems look like in an AI-native workflow.

Responsibilities

  • Own product design in your areas of the AI Track end-to-end: from defining the problem with the product manager, through user analysis, to working with engineers on the solution and accepting the build.
  • Design and iterate on human-AI interaction patterns: interfaces where providers verify, accept, edit, or reject model output and bring those patterns to a state where other teams can reuse them.
  • Ensure quality of design decisions: validate solutions with users when needed, perform design acceptance with engineering, analyze post-release results, and feed learnings back into the product.
  • Contribute to the design system within product initiatives: turn your solutions into reusable components in Storybook with tokens, naming, and documentation that are usable by both designers and AI code-generation agents.
  • Gather requirements independently: go to providers, medical operations, and product managers, identify problems, and bring back a proposal. There is no standing PM brief in AI Track, you shape the brief.
  • Accelerate design delivery using AI tools: build functional prototypes in Claude Code or Cursor on the real codebase with production components; prototypes go to engineering without redrawing.

This role is not for you if

  • You need a detailed brief before starting work. Requirements here are gathered by you, not handed to you, there is no PM or BA writing specs for AI Track.
  • You prefer managing people over hands-on design. This is an IC role with no direct reports; the impact comes from the quality of your own design decisions.
  • You design exclusively in Figma and hand off static specs. Prototyping at MEDvidi happens in code on the real codebase using AI agents, comfort with a code editor is a daily requirement, not a nice-to-have.

Requirements

  • 6+ years in product design, with a focus on complex work interfaces: EHR, admin panels, CRM, operational tools, or other systems where specialists perform their core work.
  • Demonstrable experience designing human-AI interaction: interfaces where users verify, accept, edit, or reject model output. Building a 0-to-1 agentic product is ideal; experience with review-and-approval interfaces for automated decisions also qualifies.
  • Hands-on prototyping in code using AI agents (Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent) on an existing component library or codebase, not just design tools.
  • Track record of contributing to a design system within product work: shipping reusable components, tokens, and documentation as part of feature delivery, not as a standalone project.
  • Proven ability to gather requirements independently, finding problems, talking to users and stakeholders, and driving a solution to release without waiting for a mandated brief.
  • Advanced English (B2+) and fluent Russian.
  • Availability to work within CET-compatible hours.

Would be a plus

  • Experience in healthcare or telemedicine products: understanding of HIPAA, clinical compliance constraints, and the provider's role in decision-making.
  • Experience leading a design team's transition to AI tools: setting up shared agent workflows, running workshops, driving adoption across peers.
  • Hands-on user research with specialist users: usability testing and interviews with doctors, nurses, or clinical operators (not only end consumers).

What we offer

  • High-impact environment: A chance to contribute to a product-driven company in the medical tech space.
  • Growth & compensation: Clear growth opportunities and a competitive compensation package.
  • Remote-first: Fully remote long-term collaboration under a B2B model.
  • Health & wellness: Health insurance after the probation period, plus sports & wellness compensation.
  • Career development: Clear growth opportunities, including personalized English lessons via Preply.
  • Time off: 19 paid vacation days annually, 4 additional wellness days each year, and paid sick leave for the first 5 working days.
  • Culture: Thoughtful gifts for key life events and offline corporate events.

Ready to make an impact? Send us your profile, let's build something meaningful together.

﻿

MEDvidi is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and contractors. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

jobs.description:
Description

We’re growing and looking to hire a Channel Sales Director who embodies our core values: People First, Customer Obsession, Strive for Excellence, and Integrity.

About the Company:

Claroty is a global leader in cyber-physical systems (CPS) protection, dedicated to securing the critical infrastructure that keeps the world running. We’re a fast-growing, award-winning team where innovation meets purpose—and we want you to help us define the future of cybersecurity.

About the Role:

Japan is one of the most sophisticated enterprise technology markets in the world, and one where partners, not vendors, typically own the customer relationship. The Channel Sales Director, Japan will build and lead the partner ecosystem, the primary route to Japanese enterprise.

You will set the partner strategy for Japan, own the partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, revenue and attach rate for the country. You will personally lead our most strategic partner relationships at the executive level while doing the same across the GSI, regional SI, and reseller landscape.

This is a player-coach role for an experienced partner leader who has built and scaled partner businesses in Japan before, ideally for a US technology company entering or growing in the market. You will work day to day with the Japan sales leadership and the APJ Channel team, represent Japan within Claroty’s Global Partnerships organisation, and carry the voice of Japanese partners and customers into our global product and go-to-market decisions.

*** This is a full-time, remote position open to candidates located in the Greater Tokyo Area. ***

Responsibilities

As a Channel Sales Director, Japan, your impact will be:

  • Set clear goals, territories and partner portfolios for each strategic partner, and hold the partner accountable to pipeline, revenue and attach-rate outcomes
  • Establish the partners’ operating cadence: one-on-ones, weekly pipeline reviews, deal inspection, partner QBRs and quarterly business planning
  • Coach the Partner on executive engagement, joint business planning and co-selling in Japanese enterprise accounts, and model those behaviours personally
  • Set and own the Japan partner strategy:
    • Define which partner segments, partners and motions Claroty prioritises in Japan, and in what sequence, based on revenue potential, customer reach and strategic fit
    • Design the partner coverage model across our partner landscape, and where we go deep vs. broad
    • Localise Claroty’s global partner program for Japan, including tiers, incentives, enablement paths and rules of engagement, and feed Japan requirements back into the global program design
    • Own the annual and quarterly partner business plan for Japan and report on it to APJ Partner leadership
  • Lead our most strategic partnerships:
    • Own the executive relationships with Claroty’s most consequential partners in Japan, from joint business planning through to board-level sponsorship on both sides
    • Negotiate and structure partnership agreements, including resale, co-development and MSPs, working with Legal, Finance and Deal Desk
    • Lead the creation of joint solutions and industry offerings with partner practices in Manufacturing, Food & Beverage, Healthcare, and Data Centers
  • Own partner pipeline, revenue, renewals and attach rate:
    • Carry the Japan partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline and revenue targets, and the partner attach-rate target, for the team
    • Run a disciplined forecast with the team and with Japan sales leadership, ensuring partner deals are registered, progressed and closed with predictability
    • Decide where to deploy partner investments (market development funds, enablement, co-marketing, headcount) for the highest return
    • Build the reporting and systems hygiene that gives APJ Partnerships and Claroty leadership a clear, trusted view of the Japan partner business
  • Represent Japan and drive cross-functional execution:
    • Act as the single point of accountability for the partner business in Japan with Japan sales leadership, Marketing, Legal and Product
    • Ensure Japanese partner and customer requirements, including language, data residency, security and sovereignty needs, are understood and prioritised by global product and engineering teams
    • Partner with the Japan sales leader to embed partners into account planning and co-selling for the country's priority accounts
    • Resolve channel conflict between direct sales, SIs and resellers, and set the rules of engagement that keep the ecosystem healthy as it grows
  • Be the face of Claroty’s partner ecosystem in Japan:
    • Represent Claroty at partner executive forums, industry conferences and analyst engagements related to the partner ecosystem
    • Sponsor the development of Japanese customer success stories, delivered with partners, that resonate with Japanese enterprise buyers
    • Build Claroty’s reputation as the partner-first AI company in Japan through the way your team shows up every day

Requirements

What you need to succeed in this role:

  • Minimum Qualifications:
    • Experience in enterprise CyberSecurity SaaS technology, with a substantial portion leading partner, alliances or channel businesses in Japan
    • People leadership experience over partner or alliance teams, with a track record of hiring, developing and retaining strong performers
    • Direct experience building a partner business in Japan for a US or global technology company, ideally through a period of rapid growth or market entry (Cybersecurity, enterprise SaaS, data or AI platform)
    • Proven ownership of partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue targets at a country or regional level, with the forecasting discipline to match
    • Established executive relationships with Japan's major system integrators, consulting firms, and a reputation they would vouch for
    • Experience negotiating complex partnership structures: resale agreements, joint solution development, and revenue-sharing or incentive models
    • Demonstrated ability to operate as a player-coach, personally owning strategic relationships while building a team that scales beyond you
    • Comfort shaping strategy in ambiguity and turning it into an operating plan, while working closely with global teams in other time zones
    • Business-level fluency in Japanese and English, and the cultural fluency to move between Japanese enterprise norms and a fast-moving US company
    • Based in Tokyo
  • Preferred Qualifications:
    • 10 to 15+ years in enterprise technology leading partner, alliances or channel businesses in Japan and experience with AI, data or cloud platform partnerships specifically, including partner-built solutions and marketplace motions
    • Experience on the partner side, inside a Japanese SI or distributor, and an understanding of how those organisations make decisions
    • Experience localising a global partner program for Japan and influencing its design
    • Experience working alongside professional services or applied AI teams to deliver partner-led customer outcomes
  • Nice to have:
    • Experience in Korean Channel Management and Language

About Claroty

Claroty empowers organizations to protect the mission-critical infrastructure that underpins modern life. The AI-powered Claroty Platform serves as the single source of operational truth, providing the deepest visibility and broadest protection across cyber-physical systems (CPS), leveraging five core solutions: asset inventory, exposure management, network protection, secure access, and threat detection. Claroty helps organizations operationalize CPS protection through a programmatic approach designed to reduce risk, maintain operational integrity, and meet compliance–whether in the cloud with Claroty xDome or on-premise with Claroty Continuous Threat Detection (CTD). Claroty is deployed by hundreds of organizations at thousands of sites globally. The company is headquartered in New York City and has a presence in Europe, Asia-Pacific, and Latin America. To learn more, visit claroty.com.

Claroty is widely recognized as the industry leader in CPS protection, backed by the world’s largest investment firms and industrial automation vendors. The company has been named a Leader in 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for CPS Protection Platforms two years in a row, a Customers’ Choice in the 2026 Gartner® Peer Insights™ Voice of the Customer for CPS Protection Platforms, and a Leader and a Customer Favorite in The Forrester Wave™: Operational Technology Security Solutions, Q3 2026. Claroty has also been named to the Forbes Cloud 100 and Deloitte Technology Fast 500 multiple consecutive years.

Claroty is an equal-opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment for all. We encourage applications from candidates of ALL backgrounds, and special accommodations are available upon request in all selection phases.

Role Title: French Language Expert (Belgium and Switzerland)

  • Transcription

Scope of Work

  1. Listen to and analyze multi-speaker conversational audio samples featuring a range of Belgian and Swiss French dialects and accents.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.excerpt: Business Development Representative • Full time • Location: Remote, with regular travel to meet prospects and attend trade shows and industry events • Base salary: $70,000; OTE: $108k (based on potential commission earnings) This isn't a dial-and-log-it BDR role.
jobs.description:
Business Development Representative

  • Full time
  • Location: Remote, with regular travel to meet prospects and attend trade shows and industry events
  • Base salary: $70,000; OTE: $108k (based on potential commission earnings)

This isn't a dial-and-log-it BDR role. We sell to large contractors, and the people you’ll talk to are CFOs, controllers and operations leaders who expect you to understand their business. You’ll work a short list of high-value accounts, research deeply, run the first qualifying conversation yourself, and hand our AEs opportunities that are qualified, multi-threaded and ready to close.

About Assignar

Assignar is a mission-led construction tech company. Sean McCreanor (co-founder and CEO) started Assignar in 2014 after running his own contracting business and finding there weren't any good tools for it. Today we work with hundreds of customers, from multi-million-dollar contractors to specialist crews.

We've found product-market fit. Assignar is the all-in-one margin control platform for contractors. leading digital construction operations for contractors: real-time visibility across jobsites, smart scheduling of workers to projects, equipment tracking, and data that shapes the next bid. We connect the field and finance so contractors protect margin on every job and get paid accurately and faster.

What does "own the top of the funnel" actually mean?

You'll sit inside the Marketing team and be the first real conversation most contractors have with Assignar. You'll decide who's worth pursuing, find the right people inside them, run the first discovery conversation, keep it warm and set up the AE to win.

You'll report to Madeline Crowley (VP of Marketing) and work closely with Account Executives, Solutions Engineers and Marketing. What you hear from prospects every day will shape how we go to market.

What you'll own

  • Go after the right accounts. Research and prioritise target accounts with your AE and Marketing, and qualify inbound leads hard against our ICP. Move on quickly from accounts that don’t fit. Spend your time where it counts.
  • Start conversations that go somewhere. Run multi-channel outreach (phone, email, LinkedIn and video) personalised to each recipient. Multi-thread every account to reach finance and operations leaders, not just one contact.
  • Keep warm prospects warm. Nurture prospects between meetings with follow-up that's useful, not pushy.
  • Turn engagement into pipeline. Follow up personally with prospects who attend our webinars, events and campaigns.
  • Set the AE up to win. Hand off opportunities with the buying group mapped, the economic buyer identified, the problem sized and a dated next step.
  • Show up in person. Attend trade shows and industry events like CCF and association days, and meet contractors where they are.
  • Run discovery yourself. Lead video qualification calls with an industry-specific deck. Confirm fit, identify the economic buyer and size the problem before the opportunity moves to an AE.
  • Close the loop with feedback. Share what's landing and what isn't.
  • Keep Salesforce clean. Using agents, log every call, email and meeting, and keep lead and contact records current so anyone on the team can pick up an account and know exactly where it’s at.
  • Own your number. You’re measured on qualified pipeline and revenue from right-fit accounts, not meetings booked.

Who you are

  • An experienced BDR. 2+ years in B2B sales development, ideally selling into mid-market or enterprise accounts with multiple stakeholders. SaaS preferred, and construction or trades experience is a bonus.
  • Pipeline-driven. You have a track record of hitting or beating your number on qualified pipeline or revenue, not just activity.
  • At home in the modern sales stack. Salesforce, Salesloft and Clay feel familiar, and you use AI tools to research and personalise faster.
  • A sharp writer and communicator. The best BDRs at Assignar write emails that customers actually reply to, because they’re written for the recipient, not the sender. They’re just as strong on the phone and on video.
  • Curious about construction. You don't need to have worked in the industry, but you want to understand how contractors run their business.
  • Organised and self-directed. You manage your own pipeline, move fast and like being part of a supportive team.
  • Resourceful. You don’t wait for leads. You build your own target lists from industry associations, customer lookalikes and public project data.
  • Comfortable talking to finance. You can hold a credible conversation with a CFO or controller about margin, cash flow and job costing.
  • Ambitious. You want to grow into an AE role, and you’ll keep building your skills, especially with AI, to get there.

The tools you'll work with

Salesforce · Salesloft · Clay · AI tools and agents · Apollo · JustCall

Why Join

  • You'll be part of a company with real product-market fit and a clear market to go after.
  • You'll work directly with go-to-market team members and participate in turning your daily work into revenue.
  • You'll get out to events and meet the people who use our product.
  • You'll be in a small team where your ideas about what's working get heard and used.

How we hire

We keep it quick and practical. We care about how you think, how you write and how you talk to people.

  • Apply via Breezy. Tell us a bit about yourself and what you've been working on.
  • Zoom screen with Sophie, Head of People & Culture (30 min). Get to know each other and ask us anything.
  • Interview with Madeline, VP of Marketing (45 to 60 min). Your experience, how you prospect and how you work with a sales team.
  • Reference checks. We’ll speak with two or three people you’ve worked with, ideally a former manager, to hear how you prospect, how you handle a number and what you’re like on a team.

What we stand for: Our Values

  • Do what's right
  • Customers are our why
  • Grow with purpose
  • One team

We value inclusion and welcome applicants from every background. If any part of this process needs to look different for you, let us know and we'll adjust.

No recruiters please · We respond to every application within 5 business days

jobs.title: Social Media Specialist
jobs.excerpt: About Paw Prosper At Paw Prosper, we help pets live healthier, happier lives at every stage of their journey, whether they're recovering from injury, managing chronic pain, or staying active in their senior years.
jobs.description:
About Paw Prosper

At Paw Prosper, we help pets live healthier, happier lives at every stage of their journey, whether they're recovering from injury, managing chronic pain, or staying active in their senior years. Our family of pet brands delivers best-in-class, vet-recommended solutions in mobility, rehabilitation, and pain management, including therapeutic devices. With a foundation built on expertise and compassion, we empower pet parents and veterinary professionals with products that support long-term health and quality of life

About the Role

We are looking for a creative, organized, and highly proactive Social Media Specialist to bring Paw Prosper’s direct-to-consumer brands to life across social media.

This is a hands-on role with ownership of the day-to-day social presence and content execution for assigned D2C brands. Working closely with the Social Media Manager, the Social Media Specialist will turn brand and channel strategies into engaging, platform-first content that builds awareness, strengthens our communities, and supports broader marketing goals.

The ideal candidate is equal parts content creator and content owner: someone who can develop ideas, write copy, create and edit content, manage calendars, engage with our communities, monitor performance, and proactively identify opportunities to make our social presence stronger.

This person should be comfortable managing multiple brands and priorities while keeping content organized, on-brand, and moving forward.

This is a remote position, with candidates located in the Greater Toronto Area (GTA) considered an asset due to the collaborative nature of our Marketing team.

Key Responsibilities

Content Planning & Execution

  • Own the day-to-day social media content and execution for assigned D2C brands across platforms including Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Pinterest, Reddit, YouTube, and LinkedIn, as applicable.

  • Build and maintain social media content calendars, ensuring content is planned ahead, aligned with brand priorities, and delivered on time.

  • Develop, curate, schedule, and publish engaging social content including copy, graphics, short-form video, Stories, Reels, and other platform-native formats.

  • Create and edit social-first content using tools such as Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, and native platform editing tools.

  • Translate broader brand campaigns, product launches, promotions, partnerships, and marketing initiatives into effective organic social content.

  • Adapt creative and messaging for each platform rather than taking a one-size-fits-all approach.

  • Ensure content consistently reflects each brand’s distinct voice, audience, positioning, and visual identity.

  • Proactively identify content opportunities, gaps, trends, and timely moments relevant to our brands and audiences.

Social Media Ownership

  • Take ownership of assigned brands social media execution from planning through publishing, monitoring, reporting, and optimization.

  • Keep content calendars organized and sufficiently planned ahead while remaining flexible for reactive and timely opportunities.

  • Manage scheduling and publishing through social media management tools, ensuring content goes live accurately and on time.

  • Maintain strong attention to detail across copy, creative, links, tags, product information, and brand standards.

  • Communicate potential blockers, competing priorities, or timeline risks early and proactively.

  • Work closely with the Social Media Manager on priorities, campaign direction, channel strategy, and opportunities for growth.

Community Management

  • Actively monitor and respond to comments, messages, mentions, tags, and relevant conversations across assigned social channels.

  • Foster positive, helpful, and engaging communities through thoughtful and timely interactions.

  • Identify and surface strong user-generated content, customer stories, testimonials, and community moments that can be incorporated into the content strategy.

  • Escalate customer concerns, sensitive conversations, or emerging issues to the appropriate internal teams when needed.

  • Support creator, influencer, ambassador, and community partnerships as they relate to organic social content.

Trends & Content Opportunities

  • Stay closely connected to emerging social trends, platform updates, formats, audio, memes, and cultural moments.

  • Identify trends that are relevant and appropriate for our brands rather than following trends for the sake of participation.

  • Bring forward proactive content ideas and recommendations based on audience behavior, platform trends, and brand opportunities.

  • Help evolve how our brands show up on social by testing new formats, creative approaches, and content series.

Reporting & Optimization

  • Monitor social media performance across assigned brands, including engagement, reach, audience growth, video performance, traffic, and other relevant KPIs.

  • Review performance regularly to understand what is working, what is not, and why.

  • Share insights and recommendations with the Social Media Manager and Director of Content & Community to help inform future content and channel strategy.

  • Apply learnings from performance data to continuously improve content.

  • Support monthly and campaign-specific social reporting as required.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Marketing, Growth, Creative, Product Marketing, Sales, Customer Experience, and other teams to support launches, campaigns, promotions, and key business initiatives.

  • Coordinate with internal and external creative partners to ensure social assets are delivered on time and optimized for each platform.

  • Maintain clear communication around timelines, deliverables, approvals, and dependencies.

  • Balance the needs of multiple brands and campaigns while maintaining quality and consistency.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Digital Media, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

  • 2–4 years of hands-on social media experience, ideally managing organic social content for consumer brands.

  • Demonstrated experience owning social content calendars and managing content from idea through execution and reporting.

  • Strong understanding of major social platforms, including Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Pinterest, YouTube, and LinkedIn.

  • Strong copywriting skills with the ability to adapt tone and messaging across different brands, audiences, and platforms.

  • Experience creating and editing social-first graphics and short-form video.

  • Proficiency with content creation tools such as Canva and/or Adobe Creative Suite.

  • Experience with social media management and reporting platforms such as Hootsuite.

  • Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple brands, deadlines, and competing priorities.

  • Comfortable working independently and taking ownership while also collaborating closely with a broader team.

  • Proactive communicator who raises questions, risks, and opportunities early rather than waiting for direction.

  • Curious, creative, and genuinely engaged with social media and digital culture.

  • Experience working within a multi-brand organization is considered an asset.

  • Experience with pet, lifestyle, consumer product, or e-commerce brands is considered an asset.

  • Must love animals.

Role Structure

The Social Media Specialist works closely with the Social Media Manager and Director of Content & Community and is responsible for hands-on execution and day-to-day ownership of assigned Paw Prosper D2C social channels.

The Social Media Manager provides channel leadership, strategic direction, coaching, and oversight across the D2C portfolio, while the Director of Content & Community provides broader content, brand, and community direction. The Specialist plays a critical role in bringing those strategies to life through strong planning, creative execution, community engagement, and ongoing optimization.

Compensation: The annual base salary for this position is $55,000–$65,000 CAD.

We are actively hiring for this role. This posting reflects a genuine, open position. In accordance with the Ontario Employment Standards Act, Paw Acquisition Canadian Holdings, Inc. discloses that artificial intelligence tools are used at various stages of our recruitment process to assist with screening applications, scoring evaluations, or assessing qualifications. Human oversight is maintained throughout the entire hiring process.
