jobs.description:
En Anthesis somos el equipo activador de la sostenibilidad
¿Nuestro objetivo? Lo tenemos claro: trabajamos para construir un mundo más resiliente, justo y sostenible. Y para activar ese cambio, desarrollamos y ponemos en marcha servicios y productos diseñados para generar un impacto positivo en las personas y en su entorno.

También sabemos que, para activar este cambio, necesitamos sumar nuevas miradas y seguir impulsando el talento joven. Por eso lanzamos nuestro programa de prácticas: una oportunidad para que jóvenes como tú podáis adquirir experiencia real y dar los primeros pasos en vuestra carrera profesional.
¡Únete al equipo de Personas y ayúdanos a alcanzar nuestroreto!
Buscamos una persona con ganas de aprender sobre administración laboral, gestión de personas y procesos internos, que quiera desarrollarse en un entorno colaborativo y participar en el día a día del área de Personas, dando soporte a tareas vinculadas a gestión laboral, documentación administrativa y acompañamiento a las personas trabajadoras.
📍 Ubicación: oficina de Manlleu (Barcelona). Posibilidad de realizar las prácticas de forma presencial, híbrida o remota si no resides cerca.
🗓️ Periodo de prácticas ideal: de Diciembre a Febrero

¿Cuáles serán tus retos y responsabilidades?

En esta posición tendrás la oportunidad de aprender, desde dentro, cómo funciona el día a día de un área de Personas vinculada a la gestión laboral y administrativa. Participarás en procesos clave relacionados con la gestión de personas trabajadoras y desarrollarás habilidades prácticas que te permitirán conocer el funcionamiento real de un departamento de Recursos Humanos en un entorno corporativo y multicultural.

Algunas de las tareas con las que te irás familiarizando son:
  • Control de ausencias y tiempo de trabajo: Apoyo en el seguimiento y gestión documental de incapacidades temporales (IT), permisos retribuidos, vacaciones y otras ausencias, garantizando la correcta actualización de los registros internos.
  • Redacción de documentación laboral básica: Elaboración y preparación de certificados de empresa, cartas, comunicaciones internas y otros documentos administrativos vinculados al área laboral.
  • Gestión documental y archivo: Mantenimiento, digitalización y actualización de expedientes laborales, tanto en formato físico como digital, asegurando el cumplimiento de la normativa de protección de datos (RGPD).
  • Atención y soporte administrativo: Recepción y gestión inicial de consultas de las personas trabajadoras a través de correo electrónico, canalizando incidencias y realizando el seguimiento de la documentación pendiente.
  • Apoyo al equipo de Relaciones Laborales: Colaboración con las técnicas del área en la preparación, revisión y gestión de documentación laboral diversa, así como en tareas administrativas relacionadas con la contratación, cambios de condiciones y otras gestiones del ciclo de vida de las personas trabajadoras.
  • Gestión de registros de jornada: Seguimiento y reclamación de la cumplimentación de horas en NetSuite, apoyo en la revisión de incidencias y coordinación con las personas trabajadoras para garantizar el correcto registro de la jornada.
  • Gestión y seguimiento documental: Solicitud, recepción, verificación y archivo de documentación laboral, realizando el seguimiento de documentos pendientes hasta su correcta devolución y registro.
  • Apoyo en planificación laboral: Colaboración en la elaboración y actualización de calendarios laborales, cuadrantes y otras herramientas de planificación y organización del trabajo.
  • Soporte en procesos y bases de datos de RR. HH.: Actualización de información en los diferentes sistemas de gestión de personas, contribuyendo a mantener la calidad y fiabilidad de los datos.

¿Cómo puedes acceder al programa de prácticas?

Buscamos a una persona con ganas de aprender, crecer y aportar al equipo con compromiso, atención al detalle y actitud proactiva. Para que puedas aprovechar al máximo esta experiencia, estos son los requisitos que valoramos:
  • Estar cursando estudios universitarios o de Formación Profesional relacionados con Relaciones Laborales, Recursos Humanos, Administración y Dirección de Empresas, Derecho, Gestión Administrativa, Ciencias del Trabajo o similares.
  • Tener nivel avanzado de castellano (C1). El conocimiento de catalán e inglés será un plus.
  • Poder firmar un convenio de colaboración con tu universidad o centro de estudios (prácticas curriculares o extracurriculares).
Además, nos encantará si tienes:
  • Interés por el ámbito de la gestión laboral, la administración de personas y los procesos internos de Recursos Humanos.
  • Motivación para aprender sobre contratación, documentación laboral, prevención de riesgos laborales y gestión administrativa.
  • Capacidad de organización y atención al detalle en la gestión de documentación y tareas administrativas.
  • Iniciativa para aportar ideas y colaborar en la mejora de procesos internos.
  • Buenas habilidades de comunicación y capacidad para trabajar de forma colaborativa con diferentes equipos.
  • Actitud proactiva, responsable y orientada al aprendizaje continuo.
  • Interés por desarrollarse profesionalmente dentro del área de Personas y Recursos Humanos.
  • Capacidad para gestionar información confidencial con rigor y profesionalidad.

Ventajas de unirte a nuestro equipo

Formar parte de nuestro programa de prácticas significa mucho más que aprender: es crecer, aportar y ser parte de un equipo que trabaja con propósito. Aquí te contamos lo que te espera:
  • Un equipo que inspira: te integrarás en un entorno cercano, con personas comprometidas y con ganas de ayudarte a crecer desde el primer día.
  • Impacto real: tendrás la oportunidad de adquirir experiencia práctica en una consultora líder en sostenibilidad, trabajando en proyectos con propósito.
  • Formación sobre la marcha: aprenderás haciendo, aplicando tus conocimientos en un entorno profesional y colaborativo.
  • Convenio de prácticas: formalizaremos un acuerdo con tu centro de estudios (ya sea para prácticas curriculares o extracurriculares).
  • Flexibilidad horaria: adaptamos la jornada a tus estudios o disponibilidad. Idealmente entre 15 y 20 horas semanales.
  • Trabajo en remoto: podrás trabajar desde cualquier lugar de España, fomentando un estilo de vida más equilibrado y sostenible.
  • Formación continua: aprenderás junto a un equipo de Recursos Humanos que apuesta por la innovación y el desarrollo constante.
  • Cultura inclusiva: aquí valoramos lo que te hace diferente. Apostamos por la diversidad, escuchamos todas las ideas y celebramos las distintas formas de pensar y aportar.
  • Conciliación real: además de la flexibilidad horaria, entendemos que estás en una etapa de formación y queremos que puedas compaginar todo sin renunciar a nada.

jobs.title: Growth Engineer (AI-Native)
jobs.excerpt: eorkflowsiTmethods · Remote · Reports to the CMO.
jobs.description:
eorkflowsiTmethods · Remote · Reports to the CMO. Partners with the CRO and VP Engineering.

An AI-native operator who owns high-velocity agentic GTM, then gets pulled into whatever the company actually needs next. Reign Factory, Reign Gateway and Reign Ops are the three products. iTmethods is the company. You design the strategy, orchestrate multi-agent workflows, run the agents, and ship the pipeline end to end. You personally configure and operate marketing automation and campaign execution in that motion. You also show up for product, sales, ops, and internal systems when that is the higher-leverage move.

Why this role exists

iTmethods has run engineering platforms for regulated enterprises since 2005, and now builds Reign with Reign. We sell into regulated enterprises in banking, capital markets, life sciences, semiconductor and defense. We are shipping and relaunching multiple products. The person in this seat is the operator behind the motion, and a utility player for the rest of the company.

You operate at executive cadence. You report to the CMO, with regular alignment to the CRO and VP Engineering. Decisions in hours, not committees. No middle-management lift.

The work will not stay inside growth. Some weeks you are building demand systems. Some weeks you are standing up an internal agent, fixing a broken handoff, helping a product launch land, or taking a problem nobody has named yet and making it run. You still need demonstrated hands-on marketing automation and campaign execution. If you only want strategy decks, vendor management, or a lane with no campaign ownership, this is the wrong role.

What you will own

  • The number, across the portfolio. Marketing-sourced and marketing-influenced pipeline for every product you operate on.
  • The agentic launch motion. Demand engineering for each product launch as it ships. New initiatives kick off on a quarterly cadence. You orchestrate the playbook and compound it launch after launch.
  • The stack. HubSpot, Clay, Claude agents, ZoomInfo, and our internal Campaign Manager and Sales Manager surfaces. You configure, automate, and orchestrate the multi-agent system yourself, including CRM/lifecycle automation, enrichment and segmentation, and campaign activation and measurement.
  • Data discipline. Encoded ICP per product, clean living segments, continuous scoring.
  • Governed execution. Agents and workflows run through Reign Gateway, with a record. People decide.
  • Work outside the lane. Sales enablement, product launch support, internal tooling, ops automation, research, and whatever else the CMO, CRO, or VP Engineering put in front of you. You learn the domain fast and ship.

Your first 30 days (AI-native cadence)

  • Week 1–2 · Wire. Encode ICP per product. Wire HubSpot lifecycle, Clay and ZoomInfo enrichment, Claude agent workflows, measurement. Learn the products, the buyers, and the internal systems well enough to be useful outside GTM.
  • Week 3 · Ship. Launch playbook live on the first two product motions. Always-on nurture activated per ICP. Content engine connected to capture.
  • Week 4 · Compound. Trigger-based ABM on regulatory events. Reliable MQL to SQL handoff. Reusable agentic playbook documented. First non-GTM problem taken off someone else's plate.

How you will work

  • You are AI-native. You build with agents, skills, and MCP connectors. You do not wait for a specialist, and you do not brief work you could ship yourself.
  • You learn in public and in production. New domain, new tool, new buyer, new internal mess: you get fluent fast.
  • You are dynamic. Context switches weekly. Multiple products, plus unplanned work from the executive team. You do not need a static job description to know what to do next.
  • You build in the stack (HubSpot, Clay, ZoomInfo, Claude agents). Not by briefing others to. Comparables are welcome; name the gaps.
  • You have an engineering team of builders behind you. The same people who ship Reign Factory, Reign Gateway and Reign Ops work alongside you.
  • No high-volume AI slop. Precision and trust over noise, because we sell into banks, hospitals, and defense.

Who you are (must-haves)

  • AI-native builder, not AI-curious manager. You have shipped multiple production agent or LLM workflows. You write your own prompts, compose your own skills, configure your own MCP connectors. This is the filter. If you "use ChatGPT" and manage a vendor, stop here.
  • Learner. You pick up new products, tools, and domains without a curriculum. You get dangerous in a stack you did not know last month.
  • Dynamic, and useful outside growth. You have done real work beyond campaigns and demand gen: ops, product, sales support, internal tools, implementation, or something adjacent. Breadth does not replace hands-on marketing ops.
  • Hands-on fluency with HubSpot plus Clay-class tools and ZoomInfo or comparable. Configured and operated by you, not briefed. You have run real CRM/lifecycle, enrichment/segmentation, and campaign activation/measurement workflows, not only demos or proposals.
  • Built and owned demand gen or growth at a B2B enterprise or regulated-industry SaaS.
  • Light code comfort. TypeScript or Python at read-and-modify level. JSON-LD and YAML at author level.
  • You write, build, and analyze. Not a vendor manager.
  • Track record selling into long, regulated enterprise cycles where trust is the gate.

This is not

  • A growth marketer who wants an AI overlay on last year's playbook.
  • A specialist who only wants to own paid, content, or lifecycle and never touch agents or production systems.
  • A manager who assigns agent work or marketing ops to someone else.
  • A high-volume outbound operator optimizing for activity over trust.
  • Someone who has only proposed marketing systems or built demos, without operating them.

Compensation

Competitive. Benchmarked against Toronto B2B SaaS and the North American AI-native growth-engineering market.

How to apply

The application asks for one artifact and short answers. A short paragraph plus a link beats a long resume.

  1. Walk us through a Claude or OpenAI skill you shipped in the last 90 days.
  2. Show us a HubSpot or Clay agentic workflow you built yourself.
  3. Which marketing systems have you personally configured and operated (CRM/lifecycle, enrichment/segmentation, activation/measurement)? What did you build in each, how did they connect, and how did you keep them running?
  4. Describe one campaign or ongoing marketing workflow you personally delivered: audience, objective, scale, duration, measurable results, and a failure or iteration you handled. Redacted evidence OK.
  5. Give us an example of work you did that was not growth or marketing, and how you got up to speed.

The fine print

  • This is an active, funded role. We are hiring now.
  • We use artificial intelligence tools to help screen and assess applications and to schedule interviews. A human makes advancement and hiring decisions.
  • Candidates reaching the final interview receive a decision within 30 days.
  • iTmethods is an equal-opportunity employer. We hire on merit and on what you have built. Canadian work experience is not required.
Salary: Competitive. Benchmarked against Toronto B2B SaaS and the North American AI-native growth-engineering market.

micro1 is seeking Program Analyst, Federal Agency Experience for a customer project focused on AI evaluation.   4. Check that each scenario reflects how federal planning, evaluation, and reporting actually work in an agency.
  5. Work with project coordinators to resolve unclear scenarios or answers.
  6. Use fictional or public information only. Do not include non-public agency documents, pre-decisional material, CUI, or PII.

  1. Hands-on experience as a federal program or management analyst (GS-0343, GS-0301, or equivalent), including as a contractor supporting a federal agency, in at least one of these areas: program evaluation or performance measurement, policy analysis, strategic or operational planning, decision memos and briefings for senior leaders [confirm].

Why Binance

  • Tackle challenging projects in a fast-paced and innovative enviornment with autonomy
  • Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning

jobs.title: Regulatory Business System Analyst
jobs.excerpt: At Thorne, we work to deliver high-quality, science-backed solutions to empower individuals to take a proactive approach to their well-being.
jobs.description:
At Thorne, we work to deliver high-quality, science-backed solutions to empower individuals to take a proactive approach to their well-being. Each day begins with a mission to help others discover and achieve their best health. We count on our team members to challenge and push the boundaries to make that happen. At Thorne, you’ll be joining a team of more than 750 passionate individuals committed to our cause of providing superior health solutions at every age and life stage.We’re considering candidates for both Level I and Level II. Your relevant experience will help us determine which level is the best fit. The Regulatory Business System Analyst serves as the liaison between the business units and technical and validation support personnel. This position interprets the stakeholders’ business goals into specific deliverables and understands challenges and develops solution options. The Regulatory Business System Analyst oversees that the stakeholders’ business goals have been delivered and accepted. This position provides application support by troubleshooting reported issues and coordinating the applied resolution for all Quality supported and or/or regulated company used software. The Regulatory Business System Analyst reviews and develops risk assessment for vendor scheduled software upgrades and patches for Quality supported and regulated software used by Thorne. This position manages user access and security for all Quality supported software and performs system data integrity and 21 CFR Part 11 compliance audits on Quality supported software. This position maintains the validated state of all regulated software ensuring change control, and validation procedures are followed for the software’s life cycle and audit readiness.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Becomes thoroughly knowledgeable of the applicable portions of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMPs) and maintains knowledge base on an ongoing, timely basis as procedural changes occur without relying on management intervention or direction.
  • Becomes thoroughly knowledgeable of the Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for computerized software.
  • Ensures compliance with cGMP, FDA, OSHA, and all other regulatory requirements, in accordance with company policy.
  • Adheres to company safety requirements.
  • Proactively initiates the development of streamlined systems to effectively identify and resolve quality problems and process improvement opportunities.
  • Assists in internal audits and inspections of various departments/processes.
  • Demonstrates knowledge of department procedures and company policies, pays attention to detail in all aspects, and completes all paperwork accurately, neatly, and fully.
  • Partners with process improvement teams to provide quality software compliance input and direction. Ensures that documentation of improvements is completed and approved as needed.
  • Demonstrates initiative and job knowledge by suggesting ideas, discovering new and better ways of accomplishing goals, and finds innovative, thought-out solutions to problems.
  • Builds a strong working relationship with department stakeholders and subject matter experts when dealing with requirements for software business processes that impacts software maintained by the Quality departments (Quality Assurance and Quality Control).
  • Builds a strong working relationship with department software administrators to ensure regulatory compliance of regulated software.
  • Identifies, analyzes, and evaluates risks for process improvements.

Regulatory Business System Analyst I
  • Knowledge of software validation for regulated software.
  • Experience with application support, including implementation of new software or improvements.
  • Employee maintenance.
  • Collaborate effectively with team members, stakeholders, and users to support process improvements, operational efficiencies and requirements gathering.
  • Provide support to end-users and resolve issues in a timely manner.
  • Ability to discuss and guide the business in creating and implementing their master data for the application.
  • Develop detailed requirements and use cases for software development projects.
  • Participate in system and process design discovery.
  • Capture additional user requirements that may be identified due to gaps or during demonstrations, ensuring user specification has been updated with all additions.
  • Participate in validation activities and writing validation documentation.
  • Develop and maintain business process documentation.
  • Participate in software testing and quality assurance activities.
  • Identify reporting needs.
  • Assist with the execution of qualification testing for upgrades and patches.
Regulatory Business System Analyst II
  • Proficient in Regulatory Business System Analyst I responsibilities.
  • Effectively gather and analyze feedback, facilitates discussions, and translates requirements into practical solutions that enhance operational efficiency, productivity, quality, and user experience.
  • Basic knowledge of SaaS vendor compliance and validation practices, including vendor documentation review and support of qualification and periodic assessment activities.
  • Cultivate curiosity and creative thinking during system and process design discovery to develop scalable, future-ready solutions that support evolving business needs.
  • Basic experience with software configuration that includes scripting and markup languages.
  • Analyze and troubleshoot software issues, identify root causes, and implement solutions.
  • Participate in the risk assessment evaluation of the user requirements, identifying the system impacts and gaps to meet the user requirements.
  • Participate in the initial design documents for presentation of the proposed solution – creation of form layout, business workflows identifying inputs and outputs, dependencies, gaps and risks.

jobs.title: Care Coordinator II - Care at Home
jobs.excerpt: We are seeking a highly motivated Care Coordinator to support our Care at Home team.
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly motivated Care Coordinator to support our Care at Home team. This role provides operational and non-clinical care coordination support to providers delivering in-home and telehealth care to high-risk and medically complex members, including members recently discharged from the hospital.
The Care Coordinator supports the member journey from referral through outreach, scheduling, enrollment, ongoing care coordination, and program discharge. Core responsibilities include managing referrals and communications, maintaining provider schedules, coordinating efficient driving routes, preparing patient charts, obtaining medical records, and completing provider-directed follow-up tasks.

This position works closely with members, caregivers, providers, primary care offices, hospitals, facilities, health plans, and community partners. The ideal candidate is organized, proactive, comfortable with a high volume of calls and tasks, and able to manage multiple time-sensitive priorities while providing a positive member experience.

Our Values:
  • Put Patients First
  • Empower Entrepreneurial Provider and Care Teams
  • Operate with Integrity & Excellence
  • Be Innovative
  • Work As One Team

What You'll Do

  • Manage incoming Care at Home referrals from receipt through outreach, scheduling, enrollment, or final disposition, including reviewing referral information, maintaining accurate statuses, and documenting outcomes and barriers.
  • Conduct high-volume outreach to members and caregivers by phone, text, and other approved methods to explain the program, support enrollment, schedule services, confirm visits, and follow up on missed or unsuccessful outreach.
  • Coordinate initial, follow-up, urgent, in-home, and telehealth appointments while actively managing provider schedules by filling openings, backfilling cancellations, rescheduling missed visits, and supporting established visit goals.
  • Build efficient in-home schedules by reviewing member locations, provider coverage areas, travel time, and visit logistics to geographically cluster appointments and reduce unnecessary drive time.
  • Prepare patient charts, obtain and upload medical records, and maintain accurate member, referral, appointment, provider assignment, and program information in designated systems.
  • Monitor provider task queues and complete non-clinical, provider-directed care coordination tasks, including coordinating and tracking referrals, authorizations, medical-record requests, durable medical equipment, home health, labs, imaging, hospice, and other ordered services.
  • Manage incoming calls, messages, faxes, and electronic tasks, and communicate with members, caregivers, providers, primary care offices, hospitals, facilities, health plans, and vendors to support timely follow-up and closed-loop coordination.
  • Support post-discharge and transitional care workflows, hospital tracking, member status changes, and program discharges, escalating clinical concerns, urgent requests, unresolved needs, and barriers to the appropriate team member.
  • Maintain required operational trackers, participate in meetings and process-improvement activities, provide cross-coverage when appropriately trained, and meet established expectations for timeliness, schedule utilization, chart preparation, documentation accuracy, task completion, and member service.
This is a non-clinical role. Care Coordinators complete provider-directed coordination activities but do not independently provide medical advice, assess symptoms, interpret clinical results, or make treatment decisions. Clinical concerns must be escalated to the appropriate licensed clinical team member.

Qualifications

  • High school diploma OR GED
  • Experience using Microsoft applications such as Word, Excel and Outlook
  • Experience working in healthcare setting preferred
  • Experience with referrals, authorizations, medical records, or care coordination strongly preferred
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, high-acuity environment
  • BILINGUAL – Bilingual skills preferred, based on member population
You're Great for This Role if You Have:
  • Experience coordinating care for high-risk or medically complex members
  • Experience supporting post-discharge or transitional care workflows
  • Familiarity working closely with clinical providers and carrying out provider-directed coordination tasks
  • Strong organization skills and attention to detail
  • Ability to think critically and proactively identify barriers to care
  • A member-centered approach and strong communication skills

Environmental Job Requirements and Working Conditions

  • This is a full-time, remote position. Hours are M-F 8 A - 5 P PST.
  • The national target compensation for this position is $21.00 - $24.00 per hour. Actual compensation will be determined based on geographic location (current or future), experience, and other job-related factors.

jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Manager
jobs.excerpt: Description About the Role & Hiring Manager ﻿I joined Zenity because it’s tackling a new and complex security challenge that enterprises are just beginning to face, securing AI agents everywhere, fast and at scale.
jobs.description:
Description

About the Role & Hiring Manager

﻿I joined Zenity because it’s tackling a new and complex security challenge that enterprises are just beginning to face, securing AI agents everywhere, fast and at scale. It was also an opportunity to help shape how customer success operates in a category defining company while working alongside a highly capable and ambitious team.

As a leader, I value ownership, direct feedback, and high standards. Our team operates with urgency and accountability, and I expect real ownership of customer outcomes, proactive communication, and a strong focus on delivering measurable impact for our customers.

This role plays a critical part in our next phase of growth. You’ll serve as the technical lead for complex customers, owning regular engagement, technical orchestration, and cross-organizational coordination, directly influencing how customers build their AI security program.

About Zenity﻿

Zenity is the leader in AI Agent Security and the first company to bring an agent-centric security platform to market. As enterprises accelerate AI agent adoption, we are establishing the security framework for how AI agents are secured and governed at enterprise scale.We deliver full-lifecycle visibility, governance, detection, prevention, and response for AI agents from build time to runtime, across SaaS, home-grown platforms, and end-user devices.

Backed by $180M+ in total funding, including a $125M Series C led by Norwest, with participation from SoftBank Vision Fund 2 and Microsoft's M12, Zenity is trusted by Fortune 500 and Global 2000 enterprises worldwide.

Join us in shaping how AI agents are secured at enterprise scale.

What You’ll Do

  • ﻿Own the full technical and strategic success of Zenity’s accounts, serving as the primary technical and customer-facing resource post-sale.
  • Lead complex, multi-party enterprise engagements across deployment, integrations, budgeting cycles, governance approvals, and long-term platform expansion.
  • Coordinate joint account motions involving customer stakeholders, Zenity internal teams, and large technology platform teams, ensuring alignment on strategy, integrations, and long-term value realization.
  • Run strategic reviews that clearly articulate security program improvements, roadmap alignment, integration progress, and expansion opportunities.
  • Serve as the voice of the customer to Product, Engineering, Sales, and Field Engineering to streamline complex motions and reduce internal friction.
  • Own high-impact technical escalations end-to-end, maintaining executive visibility while driving resolution across internal teams.
  • Translate sophisticated requirements into structured success plans, identifying technical risks, integration dependencies, and phased deployment strategies.
  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering to surface customer insights that influence roadmap direction and support the continued evolution of Zenity’s platform.
  • Contribute to scaling Zenity’s success model and best practices for managing strategic accounts.
  • Act as a mentor on the Customer Success team - sharing your learnings from customers and past Customer Success engagements to improve our customer experience.

Requirements

What You've Done

  • You have 6+ years in customer-facing technical roles in SaaS, cybersecurity, or enterprise software, including ownership of complex account engagements.
  • You've led customer engagements and strategic reviews inside large organizations, and can explain what changed in the customer's program as a result.
  • You've run enterprise accounts with many motions at once (governance processes, integrations, cross-functional stakeholders, external platform teams) and can describe how you kept them moving together.
  • You've owned a hard technical escalation through resolution with Engineering and Support, and can walk through what you did and what you'd do differently.
  • You've turned customer requirements into product insight that Product or Engineering acted on.
  • You have a hands-on cybersecurity background and have gone deep with customers on technical architecture, integrations, and enterprise risk.

Strongly preferred

  • Exposure to AI, enterprise security, or other emerging technologies.

What We Look For At Zenity

  • Ownership mindset, with accountability for customer outcomes rather than activity.
  • Executive presence and analytical thinking, whether you're in a technical working session or a leadership review.
  • Comfort in a fast-moving startup where structure is still maturing, and the energy to help build it.

Interview Process

Our interview process is designed to be transparent, conversational, and focused on real-world experience.

  • Recruiter Screen (30 minutes) – Learn more about Zenity, the role, and how we work.
  • VP of Customer Success Interview (45–60 minutes) – A deeper discussion about your technical background, customer management approach, and escalation ownership.
  • Support Leadership Interview – Discussion focused on technical depth, security expertise, and cross-functional within support and engineering.
  • Solutions Engineering Interview – Discussion focused on ownership of customer outcomes post sale, cross-functional sales and CS alignment, ai experience.
  • People Team Interview (45 minutes) – A conversation focused on collaboration, work style, and alignment.

Compensation

The expected OTE range for this role is $210,000–$230,000, depending on experience, skills, and location. In addition to base compensation, this role may be eligible for equity and performance-based incentives.

Zenity is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We enable enterprises to adopt AI agents securely and at scale, and that starts with building a team that reflects a wide range of perspectives and experiences. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

We’re committed to creating an inclusive environment where talented people can do their best work, securely, confidently, and with impact.

jobs.title: Senior User Acquisition Manager, Meta & Google Ads (US Degree Programs)
jobs.excerpt: Description TripleTen is a leading online coding bootcamp that offers to learn coding and data analysis skills for tech industry jobs in less than a year in the US, Latin America, and Brazil.
jobs.description:
Description

TripleTen is a leading online coding bootcamp that offers to learn coding and data analysis skills for tech industry jobs in less than a year in the US, Latin America, and Brazil.

Our research-based learning method is focused on ensuring that after completing our program, every student, regardless of their initial abilities, will find employment in tech industry with 100% money-back guarantee and 87% employment rate among our 6K+ graduates.

We are looking for a Senior User Acquisition Manager to launch and scale paid acquisition for our new online master’s degree programs offered in partnership with US universities. You will own acquisition from the first ad impression through to enrollment, with Meta Ads as your primary channel. Experience with Google Ads, particularly YouTube, is a strong plus.

What you will do

  • Launch paid acquisition from scratch for our new online master’s degree programs offered in partnership with US universities.
  • Own acquisition strategy, budgets, and hands-on campaign execution, with Meta Ads as your primary channel. Experience with Google Ads and YouTube will allow you to test and develop these channels as well.
  • Build, test, and scale acquisition funnels for a high-ticket B2C product, from the first ad impression through qualification, consultations, and enrollment.
  • Optimize for qualified prospects and customer acquisition cost, using CRM data, sales call transcripts, and conversion rates across the funnel to guide decisions.
  • Develop and rapidly test hypotheses around audiences, messaging, offers, creative formats, and landing pages. Scale what works and stop what doesn’t.
  • Turn audience research and competitor insights into actionable creative briefs. Work with the team and external partners to produce and iterate on ads and landing pages.
  • Set up advertising accounts, pixels, conversion events, and campaign tracking, with support from analytics and engineering teams where needed.
  • Work closely with Sales to improve lead quality and build a qualified waitlist ahead of the opening of paid enrollment.

Requirements

  • 4+ years in performance marketing or user acquisition, with recent hands-on experience managing both Meta Ads and Google Ads, including audience acquisition through YouTube.
  • Experience in acquisition-first or paid-marketing-first companies, where paid acquisition is a core driver of revenue.
  • Proven success acquiring customers for high-ticket B2C products through multi-step funnels involving qualification, consultations, and sales conversations. Experience with products priced at $10,000+ is strongly preferred.
  • Experience personally managing monthly advertising budgets of $50,000–$100,000 or more, with measurable business results.
  • A track record of launching acquisition from scratch: setting up accounts and tracking, testing initial hypotheses, finding effective combinations of audiences, offers, and creatives, and scaling them.
  • Strong hands-on Meta Ads expertise, including campaign structure, audience testing, pixel and conversion setup, creative experimentation, and budget optimization.
  • Hands-on Google Ads expertise beyond Search, particularly YouTube and video-led acquisition for products that require consideration and demand generation.
  • Full-funnel analytical skills: you work with CAC, ROMI, lead-to-call and call-to-sale conversion rates, and use CRM and BI data to assess performance beyond cost per lead.
  • Practical experience with GA4, Google Tag Manager, advertising pixels, and conversion tracking. You can define conversion events and validate tracking, collaborating with analysts and engineers when needed.
  • Experience testing offers, ad copy, creatives, and landing pages, and writing clear briefs for designers, content producers, and external partners.
  • Confidence working independently in a new product environment, with limited historical data and no established acquisition playbook.
  • AI tools are already part of your day-to-day workflow.
  • Full professional English.
  • Based within CET ±3 hours, with at least 2 hours of overlap with US Eastern Time.

What we can offer you

  • Competitive compensation: 4500-5000 USD Gross per month.
  • Full-time remote contract with a flexible schedule.
  • A close-knit, international team of thoughtful and driven professionals.
  • All software licenses and remote work tools you need to be successful in a remote working environment (Slack, Miro, Notion, Zoom, etc).

jobs.excerpt: Who are we?  Hi!  👋 We are Ravelin!  We're a fraud detection company using advanced machine learning and network analysis technology to solve big problems.
jobs.description:
Who are we?
Hi! 👋 We are Ravelin! We're a fraud detection company using advanced machine learning and network analysis technology to solve big problems. Our goal is to make online transactions safer and help our clients feel confident serving their customers.
And we have fun in the meantime! We are a friendly bunch and pride ourselves in having a strong culture and adhering to our values of empathy, ambition, unity and integrity. We really value work/life balance and we embrace a flat hierarchy structure company-wide. Join us and you’ll learn fast about cutting-edge tech and work with some of the brightest and nicest people around - check out our Glassdoor reviews.
If this sounds like your cup of tea, we would love to hear from you! For more information check out our blog to see if you would like to help us prevent crime and protect the world's biggest online businesses.
The Role
We are looking for an experienced Project Manager to join the Integrations team. This role will involve line managing other Project Managers, driving process improvements and ambitious goals in the team, and contributing to the delivery of successful client integrations.

Within our Integrations team, the Project Managers work alongside our Integration Engineers, with individual pairs assigned to a client integration project. The Project Manager’s focus is on understanding the client’s objectives and guiding them through the process from integration kick-off to actively using the Ravelin product(s). Your focus will be mostly on coaching others to deliver, more than leading day-to-day client project activities.

In this role, you will also be working closely with many other teams within Ravelin, bringing everything together for a successful outcome for our clients.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as a leader in establishing and developing best practices for Project Managers within the Integrations team, to ensure we continue to strive for high quality and effective integrations.
  • Support the Director of Integrations on initiatives around process improvement, change management, and the wider company goals, leading some initiatives and contributing to others.
  • Line manage a number of Project Managers, supporting and coaching them in their role.
  • Contribute to technical and business integrations with clients. This may be via other Project Managers, or by directly running client projects.
  • Deliver operational excellence, as part of overseeing a collection of projects. Anticipate potential issues and dependencies, and highlight or escalate project risks where appropriate.
  • Develop strong working relationships with our clients. This may include chairing some day-to-day client-facing meetings, but also helping to resolve complex client requirements and bringing any escalations to a calm conclusion.
  • Ensure excellent time management of your own tasks, but also assisting others to prioritise, to set goals and to set expectations with clients.
  • Maintain all project documentation, and actively promote knowledge sharing within the Integration team, and wider Ravelin teams.
  • Proactively engage with the Product team, sharing feature suggestions and interesting scenarios from client conversations.

Requirements

  • 5 or more years of line management experience.
  • Project management experience in a technical or integrations environment, with exposure to complex products or solutions.
  • A track record of process improvement, and experience in instigating change within a team and across teams.
  • Exceptional communication skills – both internally and client-facing.
  • The ability to direct and lead others confidently, and comfortable having difficult conversations when needed.
  • Analytical with great attention to detail.
  • Pragmatic problem solver and solutions-oriented.
  • Strong commercial awareness

Benefits

  • Flexible Working Hours & Remote-First Environment — Work when and where you’re most productive, with flexibility and support.
  • Comprehensive BUPA Health Insurance — Stay covered with top-tier medical care for your peace of mind.
  • £1,000 Annual Wellness and Learning Budget — Prioritise your health, well-being and learning needs with funds for fitness, mental health, and more.
  • Monthly Wellbeing and Learning Day — Take every last Friday of the month off to recharge or learn something new, up to you.
  • 25 Days Holiday + Bank Holidays + 1 Extra Cultural Day — Enjoy generous time off to rest, travel, or celebrate what matters to you.
  • Mental Health Support via Spill — Access professional mental health services when you need them.
  • Aviva Pension Scheme — Plan for the future with our pension program.
  • Ravelin Gives Back — Join monthly charitable donations and volunteer opportunities to make a positive impact.
  • Fortnightly Randomised Team Lunches — Connect with teammates from across the company over in person or remote lunches every other week on us!
  • Cycle-to-Work Scheme — Save on commuting costs while staying active.
  • BorrowMyDoggy Access — Love dogs? Spend time with a furry friend through this unique perk.
  • Weekly Board Game Nights & Social Budget — Unwind with weekly board games or plan your own socials, supported by a company budget.

*Job offers may be withdrawn if candidates do not meet our pre-employment checks: unspent criminal convictions, employment verification, and right to work.*

jobs.title: Family Office Accounting & Tax Associate (Part Time)
jobs.excerpt: We are seeking a capable, part-timeFamily Office Accounting & Tax Associate to support the bookkeeping, accounting, tax coordination, and financial reporting needs of high-net-worth families, entrepreneurs, and closely held business owners.
jobs.description:
We are seeking a capable, part-timeFamily Office Accounting & Tax Associate to support the bookkeeping, accounting, tax coordination, and financial reporting needs of high-net-worth families, entrepreneurs, and closely held business owners.
This individual will serve as Synergy’s primary internal execution resource for accounting and tax-related workflows — performing much of the initial bookkeeping and accounting work, investigating financial activity, maintaining accurate financial information, coordinating tax documentation, and working directly with clients to resolve outstanding items.
This is not a traditional bookkeeping role. The Associate will gain exposure to the complete financial lives of sophisticated families, including closely held businesses, real estate, private investments, multiple legal entities, tax planning, and family-level financial reporting. The role is designed for someone with meaningful practical accounting experience who wants to develop within a multi-family office environment.
The position is anticipated to be between 15-25 hours per week with a regular schedule during business hours. The role may be performed remotely within the United States, with optional hybrid availability for individuals located in the Greater Los Angeles area.

The position requires access to highly confidential client financial information and may include authorized view-only access to client banking, brokerage, investment, and other financial systems. Appropriate background screening will be required.

Key Responsibilities

1. Bookkeeping & Accounting

  • Perform ongoing bookkeeping and account reconciliations using QuickBooks Online
  • Review and categorize transactions and investigate unidentified or unusual financial activity
  • Review general ledgers and identify missing, incorrect, or potentially misclassified transactions
  • Prepare proposed journal entries and other accounting adjustments for senior review
  • Maintain charts of accounts and supporting financial schedules
  • Prepare preliminary P&Ls, balance sheets, general ledgers, and other financial reports
  • Collaborate with senior accounting professionals to review, correct, and finalize client books and financial deliverables

2. Tax Coordination

  • Own the collection, organization, and delivery of information required for tax preparation and tax planning
  • Coordinate tax organizers and supporting documentation
  • Collect and maintain K-1s, investment statements, closing documents, entity records, and other tax-related information
  • Work directly with tax professionals to resolve outstanding information requests
  • Develop working knowledge of the tax strategies utilized by clients to better understand the accounting and documentation requirements supporting them
  • Maintain clear boundaries between execution and advice; this role does not independently provide tax, investment, or legal advice

3. Family Office Reporting & Financial Administration

  • Maintain underlying information supporting client balance sheets, net-worth statements, and other family-office reporting
  • Track relevant financial information across closely held businesses, real estate, private investments, and personal assets and liabilities
  • Assist with mapping entity ownership and financial relationships across LLCs, partnerships, S corporations, holding companies, trusts, and other structures
  • Track investment-related tax information, including K-1s, basis information, and capital activity
  • Maintain accurate and organized accounting and tax records within Canopy and other firm systems

4. Client & Team Coordination

  • Communicate directly with clients to request documentation, clarify transactions, and resolve accounting-related questions
  • Independently schedule and lead routine bookkeeping, accounting, and documentation calls as appropriate
  • Translate accounting questions into clear, straightforward client communication
  • Own day-to-day activity within Synergy’s bookkeeping inbox
  • Collaborate closely with Client Services, senior accounting professionals, and tax professionals to keep deliverables moving
  • Exhaust available internal records, financial systems, and other resources before requesting information already available elsewhere from a client
  • Maintain appropriate responsiveness to client and internal requests and proactively escalate blockers

Qualification & Required Experience

Required

  • Minimum 2 years of hands-on QuickBooks bookkeeping/accounting experience
  • Experience performing reconciliations, transaction categorization, general ledger review, and maintaining financial records
  • Experience working with individuals and/or small-to-middle-market businesses with meaningful financial activity
  • Strong understanding of basic accounting principles and financial statements
  • Strong organizational skills and demonstrated ability to independently drive work to completion
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to interact professionally with sophisticated clients
  • Working proficiency in Microsoft Excel
  • Ability to investigate and resolve financial questions before escalating or requesting information from clients
  • Ability to consistently dedicate approximately 15–25 hours per week, including availability during normal business hours

Preferred

  • Experience with tax preparation, tax accounting, or private-client tax matters
  • Experience serving high-net-worth individuals, entrepreneurs, or closely held businesses
  • Background in family office, CPA firm, outsourced accounting/CAS, private-client tax, or similar professional services
  • CPA or Enrolled Agent credential, or progress toward one
  • Graduate or professional education in accounting, taxation, finance, business, law, or a related discipline

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Organization & follow-through: Manages multiple detailed workstreams and sees them through to completion
  • Accounting competency: Strong practical QuickBooks and bookkeeping skills with the ability to understand how transactions flow through financial statements
  • Investigative mindset: Naturally asks why something occurred and works through available information before escalating
  • Ownership: Takes responsibility for getting answers and moving work forward
  • Client communication: Professional, personable, and capable of simplifying accounting concepts without unnecessary jargon
  • Judgment: Understands the difference between factual accounting execution and matters requiring senior professional judgment
  • Learning agility: Interested in understanding how accounting, tax, investments, entities, and other disciplines connect within a sophisticated family’s financial life

Benefits

  • Paid holidays
  • Work from home with hybrid optional
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Paid vacation and sick days
  • Professional development and mentoring

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer, Embedded
jobs.excerpt: Opportunity is not evenly distributed.  Shopify puts independence within reach for anyone with a dream to start a business.
jobs.description:
Opportunity is not evenly distributed. Shopify puts independence within reach for anyone with a dream to start a business. We propel entrepreneurs and enterprises to scale the heights of their potential. Since 2006, we’ve grown to 10,000 employees and generated over $496 billion in sales for millions of merchants in 175 countries.
This is life-defining work that directly impacts people’s lives as much as it transforms your own. This is putting the power of the few in the hands of the many, is a future with more voices rather than fewer, and is creating more choices instead of an elite option.

About You

Moving at our pace brings a lot of change, complexity, and ambiguity—and a little bit of chaos. Shopifolk thrive on that and are comfortable being uncomfortable. That means Shopify is not the right place for everyone.
Before you apply, consider if you can:
  • Care deeply about what you do and about making commerce better for everyone
  • Excel by seeking professional and personal hypergrowth
  • Keep up with an unrelenting pace (the week, not the quarter)
  • Be resilient and resourceful in face of ambiguity and thrive on (rather than endure) change
  • Bring critical thought and opinion
  • Embrace differences and disagreement to get shit done and move forward
  • Work digital-first for your daily work

About the role

Data is a crucial part of Shopify’s mission to make commerce better for everyone. We organize and interpret petabytes of data to provide solutions for our merchants and stakeholders across the organization.
As a Data Engineer at Shopify, your primary responsibility will be to contribute to Shopify’s Data Warehouse. Your work will unlock powerful insights to guide the development and improvement of Shopify’s products.
As an embedded Data Engineer, you will work directly building foundations for products that transform merchants' lives. You'll collaborate with a multidisciplinary team of professionals that can include Product Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, Business Analysts, and Product Management. The data you shape will be used to power product analysis, dashboards, and reports. You will also contribute by performing product analysis and creating dashboards and reports yourself from time to time. Get excited about flexing these analysis and reporting muscles, while also evangelizing the values and excellence in the Data Engineering craft to your multidisciplinary peers in a fast moving environment with competing priorities.
Our product is designed to empower entrepreneurs. Consequently, the work you do will not only create value for our users but also contribute to global entrepreneurship. To thrive here, you need to be dedicated to your craft and committed to constant development. You should be an independent thinker who can solve complex problems and handle a bit of chaos without breaking a sweat.
Example day to day responsibilities include:
  • Working with business partners to understand business and product objectives and identify the data needed to support them
  • Designing, building, implementing, and documenting data models
  • Writing data transformations using dbt or Spark
  • Shipping data pipelines including real-time streaming and batch processing
  • Optimizing data transformation pipelines to increase freshness or reduce computational time/cost
  • Working with engineers to understand and influence how data is produced
  • Collaborating with other data engineers on tooling for automated tasks around consuming, validating raw/modeled data, updating modeled data
  • Subscribing to and implementing architecture and standards following the Data Engineer craft at Shopify
  • Collaborating with sister disciplines (Engineering, Data Science) to establish best practices and evangelize the values and priorities of the Data Engineering craft
  • Partnering closely with product, engineering and other business leaders to influence product and program decisions with data
  • Building production-quality dashboards and scalable data products

Qualifications

  • Commercial experience in Data Engineering, and/or Analytics Engineering, ​​​​​​building scalable data warehouses
  • Dimensional Modeling (Star Schema, Kimball, Inmon)
  • Advanced SQL skills (ease with window functions, defining UDFs)
  • Exposure to Data Engineering tooling: ingesting, testing transformations, lineage, orchestration, publishing data, metric layers
  • Hands-on experience implementing real-time and batch data pipelines with tight SLOs and complex transformation requirements
  • Fantastic collaboration and communication skills, demonstrated by successful large-scale projects spanning multiple teams
  • Technical thought leader, comfortable navigating ambiguity and mentoring various level of team members
  • Aptitude for product analysis, dashboarding, and reporting

Localization quality controllers (LQCs) support FunkyCorp project managers on localization projects.   • Must be a native speaker of the target language, with impeccable grammar and spelling

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer, Embedded
jobs.excerpt: Opportunity is not evenly distributed.  Shopify puts independence within reach for anyone with a dream to start a business.
jobs.description:
Opportunity is not evenly distributed. Shopify puts independence within reach for anyone with a dream to start a business. We propel entrepreneurs and enterprises to scale the heights of their potential. Since 2006, we’ve grown to 10,000 employees and generated over $496 billion in sales for millions of merchants in 175 countries.
This is life-defining work that directly impacts people’s lives as much as it transforms your own. This is putting the power of the few in the hands of the many, is a future with more voices rather than fewer, and is creating more choices instead of an elite option.

About You

Moving at our pace brings a lot of change, complexity, and ambiguity—and a little bit of chaos. Shopifolk thrive on that and are comfortable being uncomfortable. That means Shopify is not the right place for everyone.
Before you apply, consider if you can:
  • Care deeply about what you do and about making commerce better for everyone
  • Excel by seeking professional and personal hypergrowth
  • Keep up with an unrelenting pace (the week, not the quarter)
  • Be resilient and resourceful in face of ambiguity and thrive on (rather than endure) change
  • Bring critical thought and opinion
  • Embrace differences and disagreement to get shit done and move forward
  • Work digital-first for your daily work

About the role

Data is a crucial part of Shopify’s mission to make commerce better for everyone. We organize and interpret petabytes of data to provide solutions for our merchants and stakeholders across the organization.
As a Data Engineer at Shopify, your primary responsibility will be to contribute to Shopify’s Data Warehouse. Your work will unlock powerful insights to guide the development and improvement of Shopify’s products.
As an embedded Data Engineer, you will work directly building foundations for products that transform merchants' lives. You'll collaborate with a multidisciplinary team of professionals that can include Product Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, Business Analysts, and Product Management. The data you shape will be used to power product analysis, dashboards, and reports. You will also contribute by performing product analysis and creating dashboards and reports yourself from time to time. Get excited about flexing these analysis and reporting muscles, while also evangelizing the values and excellence in the Data Engineering craft to your multidisciplinary peers in a fast moving environment with competing priorities.
Our product is designed to empower entrepreneurs. Consequently, the work you do will not only create value for our users but also contribute to global entrepreneurship. To thrive here, you need to be dedicated to your craft and committed to constant development. You should be an independent thinker who can solve complex problems and handle a bit of chaos without breaking a sweat.
Example day to day responsibilities include:
  • Working with business partners to understand business and product objectives and identify the data needed to support them
  • Designing, building, implementing, and documenting data models
  • Writing data transformations using dbt or Spark
  • Shipping data pipelines including real-time streaming and batch processing
  • Optimizing data transformation pipelines to increase freshness or reduce computational time/cost
  • Working with engineers to understand and influence how data is produced
  • Collaborating with other data engineers on tooling for automated tasks around consuming, validating raw/modeled data, updating modeled data
  • Subscribing to and implementing architecture and standards following the Data Engineer craft at Shopify
  • Collaborating with sister disciplines (Engineering, Data Science) to establish best practices and evangelize the values and priorities of the Data Engineering craft
  • Partnering closely with product, engineering and other business leaders to influence product and program decisions with data
  • Building production-quality dashboards and scalable data products

Qualifications

  • Commercial experience in Data Engineering, and/or Analytics Engineering, ​​​​​​building scalable data warehouses
  • Dimensional Modeling (Star Schema, Kimball, Inmon)
  • Advanced SQL skills (ease with window functions, defining UDFs)
  • Exposure to Data Engineering tooling: ingesting, testing transformations, lineage, orchestration, publishing data, metric layers
  • Hands-on experience implementing real-time and batch data pipelines with tight SLOs and complex transformation requirements
  • Fantastic collaboration and communication skills, demonstrated by successful large-scale projects spanning multiple teams
  • Technical thought leader, comfortable navigating ambiguity and mentoring various level of team members
  • Aptitude for product analysis, dashboarding, and reporting

  • Own acquisition strategy, budgets, and hands-on campaign execution, with Meta Ads as your primary channel. Experience with Google Ads and YouTube will allow you to test and develop these channels as well.

jobs.title: Lead DevOps Engineer
jobs.excerpt: We Also Walk Dogs needs you to help our clients win fights to make the world a better place.
jobs.description:
We Also Walk Dogs needs you to help our clients win fights to make the world a better place.

Our product, ActionKit (actionk.it), is used by dozens of major progressive groups and not-for-profits to stay in touch with tens of millions of online supporters. Our clients use ActionKit to fight climate change, push back against corporate power and more.

We've already begun moving our stack from on-premises servers to AWS, and need a DevOps engineer to help us take that effort to the next level. If you'd like to work at the intersection of cool cloud tech and making a better world, this is the job for you.

ActionKit is built by We Also Walk Dogs. Named after a Robert Heinlein story about a company that specialized in solving impossible problems, We Also Walk Dogs has spent over a decade serving online progressive organizations and charities. We're a small, friendly, and clever company. And we all work remotely.

Is this the job for you?

  • Do you keep production systems running? According to our external monitoring, we've kept 99.98% uptime this past year, and gone three months without downtime, while very actively working on the product. We need someone with the expertise and discipline to help us keep that going.
  • Do you think in the cloud? After starting with a fully on-premises deployment, today we're serving millions of end-users from AWS. But we know that intelligently deploying new tools and cloud capabilities can help us do things we could never do with just a rack of servers, and we need a DevOps engineer who can take us there.
  • Can you can wear a lot of hats? We're a small company and not much for bureaucratic divisions. The boss codes; the project manager gives sales demos; most everyone, including you, does a shift of at least a few hours each week answering our clients' support tickets.

If this sounds like you, please apply!

Must haves:

  • You need to care about maintaining a high-quality deployment. We've kept our uptime record with solid automation and monitoring, jumping on oddities before they become problems, and digging into root causes when things go wrong. We need you to be able to continue that tradition.
  • You need vision as well as execution. We need you to not only keep things running smoothly, but also help lead us where we need to go next. You need expertise in modern tools and AWS capabilities, and a strategic sense of how we can use them for efficiency, manageability, performance, and reliability.
  • You need to be in touch with others' needs. We're a small, tight-knit crew where everyone pitches in. Empathy with clients and end-users is also core to our business. Everyone on the team works directly with clients.

Nice to haves:

  • Experience working with all-remote teams.
  • Experience with Django, MySQL, and Ansible.
  • Experience with AWS features and patterns like VPCs, ELBs, SQS, auto-scaling groups, multi-zone deployments, and so on.
  • That said, experience with our stack is maybe the least important factor here; Even if you've used Rails instead of Django, Postgres instead of MySQL, or Azure instead of AWS, we want to hear from you.

Why work for us?

  • Competitive salary. We are a self-funded, for-profit company.
  • Remote work. Hours and location are flexible as long as you get the work done. In this day and age you shouldn't have to relocate to San Francisco for awesome work.
  • Four weeks paid time off. We encourage you to take vacation; we are not the sort of workplace that pressures anyone into 60-hour weeks.
  • A free, great health insurance policy and 401(k)
  • Work with an awesome team for awesome causes.

jobs.excerpt: POSITION OVERVIEWWe recognize that we are all related, interdependent, and that our collective voice is powerful andnecessary to ensure a world where our future generations can thrive.
jobs.description:
POSITION OVERVIEW
We recognize that we are all related, interdependent, and that our collective voice is powerful and
necessary to ensure a world where our future generations can thrive. We believe that Indigenous
knowledge and ways of being must guide us in developing and implementing solutions to address the
issues our communities currently face. Visit our website to learn more about our values.
We are seeking an Operations and Administrative Manager to support the day-to-day systems and infrastructure that allow Native Ways Federation to do its best work. Working closely with the Executive Director and across all staff, this position will manage the operational, technology, and administrative functions that keep NWF running — from vendor relationships and financial administration to IT systems.
We recognize that operations leadership in a growing nonprofit requires adaptability, sound judgment, and a commitment to continuous improvement. Native Ways Federation seeks a resourceful and organized leader who enjoys building systems, improving processes, solving problems, and creating the organizational infrastructure that allows our team and mission to thrive.
This role owns a wide range of organizational functions, including technology and systems administration, database and records management, board and executive support, and compliance. This position will take on increasing ownership of NWF's operational backbone to help ensure our organization remains stable, efficient, and well-positioned to grow its impact.
This role provides leadership across organizational operations, including technology and systems administration, financial administration, human resources coordination, board and executive support, compliance, and organizational infrastructure. As Native Ways Federation continues to grow, the Operations & Administrative Manager will play an essential role in strengthening organizational capacity, supporting staff success, and ensuring the organization remains efficient, resilient, and well-positioned for the future.
ABOUT US
In 2008, several national Native-led nonprofit organizations founded Native Ways Federation (NWF) to
activate and expand informed giving to nonprofits in Indian Country through donor education and
advocacy. In March of 2020, Native Ways Federation hired its current Executive Director and has since
grown to a team of six. Our active founding organizations (whose leadership makes up our Board) are:
American Indian College Fund, American Indian Science and Engineering Society, Association on
American Indian Affairs, First Nations Development Institute, National Indian Child Welfare Association,
and Native American Rights Fund.
Native Ways Federation is positioned at the forefront of change. Our relationships with Native-led non-
profits, philanthropy, philanthropy-serving organizations, and others allow us to influence and bridge
the gap between these stakeholders and disrupt the “business as usual” models embedded in this
Sector.
We recognize that everything and everyone comes into this world with gifts to contribute. We honor
those gifts by acting responsibly toward one another. For our employees, this means offering generous
and comprehensive benefits, including medical and dental insurance for individuals or families, paid
time off through personal time, retirement plan with employer contributions and matching, health and
wellness time, holidays, and 6 weeks of paid medical or family leave. We also offer professional and
cultural development opportunities to strengthen skills and cultural connections.
Learn more about joining our team at Native Ways Federation, including current openings, employee
benefits, and background on our organization at www.nativeways.org/careers
Native Ways Federation is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination or harassment
against current or potential employees.
PRIMARY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Organizational Operations & Administration
  • Oversee daily organizational operations and identify opportunities to improve operations through efficient and effective internal systems, communication, and workflows.
  • Develop, implement, and maintain operational policies, procedures, and organizational systems that support staff and organizational goals.
  • Coordinate organizational logistics including vendor relationships, contracts, and office administration needs.
  • Coordinate team meetings, retreats, and travel with support from other staff,
  • Support organizational planning processes, annual workplans, and cross-department coordination.
  • Maintain organizational records, files, and documentation systems with a high level of confidentiality and accuracy.
Financial Operations
  • Coordinate day-to-day financial administration in partnership with the Executive Director and external accounting partners.
  • Assist with budgeting, expense tracking, invoice processing, grant documentation, and financial reporting processes.
  • Help ensure compliance with organizational policies, grant requirements, and nonprofit operational standards.
  • Manage contracts, subscriptions, insurance renewals, and operational vendors.
Technology & Systems Management
  • Manage organizational technology systems, software platforms, and IT support relationships.
  • Help ensure staff have functional and accessible tools, systems, and operational support needed for their work.
  • Support data management, responsible cybersecurity practices, and internal communications systems.
Human Resources & Staff Support
  • Coordinate employee onboarding, offboarding, and personnel administration while ensuring a positive employee experience.
  • Coordinate benefits administration, payroll support, staff policies, and professional development logistics.
  • Help cultivate a healthy, collaborative, and culturally grounded workplace that prioritizes staff wellbeing and sustainability.
  • Support implementation of organizational policies and employee handbook procedures.
Other Duties
  • Assist with special projects managed by the Executive Director
  • Provide administrative support and ensure continuity of essential organizational operations as needed.
  • Identify and undertake professional development and training opportunities.
  • Other duties as assigned.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • Minimum 4 years of professional work experience in the nonprofit and/or philanthropic sector.
  • Experience working with Native-led organizations, Tribal nations, and/or Native businesses.
  • Intimate knowledge of Native communities and culture.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Experience supporting nonprofit operations, administration, and utilizing multiple organizational systems.
  • Proficiency with nonprofit technology platforms; experience with or ability to quickly learn CRM, project management, and communication tools.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to handle confidential information with discretion.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and collaboratively in a remote or hybrid work environment.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • Bachelor’s degree in Nonprofit Management, Business Administration, public administration, or another related field
  • Familiarity with financial operations, and compliance in a nonprofit setting.
  • Experience with NeonOne, Asana, Microsoft 365, or Google Workspace administration.
PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS
This position requires extended periods of computer and screen use.
Occasional travel may be required for meetings and events in alignment with organization health and
safety policies.

EEOC Statement

Native Ways Federation is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.
