jobs.excerpt: Our Story Imagine being part of a team that’s not just shaping the future but actively driving it.
jobs.description:
Our Story
Imagine being part of a team that’s not just shaping the future but actively driving it. At Davies North America, we’re at the forefront of innovation and excellence, blending cutting-edge technology with top-tier professional services. As a vital part of the global Davies Group, we help businesses navigate risk, optimize operations, and spearhead transformation in the insurance and regulated sectors.

We're on the lookout for a Bodily Injury Adjuster to join our growing team! As a Bodily Injury Adjuster, you will adjust third party General Liability, Auto Liability, Errors and Omissions, and Law Enforcement claims in which a claim exists for bodily injury, personal injury or wrongdoing. This role is a full-time, home-based position that may require travel at times to claims meetings at client locations, seminars for obtaining CEU credits, and scene investigations or inspections.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform all duties as outlined in the Property Damage Adjuster Job Description
  • Daily review of workflow and claim system reminders with follow up and significant progress towards completion of any task set as a reminder, or received in workflow within 72 hours
  • Review of new claims assignments within 24 hours of assignment/Completion of the Plan of Action
  • Contact with the insured/claimant within 24 hours of assignment
  • Assign appraisers or coordinate the receipt of estimates of damage according to client guidelines or approval
  • Determine if estimates or appraisals are appropriate based upon reported damages and other evidence
  • Gather evidence of damages
  • Interview or obtain recorded statements from the claimant, the Insured and any witnesses
  • Request payment authorization according to client guidelines and Davies Claims North America policy and procedures
  • Follow client guidelines for any claim denial
  • Obtain internal investigation reports from the insured (client) when permitted by the client
  • Professional and timely communication with the client
  • Determine degree of attorney involvement, if any
  • Always act with the utmost good faith in handling of the claim from beginning to closure
  • Set reminders within the claim system for necessary follow up in an appropriate time frame
  • Accurately record any communication, or activity relevant to the claim; in the claim system notes
  • Follow procedures to image documents sent to you that are relevant to the claim file (including e-mail)
  • Meet the requirements of Continuing Education as required for licensure as an adjuster
  • Maintain a 95% claim closure ratio
  • Report to the Excess carrier on any claim that meets the requirements to do so (including status reports)
  • Immediately notify your supervisor and the client of any Summons and Complaint received, identify assigned defense counsel, communicate and cooperate with defense counsel
  • Obtain status reports from defense counsel at 90-day intervals
  • Read and Understand the Excess Carrier Insurance Policy
  • Run ISO ClaimSearch on injured claimants
  • Determine the injury status of all persons involved in a crash investigation
  • Interact with insurance adjusters from other companies to obtain information needed to process your claim
  • Respond to Reservation of Rights letters from Excess Carrier if necessary
  • Develop working knowledge of No Fault/PIP law
  • Enter necessary information into the claim system to ensure mandatory reporting to Medicare
  • Follow Davies Claims North America guidelines when settling claims involving a Medicare recipient
  • Check for the claimant’s compliance with F.S. 768.28 Sovereign Immunity
  • Recommend/assign field adjuster as necessary
  • Review field adjuster reports for thoroughness and accuracy.

Skills, knowledge & expertise

  • College degree or equivalent experience
  • Possession of Adjuster license
  • Maintain CEU credits for Adjuster license
  • Excellent knowledge of Tort Law, bad faith procedures and case law, as well as principles of liability and medical terminology
  • Previous experience with settling bodily injury claims
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite
  • Proactive, independent, dependable, and takes initiative with consistent follow through
  • Superb written and verbal communication skills conducted in a timely manner with diverse audiences
  • Superior time management skills with capability of working with and meeting deadlines
  • Exceptional capability to multi-task and prioritize with excellent organization and documentation skills in a fast-paced work environment
  • High level attention to detail with ability to utilize decision making and problem-solving skills
  • Capable of working collaboratively and independently with minimal supervision
  • Exhibit discretion with sensitive and confidential information

Equal Employment Opportunity & Legal Notices

Benefits
At Davies North America, we are dedicated to supporting the well‑being and future of our qualifying employees. Our comprehensive benefits package includes:
  • Medical, dental, and vision plans to support your health and that of your family
  • A 401(k) plan with employer matching
  • Time‑off policies, including Discretionary Time Off (DTO) for exempt employees and Paid Time Off (PTO) for non‑exempt employees
  • Paid holidays
  • Life insurance and short‑term and long‑term disability coverage
Benefit offerings, eligibility, and required employer contributions may vary based on role, classification, and applicable federal, state, and local laws, including those tied to an employee’s primary work location.
Where required by law, the Company provides paid sick leave, paid family and parental leave, and other mandated benefits in accordance with applicable state and local requirements.
Diversity and Inclusion
Davies is dedicated to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace that embraces a wide range of perspectives and experiences. We believe that diversity of thought is essential for innovation and creativity, and we actively promote an environment where all voices are valued and heard.

Compensation Transparency:
The salary range listed reflects the full compensation band for this role across all locations. Actual compensation will be based on factors such as skills, experience, qualifications, and geographic location, which may impact the final offer. We share ranges to remain transparent and consistent with pay equity practices.

Essential Functions
The following responsibilities and expectations are considered essential to the successful performance of this role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.
  • Maintain regular and dependable attendance.
  • Be available and able to perform job responsibilities during established work hours.
Background Check & Fair Chance Compliance
Any background check or review of criminal history, if applicable to the role, will be conducted only after a conditional offer of employment and in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws, including fair‑chance hiring requirements.

jobs.title: Data Science & Engineering Fellow
jobs.excerpt: About the Organization:Healthy oceans need healthy data systems, and healthy information ecosystems need stewardship.
jobs.description:
About the Organization:Healthy oceans need healthy data systems, and healthy information ecosystems need stewardship. Intertidal Agency empowers ocean data stewards and helps build data infrastructure to drive ocean conservation, management, and innovation. We support the people layer of data sharing with a combination of policy, process, and technical tools. Our multi-disciplinary partners include governments, communities, scientists, nonprofits, and businesses who want to connect ocean data to action by making data more useful, usable, and used.
Position Summary:Intertidal Agency is seeking a data scientist or data engineer for a one-year fellowship to improve data pipelines into the World Ocean Database (WOD), the primary global source for ocean temperature, salinity, oxygen, and nutrient data. The overall project goal is to make WOD data more FAIR (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, and Reusable) by standardizing workflows for data ingestion across a global community of data contributors. A specific focus for the fellow will be developing algorithmic solutions for de-duplicating data submissions from uncrewed systems, such as gliders, and expanding those solutions to address other ocean and earth science problems. Addressing this problem will require contending with three intersecting issues:
  • Identification. How do you determine that two records describe the same observation? The obvious matching key for glider data is unreliable, and finding better ones is part of the work.
  • Survivorship. Once duplicates are identified, which copy survives, and on what basis? Later submissions are often better, but not always. The rule must be defensible and documented.
  • Granularity. A glider may report every second. WOD cannot absorb that resolution across a growing fleet, and binning decisions determine what future researchers can ask of the record. Setting a community standard for granularity takes both analysis and community agreement.
Developing and publishing rigorous, community-supported solutions to these issues will be a significant contribution to WOD and the broader earth science field.
This is a one-year, fixed-term position that is supported by a Climate Reserve fellowship, and the hire will also participate in Climate Reserve network activities.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Establish and help manage a project advisory committee ocean data professionals.
  • Work directly with the major glider data providers (e.g. IOOS, EGO, and IMOS) on upstream improvements to data submissions.
  • Develop, test, and document an algorithmic method for identifying duplicate observations from gliders and other autonomous platforms, and for selecting which record to retain. Benchmark against the publicly served California Underwater Glider Network Line 80 record, roughly 67,000 quality-controlled profiles spanning 2005 to the present, then work against NOAA NCEI’s glider holdings.
  • Convene and run working sessions, including hackathons, to collaboratively develop solutions. Participants would include people experienced with the data sources, research software engineers, data scientists, and WOD experts. Support workshop participants in implementing and iterating on workshop products within their own workflows.
  • Release all code, computational notebooks, and documentation publicly under open licenses, written so that other data centers can adopt the methods. Prepare a manuscript for a peer-reviewed journal with the fellow as lead author.
  • Work with project directors and the advisory committee to draft recommendations for the Intergovernmental Oceanographic Commission (IOC) to support the new standards and workflows. These would be drafted during the fellowship and presented at the fall 2028 IOC meeting.

The Ideal Candidate

You are drawn to challenges that span disciplines. You can take a messy, real-world data problem and find structure in it. You write code other people can run and read. You work well with people with a wide range of technical fluency, from research software engineers to program managers and scientists. You have experience modernizing legacy data systems. You develop clear roadmaps and roles with your teammates that let you work independently while staying coordinated. You see AI as a tool to support human expertise and judgement, not a replacement.
You do not need to be an oceanographer. If you bring strong quantitative and data science skills, the project leads and advisors will provide the ocean science grounding.

Specific Experience Requested:We recognize that each applicant for this role will bring unique skills, knowledge, experiences, and background to this position. We welcome diverse experiences and perspectives in our applicant pool, and will be looking for candidates who possess many, but not necessarily all, of the following qualifications and experience:
  • Quantitative and algorithmic capability. Multivariate statistics and dimensionality reduction, similarity and distance metrics, clustering or classification. Experience with record linkage, entity resolution, fuzzy matching, or deduplication in any domain, including outside Earth science (e.g. bibliographic records, customer data, other sensor networks).
  • Working knowledge of why pairwise comparison across millions of records is not viable, and familiarity with blocking, indexing, approximate nearest neighbor search, or locality-sensitive hashing as ways around it.
  • Python fluency, preferably with numpy, pandas, and scipy. Version control with git.
  • Comfortable in a Unix or Linux shell on a remote machine, with pipes, regular expressions, and standard text processing tools. You will need to open an unfamiliar file, inspect it, and write something to interrogate it, with nobody available to walk you through it.
  • Reading and writing netCDF, including CF conventions, standard names, fill values, and time units. The majority of the data under consideration will be in this format.   • Treat the protection of patient data as a first principle, building security and privacy into your designs from the start

jobs.description:
What we're building

We're empowering small teams with technology that makes it easier to market and grow businesses. Our current focus is to help consumer brands shift from "workflow automation" to "agent management" within their marketing operations. Shadow is the AI coordination layer — providing shared AI memory, centralized agent control, and model orchestration for marketing teams.

Why join Shadow?

  • Product Ownership You'll ship production code daily and help steer key product and technical decisions.

  • Shape the Engineering Culture You'll influence how we work—tools, processes, standards, and hiring.

  • Work with Challenger Consumer Brands Talk directly to customers (CEOs, CMOs, VP's) of fast-growing consumer brands—some doing $80M–$500M in revenue.

The agency behind the product

Shadow is built alongside Darkroom — a performance marketing agency that's been operating for 10 years, employs 100+ people, runs 100+ clients at a time, and has worked with over 1,000 consumer brands. The agency is both our proving ground and our first user, which means the data you build with is real marketing data at real volume from day one — not a synthetic demo.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone (9 AM–5 PM EST).

The role

You own the pipelines that bring the world's marketing data into Shadow — and keep them fast, accurate, and reliable as we scale to thousands of users. Every brand connects its full stack (ad platforms, ecommerce, analytics, email/SMS), and you make that data land cleanly, normalize into shared schemas, and stay in sync. The agent is only as good as the data underneath it; that layer is yours.

This is a hands-on, build-heavy engineering role for someone who has run large data systems before and wants to do it again in a smaller, faster environment.

What you'll own

  • Build and scale the ingestion layer across third-party marketing APIs (Meta, Google, TikTok, GA4, Shopify, Klaviyo, and more) — auth, extraction, rate-limit handling, backfill, and incremental sync.

  • Design normalization and transformation pipelines that map messy, platform-specific data into shared, queryable schemas (e.g. a unified creative/campaign/order model).

  • Own data reliability at scale — sync accuracy, freshness, coverage, and observability. Build the systems that detect when a connection breaks or a number looks wrong before a user does.

  • Engineer for multi-tenant scale and security: pipelines and storage that stay performant and cost-efficient across 1,000+ users and hundreds of connected brands — with strict data isolation, privacy, and compliance built in, not bolted on.

  • Partner with the AI and data-science teams to expose clean, well-modeled data the agent can retrieve and reason over.

Must haves

  • Experience building and operating large enterprise data pipelines engineered for scale — systems serving 1,000+ users (or equivalent data volume / tenancy), where reliability, isolation, and cost at scale were real constraints you solved.

  • Strong SQL and Python, with production experience in a modern data warehouse (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, or similar).

  • Deep familiarity with ETL/ELT patterns, incremental sync, schema design, and data modeling for analytics.

  • Built and maintained integrations against third-party APIs — OAuth flows, pagination, rate limits, schema drift, and the operational reality of connectors that break.

  • A bias toward observability and data quality: you instrument your pipelines and you don't ship data you can't trust.

  • Experience building or operating within SOC 2-compliant systems with enterprise-grade security and privacy — you've handled sensitive customer data under real compliance constraints (access controls, encryption, data isolation, auditability) and treat it as a first-class engineering requirement.

Nice to haves

  • Experience in martech, adtech, or an adjacent data-heavy marketing domain — you've worked with ad platform or ecommerce data before and know where the bodies are buried (attribution windows, currency/timezone messes, deduping across platforms).

  • Familiarity with our stack: GCP (BigQuery, Cloud Run), PostgreSQL + pgvector, and orchestration/transformation tooling (dbt, Airflow, Dagster, or similar).

  • Experience with pipeline observability and tracing in an AI/LLM context (e.g. Langfuse).

  • Comfort supporting data that feeds AI agents and retrieval systems, not just dashboards.

Culture fit

  • Obsessive about data organization at scale. We're hiring for someone who lives in the data layer and wants to own it end to end.

  • You’re a power AI user. You've embedded AI into every workflow you touch and you think in systems — not one-off prompts, but repeatable structures that compound.

  • Entrepreneurial. You don't need much direction to move fast, you pivot when the situation demands it, and what you ship is production-grade, not a prototype you hand off for someone else to finish.

What It's Like to Work at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.

  • Remote-First Culture: Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in-office time. Hub locations include Brazil and Spain.

  • Parental Leave: Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition.

  • Growth: Our interdisciplinary model gives every Darkroomer exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry.

Equal Opportunity Statement

We are an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

jobs.description:
About JumpSeat

JumpSeat is a hybrid creative agency + advisory organization working alongside B2B marketing and revenue teams to drive growth.

We're a remote-first crew across the US, Buenos Aires and Italy. We care about bold, specific work, and about the people who make it.

The role

We're looking for a Senior Art Director / Brand Designer to join our creative team.

You'll be part of Story, our brand and creative practice. It's where we help B2B companies find the story only they have the right to tell, then make it easier to sell and harder to ignore. That covers brand development, solution storytelling, and creative campaigns, all built from the market signals we uncover for our clients.

You'd sit somewhere between a classic Art Director and a brand designer. You'll get a strategic or conceptual brief, find the idea in it, build a visual world around that idea, and then see it all the way through to the finished piece. Think key visuals, campaign identities, and brand systems that still look great on every touchpoint.

You'll have a lot of autonomy here. We trust you to make good creative calls without someone looking over your shoulder. When feedback comes in, we want you to get what's really behind it, not just tick off the comments.

You'll also help us figure out how AI fits into the way we create. We're excited about new tools and use them to explore more and move faster. But the idea, the taste, and the final call? Those stay with people.

If you've got a strong portfolio across both branding and campaigns, we'd love to talk.

What you'll do

Find the idea.

  • Take strategy and messaging and turn them into visual concepts bold enough to stand out. Buyers ignore generic, and so do we.
  • Explore a few different creative directions, share them, and know which one is worth fighting for.
  • Bring real Art Direction thinking to every brief, not just great execution.

Build brands that scale.

  • Design full brand identities and visual systems that help clients own a position competitors can't claim, not just a logo here and a one-off piece there.
  • Lead brand refreshes that move things forward without losing what people already recognize.
  • Make sure every system has the depth and flexibility to work wherever it ends up.

Bring campaigns to life.

  • Create campaign concepts, key visuals, and campaign identities from a blank page, including ABM programs and thought leadership that give accounts already in motion a reason to engage.
  • Take one big idea and carry it across websites, decks, social, paid media, events, and whatever comes next.
  • Sweat the details: typography, layout, composition, color, and hierarchy.

Create with AI, lead with judgment.

  • Use AI to go wider when you're exploring, test ideas quickly, and speed up production.
  • Keep the concept in the driver's seat. The tools should serve the idea, not decide it.
  • Edit hard and refine by hand until it feels like the brand and meets our bar.
  • Share what's working with the team, because the tools keep changing and we learn faster together.

Who you are

  • You're a Senior Art Director or Brand Designer with 7+ years under your belt, ideally from a strong agency or studio.
  • You think in concepts first. You can tell us the idea behind a project before you show us a single frame.
  • You've created original key visuals and campaign identities, not just adapted someone else's.
  • You love building systems, and you've designed complete brand systems with real depth.
  • You're a little obsessed with craft: typography, layout, composition, color, and visual hierarchy.
  • You're independent and decisive. You can go from brief to direction without needing your hand held.
  • You're great with feedback. You use it to make the work better instead of applying every comment literally.
  • You're curious about new tech, AI included, and you have the eye to tell what's actually good.
  • You're fluent in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite.
  • You're comfortable working in English with a remote, multicultural team.

Nice to have

  • You've used AI image, video, or design tools in your own creative work.
  • You've worked at an agency or consultancy across different industries.
  • You've done integrated or multi-channel campaigns.
  • You've designed for websites and digital.
  • You have a feel for motion and animation.
  • You're a confident presenter who can stand behind the work.

What we'd love to see in your portfolio

We care more about how you think than how many projects you've done. So show us:

  • The idea behind each project.
  • How a key visual grew into a full campaign system.
  • The directions you explored, not just the one that won.
  • Brand systems with depth, and how they play out across formats.
  • Consistent, high craft.
  • Where you used AI, what you kept, and what you threw out. We love seeing process work.

How we'll get to know you

  1. A chat with our Talent team.
  2. A portfolio review, where you walk us through two or three projects from idea to execution.
  3. A practical case, where you show us how you'd tackle a real-world creative challenge.
  4. A conversation with some of our senior team.

What's in it for you

  • Real influence. You'll shape how our brands and campaigns look, and how we create them.
  • Great people. A team that will challenge you, inspire you, and have your back.
  • Remote first. Colleagues across the US, Buenos Aires, and Italy.
  • Balance, for real. Unlimited PTO, Summer Firdays, time off between holiday, and more.

Ready to take the seat?

No safe stories. If you want to own both the idea and the craft, we'd really like to hear from you.

jobs.description:
Senior Meta Media Buyer (High-Ticket B2B Funnels) | $250K+ OTE | Remote

Mission
Own and scale GNO's Meta ads from $50K+/month to $150K+/month, generating qualified calls that show up and close, within target cost per booked call and cost per acquisition.

About GNO Partners
GNO helps Amazon brands scale and grow profits. Our founders built and exited two 7-figure Amazon brands. Since then, we've worked with 1,300+ brands, with 500+ active clients doing over $1B in combined sales, all run on a proprietary system we've built over 9 years. Meta is one of our main growth channels and we're ready to put real budget behind it.

About the Role
This is not a maintenance role. We want a senior buyer who has been in the trenches. You've personally run the accounts, made the calls and owned the numbers yourself, not "led a team that did it." You've built and scaled application (Direct App) and VSL call funnels for agencies, coaches or B2B service businesses. You'll own strategy and execution and work directly with the founders.

The major focus of this role is the ads themselves: ad strategy, ideation, copywriting, and creative. You'll come up with the angles, write the hooks and scripts, and drive what gets produced and tested. Media buying is a core part of the job too, but winning creative is what will move the numbers here.

Today we mainly run a Direct App funnel: ad → application → booked call.

Compensation

  • Base: $120K-$150K (negotiable, based on experience)
  • Commissions: $100K-$130K, tied to performance
  • OTE: $250K+ (uncapped)
  • Fully remote

What success looks like (first 3-6 months)

  • Hit the weekly qualified call targets agreed with the founders without tanking lead quality or show rate.
  • A steady pipeline of new ad concepts every week, built on angles, hooks and iterations of winners.
  • Scale spend from $50K+ toward $150K+/month while staying at CPBC & CAC KPI.
  • Tracking you trust: Pixel + CAPI + CRM, with 90%+ of booked calls tied back to the ad.
  • A structured testing engine with multiple meaningful tests per week across hooks, creatives, audiences and offers.

Responsibilities

  • Own ad strategy and creative: come up with angles, write ad copy, hooks and video scripts, brief production, and turn winners into new iterations.
  • Plan, build and manage Meta campaigns for:
    • Application and book-a-call funnels
  • Set up and maintain tracking (Pixel, CAPI, custom conversions, UTMs, offline events), and fix issues fast.
  • Own weekly reporting: KPIs, insights and a clear action plan.
  • Analyze the full funnel (impression → click → opt-in → booked → show → close) and fix what's broken, beyond "change targeting."
  • Work with the founders, creative and sales on new angles, offers and creatives.
  • Document structures, naming conventions and SOPs.

Requirements

  • 3+ years running Meta ads for agencies, coaches or B2B service businesses.
  • Strong direct-response copywriting and creative strategy, with a portfolio of ads you wrote or ideated that scaled.
  • Personally managed $100K+/month on Meta for 12+ consecutive months.
  • Hands-on with call, application, or VSL funnels.
  • You think in pipeline metrics (show rate, close rate, CAC), not front-end CPL.
  • Solid tech: Events Manager, CAPI, custom conversions, UTMs, GA4/attribution (Hyros or similar is a plus), CRM (Pipedrive).
  • Excellent written English and clear, structured thinking.

Job Title: Clinical AI Sales Specialist - MRI

Job Location: Remote

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Job Description Summary

As part of the GE HealthCare MR organization, the USCAN MR Clinical AI Sales Specialist – icobrain will be responsible for driving growth and adoption of icobrain across the U.S. market.

This role combines new business development with strategic account engagement and close collaboration across the broader GE HealthCare MR commercial organization. The successful candidate will develop new opportunities while leveraging GE HealthCare's established customer relationships, MR installed base, and commercial teams to expand the adoption of icobrain within health systems, academic medical centers, imaging organizations, and neurology-focused practices.

The role will also partner closely with the Customer Success team to support existing customers, including renewals and the transition of legacy icometrix agreements to GE HealthCare contracts.

This is a primarily remote sales role, with most customer engagement, prospecting, presentations, demonstrations, and opportunity development conducted virtually through phone and Microsoft Teams. In-person engagement will also be an important part of the role at strategic customer meetings, conferences, and other industry events.

The ideal candidate will bring a strong commercial mindset, an interest in MR and clinical AI, and the ability to work effectively within a highly collaborative, matrixed organization.

Job Description

  • Drive icobrain growth: Develop and execute a regional sales strategy to achieve orders and revenue goals while expanding icobrain adoption across key accounts and market segments.
  • Develop new opportunities: Identify, qualify, and advance new icobrain opportunities through direct customer engagement, targeted prospecting, and collaboration with GE HealthCare MR sales teams.
  • Leverage the broader GE HealthCare organization: Partner closely with MR Account Managers, Imaging Account Executives, clinical teams, product specialists, and other commercial stakeholders to identify opportunities within existing GE HealthCare accounts and the MR installed base.
  • Excel in a virtual and in-person selling environment: Proactively engage customers and prospects through phone, Microsoft Teams, email, and other virtual channels. Effectively develop relationships, deliver presentations and demonstrations, and advance opportunities remotely, while also actively engaging customers and prospects at conferences, industry meetings, and other in-person events.
  • Engage clinical and executive stakeholders: Build relationships with radiologists, neuroradiologists, neurologists, imaging leaders, IT stakeholders, administrators, and other decision makers involved in the evaluation and adoption of clinical AI solutions.
  • Serve as an icobrain subject matter expert: Develop a strong understanding of icobrain's clinical applications, workflows, and customer value and effectively communicate that value to clinical, technical, and business audiences.
  • Lead customer presentations and demonstrations: Deliver compelling product presentations and demonstrations, both virtually and in person, tailored to customer needs, workflows, and clinical use cases.
  • Navigate complex health systems: Develop account strategies that recognize the clinical, technical, financial, contracting, and operational requirements involved in adopting enterprise clinical AI solutions.
  • Own new opportunities from identification through close: Coordinate the commercial process across internal and customer stakeholders, including opportunity development, demonstrations, proposals, contracting, and transition to implementation and Customer Success.
  • Support renewals and contract transitions: Work closely with the Customer Success team to support existing customer renewals and help transition legacy icometrix customers to GE HealthCare agreements. Serve as a commercial partner during these discussions, helping maintain continuity of the customer relationship, address commercial needs, and identify opportunities to expand adoption.
  • Build strategic customer partnerships: Identify opportunities to position icobrain as part of broader MR and enterprise imaging strategies, particularly within academic medical centers, strategic health systems, and customers investing in advanced MR capabilities.
  • Maintain strong pipeline and forecast discipline: Accurately manage opportunities, pipeline, customer activity, and forecasts using GE HealthCare's CRM and established commercial processes.
  • Bring the voice of the customer back to the organization: Share market insights, competitive intelligence, customer feedback, and emerging clinical needs with Product, Marketing, Customer Success, and MR leadership to help inform future commercial and product strategies.

Required Qualifications:

    • 3+ years of sales or commercial experience in healthcare, medical technology, diagnostic imaging, healthcare IT, clinical software, or a related field.
    • Demonstrated ability to develop new business and successfully manage complex sales opportunities from identification through close.
    • Experience navigating hospitals, health systems, academic medical centers, or other complex healthcare organizations.
    • Demonstrated ability to build customer relationships and successfully advance sales opportunities in a primarily virtual selling environment.
    • Ability to work effectively in a primarily remote sales model, with travel as needed for strategic customer meetings, conferences, industry events, and other high-value commercial activities.

Preferred:

    • Ability to work effectively in a matrixed commercial environment, collaborating with account teams, specialists, Customer Success, and other functions while maintaining ownership and accountability for assigned business objectives.
    • Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to translate clinical and technical concepts into clear customer value.
    • Strategic account planning skills and the ability to engage stakeholders at multiple levels within an organization.
    • Ability to balance new business development with support of an established customer base, including renewals, contracting discussions, and expansion opportunities.
    • Strong organizational skills with demonstrated pipeline, forecasting, and CRM discipline.
    • Experience with diagnostic imaging, MRI, neurology, neuroradiology, clinical AI, or healthcare software is strongly preferred.
    • Ability to represent icobrain and the GE HealthCare MR organization effectively at customer meetings, conferences, industry events, and other in-person commercial activities.
    • Most importantly, a genuine interest in advancing MR and neurological care through the meaningful application of clinical AI.

We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening. For U.S. based positions only, the pay range for this position is $76,800.00-$115,200.00 Annual. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the pay range and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. The specific compensation offered to a candidate may be influenced by a variety of factors including skills, qualifications, experience and location. In addition, this position may also be eligible to earn performance based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es) and/or long term incentives (LTI). GE HealthCare offers a competitive benefits package, including not but limited to medical, dental, vision, paid time off, a 401(k) plan with employee and company contribution opportunities, life, disability, and accident insurance, and tuition reimbursement.

GE HealthCare offers a great work environment, professional development, challenging careers, and competitive compensation. GE HealthCare is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

GE HealthCare will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States for this opening. Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen (as applicable).

While GE HealthCare does not currently require U.S. employees to be vaccinated against COVID-19, some GE HealthCare customers have vaccination mandates that may apply to certain GE HealthCare employees.

Título da Vaga: Gravador(a) de Vídeos em Casa

Tipo de Contratação: Prestador(a) de Serviços

Localização: Remoto – profissionais baseados na América Latina e no Caribe. Países elegíveis incluem:

Argentina, Bahamas, Barbados, Brasil, Chile, Colômbia, Costa Rica, República Dominicana, Jamaica, México, Panamá e Uruguai.

Resumo da Vaga:

Nesta função, você utilizará sua experiência para ajudar no treinamento de sistemas de IA de última geração. Seu trabalho contribuirá diretamente para a forma como esses modelos aprendem, raciocinam e executam tarefas por meio de dados reais e de alta qualidade. Não é necessário ter experiência prévia com Inteligência Artificial — o mais importante é sua capacidade de seguir instruções e produzir dados de qualidade.

Principais Responsabilidades

  1. Capturar dados precisos de movimento utilizando os sensores IMU do seu smartphone durante atividades físicas especificadas.
  2. Gravar vídeos sincronizados para garantir a precisão dos dados e a integridade de todas as informações de movimento coletadas.
  3. Seguir protocolos técnicos detalhados para atender consistentemente aos padrões de qualidade, rotulagem e padronização do projeto.
  4. Entregar no mínimo 10 horas semanais de vídeos aprovados e de alta qualidade durante todo o período do projeto.
  5. Comunicar-se de forma clara e proativa com a equipe para esclarecer dúvidas e compartilhar observações sobre o processo de coleta de dados.
  6. Garantir entregas pontuais e consistentes, em conformidade com os marcos e expectativas do projeto.
  7. Participar da verificação de compatibilidade do dispositivo e de um processo de entrevista inovador com suporte de IA durante o onboarding.

Requisitos

  1. Ter acesso a uma faixa para fixação do celular na cabeça (head strap), capaz de registrar ambas as mãos, em até 48 horas após a data de início.
  2. Possuir um smartphone compatível. Dispositivos suportados incluem:
  3. iPhone 12 ou superior;
  4. Google Pixel 6 ou superior;
  5. Samsung Galaxy S21 ou superior.
  6. Excelente atenção aos detalhes e capacidade comprovada de seguir protocolos padronizados.
  7. Capacidade de gerenciar entregas de forma consistente e cumprir prazos em um ambiente dinâmico e orientado por dados.
  8. Excelentes habilidades de comunicação escrita e verbal para documentação e colaboração remota.
  9. Facilidade com tecnologia e experiência no uso de dispositivos móveis para captura de vídeo e dados de sensores.
  10. Condições físicas para realizar tarefas repetitivas de movimento com segurança e eficiência.
  11. Acesso a um smartphone compatível capaz de realizar coleta de dados com alta fidelidade.

Observação: Candidaturas enviadas utilizando um endereço de e-mail Gmail serão consideradas um diferencial, pois facilitam a integração com as ferramentas do projeto.

Qualificações Desejáveis

  1. Formação ou experiência em robótica, cinesiologia, coleta de dados por sensores ou áreas técnicas relacionadas.
  2. Experiência com análise de movimento humano, segmentação de atividades ou rotulagem de conjuntos de dados para aprendizado de máquina.
  3. Familiaridade com organização e estruturação de grandes conjuntos de dados para aplicações de IA e robótica.

Estrutura de Remuneração

  1. A remuneração é baseada na produção. Os profissionais são pagos por cada vídeo gravado que atenda às especificações do projeto. O tempo necessário para concluir as atividades pode variar de acordo com a experiência e o fluxo de trabalho de cada participante.

Há requisitos mínimos de entrega: os vídeos devem possuir a duração especificada pelo projeto, e cada profissional deverá enviar entre 10 e 15 horas de vídeo por semana.

Início das Atividades e Disponibilidade

  1. Normalmente concluímos o processo de seleção em até 48 horas, portanto buscamos profissionais disponíveis para iniciar rapidamente. Caso seja selecionado(a), esperamos que você comece sua primeira tarefa assim que avançar no processo de candidatura.
  2. A expectativa é que o início das atividades ocorra aproximadamente 24 horas após a conclusão do onboarding.

Requisitos de Equipamentos

Smartphone

  1. Todas as tarefas deste projeto deverão ser realizadas utilizando um smartphone.
  2. Os participantes gravarão seu fluxo de trabalho diretamente pelo dispositivo móvel enquanto executam as atividades.

Faixa para Cabeça (Head Strap)

  1. As tarefas exigem o uso de uma câmera posicionada na cabeça por meio de uma faixa (head strap).
  2. Os participantes gravarão vídeos em primeira pessoa enquanto realizam as atividades físicas.
  3. As especificações da faixa necessária e de quaisquer equipamentos adicionais serão compartilhadas durante o processo de onboarding.

AVISO IMPORTANTE:

Os candidatos que atenderem aos requisitos de localização e equipamento do projeto serão contatados em breve para realizar um processo de verificação de identidade. Os candidatos selecionados deverão poder concluir esta verificação de identidade dentro de 48 horas após serem contatados. A verificação de identidade é necessária antes que o contrato possa ser enviado para assinatura.

JOB SUMMARY:

Choice Hotels, one of the world’s largest lodging franchisors, is seeking an Extended Stay Revenue Manager for our Choice Revenue Optimization Consultation Services (ChoiceROCS) team, supporting Extended Stay hotels. As part of ChoiceROCS, you will partner with franchisees to implement length-of-stay-driven revenue optimization strategies that drive hotel performance. In this role, you will lead revenue strategy meetings with key hotel stakeholders, providing expert guidance on extended stay pricing, inventory, and rate strategy to maximize revenue and ensure success within the ROCS program.


Note: This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship now or in the future.


RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead Revenue Strategy Calls with hotel teams, reviewing length-of-stay (LOS) mix, weekly and monthly rate performance, and stay-length pricing strategy
  • Generate and distribute relevant Revenue Management reports
  • Align with Choice Commercial Teams and partner with hotels to create and implement extended stay strategies, including focus on LOS-based rate strategy and managing long-stay demand to drive results
  • Proactively communicate with properties regarding performance of Revenue Management Strategies, including how LOS restrictions and rate changes affect occupancy and RevPAR.
  • Monitor competitive extended stay rate positioning against brand and independent competitors, and recommend adjustments that protect rate integrity and market share
  • Provide portfolio performance updates to Senior Management

QUALIFICATIONS:

Employment Experience

  • Minimum 1-3 years of experience in revenue management or consulting with a focus on financial analysis or revenue analytics; extended stay or long-stay lodging experience strongly preferred.

jobs.title: Merchant Support Specialist
jobs.excerpt: Szia!  Mi vagyunk a Teya.  A Teyát az az egyszerű meggyőződés hívta életre, hogy a helyi vállalkozások jobbat érdemelnek.
jobs.description:
Szia! Mi vagyunk a Teya.

A Teyát az az egyszerű meggyőződés hívta életre, hogy a helyi vállalkozások jobbat érdemelnek.

Azok a kávézók, éttermek, szalonok, üzletek és vállalkozások, amelyek karaktert adnak az utcáinknak, munkahelyeket teremtenek, és mozgásban tartják a közösségeinket. A pénzügyi szolgáltatások terén viszont régóta nehézségekkel találkoznak. A körülményes eszközbeszerzés, a nehezen elérhető ügyfélszolgálat és a bonyolult folyamatok rengeteg időt, energiát és pénzt vesznek el tőlük ahelyett, hogy a saját vállalkozásukra és ügyfeleikre figyelhetnének.

A Teya azért létezik, hogy ezen változtasson.

Olyan, egész Európa-szintű pénzügyi platformot építünk a helyi vállalkozásoknak, ahol az egyszerű eszközök, az átgondolt dizájn és a valódi emberi segítség áll a középpontban. Partnereink biztos támaszként számíthatnak ránk a cégük menedzselésében, ez a felelősség pedig a mindennapi munkánk alapja.

A dinamikus fejlődésben hiszünk, nem engedünk a minőségből, és a legkisebb részlet felett sem siklunk át. Hisszük, hogy a kimagasló teljesítmény és a valódi vendégszeretet kéz a kézben jár.

Ha szeretnél értékteremtő termékeket fejleszteni, valódi problémákra megoldást találni, és megbízható partnere lenni a helyi vállalkozásoknak, nagyon várjuk a jelentkezésedet!

A csapatod

A Teya magyarországi Customer Management csapatának tagja leszel. Ez a csapat felel azért, hogy kereskedőink a lehető legmagasabb színvonalú támogatást kapják, a működésük gördülékeny legyen, és hosszú távon elégedettek maradjanak. Ebben a pozícióban közvetlenül hozzájárulsz majd ahhoz, hogy a kereskedők hogyan élik meg a mindennapjaikat a Teyával.

A küldetésed

A Merchant Support Specialist szerepe, hogy a kereskedők számára a lehető legmagasabb színvonalú támogatást biztosítsa. A feladat három fő pillérre épül:

  • Kereskedői kapcsolatok kezelése

Minden, amit a Teyánál teszünk, egy célt szolgál: értéket teremteni a kereskedőinknek. Ebben a pozícióban te vagy az, aki közvetlen kapcsolatban áll a kereskedőkkel, első kézből tapasztalhatod a problémáikat, és gyorsan, hatékonyan találhatsz rájuk megoldásokat.

  • Személyes ügyfélkommunikáció

Amikor a kereskedők problémákkal szembesülnek, a Merchant Support Specialist biztosítja a megfelelő megoldást. Ehhez elengedhetetlen a Teya termék- és szolgáltatásportfóliójának alapos ismerete, valamint a technológiai affinitás, hogy hatékonyan kezeld a beérkező kéréseket a rendszereinken keresztül.

  • Helyszíni támogatás

Szeretnénk a kereskedők számára személyre szabott támogatást nyújtani, ami magában foglalja, hogy a Merchant Support Specialist ellátogat az üzleteikbe, és közvetlenül segít a felmerülő problémák kezelésében (például telepítés, helyszíni technikai támogatás).

A történeted

  • Szorgalmas vagy, kiemelkedő kommunikációs készségekkel rendelkezel, és aktívan törekszel a folyamatok fejlesztésére

  • Képes vagy meghallgatni és megérteni a kereskedők kihívásait, és gyorsan, hatékonyan megoldást találni rájuk

  • Rugalmas vagy, gyorsan tanulsz, nem félsz teljes felelősséget vállalni a feladataidért, és hajlandó vagy utazni

  • Korábbi szakmai tapasztalat nem szükséges – ha folyamatosan szeretnél fejlődni és tanulni, várjuk a jelentkezésedet!

  • Folyékonyan beszélsz magyarul és angolul

  • Rendelkezel Magyarországon munkavállalási joggal és B kategóriás jogosítvánnyal

Amit kínálunk:

  • Versenyképes fizetés

  • SZÉP kártya

  • AYCM SportPass, amely országszerte több száz sportlétesítményhez biztosít hozzáférést

  • Magánegészségügyi biztosítás

  • Évi három extra szabadnap

  • 5 terápiás vagy coaching alkalom évente

  • Ingyenes havi tömegközlekedési bérlet vagy parkolóhely az irodánál

  • Friss gyümölcsök és irodai snackek minden nap

  • Barátságos, kényelmes és informális irodai környezet Buda szívében

  • Csapatépítő rendezvények és tevékenységek az irodában és azon kívül

  • Lehetőség egy nemzetközi környezetben dolgozni, a világ különböző pontjain élő kollégákkal együttműködve

A Teya elkötelezett az egyenlő esélyek biztosítása mellett.

Elkötelezettek vagyunk egy befogadó munkahelyi környezet kialakítása mellett, ahol mindenki, függetlenül származásától, nemi identitásától, szexuális irányultságától, életkorától, akadályoztatottságától, vallásától vagy hátterétől, kibontakozhat és a legjobbat hozhatja ki magából. Hisszük, hogy a sokszínű csapat kreatívabb ötletekhez, jobb eredményekhez és egy támogatóbb munkahelyhez vezet mindenki számára.

Ha a jelentkezési folyamat bármely szakaszában szükséged lenne bármilyen jellegű támogatásra vagy segítségre, kérjük, hogy jelezd felénk. Elkötelezettek vagyunk amellett, hogy a jelentkezési folyamat mindenki számára elérhető legyen.

jobs.excerpt: Peraton Overview Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy.
jobs.description:
Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Responsibilities

Peraton is seeking a Operations Manager .This position is the BASIS Operations Manager role and is a senior leadership role within Peraton BASIS program responsible for the overall direction, cohesion, and performance of multiple operational workstreams. Reporting directly to the Program Manager, this individual provides strategic and operational leadership across areas such as, but not limited to Data Quality, Quality Assurance, Electronic Health Records Modernization (EHRM), Duplicate Identity Resolution Program (DIRP), Defense Health Agency (DHA) Initiatives, and Development, Modernization & Enhancement (DME).

The Operations Manager is accountable for the overall health and performance of all operational areas, ensuring alignment and delivery for the BASIS Performance Work Statement (PWS) and Quality Assurance Surveillance Plan (QASP) requirements. A core responsibility of this position is the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of processes and procedures that drive team efficiency, standardize operations, and ensure the program consistently meets contractual performance thresholds.

The Operations Manager is responsible for developing and delivering clear, concise, and data-driven briefings to senior program leadership and Government customers, including Defense Manpower Data Center (DMDC) leadership, and other key Government stakeholders. This includes preparing and presenting operational status updates, performance metric summaries, risk and issue assessments, and process improvement initiatives in formal and informal settings such as Monthly Status Reviews, In-Progress Reviews, and ad hoc Government-requested meetings. The Operations Manager ensures that all briefing materials accurately reflect the state of program operations, are tailored to the appropriate audience, and convey actionable insights that support informed Government decision-making. This individual proactively engages with Government customers to understand evolving priorities, communicate program performance against Performance Work Statement requirements, and build the trust and transparency necessary for a successful long-term partnership.

This position is remote

Below are some of the Operational Areas of Responsibility but not all inclusive.

Data Quality

  • Provide overarching leadership and accountability for all Data Quality operations, including Personal Data Repository (PDR) and TRICARE data programs
  • Partner with the Data Quality Manager to ensure data sweeps, error correction targets, and reporting commitments are met
  • Drive development of standard operating procedures (SOPs) that improve data quality workflows and reduce error recurrence
  • Ensure the program meets weekly error metric reporting and periodic Data Quality Analysis Report deliverables

Quality Assurance

  • Provide senior-level oversight and accountability for the program's Quality Control Plan (QCP) and Quality Assurance program
  • Partner with the Quality Assurance Lead to ensure testing standards, automated code coverage requirements (minimum 90%), and Test Driven Development (TDD) practices are consistently upheld across all development activities
  • Champion the development of quality-focused processes that integrate seamlessly
  • Ensure Quality Status Reports (QSRs) accurately reflect program performance and are submitted with each Monthly Status Report (MSR) on time

Electronic Health Records Modernization (EHRM)

  • Provide leadership accountability for the EHRM Operations and Maintenance (O&M) workstream
  • Partner with the EHRM Project Manager to ensure Information Systems Testing (IST) liaison commitments, defect tracking, and environment maintenance activities are executed effectively
  • Support the development of streamlined processes for EHRM defect management and stakeholder communication

Duplicate Identity Resolution Program (DIRP)

  • Provide senior-level accountability for the Duplicate Identity Resolution Program, ensuring the program meets work products and minimum monthly performance thresholds for merges, unmerges, and overlay corrections
  • Partner with the Duplicate Identity Resolution Project manager to identify process improvements that increase throughput and reduce manual processing time
  • Ensure all work products are delivered on time; trend analysis, algorithm review, and annual identity correlation reporting commitments are met

Defense Health Agency (DHA) Initiatives

  • Provide overall leadership accountability for all Defense Health Agency-directed enhancements and initiatives under the program
  • Partner with the Defense Health Agency Initiatives Manager to ensure milestone adherence, stakeholder coordination, and deliverable quality
  • Support the development of repeatable processes for onboarding, tracking, and delivering Defense Health Agency initiative requirements

Development, Modernization & Enhancement (DME)

  • Provide accountability for the successful planning and execution of all Development, Modernization & Enhancement
  • Partner with the Development, Modernization & Enhancement Project Managers to monitor milestone adherence, manage dependencies, and escalate risks to the Program Manager
  • Drive the development of standardized processes for requirements intake, delivery tracking, and change management across modernization efforts

General Responsibilities

  • Develop, implement, and continuously refine program-wide processes and procedures to improve operational efficiency, reduce rework, and ensure all teams consistently meet Performance Work Statement requirements
  • Establish and maintain a cross-functional operating rhythm to surface risks, resolve dependencies, and ensure alignment across all operational areas
  • Contribute to Monthly Status Reports (MSRs), Weekly and Annual In-Progress Reviews (IPRs), and the Risk Management Plan
  • Identify operational gaps and lead root cause analysis efforts; develop corrective action plans as needed
  • Ensure all personnel across operational areas meet security, Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) / Personally Identifiable Information (PII) handling, and mandatory annual training requirements
  • Support transition-in and transition-out planning activities as required by the Government

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • 10 years of progressive experience in program or operations management, with at least 3–5 years in a senior leadership role overseeing multiple concurrent workstreams
  • Ability to obtain a DoD Secret clearance
  • Must be a US Citizen
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex, multi-disciplinary teams within a Department of Defense (DoD) or Federal Government contracting environment
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional operations and drive accountability across diverse teams without direct line authority over all personnel
  • Experience developing, implementing, and improving processes and standard operating procedures (SOPs) at the program or enterprise level
  • Strong track record of delivering data-driven briefings and status reports to senior Government customers and executive leadership
  • Demonstrated experience managing contractual performance requirements, including Performance Work Statements (PWS) and Quality Assurance Surveillance Plans (QASP)
  • Experience with risk management, root cause analysis, and corrective action planning
  • Familiarity with data quality operations, including error tracking, metric reporting, and data governance principles
  • Experience supporting or overseeing quality assurance programs, including test standards, automated testing coverage, and software development lifecycle (SDLC) practices
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and collaboration tools such as Microsoft Teams and SharePoint
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to tailor messaging to both technical and non-technical audiences

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree in a related field
  • Experience supporting Defense Health Agency (DHA), Defense Manpower Data Center (DMDC), Military Health System (MHS), or other DoD health IT programs
  • Familiarity with Electronic Health Records Modernization (EHRM) programs, initiatives, or environments
  • Experience with identity resolution programs, duplicate record management, or similar data integrity operations
  • Knowledge of Development, Modernization & Enhancement (DME) project execution within a Government contracting framework
  • Familiarity with TRICARE data systems, the Personal Data Repository (PDR), or related military health data programs
  • Experience contributing to or managing Monthly Status Reports (MSRs), In-Progress Reviews (IPRs), and other formal Government reporting deliverables
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent
  • Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or higher, or equivalent process improvement certification
  • Experience with Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) and Personally Identifiable Information (PII) compliance requirements in a DoD environment
  • Familiarity with Test Driven Development (TDD) practices and automated code coverage standards in an Agile or DevSecOps environment

Target Salary Range

$104,000 - $166,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

Benefits Statement

Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at

Application Statements

The application period for the job is estimated to be 30 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate’s own.

Innodata (Nasdaq: INOD) is a global data engineering company. We believe that data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) are inextricably linked. At Innodata, we’re partnering with the world’s leading technology companies to build the future of generative AI and large language models (LLMs). We’re on the lookout for smart, savvy, and curious Generative AI Specialist to join our global contributor community as part of our Subject Matter Expert (SME) on Demand program.

This is not a traditional full-time role. It’s a part-time, remote, flexible, project-specific opportunity designed for those who want to make a real impact—on their schedule. Whether you're a writer, linguist, educator, researcher, or just deeply passionate about language and logic, this role lets you contribute to cutting-edge AI development while maintaining control over your time.

You’ll be helping LLMs learn the intricacies of language and reasoning—not just how to write, but how to think. If you’ve ever dreamed of shaping the intelligence behind tomorrow’s technology, this is your chance.

This is more than just a gig—it’s a rare chance to help shape the future of AI from anywhere in the world, on your own terms.

What You’ll Own:

  • Rating/assessing the performance of AI models or algorithms based on their output or behavior through a set of evaluative questions.
  • Labeling elements of a piece of content rather than the content as a whole.
  • Assigning predefined categories or labels to items.
  • Evaluating the perceived quality and/or appropriateness of content
  • Generating labels to advance understanding of a concept, trend etc.
  • Creation of additional training data for machine learning models by applying transformations to the original data, such as modifying images (rotation, flipping, cropping), generating new text (paraphrasing, summarization), or altering audio/video signals (speed modification, pitch shifting) to reduce overfitting and increase dataset diversity.
  • Reviewing data and identifying whether or not a product feature works as intended based on the project's guidelines.
  • Labeling model outputs to identify if a piece of content is or isn't something. Examples: identify clickbait; identifying gaming videos; identifying branded content.
  • Ordering or ranking items based on a set of preferences or criteria.
  • Creating prompts or questions that will be used to generate responses from a language model or other AI system.
  • Projects that evaluate the relevance of content based on a relevancy scale (1-3, 1-5, etc.).
  • Generating responses to prompts or questions using a language model or other AI system.
  • Rewriting existing text while preserving the original meaning, often to improve clarity or style and adherence to guidelines.
  • Producing concise summaries of longer pieces of text or data.
  • Converting spoken language or audio content into written text.
  • Converting text or spoken language from one language to another.
  • Gathering and compiling various forms of data to be used for training, evaluating, or fine-tuning the AI models. This may include text, images, videos, audio files, or other types of digital content.

You’ll Thrive in This Role If You Have:

  • A Bachelor’s degree or higher in a humanities specialization is required. Advanced degrees are strongly preferred (Master’s or PhD)

jobs.excerpt: About Clarity Pediatrics Clarity Pediatrics is reimagining pediatric chronic care, starting with ADHD.
jobs.description:
About Clarity Pediatrics

Clarity Pediatrics is reimagining pediatric chronic care, starting with ADHD. After successfully launching our virtual clinic for ADHD and anxiety, we are expanding our pediatric care platform to address other common chronic conditions and are focused right now on Obesity and Overweight management. Our clinical model is tech-enabled, backed by the best science, and designed to deliver exceptional health outcomes that transform a child's trajectory.

Our co-founders and leadership team have deep commitment to clinical excellence and domain expertise in healthcare. Our CEO, Christina LaMontagne, has led two startups and earned her MBA at Harvard Business School. Our Chief Medical Officer,Alesandro Larrazabal, MD, trained at UCSF and Stanford. Until recently, he was a Medical Director building specialty care services at Kaiser Permanente. Earlier, he worked at IDEO.

We're backed by top VCs who have supported category-defining health-tech companies like One Medical, Hims, Spring Health, Cityblock, Honor, and Tia.

The Role

For a lot of families, food is where the hardest moments of the day happen. ADHD medications can blunt appetite, picky eating can turn dinner into a standoff, and weight conversations can leave kids feeling judged. As our Registered Dietitian, you'll help families turn those moments into progress, with care that is practical, evidence-based, and free of stigma.

You'll join a true multidisciplinary team. Our physicians, nurse practitioners, and behavioral health clinicians treat together, so your nutrition plan isn't a referral that disappears into a chart. It's part of one coordinated plan for the whole child.

This is also a chance to build. You'll help design the evidence-based programming and protocols behind our nutrition care, from 1:1 visits to virtual group programs for kids and caregivers. If you've ever wanted to design the program instead of just running it, this is that role, on a part-time schedule you set.

What You'll Do

Care for kids and families (Practice Devotion to our Families)

  • Conduct 1:1 virtual nutrition visits for children and caregivers as part of our integrated care model.

  • Lead engaging virtual group sessions that give kids and caregivers practical tools they can use at the next meal.

  • Meet families where they are, with culturally responsive, non-stigmatizing language and plans that fit real budgets, schedules, and food traditions.

Deliver safe, high-quality care (Patient Safety Always Comes First)

  • Assess growth, intake, and medication effects such as appetite suppression, and flag concerns to the care team quickly.

  • Monitor progress, adjust recommendations, and document every interaction accurately and on time.

Work as one team (Earn Trust From Everyone)

  • Partner closely with our physicians, nurse practitioners, and behavioral health clinicians on shared, whole-child care plans.

  • Be a trusted voice for families and colleagues: clear, warm, and consistent.

Build what's next (Observe, Improve and Innovate)

  • Help design evidence-based nutrition programming and group curricula, drawing on pediatric nutrition research, family-based behavioral treatment, and motivational interviewing.

  • Share what you learn from families so we can keep improving the model, and help us measure what's working.

Who You Are (Play to Win)

  • A credentialed RD. You hold an active RD or RDN credential through the Commission on Dietetic Registration (CDR).

  • Experienced with kids and families. You have 3+ years of clinical or community nutrition experience, ideally in pediatric or family-focused settings.

  • Skilled in weight and metabolic health. You've supported patients with obesity, overweight, or metabolic conditions, and you know how to talk about weight in ways that build trust instead of shame.

  • A confident group facilitator. You can keep a virtual room of kids or caregivers engaged, and you enjoy it.

  • Comfortable with virtual care. You use EMRs and telehealth platforms with ease and document efficiently.

  • Culturally responsive. You've worked with families from diverse backgrounds and tailor your recommendations to their culture, resources, and goals.

  • A builder at heart. You're energized by a fast-growing startup and happy to iterate on new care models.

  • Ready to serve our Medicaid families. You're enrolled in California or Texas Medicaid, or willing to enroll.

Bonus points

  • State dietitian licensure, or openness to obtaining licenses with support from Clarity Pediatrics Medical Group.

  • Spanish fluency.

Compensation, Schedule and Benefits

The pay range for this role is 40–50 per hour, depending on experience. You're paid for all time worked, including visits, group sessions, prep, and documentation.

This is a part-time, hourly W-2 role, fully remote. You choose your hours within our operating window of Monday through Friday, 2pm–8pm PT. This role is eligible for sick leave and 401k participation.

Our Commitment to Inclusion

At Clarity, we believe every family deserves care that sees and understands them, and that starts with the team we build. Our patients and their families come from every background, community, and walk of life, and we're at our best when our team reflects that diversity. As a female-led company, we know firsthand that different perspectives lead to better decisions, better technology, and better care for kids.

We're building a workplace where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong, and where trust is earned and extended to all. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, including those whose experience doesn't match every line of this description. If this role excites you, we'd love to hear from you.

Clarity Pediatrics is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law. We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Part Time Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:

  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

  • Conduct virtual visits as needed

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:

As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD

“The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD

  • Malpractice insurance coverage (during Signify Health-related activities)

Job Title: In-Home Health - Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant (Part Time) - La

Job Location: Work at Home, Wisconsin, United States

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Part time

Job Seniority Level:

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Part Time Clinician (Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant) to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:

  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

  • Conduct virtual visits as needed

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“I love seeing health plan members at home. You get a better picture of their health when you see where they live.” - Erica R., PA

“At Signify Health, we have the time to help people and to truly listen to their questions and concerns. We can help guide them so they can take better care of themselves. We really can make a change in communities.” - Ali B., NP

“I like how Signify Health manages my experience. I’m just doing the clinician part of my job without all the administrative responsibilities. I have the time to provide education so people have a better understanding of their health. I can answer their questions without rushing out the door.” - Andrew K., PA

Part-time employees qualify for:

  • Select benefits (see benefits guide for details)

  • Malpractice insurance coverage (during Signify Health-related activities)

  • Supplies and other perks

Required & Preferred Qualifications (NPs and PAs)

  • Active, unrestricted license(s) in coverage area(s)

  • Board certification (required)

  • Multi-state licenses (preferred)

Anticipated Weekly Hours

29.5

Time Type

Part time

Pay Range

The typical pay range for this role is:

$41.85 - $90.13

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors.

Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong.

Great benefits for great people

We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families.

This part‑time position is eligible for a range of benefits and programs that support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues. Depending on hours worked and eligibility, the benefits for this position include dental, vision, wellness resources, employee discounts, access to certain voluntary benefits, and other programs.

Additional details about available benefits are provided during the application process and on Benefits Moments.
