jobs.title: Office Coordinator (Part-time)
jobs.excerpt: The company Small businesses move fast.  Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight.
jobs.description:
The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

We're looking for an Office Coordinator.

You'll run the day-to-day of our Leeds office, making it a well-run, safe and welcoming place for the 100+ iwocans who work from there.

The team

The office team looks after iwoca's four offices in London, Leeds, Berlin and Frankfurt, and the events that keep iwocans connected across them. The team is led by the Office & Community Manager, who is based in London.

The Leeds office is home to most of iwoca's collections, customer success and account management teams, plus smaller groups from across the business. It's busiest midweek, when most teams come in together.

The role

As Office Coordinator, you'll report to the Office & Community Manager. You'll be the person who keeps the Leeds office running, and the first person iwocans in Leeds come to when something needs sorting.

  • Ownership. You'll run the office day to day: the weekly food and drinks order, deliveries, post and supplies, and the office Soldo card, reconciled each month. You'll walk the office each week and fix small issues yourself.

  • Variety. You'll welcome visitors and candidates, sort out meeting room clashes, and book and oversee cleaners, tradespeople and suppliers, from the coffee machines and Billi taps to the plants.

  • Responsibility. You'll keep the office safe. You'll be one of the office's fire marshals and first aiders, carry out facilities maintenance checks, and keep the first aid kits stocked.

  • Community. You'll help iwocans in Leeds feel part of iwoca and enjoy being here. You'll run the weekly office tour for new joiners, help teams to celebrate key moments like work anniversaries and organise community events.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Office operations. You have at least a year's experience running the day-to-day of an office or front of house, including ordering, deliveries and visitors.

  • Suppliers and contractors. You have worked with building management, contractors and facilities suppliers, and held them to what they agreed to deliver.

  • Fixing things without being asked. You have been the person who spots what isn't working in an office and sorts it. You can talk us through examples.

  • The physical side. You're comfortable unpacking deliveries, setting up for events and moving supplies of up to 15–20kg.

Bonus:

  • First aid and fire safety. You hold first aid or fire marshal certificates. If not, we'll train you when you join.

  • Expenses. You have managed company expenses on Soldo or a similar platform.

  • Facilities qualification. You have an IWFM qualification or equivalent.

  • AI Literacy. Experience using generative AI tools to drive efficiency in administrative tasks, paired with the judgment to audit and fact-check all AI-generated content.

The salary

We expect to pay from £26,500 to £30,000 (pro rata for 20 hours a week) for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A choice between a dedicated dental plan or a health cash plan that reimburses everyday medical expenses.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

Useful links:

  • iwoca benefits & policies

  • Interview welcome pack

Compensation Range: £26.5K - £30K

jobs.excerpt: About Huawei Research and Development UK Limited Founded in 1987, Huawei is a leading global provider of information and communications technology (ICT) infrastructure and smart devices.
jobs.description:
About Huawei Research and Development UK Limited

Founded in 1987, Huawei is a leading global provider of information and communications technology (ICT) infrastructure and smart devices. We have 207,000 employees and operate in over 170 countries and regions, serving more than three billion people around the world.

Our vision and mission is to bring digital to every person, home and organization for a fully connected, intelligent world. To this end, we will drive ubiquitous connectivity and promote equal access to networks; bring cloud and artificial intelligence to all four corners of the earth to provide superior computing power where you need it, when you need it; build digital platforms to help all industries and organizations become more agile, efficient, and dynamic; redefine user experience with AI, making it more personalized for people in all aspects of their life, whether they’re at home, in the office, or on the go.

This spirit of innovation has led Huawei to work in close partnership with leading academic institutions in the UK to develop and refine the latest technologies. With a shared commitment to innovation and progress, both parties have worked together to achieve common goals and establish a strong partnership. The partnership between UK and Huawei help to develop the technologies of the future that will transform the way we all communicate, work and live.

For the past 30 years we have maintained an unwavering focus, rejecting shortcuts and easy opportunities that don't align with our core business. With a practical approach to everything we do, we concentrate our efforts and invest patiently to drive technological breakthroughs.

This strategic focus is a reflection of our core values:

  • Staying customer-centric,

  • Inspiring dedication,

  • Persevering,

  • Growing by reflection.

Huawei Research and Development UK Limited Overview

Huawei’s vision is a fully connected, intelligent world. To achieve this, we work to inspire passion for basic research around the world. Our combined passion drives development across the global innovation value chain. Huawei has the largest Research and Development organization in the world with 96,000+ employees in research centers around the globe. In the UK, we already have design centers in Cambridge, London, Edinburgh and Ipswich. We continue to explore and define new research directions and new services. We have expanded our collaborations with academic researchers; researched new network architectures, integration of communications and key enabling technologies; and developed the fundamental theories of these technologies. We invite you to join us on this exciting journey and drive your career forward.

Job Summary

We are looking for individuals with a strong background in competitive programming to support Huawei’s contest talent initiative.

This is a part-time role focused on helping us better understand and evaluate contest talents across global competition communities. The emphasis is on leveraging real competition experience (e.g., ICPC, IOI) to provide practical input, as well as supporting talent recommendation and attraction.

The role is suitable for experienced ICPC participants, coaches, or individuals actively involved in competitive programming communities.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Help review and interpret contest talent profiles and achievements

  • Provide input on talent strength based on competition experience and performance signals

  • Support identification, recommendation, and attraction of promising contest talents across ICPC, IOI, Codeforces, Kaggle, etc.

  • Share insights on competition trends and talent signals within the community

  • Support internal understanding of how contest talents can be evaluated

  • Help increase awareness of Huawei’s contest talent initiative within relevant communities (informal/community-level engagement)

This job description is only an outline of the tasks, responsibilities and outcomes required of the role. The jobholder will carry out any other duties as may be reasonably required by his/her line manager. The job description and personal specification may be reviewed on an ongoing basis in accordance with the changing needs of Huawei Research and Development UK Limited.

Person Specification:

Required:

  • Strong competitive programming background (ICPC participation, coaching, or equivalent experience)

  • Familiarity with competitive programming platforms (e.g., Codeforces, AtCoder, etc.)

  • Ability to assess contest talent based on real competition experience

  • Good understanding of characteristics of strong contest talents

  • Comfortable discussing technical talent in an informal and collaborative English environment

Desired:

  • ICPC coaching or mentoring experience (university or team level)

  • Experience participating in international programming competitions

  • Active engagement in competitive programming communities

Why this role:

This is an opportunity to stay closely connected to the competitive programming community while helping shape how we understand and engage contest talents.

The role may also include opportunities to engage with Huawei teams globally, including participation in selected academic and technical programs such as summer or winter camps.

As a part-time position, it offers flexible working time and location.

About LearnLux

LearnLux is the leading provider of workplace financial wellbeing, blending fiduciary digital planning with access to one-on-one guidance from Certified Financial Planner™️ professionals. Our award-winning program helps employees navigate critical financial decisions from budgeting and benefits elections to equity compensation, home buying, and retirement so they can feel confident about their money and focused at work. Advanced reporting helps our partners understand impact, driving outcomes like reduced financial stress, increased productivity, and improved retention.

We’re building LearnLux with intention. We move quickly, operate with a high bar for quality, and value people who take ownership of their work. If you’re energized by solving new problems, taking accountability, and pushing yourself to do your best work every day, you’ll find this a rewarding environment.

We’re a venture-backed company that has raised over $35M to date and is supported by experienced investors and long-term partners. We’re a growth-focused business building for scale, and we’re excited by the opportunities and challenges that come with that journey.

Leveraging the LearnLux digital experience you will work directly with employees to provide them with unbiased, holistic financial guidance. Your extensive financial experience and client-first approach will help employees prepare for and accomplish their personal and financial goals.

This role is 100% remote within the US and reports to the Director of Financial Planning.

  • Must be available to work various shifts from 8 AM - 11 PM ET Monday through Friday with a typical expectation, but not guarantee, of 5-15 hours per week
  • Meet and engage with clients remotely over video, chat and email to give guidance on topics like budgeting, student loans, retirement readiness, equity compensation, debt management and more
  • Advise on the LearnLux methodology to improve and respond to the changing financial environment
  • Participate in monthly team meetings to bring your subject matter expertise to improve the LearnLux digital experience
  • Become an expert on our client’s benefit plans so you can act as an extension of their team during open enrollment

You should bring

  • CFP® designation required
  • Passion for educating individuals to take control and invest in their financial future

  • Can demonstrate ability to take initiative and execute

jobs.description:

With 30 years of experience in technological transformation, we accelerate innovation with expertise in Agentic SDLC, Application modernization, Data & AI, Martech and Business strategy.

We are 8,000 CI&Ters across more than 25 countries, collaborating to build solutions with real impact. AI is already part of how we work, evolve, and innovate every day.

Job Description — Senior Forward Deployed Engineer, AI & Data

About the role

A Forward Deployed Engineer is a business-outcome-driven engineer who combines technical expertise, closeness to users and strong execution to turn operational challenges into working digital and AI solutions. In one sentence: you connect engineering to the real world, shortening the distance between spotting a problem and putting a solution into production.

We are looking for a senior Forward Deployed Engineer to join a global enterprise client that is scaling generative and agentic AI. You will own solutions end to end: running discovery with users and stakeholders, building the data foundation on Databricks, shipping chatbots and AI agents to production, and delivering the APIs and front-end pieces that put them in users' hands. Your depth is in AI and data; you are also comfortable delivering software across the stack, whatever the technology.

What you will do

You will run discovery sessions with the client to uncover the real problem behind each request, map users, workflows and data sources, and turn needs into clear requirements and a delivery plan.

You will ship chatbots and AI agents to production, connecting LLMs to the client's data safely with Mosaic AI Model Serving, Vector Search for RAG, the Mosaic AI Agent Framework and tool calling with Unity Catalog functions, and measuring quality in production with MLflow tracing and evaluation. You will keep the knowledge base alive, automating document ingestion, chunking and embeddings and monitoring content freshness and quality.

You will build the data foundation: ingesting, cleaning and transforming large volumes of structured and unstructured data from SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Cosmos DB, APIs, files and SharePoint into Databricks, using a medallion architecture (bronze, silver, gold) on Delta Lake.

You will deliver the software around the AI: building APIs that expose agents and datasets to other systems, and front-end features that bring them to users, working in the client's existing React and .NET applications with the support of AI coding tools.

You will protect sensitive data by applying guardrails through AI Gateway, masking or filtering personal data before it reaches a model and enforcing Unity Catalog permissions. You will make pipelines and services resilient, designing for unstable sources with retries, idempotent loads, checkpoints and alerting, so a failing endpoint never breaks the process or corrupts the data.

You will configure and integrate Azure Databricks with the client's Azure environment, including Unity Catalog on ADLS Gen2, Key Vault-backed secret scopes, Event Hubs, Data Factory, Azure SQL, Power BI and Azure Monitor.

You will ship with engineering discipline, versioning, testing and deploying notebooks, jobs, pipelines and services through Azure DevOps YAML pipelines and Databricks Asset Bundles, with checks that stop breaking changes before production. You will investigate slow jobs, optimize workloads and keep compute and model costs under control at scale.

You will turn data into decisions through analyses, Genie spaces and Power BI dashboards, and you will lead technically: owning incidents with calm, clear communication, documenting decisions, challenging assumptions respectfully and mentoring other engineers.

Must-have requirements

Fluent English, spoken and written. You run client meetings, negotiate scope and explain complex topics without friction.

8+ years in software or data engineering, with a track record of taking solutions from idea to production.

Proven client-facing experience in discovery, expectation management, presenting to stakeholders and handling disagreement.

Hands-on experience shipping generative AI solutions to production, such as RAG assistants and AI agents, preferably on Databricks: Model Serving (Foundation Model APIs and external models such as Azure OpenAI), Vector Search, Agent Framework, MLflow tracing and evaluation, and AI Gateway guardrails. A clear understanding of failure modes such as hallucination, latency, cost and data leakage.

Strong Apache Spark and Databricks experience in production: PySpark and Spark SQL, Delta Lake, medallion architecture, Unity Catalog, Workflows or Jobs, and performance tuning.

Strong Python and SQL, including relational modeling and query tuning, and experience with at least one NoSQL store (Cosmos DB, MongoDB or Redis).

Practical experience building production APIs (for example with FastAPI, .NET or Node.js) and at least some experience delivering front-end features in a modern framework, preferably React. Expert-level React or .NET is not required, but you must be able to deliver working software in the client's existing stack.

Production experience with Azure, including ADLS Gen2, Key Vault, Managed Identity, Entra ID, Data Factory, Azure Monitor and cost management.

Experience with Azure DevOps or an equivalent platform: repositories with pull request workflow, multi-stage YAML pipelines with environments and approvals, and backlog planning.

A quality mindset: automated tests for pipelines and services, data-quality expectations, code review culture and CI/CD applied throughout delivery.

Daily use of AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor or GitHub Copilot, with the discipline to review and test generated code.

Clear writing: design documents, architecture decision records and status updates.

Nice to have

Deeper experience with React and TypeScript or with .NET and C#, including micro frontends and single sign-on.

Experience with Genie and Databricks Apps, DBT, infrastructure as code (Bicep or Terraform) and streaming data with Structured Streaming and Event Hubs.

Experience with GenAI frameworks outside Databricks, such as LangGraph, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, Azure AI Foundry or MCP.

Docker, Kubernetes (AKS) and OpenTelemetry; security and privacy fundamentals such as OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, LGPD and GDPR.

Databricks certifications (Data Engineer Professional, Generative AI Engineer) or Azure data and AI certifications, and a background in consulting or customer success engineering.

Who you are

You take ownership and do not wait for perfect requirements or clean data. You care about business outcomes more than about the technology itself. You design for failure, assuming sources will break and planning for it. You stay calm under pressure and communicate more when things go wrong, not less. You are pragmatic and choose the simplest solution that solves the real problem, and you learn new stacks quickly when the problem calls for it.

jobs.excerpt: About us Your work can help save students’ lives.
jobs.description:
About us

Your work can help save students’ lives. For over 25 years, Gaggle has partnered with K-12 schools on student safety, and our team has helped save more than 8,600 student lives since 2018. Our technology flags signs of concern in students’ digital activity, our trained safety professionals review them around the clock so the right people can step in before a crisis, and our coaching and therapy services help students get support afterward. Today we serve more than 6 million students in over 1,500 districts, and protecting their data is central to that trust. Join our fully remote team, named a 2026 Top Workplace for remote work.

The opportunity

We're at a rare point in Gaggle's history. Our platform is evolving, and we're modernizing the infrastructure and engineering practices behind it, with security built in from the start and everything defined as code. Our engineering is becoming AI-first: engineers own the design and architecture, AI writes the code, and every change goes through risk-based governance, with review and controls matched to the risk of the change.

We're also rebuilding much of our IT and security foundation, including the identity systems our company runs on, and you'll lead it. Most security leaders inherit a program and spend years working around old decisions. Here, you'll define what our security, compliance and IT should look like and build it, in close partnership with a hands-on CTO.

What you'll do

  • Own the security and compliance program. Define the program, set priorities and implement it. Serve as Gaggle's Information Security Officer.
  • Mature our compliance posture. Maintain SOC 2, and lead our alignment with FedRAMP as K-12 requirements evolve. Prepare for HITRUST if our health-related products require it.
  • Rebuild our IT foundation. Modernize identity and SSO, endpoint management and security, data loss prevention, and access management as we move off legacy infrastructure.
  • Build security into how we engineer. Partner with engineering to define control requirements, review designs and make compliance evidence part of how we build and ship.
  • Build a security-aware culture. Educate and equip employees so security becomes part of how we work, not a gate.
  • Enable safe AI adoption. Set the guardrails (policy, data handling and vendor review) that let the company move fast with AI, without slowing it down.
  • Lead our Systems Support Engineering team and shape how it grows as our platform and tools evolve. The three-person team is the top tier of technical support for our customer platform, handling the hardest escalations, and also runs internal IT.
  • Lead the decommissioning of legacy infrastructure (data sanitization, access and contract exit), in close partnership with the CTO.
  • Make the case for investment. Weigh costs against risk, prioritize initiatives and recommend where we invest.

What you'll bring

  • Experience building or substantially maturing a security and compliance program.
  • Hands-on implementation. You're comfortable doing the work yourself, not only directing it.
  • AI-forward in your own work. You use AI tools every day and actively look for ways to apply them to security, compliance and IT.
  • GRC expertise: policies, controls, risk management, audits, and holding engineering accountable for controls. You've obtained and maintained a certification such as SOC 2, HITRUST or FedRAMP.
  • Real cloud security literacy (AWS preferred). You can read an architecture and spot a missing control, and you understand OWASP and why it matters. You don't need to write code.
  • Experience leading IT and identity changes, such as a company-wide MDM, EDR or DLP rollout, or an SSO migration.
  • Experience leading an operational support team, such as IT support or escalation-level technical support.
  • Strong judgment about what to fix first, and the ability to explain why.
  • A business partner's mindset. You make risk-based trade-offs that help the business grow safely, and you'd rather find a path to yes than build a wall.
  • Steady, empathetic people leadership.

Our Team Commitment

Gaggle is proud to be recognized as a 2026 Top Workplace. We are committed to equal opportunity without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, marital status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

This position is responsible for developing secure and reliable interfaces, building REST APIs, supporting enterprise data exchange, and ensuring interoperability between EAM/CMMS and critical VA financial, logistics, healthcare technology, and reporting systems.

You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, Database Administration, and Finance Operations to develop accurate reporting, investigate transaction and balance discrepancies, and optimize SQL queries supporting high-volume payment and ledger data.   • Strong SQL performance-tuning skills, including experience with execution plans, indexing, statistics, and troubleshooting slow-running queries.
  • Strong understanding of database fundamentals, data modeling, data integrity, and large transactional datasets.
  • Experience building, scheduling, and supporting production reporting processes.
  • Experience working with financial or transactional data where accuracy across amounts, balances, dates, and reporting periods is critical.
  • Experience in fintech, banking, payments, or another financial-services environment.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify the root cause of complex data discrepancies.
  • Ability to communicate technical findings clearly to nontechnical business partners.

jobs.excerpt: Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.
jobs.description:
Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.

Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.

Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.

With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.

About the Team

The Security Operations Team at Harness is a small, high-leverage organization responsible for how we detect, investigate, and respond to threats across our cloud environment and the platform we run for customers. We measure ourselves against NIST CSF 2.0 and work closely with Cloud Security, IAM, Product Security, and Platform Engineering. We design for assume-breach: layered preventive controls, strong identity as the perimeter, and fast detection and response.

The Role

We are looking for a Director to own Security Operations (SOC), Detection Engineering, and Incident Response at Harness. You will build and lead the team that monitors our environment, engineers high-quality detections, and responds to incidents, and you will be accountable for how quickly and reliably we find and contain threats.

This is a player-coach leadership role. You are expected to stay close to the technical work, set the detection and response strategy, and build the team, tooling, and metrics that make Security Operations scalable.

What You Will Do

Security Operations & Incident Response

  • Lead the SOC, including monitoring, triage, escalation, and on-call coverage, and manage any external SOC or managed detection and response (MDR) partners.
  • Own the incident response lifecycle: runbooks, tabletop exercises, executive communication for high-severity incidents, and post-incident reviews that drive lasting fixes.
  • Define and report operational metrics such as detection coverage, alert quality, mean time to detect, and mean time to respond.
  • Coordinate with Legal, Privacy, and Customer Success on incident communication and customer or regulatory notification obligations.

Detection Engineering

  • Set the detection strategy and roadmap, with detections mapped to attacker techniques (MITRE ATT&CK) and prioritized by real risk to Harness and our customers.
  • Build a detection-as-code practice with peer review, testing standards, and a managed detection backlog.
  • Ensure the right telemetry is collected across cloud, Kubernetes, identity, endpoint, SaaS, and CI/CD systems, and partner with platform teams to close gaps.
  • Validate detections through purple-team exercises and testing, and tune continuously to reduce noise.

Automation & Tooling

  • Own the SIEM, SOAR, EDR, and cloud-native logging stack, including roadmap, budget, and vendor relationships.
  • Reduce manual work through automation and AI-assisted triage and investigation, with human review where it matters.
  • Integrate threat intelligence and threat hunting into detection and response workflows.

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Hire, coach, and develop SOC analysts and detection engineers, and build a sustainable on-call culture.
  • Partner with Cloud Security and IAM to align detection coverage with infrastructure and identity controls.
  • Translate NIST CSF 2.0 goals into a prioritized roadmap with clear owners and executive-ready reporting.
  • Support customer trust by contributing to security briefings, questionnaires, and architecture reviews.
  • Present security operations posture, risk, and progress to senior leadership.

What We're Looking For

Required

  • 10+ years in security operations, incident response, detection engineering, or security engineering, with 5+ years leading technical teams.
  • Experience leading a SOC or detection and response function, including leading team leads or senior engineers.
  • Hands-on depth in detection engineering: you have written, tuned, and retired detections across SIEM, EDR, and cloud telemetry.
  • Proven experience as incident commander or senior leader on significant security incidents.
  • Strong experience with SIEM, SOAR, EDR, and cloud-native logging, and with automation using scripting (such as Python).
  • Working knowledge of cloud environments (AWS, GCP, Azure) and Kubernetes from a detection and response perspective.
  • Working knowledge of security frameworks and compliance regimes (NIST CSF, SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP or similar).
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; comfortable presenting to executives and to customer security teams.

Preferred

  • Experience at a SaaS, DevOps, or developer-tools company, especially one with customer-hosted or hybrid components.
  • Experience building detection-as-code pipelines and measuring detection quality.
  • Experience managing MDR or co-managed SOC relationships with accountability for outcomes.
  • Experience applying AI to triage, investigation, or detection engineering.
  • Experience with threat intelligence and threat hunting programs.
  • Relevant certifications (CISSP, CISM, GCIH, GCFA, GCDA, or similar) are a plus, not a requirement.
Pay transparency
$248,000—$300,000 USD

jobs.description:
About the Role

Connect is one of the premier and fastest selling products at Sutherland, providing a full omni-channel, Contact Center as a Service solution for our clients. We are looking for an experienced Sr. Product Delivery Manager to join our growing team and drive the delivery of Connect products and services through the full development lifecycle.

The Product Owner sets product vision and roadmap direction. From that point the product is yours through delivery: shaping requirements into a solution that can actually be built, making the trade-off calls that decide what ships and what defers, driving the build, running QA and UAT, and getting the product released and ready to deploy. Client deployments are run by the project management organization, and you support them as the product authority. At times this team carries the deployment directly. This is not a coordination role. You are expected to apply product judgment on scope, design, and release readiness, and to carry the professional standing that earns you the respect of engineering, operations, and clients.

Real contact center expertise is essential. You will make product and delivery decisions daily on omni-channel routing, telephony, agent desktop, recording, reporting, and integration behavior. You need to know how a contact center runs well enough to recognize when a design will not hold up against real routing, peak volume, or a failover, and to make that case to engineering. Candidates must have delivered products or capabilities on a contact center platform.

You will join a team of Product Delivery Managers reporting to the Head of Product Delivery. Delivery work is shared across the team, so you will coordinate with your peers on dependencies, shared components, release trains, and release order, and help shape the standards the team works to. The role has no direct reports and depends on working effectively across architecture, engineering, QA, project management, implementation, and operations. This is a remote position based in the United States. The team works US business hours, primarily Eastern Time and extending to Pacific Time, and that must be your normal business day. This role cannot be worked as an offset shift from another region.

Key Responsibilities

Requirements Intake & Delivery Planning

  • Take product direction and priorities from the Head of Product Delivery and shape them into a delivery plan, including where the approach has to change to hold up in a live contact center.
  • Review requirements for clarity, completeness, testability, and feasibility. Take gaps, conflicts, and ambiguities back to the Head of Product Delivery and resolve them before work starts.
  • Break requirements into epics, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria that development and QA can work from.
  • Size and phase the work with engineering, set milestones and release targets, and identify dependencies, assumptions, and risks up front.
  • Coordinate with peer Product Delivery Managers on cross-product dependencies, shared components, and release order.
  • Separate client-specific configuration from core product capability, and flag anything that would change product direction for the Head of Product Delivery.
  • Escalate scope, capacity, or timeline conflicts to the Head of Product Delivery with options and a recommendation.

Design & Build

  • Own execution for your assigned products and features: scope, schedule, quality, and dependencies.
  • Work with solution architects and engineering leads to turn approved requirements into functional and technical designs, and test those designs against real routing, agent workflow, telephony, recording, and reporting behavior.
  • Act as product owner for the scrum team: maintain the backlog, clarify requirements, clear roadblocks, and accept completed work against the acceptance criteria.
  • Maintain accurate delivery status and raise risks, issues, and blockers early with a recommended course of action.
  • Make the scope calls inside a release: decide what ships and what defers based on defect risk, client impact, and production readiness.

QA, UAT & Release

  • Set test scope, strategy, and entry and exit criteria with QA, and confirm coverage against the documented requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Run defect triage and prioritization, push fixes and retests, and track defect trends against the release date.
  • Plan and lead user acceptance testing with internal and client stakeholders and obtain UAT sign-off.
  • Own the product release plan with engineering and operations, including environment readiness, rollback, and go / no go criteria for putting the product into service.
  • Give the Head of Product Delivery a go or no go recommendation supported by test results, open defects, and known risk.
  • Support the project management organization on client deployments as the product authority, and lead the deployment directly when this team carries it.

Release & Deployment Support

  • Produce the release package the deployment teams work from: release notes, configuration and technical documentation, runbooks, and internal readiness sessions.
  • Hand the product to operations, support, and the project management organization with escalation paths, known issues, and supportability documentation.
  • Act as the product escalation point once deployments are in the field: answer design and configuration questions, and own resolution of product defects found during rollout.
  • Stay engaged through hypercare on the product side, working with operations and support until production issues and post-release fixes are closed.
  • Turn production performance, defect trends, and delivery lessons into roadmap direction and bring it back to the Head of Product Delivery, and manage delivery of enhancements, maintenance releases, and version upgrades.
  • 7+ years of hands-on contact center technology experience across voice, email, chat, SMS, social, web, video, and mobile.
  • 5+ years in product delivery, delivery management, product ownership, or technical project management for software products.
  • USA EST or CST working hours
  • Hands-on delivery or configuration experience on at least one major contact center platform: Genesys, NICE, Cisco, Avaya, Five9, Amazon Connect, or Twilio Flex.
  • Working knowledge of how contact center components fit together: ACD and routing, IVR and self-service, CTI and agent desktop, dialer and outbound, call recording, screen recording, quality management, workforce management, and reporting.
  • Experience with contact center integrations: CRM and ticketing, screen pop, APIs and webhooks, SIP and carrier connectivity, and reporting feeds.
  • Experience planning and executing production releases into live 24x7 customer-facing environments, including go-live, rollback, and go / no go decisions.
  • Working knowledge of QA practice: test strategy, defect triage and prioritization, release criteria, and UAT.
  • Experience with Agile, Scrum, or hybrid delivery, using Jira or Azure DevOps.
  • Familiarity with the regulatory environment contact centers operate in, including PCI-DSS, TCPA, GDPR, HIPAA, and call recording consent.
  • Prior experience reviewing and analyzing contact center solutions, and recommending design improvements and roadmap direction.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including reporting to leadership and translating between business and technical audiences.
  • Sound judgment under pressure: able to weigh incomplete information and make a defensible call rather than escalate every decision.
  • Strong analytical skills and the discipline to track dependencies, defects, and commitments without losing sight of the release goal.
  • Takes accountability for delivery outcomes and product quality.
  • Effective in a fast-paced hybrid Agile environment with shifting priorities.
  • Builds durable working relationships across engineering, QA, operations, and client teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Delivery experience in a BPO or outsourced contact center environment, with multi-client and multi-site deployments.

jobs.description:
Azure Data Architect

Location: India, Remote

Growth through diversity, equity, and inclusion. As an ethical business, we do what is right — including ensuring equal opportunities and fostering a safe, respectful workplace for each of us. We believe diversity fuels both personal and business growth. We're committed to building an inclusive community where all our people thrive regardless of their backgrounds, identities, or other personal characteristics.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Define and communicate the organization’s data strategy, including data quality, security, classification, lifecycle, data flow, compliance, common business vocabulary, and strategic data requirements.
  • Establish and implement data governance policies, standards, naming conventions, procedures, and frameworks to ensure data integrity, privacy, regulatory compliance, stewardship, and continuous quality improvement through profiling, cleansing, monitoring, and measurement.
  • Collaborate with business and technology stakeholders to align data initiatives with organizational goals; facilitate workshops, gather requirements, maintain data inventories, and document current and target states, business processes, data journeys, and source-to-target mappings.
  • Design scalable, secure, and high-performing conceptual, logical, and physical data models and architectures across relational and NoSQL databases, data warehouses, lakehouses, MDM, Big Data, and ML-enriched data environments.
  • Evaluate and oversee data platforms, technologies, and frameworks, including storage, integration, analytics, and reporting solutions; optimize performance and implement security, backup, disaster recovery, ETL/ELT, pipelines, and data acquisition strategies.
  • Communicate complex concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders, guide developers and data specialists, deliver knowledge-sharing and training, promote architecture best practices, and recommend emerging technologies to strengthen data capabilities.

What We're Looking For:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, with 8+ years of Data Architecture or equivalent experience, preferably in complex organizations; relevant certification is advantageous.
  • Strong expertise in data management, governance, database design, integration, and industry best practices, with experience developing frameworks that ensure data integrity and compliance.
  • Proven ability to design conceptual, logical, and physical data models using Erwin or Draw.io, applying normalization, denormalization, generalization, and performance optimization techniques.
  • Hands-on experience with Azure Data Factory, Synapse, Databricks, Databricks Catalogs, and Unity Catalog, plus relational and NoSQL databases, data warehouses, Big Data, and cloud lakehouse platforms.
  • Expertise in working with various database technologies, such as relational databases (e.g., SQL Server, MySQL) and NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB, Cassandra, DynamoDB), Dbx Catalogs
  • Experience designing ETL processes and data pipelines using integration patterns and best practices, while optimizing data storage and processing for BI, analytics, and reporting.
  • Skilled in data profiling, cleansing, harmonization, and quality assessment, with knowledge of GDPR, CCPA, encryption, access controls, and data masking for sensitive information.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to collaborate with business analysts, developers, data scientists, and stakeholders to define requirements, resolve data issues, and deliver data initiatives while staying current with emerging trends.

    • Must have skills:

  • Requirement Gathering and Analysis
  • Data Modelling and Design

We Offer:

  • Stable employment. On the market since 2008, 1500+ talents currently on board in 7 global sites.
  • “Office as an option” model. You can choose to work remotely or in the office, depending on your location.
  • Flexibility regarding working hours and your preferred form of contract.
  • Comprehensive online onboarding program with a “Buddy” from day 1.
  • Cooperation with top-tier engineers and experts.
  • Unlimited access to the Udemylearning platform from day 1.
  • Certificate training programs. Lingarians earn 500+ technology certificates yearly.
  • Upskilling support. Capability development programs, Competency Centers, knowledge sharing sessions, community webinars, 110+ training opportunities yearly.
  • Internal Gallup Certified Strengths Coach to support your growth.
  • Grow as we grow as a company. 76% of our managers are internal promotions.
  • A diverse, inclusive, and values-driven community.
  • Autonomy to choose the way you work. We trust your ideas.
  • Create our community together. Refer your friends to receive bonuses.
  • Activities to support your well-being and health.
  • Plenty of opportunities to donate to charities and support the environment.
  • Modern office equipment. Purchased for you or available to borrow, depending on your location.

jobs.title: Solutions Architect
jobs.excerpt: Join Our Dynamic Team as a Solutions Architect!  🌟 Do you enjoy building complex Microsoft Azure solutions, not just designing them?
jobs.description:
Join Our Dynamic Team as a Solutions Architect! 🌟

Do you enjoy building complex Microsoft Azure solutions, not just designing them? Do you thrive in a fast-paced, innovative environment? At Babble, we’re on a mission to be our customers’ most trusted advisor for cloud-based technologies. We’re looking for passionate and talented individuals to join our dynamic team. If so, we have the perfect opportunity for you!

Purpose of the Role

The Solutions Architect is a senior, hands-on technical delivery resource and technical authority within the Babble Professional Services team. The primary focus of the role is the personal implementation, configuration and deployment of complex customer solutions, centred on Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure and extending across Modern Workplace, Cyber Security, Networking and Backup/DR. Operating as a Level 3 Engineer, the role personally builds and deploys solutions on complex, high-risk and multi-domain projects and sets the technical standard for how solutions are built and configured across the team.

The role also owns the design phase of customer engagements, producing High-Level Designs, Low-Level Designs and Statements of Work that translate requirements into buildable, production-ready solutions. Design and deployment are treated as a single continuum: the Solutions Architect is accountable for the technical quality of the solution from design through to a working, tested and handed-over deployment, and stays hands-on throughout.

Key Responsibilities

Hands-on Technical Delivery

  • Lead hands-on implementation on complex, high-risk or multi-domain projects including Azure Virtual Desktop deployments, complex network architectures, multi-tenant security configurations, hybrid identity environments, and large-scale migration programmes.
  • Personally build, configure and deploy Microsoft Azure environments, including landing zones aligned to the Cloud Adoption Framework, management group and subscription structures, Azure Policy, RBAC and cost governance.
  • Implement Azure networking, including hub-and-spoke topologies, VNet peering, Azure Firewall, NSGs, VPN Gateway, Private Endpoints, Azure DNS and hybrid connectivity to on-premises and branch sites.
  • Deploy and configure identity and access solutions, including Microsoft Entra ID, hybrid identity (Entra Connect and Cloud Sync), Conditional Access and Privileged Identity Management.
  • Deliver Azure Virtual Desktop and Windows 365 deployments end to end, including host pools, image management, FSLogix profile storage, scaling and security baselines.
  • Plan and execute server, workload and data migrations to Azure using Azure Migrate and related tooling, including cutover, rollback planning and post-migration optimisation.
  • Implement Azure backup and disaster recovery using Azure Backup and Azure Site Recovery, including recovery testing against agreed RTO and RPO.
  • Configure security and monitoring across Azure and Microsoft 365, including Defender for Cloud, Defender XDR, Microsoft Sentinel, Azure Monitor and Log Analytics.
  • Automate deployment and configuration using PowerShell, Azure CLI and Infrastructure as Code (Bicep, ARM and/or Terraform), and build reusable deployment templates for the team.
  • Deploy and configure the wider Babble portfolio hands-on, including Microsoft 365 and Intune, Sophos Firewall and Sophos Central, Mimecast, and Acronis Cyber Protect.
  • Act as the final technical escalation point during delivery, diagnosing and resolving complex configuration, integration and environment issues directly.

Design, Assurance and Team Leadership

  • Produce High-Level Designs and Low-Level Designs for customer solutions across Modern Workplace, Cyber Security, Network and Backup/DR domains, defining the technical architecture, configuration specifications, integration requirements, and dependencies that form the basis of all Professional Services delivery.
  • Author Statements of Work that clearly define project scope, deliverables, assumptions, exclusions, acceptance criteria, and delivery milestones, ensuring commercial and technical alignment between what has been sold and what will be delivered.
  • Provide technical guidance and design assurance throughout the delivery lifecycle, reviewing implementation progress against HLD/LLD specifications, validating configuration decisions made by fellow engineers and advising on deviations from the approved design where necessary.
  • Act as a senior technical resource for the wider Professional Services team, providing guidance on design ambiguities, environment conflicts, vendor-specific technical issues, and scope boundary questions to support effective project delivery across all levels.
  • Support pre-sales technical activities including customer scoping calls, solution qualification, technical feasibility assessments, and design input for proposals, ensuring opportunities are technically sound and deliverable before commitment to Statement of Work.
  • Conduct technical design reviews with customers to validate requirements, confirm design assumptions, identify risks, and secure sign-off on the proposed solution architecture before delivery commences.
  • Define and maintain technical standards, deployment checklists, configuration baselines, and design templates used across the Professional Services team, ensuring consistency and quality across all project deliveries.
  • Validate UAT results and technical acceptance for projects where the Solutions Architect has produced the design, confirming that the delivered solution meets the specifications defined in the HLD/LLD and Statement of Work.
  • Mentor and develop Level 1 and Level 2 engineers through technical guidance, design reviews, knowledge sharing and structured feedback, actively supporting career progression and capability uplift within the Professional Services team.
  • Collaborate with the Support Desk, NOC, Product Managers, and Solution Leads to ensure solutions are designed for operational supportability, including monitoring requirements, escalation paths, documentation standards, and ongoing managed service compatibility.
  • Identify and communicate project risks, design constraints and technical dependencies to Project Managers, the Solutions Delivery Manager and customers, providing clear recommendations and mitigation options to support informed decision-making.
  • Lead post-implementation design reviews on complex projects, evaluating design effectiveness against delivery outcomes, capturing lessons learned and feeding improvements back into design standards and templates.
  • Maintain expert-level technical skills and advanced vendor certifications across the Babble solution portfolio, attending vendor technical briefings, evaluating new product capabilities, advising on the evolution of the portfolio and staying current with platform roadmaps, architectural best practices and emerging technologies across Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, Mimecast, Sophos, Acronis and networking.
  • Extensive experience of solution design and delivery across all four domains (Modern Workplace, Cyber Security, Backup/DR and Networking) and Azure.
  • Demonstrable design authorship (High-Level Designs, Low-Level Designs and Statements of Work) and pre-sales technical experience.
  • Track record of mentoring and raising the technical capability of a delivery team.

Desired Certifications

  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305), or its current Microsoft successor certification.
  • Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert (SC-100), or its current Microsoft successor certification.
  • Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert (MS-102), or its current Microsoft successor certification.
  • Sophos Certified Architect for Sophos Firewall and Sophos Central Endpoint/Server (each requires the corresponding Sophos Certified Engineer certification as a prerequisite).
  • Acronis Certified Engineer (Cyber Protect).
  • Mimecast Certified Product Professional, Advanced level (Email Security, Cloud Gateway).

Advantageous Certifications

  • PRINCE2 7th Edition Practitioner, or equivalent project management certification (for example PMP or APM PMQ).
  • ITIL 4 Foundation (or ITIL Version 5 Foundation) in IT service management.
  • CISSP (ISC2), or equivalent senior security certification; CompTIA Security+ (SY0-701) is an acceptable foundational alternative.
  • CrowdStrike Falcon certifications such as CrowdStrike Certified Falcon Administrator (CCFA) or Falcon Responder (CCFR), and familiarity with the Falcon Complete managed detection and response service.

Why work for Babble?

  • Risk cover; covering Life Cover, Critical Illness Cover, funeral benefits and some Disability benefits
  • 22 days holiday Balance PLUS UK Bank Holidays - with increased annual leave based on length of service
  • 5% allowance based on basic salary that can be towards Medical Aid.
  • UPS provided to assist with load shedding (2-4hrs power for a laptop)
  • Babble issued laptop
  • Annual Company Celebrations

Home-Working Policy

  • Your location will be home based, and you will require stable internet connection.
  • It will be your responsibility to have a solution in place to mitigate loadshedding to ensure you are able to work your normal shifts effectively, working from a public space is not deemed a acceptable solution.
  • As a home worker we expect you to have a suitable work set up, desk and a chair in a quiet space.

The recruitment journey

We want to fill this role quickly, but we want to get the right person. The recruitment process will consist of a screening call. If you proceed past this then you will have an interview over Teams and possibly a follow up interview and competency testing depending on the role requirements.

Direct Candidates Only

Babble | Leading UK Cloud Solutions Provider

Why Babble?

Babble is a Customer Experience-led growth business. As the ultimate Trusted Advisor for cloud-based technologies, we specialize in empowering businesses with the best solutions from the world's leading providers.

We are specialists in:

  • Microsoft Modern Work
  • Cybersecurity
  • Contact Centre Technology
  • Mobile Solutions
  • Communications & Connectivity

With thousands of customers, we're just scratching the surface of our potential. Many of our clients currently benefit from one or two of our technologies, presenting an incredible opportunity to introduce them to our full suite of market-leading solutions.

Join us on this exciting journey and let's achieve greatness together!

About Us | Leading UK Cloud Solutions Provider | Babble

jobs.title: Senior Staff Platform Engineer
jobs.excerpt: About Terzo Every company negotiates contracts to save money.
jobs.description:
About Terzo

Every company negotiates contracts to save money. But once those contracts are signed, very few organizations know whether they're actually paying what they negotiated.

That's where Terzo comes in.

Terzo is the Enterprise AI platform that connects contracts with real world spend, helping the world's largest organizations instantly identify cost savings, financial risk, and opportunities hiding across billions of dollars in enterprise spend.

Our platform transforms millions of contracts, invoices, purchase orders, and financial records into one intelligent system that continuously answers questions like:

  • Are we paying the prices we negotiated?
  • Where are we overspending?
  • Which suppliers should we renegotiate?
  • What savings opportunities can AI uncover today?

Instead of spending months manually searching through documents and spreadsheets, Terzo gives procurement and finance teams real time answers, and AI agents that help them take action.

Our mission is simple: Help every organization save millions.

We're building enterprise software that's as intuitive as the best consumer products while solving some of the world's largest financial challenges.

At Terzo, we move fast, think big, and obsess over customer outcomes. We hire builders who take ownership, embrace ambitious goals, and want to help define the future of AI powered financial intelligence. If you're excited about building technology that saves organizations millions of dollars and changes how the world's largest companies operate, we'd love to build it with you.

The Opportunity

The Senior/Staff Platform Engineer will own the infrastructure that every Terzo product team ships on. Our platform processes enterprise scale document collections, powers real time AI agents, and serves the Financial Intelligence Graph to Fortune 500 customers who expect production grade reliability.

You'll build and operate our cloud infrastructure on Azure, data pipeline orchestration with Ray, Service Bus, and CDC, CI/CD and deployment automation, observability, incident response, and platform security. You're the person who makes sure the rest of engineering can move fast without things breaking.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and own the core platform infrastructure that Terzo's product, data, and AI teams build on.
  • Own our Azure cloud environments and infrastructure as code with Terraform.
  • Build and operate data pipeline orchestration and distributed compute, including Ray, Service Bus, and CDC.
  • Build and scale the infrastructure behind our AI agents, orchestration, and workflow engines.
  • Own CI/CD, deployment automation, and developer tooling so engineering can ship quickly and safely.
  • Lead observability across the platform, including monitoring, alerting, logging, distributed tracing, and LLM monitoring at scale.
  • Strengthen platform security across infrastructure, data, and access for enterprise customers with sensitive financial data.
  • Set SLOs, plan capacity, lead incident response, and automate away repetitive operational work.
  • Partner with product and engineering on architecture decisions and the platform roadmap, and mentor engineers as the team grows.

What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years of experience building and operating production cloud infrastructure at scale.
  • Strong experience with infrastructure as code using Terraform and managing cloud platforms; Azure is a plus.
  • Solid understanding of container orchestration with Kubernetes and Docker and modern deployment patterns.
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and developer tooling.
  • Strong observability experience, including monitoring, alerting, logging, and tracing with tools like Datadog, Prometheus, or OpenTelemetry.
  • Strong SRE instincts: you think in terms of SLOs, capacity planning, incident response, and removing manual work through automation.
  • A strong security mindset for critical systems, including access, data protection, and threat detection; experience with enterprise compliance like SOC 2 is a plus.
  • Experience with data infrastructure, distributed compute like Ray, or streaming like Kafka or Azure Service Bus is a plus.
  • Experience with AI observability, including monitoring, tracing, and evaluating LLM and AI agent systems in production.
  • Experience at a high growth company building infrastructure from the ground up, especially where uptime and data integrity are contractual, is a plus.

Ways of Working

  • High ownership mentality with accountability for the reliability and security of the platform.
  • Clear, direct communicator who can explain technical tradeoffs to engineers, product, and leadership.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and making architecture decisions with high autonomy.
  • Works closely across engineering, product, data, and AI teams.
  • Energized by building in a fast moving environment where you test quickly, learn, and scale what works.

Why Terzo

  • Join a company building a new category in the enterprise financial AI space.
  • Own the foundation that every Terzo product and AI agent runs on.
  • Solve hard distributed systems and AI infrastructure problems at enterprise scale.
  • Work alongside engineers from top AI and technology companies.
  • Join during a strong growth stage with meaningful equity upside.

Our Core Values

  • Find the Money: Customer results define our success. Prove the value.
  • Raise the Bar. Stay Coachable: Expect excellence. Be willing to change.
  • Own the Outcome: No one is coming. It's up to us.
  • Radical Candor. Earn Trust: Be direct. Show the evidence. Share it wide.
  • Move Fast. Learn Faster: Shorten the distance from idea to impact.
  • Win as One Team: The best idea wins, and we all win when it does.

Benefits & Perks

  • Base salary range of $200,000 to $255,000, depending on experience, plus performance bonus and employee stock option plan
  • 100% premium paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for self, spouse, and family
  • 401(k) with 3% employer contribution of salary
  • Flexible work arrangements and generous PTO

Terzo is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a team that reflects a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we evaluate candidates based on qualifications, impact, and alignment with the needs of the role.

jobs.excerpt: Shape what’s next in dental technology.  Join Henry Schein One!
jobs.description:
Shape what’s next in dental technology.

Join Henry Schein One!


Join a global leader redefining dental practice management and do work that actually matters. At Henry Schein One, we are a team of care catalysts: people who fuel innovation, challenge the status quo, and bring an entrepreneurial mindset to everything we do. Your ideas fuel innovation that enhances patient care and drives real results for practices. 


We don’t just talk about impact; we build it! Backed by a trusted reputation, our leaders foster an inclusive and supportive environment where we stay solely focused on our mission, empowering you to think boldly, collaborate creatively, and grow. We have high expectations for performance and delivering results; as part of a winning team, you’ll work hard, challenge the status quo, and bring a growth mindset. Here, your strengths are recognized, your development matters, and your wins celebrated. 



We are seeking an experienced and forward-thinking Staff Software Engineer to join our engineering team and help shape the future of Dentrix Ascend. This role leads the technical design and delivery of key platform capabilities, building resilient, scalable solutions that stand up to imperfect data from external partners.

The Staff Software Engineer is a hands-on individual contributor and technical leader on a Scrum team of 5 engineers, reporting to the Engineering Manager. You will split your time roughly evenly between writing code and reviewing code and collaborating with product and engineering partners, drive incident response and postmortems, mentor fellow engineers, and embrace AI-DLC. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex problems, thinks deeply before rushing to solutions, and takes ownership of their work.

This position is remote within the United States up to 10% travel as needed.

This position is not eligible for employment-based visa sponsorship. To be considered, candidates must be authorized to work in the United States for Henry Schein One without the need for current or future employer sponsorship.

What You Will Do

Technical Design & Development

  • Lead the technical design and development of backend features and third-party integrations for the Dentrix Ascend platform, from initial design through production delivery
  • Build systems that are resilient to bad data, including fallbacks for missing information and integrations with third-party data vendors
  • Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code, following Test-Driven Development (TDD) practices and clean architecture principles
  • Apply expert-level understanding of object-oriented design, SOLID principles, refactoring, and design patterns to ensure long-term maintainability
  • Contribute to system architecture, focusing on performance, scalability, and reliability
  • Lead technical design for cross-team projects, translating business requirements into robust technical solutions

Quality, Reliability & Automation

  • Troubleshoot and debug complex technical issues, including database and SQL query performance
  • Drive incident response and postmortems
  • Serve as a quality gate for the team and contribute to test automation
  • Use AI-assisted development tools to improve team productivity and code quality
  • Deploy daily to CI/CD tiers and partner with DevOps/SRE to maintain pipelines and promote automation

Collaboration & Mentorship

  • Partner closely with Product Management, Design, Data/Analytics, Security, and DevOps/SRE to understand requirements and deliver the right solutions
  • Mentor junior engineers and raise the technical bar for the team
  • Participate in Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, stand-ups, retrospectives, and code reviews
  • Stay current with Java and related technologies, advocating for modern tools and practices

Preferred Technologies and Platforms:

  • Languages & Frameworks: Java 17, Spring Boot, and Groovy
  • Databases: Postgres and SQL Server
  • Cloud Platforms: AWS
  • Containerization: Docker and Kubernetes
  • DevOps & CI/CD: GitLab
  • Monitoring & Observability: Dynatrace
  • Architecture: Microservices and REST APIs
  • Frontend: React, Vue, and Backbone

What We Are Looking For

  • 8+ years of experience building backend software with Java and Spring Boot, including significant hands-on experience developing enterprise-level applications
  • Ability to think deeply about large-scale problems, stepping back rather than rushing to solutions
  • Database engineering skills, including competence writing SQL queries and troubleshooting and debugging data issues
  • Comfort with daily and zero down time deployments
  • Experience creating and working with microservices and modern architectural patterns
  • Experience with large language models (LLMs) or similar AI tools for generating, interpreting, and improving code
  • Understanding of domain-driven design and expert-level experience in unit, integration, and end-to-end testing
  • Experience working in an agile environment with Scrum or Kanban
  • Excellent communication skills, including working closely with Product to understand requirements
  • Comfort with ambiguity and a sense of ownership and follow-up
  • Ability to explain your technical decisions, tradeoffs, and effectively estimate engineering work within 6–12-month timelines

What Will Set You Apart

  • Bachelors or advanced degree in Computer Science or a related field
  • Experience leading technical design for cross-team projects and mentoring junior engineers
  • Domain knowledge in insurance and claims
  • Experience with systems infrastructure alerting and dashboards
  • Full-stack experience

The posted range for this position is $150,000 – $165,000 which is the expected starting salary range for an employee who is new to the role to fully proficient in the role. Many factors go into determining employee pay within the posted range including prior experience, current skills, location/labor market, internal equity, etc. This position is eligible for a bonus target not reflected in the range. #HSONW

What you get as a Henry Schein One Employee

  • A great place to work with fantastic people.

  • A career in the healthcare technology industry, with the ability to grow and realize your full potential.

  • Competitive compensation.

  • Excellent benefits package! Medical, Dental and Vision Coverage, 401K Plan with Company Match, Paid Time Off (PTO), Paid Parental Leave, Short Term Disability, Work Life Assistance Program, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Education Benefits, Worldwide Scholarship Program, Volunteer Opportunities, and more.

*Benefits may vary by location or status.

Henry Schein One is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate against applicants or employees on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, disability that can be reasonably accommodated without undue hardship, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, citizenship, marital or veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

Fraud Alert

Henry Schein has recently been made aware of multiple scams where unauthorized individuals are using Henry Schein's name and logo to solicit potential job seekers for employment.

Please be advised that Henry Schein's official U.S. website is . Any other format is not genuine. Any jobs posted by Henry Schein or its recruiters on the internet may be accessed through Henry Schein's on-line "career opportunities" portal through this official website. Applicants who wish to seek employment with Henry Schein are advised to verify the job posting through this portal.

No money transfers, payments of any kind, or credit card numbers, will EVER be requested from applicants by Henry Schein or any recruiters on its behalf, at any point in the recruitment process.

jobs.description:
We are open to supporting 100% remote work anywhere within the United States. Must be able to support Eastern Time Zone.

ICF is a rapidly growing, entrepreneurial, multi-faceted consulting company that works with government representatives and users to design, build, and modernize mission-critical federal systems. Our teams deliver secure, scalable, and high-performing solutions that directly support operational effectiveness and service delivery.

ICF is seeking a Software Engineer (Java, SQL Server). This position will be focused on maintaining and enhancing the existing Java and SQL Server-based platform; optimizing and modernizing backend services; and supporting cloud-ready architecture initiatives.

This position requires deep hands-on experience with Java-based enterprise systems and advanced SQL Server development, including complex stored procedures, performance tuning, and database optimization. Experience with React is considered a plus but is not required.

You should have experience with common development tools, techniques, and enterprise application design patterns. All team members are dynamic with experience delivering end-to-end solutions, with strong emphasis on backend and database technologies. If you have an incredible passion for innovative technology development and enjoy working with clients, ICF is the place for you.


Essential Functions:

  • Work in a full life-cycle software engineering project environment.
  • Maintain, enhance, and refactor existing Java and SQL Server applications.
  • Design and implement RESTful APIs using Spring Framework or Spring Boot.
  • Develop, analyze, optimize, and troubleshoot complex SQL Server stored procedures, queries, indexing strategies, and performance tuning efforts.
  • Support application modernization and cloud migration initiatives.
  • Bring new ideas, tools, services, and techniques to the group.
  • Use analytical thinking to make decisions based on facts and metrics whenever possible.
  • Demonstrate a desire to learn and accept new challenges within and outside of team.
  • Conduct thorough code reviews, implement unit and integration tests, and ensure code quality.
  • Stay up to date on assigned specialties, work on expanding to others.
  • Be willing to step up and lead initiatives at, or slightly above your title.
  • Follow ICF coding standards.
  • Foster asynchronous communication approaches and thrive in remote working environment.
  • Expected to own smaller efforts and components of larger projects.

What You Must Have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, management information systems, mathematics, related field or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience with a strong backend focus.
  • 5+ years of experience with Java development including development of REST APIs using Spring Framework or Spring Boot.
  • 5+ years of experience with SQL Server, including writing, debugging, optimizing, and maintaining complex stored procedures and queries.
  • 2+ years of experience with JPA, Hibernate, or equivalent ORM technologies.
  • 1+ year of experience with Agile and Scrum methodologies, including sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives.
  • Experience working with containerization with Docker.
  • Excellent communication skills both written and verbal.
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust.
  • MUST RESIDE IN THE United States (U.S.) and the work MUST BE PERFORMED in the United States (U.S.), as this work is for a federal contract and laws do apply.
  • Must be US Citizen or Permanent Resident (Greencard holder) due to federal contract requirements.

Working at ICF

ICF is a global advisory and technology services provider, but we’re not your typical consultants. We combine unmatched expertise with cutting-edge technology to help clients solve their most complex challenges, navigate change, and shape the future.

We can only solve the world's toughest challenges by building a workplace that allows everyone to thrive. We are an equal opportunity employer. Together, our employees are empowered to share their expertise and collaborate with others to achieve personal and professional goals. For more information, please read our EEO policy.


We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.


Work Authorization and Sponsorship

All candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. This position is not eligible for new H-1B visa sponsorship by ICF. Candidates who currently hold valid work authorization may be considered for a change of employer petition, subject to company policy and applicable immigration requirements.

Reasonable Accommodations

Reasonable Accommodations are available, including, but not limited to, for disabled veterans, individuals with disabilities, and individuals with sincerely held religious beliefs, in all phases of the application and employment process. To request an accommodation, please email  and we will be happy to assist. All information you provide will be kept confidential and will be used only to the extent required to provide needed reasonable accommodations. 


Read more about workplace discrimination rights or our benefit offerings which are included in the Transparency in (Benefits) Coverage Act.


Bot and Third-Party Applications

Please note that this application must be submitted directly by the applicant for consideration. Failure to do so may result in the application being excluded for consideration. Applicants needing an accommodation for disability or religious purposes in connection with the application process should contact for assistance.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

At ICF, we are committed to ensuring a fair interview process for all candidates based on their own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools to generate or assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is not permitted. This policy is in place to maintain the integrity and authenticity of the interview process. 


However, we understand that some candidates may require accommodation that involves the use of AI. If such an accommodation is needed, candidates are instructed to contact us in advance at . We are dedicated to providing the necessary support to ensure that all candidates have an equal opportunity to succeed.  


Pay Range
