jobs.description:
Voyager is an innovative space, defense, and national security technology company committed to advancing and delivering transformative, mission-critical solutions. We tackle the most complex challenges to unlock new frontiers for human progress, fortify national security, and protect critical assets to lead in the race for technological and operational superiority from ground to space.

Forge the Future: Join Voyager Technologies

The future belongs to those who build it. At Voyager Technologies, we’re building technologies that protect lives, expand frontiers and prepare us for what’s next. And we’re doing that with people who are wired to solve, build, adapt and lead. These roles are not for the faint of heart. 

You’ll help lay the foundation for humanity's future. Join a culture where innovation thrives, curiosity is rewarded, and impact is real. We’re a company of doers, thinkers and builders, united by purpose and grounded in reality.

If you want to put your skills to work where the stakes are real and the mission is bigger than any one person, forge the future with Voyager.

We are seeking a Staff Software Engineer to build the core of our agentic engineering platform: the shared services, agent orchestration, and data layer that every engineering domain plugs into. You will make it possible for domain experts to add new disciplines as plugins, for agents to call solvers and tools safely, and for every result to carry the provenance an engineering program can trust.

You will be joining an early-stage team within Voyager's Advanced Technology Group building an AI-native engineering platform. We hire curious, highly motivated domain experts who already build with AI and have the taste to know what good looks like.

If your experience aligns with our basic qualifications and you are inspired by our mission, we’d like to connect. If you don’t see the right role right now, Join Our Talent Community and stay connected as we continue to build what’s next.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and build core platform services: agent orchestration, tool and solver integration, workflow execution, the plugin framework new engineering domains build on, and manage the infrastructure that the platform runs on.
  • Own the data layer for engineering artifacts (requirements, designs, parts, simulation and test results) with provenance and traceability end to end.
  • Build evaluation, observability, and governance tooling: evals, tracing, cost controls, and guardrails on agent actions.
  • Profile and optimize the performance of the agentic system and keep it current with all of the latest developments from the frontier.
  • Create evaluation pipelines and run rigorous experiments to optimize agent performance.
  • Ship user-facing features across the full stack (Python/FastAPI back end, React front end).
  • Focus on creating a seamless, polished user experience.
  • Harden the platform for partners: security, access control, multi-tenancy, and deployment to cloud and controlled environments.
  • Pair with domain engineers and FDEs to turn their workflows into reusable platform capabilities.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or related field with 6+ years building production software, including distributed back-end systems.
  • Working proficiency with Claude Code or Codex.
  • Critical thinker and excellent communicator.
  • Strong Python and TypeScript; FastAPI or similar; React.
  • PostgreSQL and document stores (e.g., MongoDB), with data modeling for complex domain objects.
  • Has shipped LLM- or agent-based systems to production: tool calling, orchestration, evals, and observability.
  • Cloud infrastructure, containers, and CI/CD.
  • Demonstrated AI-first workflow: ships with coding agents daily and knows when not to trust the output.
  • S. citizen with ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Secret Security Clearance. TS preferred.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience building engineering software (CAD, EDA, PLM, or simulation).
  • Deployment in secure or air-gapped environments.
  • Background in an engineering discipline.

Travel, Physical and/or Government Mandated Requirements:

  • Remote (U.S.), with periodic travel to Voyager locations (Los Angeles, CA; Washington, D.C.; Seattle, WA) for lab work, hardware test events, and technical reviews.
  • Clearance Required: Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Secret Security Clearance. TS preferred.

jobs.title: Backend Software Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Newsweek is the global media organization that has earned audience time and trust for more than 90 years.
jobs.description:
Newsweek is the global media organization that has earned audience time and trust for more than 90 years. Newsweek reaches 100 million people each month with thought-provoking news, opinion, images, graphics, and video delivered across a dozen print and digital platforms. Headquartered in New York City, Newsweek also publishes international editions in EMEA and Asia.

Backend Software Engineer(PHP/WordPress & Python)

Company: Newsweek

About the Role

Newsweek is looking for a Backend Software Engineer to help develop, maintain, and enhance the technology powering our digital publishing platforms.

In this role, you will focus primarily on WordPress development, PHP backend engineering, and content management systems (CMS), building reliable, scalable solutions that support newsroom operations and content delivery across Newsweek's digital products.

You will work on custom WordPress functionality, editorial tools, content APIs, and integrations that enable our teams to create, manage, and publish content efficiently. You will also contribute to backend services built with Python and cloud technologies.

We are looking for an engineer who combines strong technical fundamentals with a modern, AI-assisted approach to software development. You should be comfortable leveraging AI tools to accelerate development, improve code quality, solve problems, and streamline engineering workflows while maintaining ownership of the solutions you deliver.

The ideal candidate has strong experience with WordPress architecture and PHP development, understands modern API-driven applications, and is comfortable working across multiple backend technologies.

What You'll Do

WordPress & CMS Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain custom WordPress functionality, including custom post types, taxonomies, metadata, plugins, and editorial workflows.
  • Build and enhance Gutenberg blocks and editor tools to improve the content creation and publishing experience.
  • Develop and maintain REST APIs that support content delivery to web applications and other digital platforms.
  • Optimize WordPress performance, scalability, security, and maintainability, following WordPress VIP best practices.
  • Collaborate with editorial, product, and engineering teams to translate publishing requirements into effective technical solutions.

Backend Services & Integrations

  • Develop, maintain, and improve backend services and APIs using PHP and Python.
  • Support asynchronous processing, background jobs, and integrations between internal and external systems.
  • Work with relational databases, caching technologies, and cloud-based services to ensure reliable application performance.
  • Integrate third-party platforms and services, including media, analytics, and content distribution tools.
  • Investigate and resolve production issues, improve system reliability, and contribute to ongoing technical improvements.

AI-Assisted Development & Engineering Productivity

  • Effectively leverage AI-powered development tools to accelerate coding, debugging, testing, documentation, and code reviews.
  • Use AI to support problem-solving, code refactoring, technical research, and implementation of new features.
  • Critically evaluate, test, and validate AI-generated code to ensure correctness, security, performance, and maintainability.
  • Identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity through AI-assisted workflows and automation.
  • Continuously explore emerging AI development capabilities and adopt practical approaches that improve software delivery without compromising engineering standards.
  • Follow company security and data privacy policies when using AI tools, ensuring sensitive information and proprietary code are handled appropriately.

Engineering & Collaboration

  • Write clean, maintainable, well-documented, and testable code.
  • Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and architectural decisions.
  • Develop automated tests and follow established CI/CD and deployment practices.
  • Collaborate with frontend engineers, product managers, and other stakeholders to deliver high-quality solutions.
  • Take ownership of assigned features and technical improvements from design through deployment.
  • Identify opportunities to improve developer workflows, application performance, and code quality.

Required Qualifications

  • Strong professional experience developing and maintaining production WordPress applications.
  • Advanced knowledge of PHP 8+, object-oriented programming, and modern PHP development practices, including Composer and dependency management.
  • Experience building custom WordPress plugins, post types, taxonomies, metadata, and REST APIs.
  • Hands-on experience developing custom Gutenberg blocks and working with the WordPress block editor.
  • Understanding of WordPress security, performance optimization, caching, and coding standards.
  • Experience designing, building, and maintaining RESTful APIs.
  • Working knowledge of Python, including experience developing backend applications, APIs, or background processing services.
  • Experience with relational databases such as MySQL or PostgreSQL.
  • Familiarity with Docker, Git, automated testing, and CI/CD workflows.
  • Ability to understand and modify React and JavaScript code, particularly in Gutenberg-based interfaces.
  • Practical experience using AI-assisted development tools, such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, or equivalent solutions, to improve development efficiency and code quality.
  • Demonstrated ability to critically review, validate, and improve AI-generated code rather than relying on it without verification.
  • Understanding of responsible AI usage in software development, including security, intellectual property, and data privacy considerations.
  • Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced development environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience developing or maintaining applications on WordPress VIP or other enterprise WordPress hosting platforms.
  • Experience with asynchronous Python frameworks such as FastAPI or Quart.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms, particularly Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Experience with Redis, distributed caching, message queues, or event-driven systems.
  • Knowledge of cloud-native applications, containerized services, and background workers.
  • Experience with search technologies such as Elasticsearch.
  • Familiarity with CDN technologies, cache invalidation, and content delivery optimization.
  • Experience integrating third-party publishing, analytics, media, or audience engagement platforms.
  • Experience with automated testing frameworks such as PHPUnit and pytest.
  • Familiarity with monitoring, logging, and application performance management tools.
  • Understanding of modern frontend development practices, including React, CSS, and SCSS.
  • Experience improving engineering processes through AI-assisted automation, testing, or development workflows.
  • Previous experience working with digital publishing, media, or content-heavy platforms.

What Success Looks Like

  • You deliver reliable, maintainable WordPress functionality that improves editorial workflows and publishing capabilities.
  • You build efficient APIs and backend services that support Newsweek's digital products.
  • You help improve application performance, stability, scalability, and security.
  • You effectively use AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity, accelerate delivery, and maintain high code quality.
  • You demonstrate sound engineering judgment, including the ability to recognize when AI-generated solutions require modification or should not be used.
  • You take ownership of your work and collaborate effectively with engineering, editorial, and product teams.
  • You contribute to a high-quality codebase through testing, documentation, code reviews, and thoughtful engineering practices.

Newsweek is an equal opportunity employer. We seek employees of diverse backgrounds and are committed to providing an inclusive, equitable and respectful workplace.

jobs.title: Principal Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Join Aya Healthcare, winner of multiple Top Workplace awards!
jobs.description:
Join Aya Healthcare, winner of multiple Top Workplace awards!

The Principal Engineer will define how AI systems are built, structured, and scaled across Aya's AI-native team. This person will set the engineering standards for AI-native system design (agents, workflows, orchestration, prompts, tools, and integration) and make them real by building alongside the squads. Principals lead the work, not the people: you own technical excellence and direction across the team, while managers own people, performance, and growth.

This person is part of our AI-native team within Aya, which is focused on disrupting the market with AI Native user experiences and AI Native delivery practices, from UX, Product Management, Lean Delivery, Architecture, Engineering, and Evaluation. The team has a startup mentality with a constant eye towards scale, security, quality, and consumer trust.

Who We Are:

We’re an $8+ billion, rapidly growing workforce solutions provider in the healthcare industry. We deliver tech-enabled services that help healthcare organizations meet and manage their contingent labor needs. We build and manage tech-enabled marketplaces for national and local healthcare talent and deliver contingent labor management solutions through our proprietary software platform.

At Aya, we’re obsessed with creating exceptional experiences for our clients, clinicians, and employees. In fact, we put employee satisfaction above all else. Our team members are responsible for incomparable customer experience and we know that happy employees are critical to maintaining happy clients. We foster an entrepreneurial, high-energy, low-bureaucracy culture and value innovative thinking and creative problem solving. We embrace diversity in thought and backgrounds unified by a commitment to high achievement. When you join Aya, you’ll be surrounded by teammates who care about you as an individual and leaders who will help you grow both personally and professionally.

Responsibilities:

  • Define the patterns Aya uses for agents, workflows, orchestration, memory, and tool use, and keep them current as the technology moves.
  • Set standards for prompts, models, tools, and system integration, and encode them in the golden path, templates, and automated checks rather than in reviews.
  • Build the hardest parts first: prove a pattern in production inside a squad, then make it reusable for every other squad.
  • Guide engineers on building reliable AI systems: fragile prompts, poor orchestration, hidden coupling, and cost and latency surprises caught before they ship.
  • Ensure consistency of implementation across domain, platform, and experience squads without becoming a gate; the pipeline enforces the standard, you raise the bar.
  • Partner with Architecture on reference architectures, service boundaries, and build versus buy versus model decisions, and own the engineering consequences.
  • Partner with Evaluation Engineering so every pattern ships with its evaluation: scenarios, thresholds, and the telemetry that proves it works.
  • Mentor engineers on AI-native practice, from pairing on a squad's problem to running design reviews and demos that others learn from.
  • Write decisions, tradeoffs, and results into the decision record; recommend the approach and own whether it holds up in production.
  • Promote secure development and appropriate handling of protected health information and personally identifiable information in every pattern you set.
  • Work from live telemetry and the work board, inside the squads, not from a queue of architecture requests.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in computer science, engineering, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of software engineering experience, including several years as a senior or principal engineer setting technical direction across multiple teams.
  • Hands-on experience building and operating AI-enabled systems in production: LLM applications, agents, orchestration, retrieval, tool use, or model APIs.
  • Deep knowledge of distributed systems, APIs, cloud platforms, CI/CD, observability, security, and operational excellence.
  • Ability to define practical standards and influence teams without relying on formal authority, and to explain decisions to engineers, product, and executives.
  • Strong written communication and the judgment to know when a pattern is ready to be the standard.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with Azure, Python, TypeScript, SQL, Databricks, vector search, RAG, agent frameworks, MCP, or model APIs.
  • Experience establishing engineering standards or a platform golden path used by many product teams.
  • Experience in healthcare or another regulated environment with sensitive data.

What We Offer:

  • Free premium medical, dental, life and vision insurance
  • Generous 401(k) match
  • Aya also offers other benefits to those that are eligible and where required by applicable law, including reimbursements and discretionary bonuses
  • Aya provides paid sick leave in accordance with all applicable state, federal, and local laws. Aya’s general sick leave policy is that employees accrue one hour of paid sick leave for every 30 hours worked. However, to the extent any provisions of the statement above conflict with any applicable paid sick leave laws, the applicable paid sick leave laws are controlling
  • Celebrations! We hit our goals and reward ourselves.
  • Company-sponsored virtual events, happy hours and team-building activities are always on the horizon — plus, you get a special treat on your birthday!
  • Unlimited DTO — we believe in time off!
  • Virtual yoga, meditation or boot camp classes offered daily

Compensation: Aya reasonably anticipates the pay scale for this position to be an annual salary of $185,000 to $195,000.

The pay scale for this position may vary if applicant possesses experience outside of what Aya reasonably anticipates for this position. Bonuses are subject to the role and your manager’s discretion.

jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets.
jobs.description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer to our Information Systems (IS) team. This role is an opportunity for an “automation-first” senior technologist with a passion for Linux to build a career with Canonical and drive the success with those leveraging Ubuntu and open source products. If you have experience of IT operations automation, Infrastructure as Code and a passion for technology, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.

Job Summary

The IS team at Canonical supports and maintains all of Canonical’s IT production services. The team is in charge of running services used by over 60 million Ubuntu users.

As an Senior SRE & Gitops engineer you’ll be in a unique position to drive operations automation to the next level, both in our own private clouds as well as in the public clouds. We do this by utilizing the best of open source infrastructure as code software, software development practices such as CI/CD pipelines, and Canonical’s leading products for software operation automation.

In addition to defining the infrastructure as code, you will improve Canonical products and the open-source technologies they’re based on by providing critical feedback to developers on how their products operate at scale. This is done by submitting bugs (and sometimes writing pull requests) and collaborating on design and implementations with other teams within the company.

You’ll be part of a global team of SREs that work together and support each other to provide the best possible services to our company, Canonical’s customers and the Ubuntu Community.

As a Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer you will

  • Drive the development of automation, Gitops in your team as an embedded tech lead
  • Closely collaborate with the IS architect to align your solutions with the IS architecture vision
  • Design and architect services that IS can offer to the organization as products
  • Apply your experience of IaC to develop infrastructure as code practice within IS by constantly increasing automation and improving IaC processes
  • Automate software operations for re-usability and consistency across private and public clouds, taking into consideration the complexities of distributed systems
  • Maintain operational responsibility for all of Canonical’s core services, networks, and infrastructure
  • Develop skills in troubleshooting, capacity planning, and performance investigation, Setting up, maintaining and using observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and Elasticsearch; design, implement and maintain monitoring and alerting for various systems and services
  • Provide assistance and work with globally distributed engineering, operations, and support peers
  • Be given uninterrupted development time to focus on larger projects and automation of manual tasks
  • Share your experience, know-how and best practices with other team members in design sessions, mentorship and ‘doing work together’

jobs.title: Senior Software Developer - Advanced DDI
jobs.excerpt: We're BlueCat—a Great Place to Work for good reason.
jobs.description:
We're BlueCat—a Great Place to Work for good reason. Our team solves critical network challenges for some of the world's largest organizations. In simple terms, we manage the systems that keep networks running smoothly, securely, and reliably—the backbone infrastructure that powers digital transformation for enterprises globally. Our Intelligent Network Operations platform delivers and enables AI-driven agentic ops at scale, automating and simplifying how companies manage, secure, and optimize their networks.

But what makes us different is how we work: we believe great work happens in an environment where you're trusted, heard, and supported. With teams globally, we're building a workplace culture that values collaboration and integrity as much as innovation. If you're looking to advance your career with a company that invests in its people, this is it.

About the role:As a Senior Software Engineer on BlueCat’s Advanced DDI team, you’ll design, build and run core services of the BlueCat Cloud Platform. This platform delivers enterprise-grade DNS, DHCP and IPAM (DDI) to customers around the world. Our services are built in Rust and Go and run on Kubernetes. You’ll own significant pieces of the system end to end, write production code every day, and help raise the quality of the team’s work, on systems where safety, reliability and performance matter most. You’ll work closely with product, security, SRE and infrastructure partners, and you’ll help shape how our team uses AI-assisted development.

We welcome engineers early in their senior career as well as those with deep experience. If you’ve been owning features and services and want to grow your scope, we’d like to hear from you.

What you'll do:

  • Design, build and maintain high-performance services in Rust and Go that tolerate real-world failure: network partitions, cascading failures, resource exhaustion and unexpected traffic.
  • Take ambiguous problems and turn them into clear designs with trade-offs, then lead them through delivery.
  • Own the reliability of your services: telemetry, alerting, guardrails and operational workflows that reduce downtime and speed recovery.
  • Partner with product, security and SRE to define requirements and keep our services secure by default.
  • Contribute to design reviews and code reviews, and mentor mid-level and junior engineers.
  • Use AI coding agents in your daily work, and contribute shared skills, prompts and practices that make them effective for the whole team.

What we're looking for:

  • Typically 5+ years of software development, including building and running production services. Experience with distributed systems is a strong plus.
  • Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Sound judgment that balances technical quality against delivery and real-world constraints.

Technical depth

  • Solid production experience in at least one of Rust or Go, and the willingness and ability to work productively in the other. You don’t need to be an expert in both. We’ll help you ramp up.
  • Rust: ownership, async and concurrency patterns.
  • Go: goroutines and channels, idiomatic design.
  • Working knowledge of networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP and HTTP/S. You can reason about latency and performance when something misbehaves.
  • Experience running services on Kubernetes and Docker containers, including image construction, debugging and security basics.

AI-assisted development

  • Hands-on experience using AI coding assistants and agents in daily engineering work, with good judgment about when to trust, verify or override their output.
  • Experience configuring or extending agents, such as writing skills, prompts or project instructions.
  • A habit of reviewing and testing AI-generated code to the same standard as any other change.

Reliability and security

  • You build for failure: sensible timeouts and retries, observability, and tests that cover the unhappy paths.
  • You think about how your code behaves in CI/CD, deployment and production, not only in development.
  • You follow secure development practices and flag risks early.

Collaboration

  • You work effectively with product, security, SRE and infrastructure.
  • You give clear, constructive code reviews and enjoy helping teammates grow.

Bonus points

  • Experience with both Rust and Go, including Tokio.
  • Python for tooling and automation.
  • Experience with agent workflows or internal developer tooling around AI.
  • Microservices, service mesh or high-availability system experience.
  • Familiarity with DNSSEC, DHCP failover, IPAM or other DDI technologies.
  • Open-source contributions in Rust or Go.
If you share our enthusiasm for the future of our company and are eager to contribute to our vibrant workplace, we look forward to receiving your application! Our comprehensive benefits encompass your health, financial well-being, and overall wellness, and we are committed to providing an exceptional work environment, enriching employee programs, and fostering a remarkable company culture. At our core, we champion values such as transparency, curiosity, respect, and above all, the pursuit of enjoyment.
In addition, we offer a range of appealing perks, including:
A Professional Development Budget
Dedicated Wellness Days and Wellness Week
A Lifestyle Spending Account
An Employee Recognition Program
Join us in shaping the future of our organization, where your talent and dedication can truly thrive. We invite you to apply and become a valuable member of our team!
BlueCat is an Equal Opportunity Employer that is committed to inclusion and diversity. We also take affirmative action to offer employment and advancement opportunities to all applicants, including minorities, women, protected veterans, and individuals with disabilities. BlueCat will not discriminate or retaliate against applicants who inquire about, disclose, or discuss their compensation or that of other applicants.
